tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 36 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'bur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'khrug rgyas/

ji ci— zhe0 rdo/—————pro rkya— snye(lke—sgyu snye she / rdo rdo / rdo ༷la4rtarderdo 7—tsho tsho—༷ke ( pre༄ rme/rdoshesherderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderngosnyi — ri dze rdo /rdo /rderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderde sgru — ṭā~Xtsho :༷rngoXtshe / khro / / rdo rdo she / — ring(sa ri ra ci ri dze — 7sna da mi rte hūṃ /rderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderde༈tsho ༷— —— sku ga rderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderde/ 4ste /sti rderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderdeju 7ḍi 'o sgo trī ca / — ji swā — do4 sna —ri rta tsho—ri tsā rdo rnye sto rta — de6— kho( — stsoñtsahochi ga sdi gyu’lte sni chi ri lngephropoḍūjirderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderdetsho ga she2( skyi rko tsā she — rna ( 7༷ snasgyu — (lnga ri gi spya /ji 2rā shā//ju tsho tshol tsho ri di 7rdo/snye dros / rdo / sdes rto cho/rta1rderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderde — co si tsho pho krakā this gi/re /tsho / ( sto she:ske(pa / trī1 'a ༅ tsāsgyu sna rngo —yu ju rī ṇi rnga rdo chi ri ri sni du sgyu tswa skyi 7 zu 4rtse ji rdo di // /bye e( ’ji rā rna / ’4 sto ( rderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderdespya snye 〉 sgyu sna rdo ji / pa ‘ tre za 4kya sgyu to 〉4pho / rngo sdu po rko ske rnga sne tsho spro sto ༈ na tshe khu lte rjo (/rngo/rdo / rdorje rdo / / sgyu 9rdo dī ‘shesnye/sdirderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderderdelternyeljasni ji/rdo rdo / rdo / / rdo / rdo / rdo snye snye rdo’rto thu chi ri tsho /

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rting zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btang/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces bshus〉zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig snrogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yan/ ——

'a 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis smo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ta cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'a zug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ zugad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu skrungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags r+ṣa gyi slob grwa wo mo —1 —

rnams su bod yig gi dpe ma sgo wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhud slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/ —2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru / gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi sa/yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal ba4/da/ da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag /ba gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhus/sa pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni spo dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bzhas mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'gyung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rdza 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/ da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu du 7 5 pa rta sne sgro 1 6 3 'di grang gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa sbo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bzhes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug ྅ hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591 )la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bzhas gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab bshus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'khyams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta puṇ+ḍa nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang spru/sar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel r+ṣa pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

zab mo gzhan stong dbu ma'i brgyud 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 1dpal rgyu 'bras dbu ma'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 6'ching ba rnam grol gyi 'grel pa bzhugs/ ༷ 10theg mchog shin tu rgyas pa'i dbu ma chen po rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 12mthar thug dbu ma chen po'i gnad bstan bcos yid bzhin nor bu lta bu snying po nges pa bzhugs/ 85gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 102gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan gyi lung sbyor zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 124gzhan stong snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 162tshul gnyis rnam par 'byed pa nges pa'i don gyi 'jug ngogs bzhugs/ 183zab don nyer gcig pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 196stong nyid kyi rab tu dbye ba khyad par du 'phags pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 209

zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ༷ 225theg pa chen po blo sbyong don bdun gyi khrid yig bzhugs/ 327lam mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 346zhib mo rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 350rnam grangs kyi mdo slob phan zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 370dge bshes dpal ldan shākya bstan 'dzin gyis dri lan gnad kyi gsal byed bzhugs/ 404stag lung zhabs drung gi gsung lan bzhugs/ 459rgyal ba'i sku gzugs kyi cha tshad bstan pa bde skyid 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 467

zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu sa zab mo gzhan stong dbu ma'i brgyud 'debs/ rgyal ba sras bcas 'a phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan ye shes lnga ldan sku gsum dngos/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi 'byung gnas te/ /'phags tshogs 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi gtso bo mchog /bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /thog med dus nas byang chub sangs rgyas kyang / /'gro ba'i don du rgyal sras tshul ston pa/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab chen por dbang bskur brnyes/ /mgon po byams pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes zhi ba'i 'od byed sa brnyes shing / /mi pham mgon po'i zhal lung bdud rtsi thob/ /'dzam gling 'di na theg chen bstan pa'i bdag /'phags pa thogs med: /gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin dang gnyis su med/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i bka' rnams thugs su chud/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyin byed gcig pur gyur/ /rgyal sras dbyig gnyen /phra zhing rtogs dka' drang srong chen po'i lam/ /bde gshegs snying po'i legs bshad seng ge'i sgra/ /ring nas nub pa slar yang gsal mdzad pa'i/ /gaṅgā mai tri'i: /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba'i dri ma gtan nas spangs/ /brtul zhugs spyod mdzad a wa dha tī pa/ /mi pham zhal gzigs phyogs kun rgyu ba'i tshul/ /dga' ba grags pa'i: /theg mchog gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ /tshangs spyod dpal gyis brgyan pa'i dge

slong ste/ /gnas lugs zab mo'i don gzigs kha che ba/ /'byung gnas zhi ba'i:bgrang yas mkhas grub byon pa'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /dpag yas lhag pa'i lha yis byin gyis brlabs/ /mtha' yas gsung rab legs mkhyen rnal 'byor mchog /bram ze sa rdzo na la: /bde mchog 'khor lo'i zhal gzigs mkhas pa'i phul/ /phyogs 'dir gzhan stong dbu ma'i sgra bsgrags shing / /dpe med grong du rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa/ /dga' lo tsā ba'i rdo rje'i zhabs la: /mi pham gzhung la mkhas pa'i phul du gyur/ /dbu ma'i lam las chos nyid zab mo gzigs/ /sdom brtson dam pa btsan rigs kha bo che/ /dri med shes rab: /dgra gnyen chags sdang spangs te gzhan yul byon/ /zab mo'i mdo dang rgyud sde du ma mkhyen/ /rgyal tshab byams pas rjes bzung la stod pa/ /dar ma brtson 'grus: /rang byung ye shes gcig car thugs la 'khrungs/ /zhal mthong kun yang lam sna zin par grags/ /snying po'i bstan pa gsal mdzad dol pa gnyan/ /ye shes 'byung gnas: /'phags mchog gnyis kyi dgongs pa gcig tu gzigs/ /theg chen mngon pa'i bstan pa gsal mdzad pa/ /byang chub skyabs dang gzhon nu byang chub ste/ /'jad ston sku mched /sdom brtson chos skyong bran du snyen la ba po/ /sde snod 'dzin pa mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /phyag rdor zhal gzigs chos rje skyo ston pa/ /smon lam tshul khrims: /'phags pa mi g.yo mgon po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bka/3 dang bstan bcos mtha' dag thugs su chud/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /bcom ldan ral gri'i: /mang thos mthar phyin dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ /nyan bshad sgo nas bstan pa nyin mor mdzad/ /che —2—

dgus zhabs la bshud pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /skyi ston 'jam pa'i dbyang rnga la:/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir nges don bstan pa'i bdag /'gran med dam pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'jig rten dbang mgon po'i rnam 'phrul jo nang pa/ /kun mkhyen chen po'i: /blo gsal 'dus pa dam pa kun gyi rgyan/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug phas kyi rgol ba 'joms/ /mkhas mchog rnams kyi bla ma kun dga' dpal/ /nya dbon chos rje'i /bla mas byin brlabs 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub/ /snying rje chen pos rgyal ba'i sras su chud/ /bde gshegs snying po'i don la nges pa 'khrungs/ /chos dpal mgon po'i /'dul mngon rgya mtsho'i pha rol son nas kyang / /phyi ma'i dus na gzhung brgya smra ba'i mchog /dam pa'i spyod ldan byang chub thugs gnyis 'byongs/ /blo gros bzang po rgya mtsho'i: /zab mo'i don la ting 'dzin brtan pa thob/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bur mngon sum gzigs/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig pa'i don yod dpal/ /byams mgon gnyis par grags la: /mdo sngags gzhung lugs nges gsang kun gzigs nas/ /log smra mtha' dag yang dag rigs pas sel/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gnas lnga rig pa'i phul/ shākya mchog ldan: /mkhas mchog gang de'i gsung gi gsang ba las/ /nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i blo gros can/ /mkhas pa'i dbang phyug 'od gsal rdo rje'i thugs/ /don yod grub pa'i: /phyogs 'dzin spangs te dam pa'i chos kyi sgo/ /mtha' dag gsan zhing thugs su chud gyur nas/ /skal bzang yid kyi re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bor: /rgyal ba dges pa'i lam las mthar thug brnyes/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor dbang bsgyur —3—

ba/ /thar 'dod 'gro ba kun gyi ded dpon mchog /kun dga' rgyal mtshanangurlabs chen ting 'dzin gzungs dang smon lam gyi/ /chu gter dbus na ye shes ri bo'i rgyal/ /gzhan phan lha dbang tshogs bcas kun gyis bsten/ /grags ldan grub pa mchog la: /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pas/ /dus mthar bshes gnyen gzugs kyis 'gro don mdzad/ /dus rnams kun tu 'gro kun thar bar 'god/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa dang / /zhi lhag ting 'dzin nyams myong gong 'phel gyis/ /gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i dri ma kun bsal nas/ /dri bral bde gshegs snying po mngon 'gyur shog /phyis brgyud pa'i bla ma gzhan 'jug na yang dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyi gong du 'jug /dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyi slo ka de rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs su bya'o/ /ye shes 'gyung gnas kyi rjes la dge bshes tho gar gnam lde 'jug pa'ang yod mod mi dgos la/ 'di la brgyud pa'i khyad par gzhan 'jad ston sku mched kyi rjes la zhang mya ngan med/ lo mchog pa/ spang lo/byang rtse/ nya dbon sogs ded kyang chog par grags la/ thogs med sku mched nye brgyud la mi dgos kyang lugs 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin pa'i phyir nges par 'jug dgos la/ rnam pa gcig tu ring brgyud la mos na sku mched kyi rjes su blo gros brtan pa/ yon tan blo gros/ gang spel/ dharma ma ti/ bha bya mi tra/rat+na mi tra/ shan+ti pa/ mai tri ba rnams brgyud pa yin pas de bzhin 'ded la/ yang gzhan stong gi lta ba'i rim pa klu sgrub nas brgyud pa ni/—4—

zab lam gzhan stong dbu ma'i brgyud 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ klu sgrub/sha wa ri/ mi tri ba man chad sngar bzhin no/ /'di ni 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thams cad kyi dgongs don gcig tu dril ba'i dmar khrid kyi brgyud pa yin la/ byams chos sde lnga so so'i khrid la brgyud pa tha dad du yod do/ /gzhan stong dbu ma'i lta khrid kyi brgyud 'debs 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /zhus dag/

zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ru budha bo dhi sa te khyuX rgya gar skad du/ shrī he tu pha la ma bya ma bi nu pra ka ra nā maX bod skad du/ dpal rgyu 'bras dbu ma'i thig le zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye 'gro'i mgon po jo nang pa/ /shes rab rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud/ /gang de'i dgongs pa dbu ma'i chos/ /gzhan gyis ma rtogs 'dir bshad bya/ /gnas lugs dbu ma 'khor 'das kun khyab yin/ /sems can rnams la gzhi yi chos su snang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la lam du snang / /gdul bya dag pa rnams la 'bras bur snang / /de gsum snang tshul yin gyi gnas tshul min/ /gnas lugs rjen pa sangs rgyas kho nas gzigs/ /lam zhugs rnams kyis phyogs re mthong ba dang / /gnas tshul 'khrul tshul 'dres mar snang ba yod/ /gnas lugs de ni zung 'jug kho na ste/ /gzhi yi gnas tshul 'bras bu'i sdod lugs yin/ /gnas lugs de ni dbu ma yin pa'i phyir/ /de la mthun par 'jug na dbu ma'i lam/ /kun rdzob don dam zung 'jug ces pa dang / /snang stong zung 'jug gsal stong zung 'jug dang / /thabs shes stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug dang / /bde stong sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug dang / /sku dang ye shes zung 'jug la sogs pa/ /de dag kun la'ang lam gyi zung 'jug dang / /gnas lugs chos —6—

nyid zung 'jug so sor dbye/ /lam rnams bden med sgyu ma lta bu yin/ /don dam dbyings kyi zung 'jug ces bya ba/ /chos sku nges pa'i don gyi sangs rgyas te/ /bde gshegs snying po de yin chos dbyings te/ /stong nyid spros bral rang bzhin sher phyin te/ /kun 'gro yin phyir kun khyab cha med de/ /dus gsum kun la khyab phyir dus med do/ /mtshan dpe la sogs sangs rgyas yon tan kun/ /rang byung gdod nas grub pa'i rtag pa ste/ /mdo las chos dbyings sangs rgyas rtag par gsungs/ /de nyid sngags las 'gyur med bde bar bstan/ /mdo las sangs rgyas chos kun ldan par gsungs/ /de nyid sngags las rnam kun mchog ldan no/ /bder bzhegs snying po rtag par 'jog pa'i gnad/ /gnas lugs 'gyur med bde ba yin par thugs/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan rang byung lhun grub pa'ang / /chos nyid rnam pa kun ldan nyid las so/ /'gyur med de nyid rnam pa thams cad par/ /gdod nas rtag tu shar ba ngo mtshar che/ /rnam kun tshul du shar yang lhan skyes kyi/ /bde chen gcig tu ro mnyam rmad du byung / /rnam pa kun ldan yin yang cha bcas min/ /rang bzhin 'gyur med gnas kyang dus kun shar/ /srid gsum rnam par shar yang spros dang bral/ /bde chen rang gis rig kyang myong tshor bral/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan shes bya kun khyab cing / /ye shes gcig dang shes bya thams cad mnyam/ /shes bya ma lus ma 'dres gsal bar mkhyen/ /mkhyen pa de la spros pa ci yang med/ /chos nyid rang bzhin chos sku yin pa'i phyir/ /chos sku'i rang bzhin yon tan ldan par grub/ /chos sku shes bya kun mkhyen ye shes phyir/ /rnam pa thams cad par yang grub pa yin/ /chos dbyings —7—

ngo bo dbye ba med par gsungs/ khres bya re re la yang chos dbyings re/ /yod pa lta bu ra gsungs pa'i skabs kyang yod/ /de gnyis sdoms pas rnam kun mchog ldan grub/ /gzugs sogs mi dmigs gzugs sogs la mi gnas/ /yod med mi dmigs yod med la mi gnas/ /de ltar gsungs pa'i kun rdzob las grol zhing / /mi rtag spros las grol bas rtag par grub/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin nam yang 'gyur med dang / /sangs rgyas rtag pa 'gro la yod gyur na/ /rtag na rtag dngos spros par 'gyur snyam pa'i/ /dogs pa bsal phyir spros bral stong par gsungs/ /stong pa zhes pas nam yang bden med dang / /ci yang ma yin tsam zhig bstan pa min/ /kun rdzob phyogs nas med dang ma yin stong / /don dam phyogs nas rtogs pa'i yul gyis stong / /don dam rang gi ngo bos stong par lta/ /gsungs pa'i dgongs pa don dem la dmigs nas/ /blo yis bzung ltar ma grub pa la dgongs/ /ye med ye min tsam gyi stong pa min/ /snying po de nyid rnam pa kun ldan yin/ /de nyid mi 'gyur rtag yin bde ba'ang yin/ /sngags kyi tshul las de ltar gsal bar bshad/ /mdo las de la dgongs nas phyogs mtsho ni gsungs/ /cha med kun khyab nam mkha' lta bu la/ /bsgribs dang ma sgrib cha gnyis mi 'thad zer/ /de ni 'dod thog yin te chos dbyings kyi/ /rang ngos nas ni bsgribs dang ma sgrib med/ /de la dmigs pa'i yul can shes pa la/ /gnas skabs du ma yod phyir dbye ba bstan/ /rtogs pa po la dbye ba yod pas na/ /rtogs bya'i yul la'ang dbyer yod lta bur bshad/ /dngos su rang blo sgrib pas bsgrib gyur kyang / /blo ngor chos nyid sgrib pas —8—

bsgribs ltar snang / /grong khyer sprin dang smugs pas bsgrib pa na/ /'gro rnams nyi ma sprin gyis bsgribs par 'dzin/ /sa la sprin te rlung gis gtor ba na/ /nyi ma'i sgrib byed sangs zhes rtog pa ltar/ /gdul bya'i blo dang bstun nas de bzhin nyid/ /dri bral gnas skabs thob par gyur zhes gsungs/ /sangs rgyas dam pa'i don du yod pa ste/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni don dam yin pa'i phyir/ /gzhan du sangs rgyas don dam min 'gyur te/ khyad gzhi med na khyad chos mi srid phyir/ /thob bya sangs rgyas gnas lugs yin nam min/ /min na 'khrul snang thob pas dgos pa ci/ /gnas lugs yin pas sangs rgyas thob 'gyur na/ /sems can dus kyi chos nyid de yin pas/ /de de'i bar du yod cing ma 'gyur rtags/ /sngon dang phyi mtha' dus gsum don la med/ /gnas skabs gsum sogs blo yis mthong tshul yin/ /dus kyis gos ma myong ba'i chos nyid gnas/ /'khrul dang 'khor ba rnam rtog dbang gis byung / /gnyen por rnam par mi rtog lam bsgom bya/ /rtog pa'i bzhon pa las kyi rlung yin pas/ /rlung rnams dbyings su dag byed thabs bsgom na/ /'bras bu don gnyis phun sum tshogs/ /de las mngon par gsal bar 'byung / /dbu ma'i don bshad dge ba 'dis/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i gnas thob shog /ces pa rgyu 'bras dbu ma'i thig le zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o/ /phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu med pa'i skye bo thams cad grub mtha' bzang po mthar thug 'di la 'jug par gyur cig /zhus dag / shubhaX/—9—

oṃ swā sti/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi ngo bo bla ma la phyag 'tshal nas 'di bshad par bya'o/ /rgya gar skad du/ zi bi mu lto pa de sha zhes bya ba/bod skad du bsgyur na/ 'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag ces pa'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes 'gyur gyi phyag go/gzhung chung 'di'i don zab cing rgya che ba yin mod kyi/ tshig don mdo tsam bshad na/ 'dir thog ma kho nar shes rab zab mo'i sgo nas/ 'ching ba rang grol gyi man ngag bstan pa ni/ kye ho gang gis 'ching bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /de nyid grol bar byeng/ pa'i lam/ /'di na 'ching ba gang yang med/ /'ching ba gang yin de grol ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa las/ kye ho zhes pa bod pa'o/ /'ching bar byed pa'i rgyu ni nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog ste/ 'khor ba pa thams cad de'i rang bzhin ma shes pas bcings pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa sems kyi rang zhal lta shes pas nyon mongs dang rnam rtog de nyid grol bar byed pa'i lam du 'gyur ro/ /'di na 'ching bya 'ching byed 'ching ba gang yang dngos gnas la grub pa med pas/med pa ltar ngo 'phrod na/ 'jig rten pa rnams 'ching bar byed pa gang yin pa des/ rnal 'byor pa grol bar 'gyur ba'o/ /tshigs rkang dang pos rgyu gzhi dus dang / gnyis pas lam dang / lhag ma gnyis kyis 'bras bu'ang bstan pa yin no/ /de nas thabs khyad par can gyi sgo nas/ 'ching ba rang grol gyi man ngag ni/—10—

'dod chags bde ba chen por dag /zhe sdang 'od gsal me lce 'bar/ /gti mug rnam par mi rtog nyid/ /dug gsum sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ /ces gsungs te/rang bzhin stong nyid ngo shes lam 'byer du ma zad/ thabs zab khyad can 'di yang yod de/ 'dod chags ched kyis ma spangs par zhu bde bsgom pa'i rkyen gyis rang bzhin bde chen mngon du 'gyur ba'o/ /zhe sdang gi gsal cha de nyid 'od gsal gsal stong du 'char ba dang / shes pa had po dang gnyid 'thug po sogs gti mug kha rgyal bar yang / mi rtog pa'i yon tan rang myos su yod pas/rnam par mi rtog pas lam du btang ngo / /'dod chags bde ba longs sku/ zhe sdang gsal ba sprul sku/ gti mug mi rtog pa chos sku rnams su gdod ma lhun grub tu gnas pa de thabs kyis lam du bsral bar bya'o/ /rgya gar gyi grub thob chen po snyi dza ga t+pa tra ā na nā'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa 'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag rdzogs so/ /zhes pa ni/ /mdzad byang lo tsā bas bcug pa'o/ /rgya gar gyi slob dpon de nyid dang lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o/ /zhes pa ni 'gyur byang ngo / /'di'i dge bas gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur bar shog cig /rgyas par khro phu ba'i 'grel par blta bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang / tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /zhus dag /maṅga laX/ /

par nges pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ theg mchog shin tu rgyas pa'i dbu ma chen po rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus rgyal ba'i sras po'i tshul/ /rgyal ba'i chos 'dzin rgyal dang mdzad pa mtshungs/ /rgyal mchog mtshungs med rgyal bas lung bstan pa/ /rgyal de 'dren mchog rgyal bar yid gnyis spangs/ /gang zhig tshul khrims shin tu rnam par dag /gang 'di shes bya'i rnam pa kun la mkhas/ /gang la byang chub sems kyi ngang tshul yod/ /gang dag de gsum ldan pa phyag gi gnas/ /gang zhig nga rgyal phrag dog rtsub sems med/ /gang zhig chos dang dam pa mi spong pa/ /gang zhig rang gi yon tan ngom mi byed/ /gang zhig de de'ang dam pa yin phyir mos/ /gang zhig dgongs pa zab mo nges par 'grel/ /gang la sngon med yang dag lta bas mdzes/ /gang 'di rtse gcig sgrub la mngon par brtson/ /gang las rmad byung ya mtshan gus pa'i gnas/ /rton pa bzhi ldan kun mkhyen jo nang pa/ /nges pa'i don du sems dpa' che yin la/ /snang ngor gong du smos pa'i chos kun ldan/ /'brel tshad don mchog sbyor ba'i phrin las can/ /gang 'di'i grub mtha' rmad byung ba/ /rgyal ba kun gyi nges gsang 'di/ /ring nas sbas pa slar spel phyir/ /de gsung rnam par bshad par bya/ /'dir ni gnas lugs 'khrul —12—

ba spangs pa yi/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i grub mtha' ma nor ba/ /skyon kun las grol dbu ma'i chos mchog ste/ /gang la 'jug pa'i yul 'di nges par bzung / /bla med byang chub sgrub la thun mong min pa'i rgyu/ /rnam par grol ba mchog dang bde ba'i rgyur 'gro ba/ /dad dang snying rje shes rab mtshungs med 'di las 'byung / /dgos pa gang gi phyir du 'jug pa de yin no/ /nges don mdo dang sa bcu'i dbang phyug dang / /drang nges (lde byed par lung bstan 'phags pa'i mchog /thogs med zhabs te mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan bcas/ /spros bral rig par lung bstan klu sgrub sogs/ /dam pa'i gsung la legs par brten/ khreng rta chen por rlom zhing grags/ /rmongs pa'am gya gyu spyod rnams kyi/ /tshig ni yid ches min pas spangs/ /gsung rab don kun legs rtogs dang / /bdud kyi lam las 'da' ba dang / /las gyi sgrib pa zad 'gyur dang / /bsod nams dpag med phul byung thob/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob 'gyur ba/ /'di la zhugs pa'i phan yon te/ /chos gzhan bskal par spyad las kyang / /'di ni yud tsam spyad pa'ang mchog /ji ltar 'jug tshul ci zhe na/ /tshad ma'i lung gi rjes 'brang zhing / /rigs pa'i yan lag tshang bas 'jug khas mi len pa'i g.yo sgyu bkag /gang la 'jug dang dgos pa gang phyir 'jug /gang la brten nas 'jug dang de la ni/ /zhugs pa'i phan yon ji ltar 'jug tshul te/ /thog mar dge ba'i ngo mtshar rnam lnga'o/ /don dam de bzhin nyid bdag dam pa'i bdag /don dam cha med kun 'gro khyab pa po/ /bdag med bde gshegs snying po bdag gi mchog /gnas lugs dbu ma chen po 'gyur ba med/ /'di don ma —13—

rtogs rmongs shing 'khrul ba las/ /gzhi dus glo bur 'khor ba'i chos rnams shar/ /de 'dra rtogs pa'i tshul ni lam zhes bya/ /rang rang dro mas dag tshe 'bras bur btags/ /dbu ma'i don gyi mdor bstan 'di yin te/ /rtogs bya gnas lugs don gyi dbu ma dang / /rtogs byed nyams myong lam gyi dbu ma'o/ /ga'i 'bras gnyis ka dang po'i khongs su 'du/ /de la re zhig srid pa'i chos rnams ni/snang grags kun rdzob rnam par shes pa'i yul/ /don dam dbyings ni ye shes spros pas dben/ /gdod nas zhi ba myang 'das chos nyid do/ /rnam shes ye shes rgyal khams so so dang / /kun rdzob don dam so sor bden tshul dang / /rang bzhin gcig kyang gcig las grol ba dang / /mtshan nyid 'gal yang tha dad pa las grol/ /ye shes 'gyur med ngo bos yod na yang / /gcig shos nam yang grub pa med pa'i phyir/ /med la gcig dang tha dad gang yang med/ /skye 'gag rtag chad 'gro 'ong yod ma yin/ /tshul 'di rtogs na theg chen mtha' dag rtogs/ /'di ma rtog pas rtag chad g.yang sar lhung / /bsod nams chen po'i don 'di go bar 'gyur/ /blo mchog rnams kyis 'di la nges pa rnyed/ /'tsho ba mtha' gnyis spangs pa dbu ma'i lam/ /spyod pa'ang blang dor ma nor dbu ma ste/ /sgom pa'i zhi lhag zung 'jug dbu ma yin/ /lta ba'i gnas skabs kun tu dbu ma sbyar/ /bdag dang byed pos stong pas yod mtha' spangs/ /rgyu 'bras mi bslu chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /sems rgyun tsam las nga bdag gzhan med phyir/ /rtag par gnas dang sngar byung chad pa med/ /kun brtags nam yang med mod 'khrul ngor snang / /kun rdzob tsam la stos pa'i dbu ma'o/ /phyi rol don spang —14—

sems ni sna tshogs snang / /rnal 'byor pa yi kun rdzob dbu ma yin/ /sems de gsal bar 'char yang rang bzhin med/ /rnam grangs tsam gyi don dam dbu mar 'dod/ /yongs grub kho na gnyis kyi chos bral ba/ /don dam dbu ma zhes byar rgyal rnams bzhed/ /rnam pa thams cad nyid kyang mi 'gyur ba/ /de ni dbu ma'i mtshan nyid mthar thug yin/ /mkhas dang grub par rlo me zhing khas len pa/ /phal cher zab don 'di la rab tu 'khrul/ /kun rdzob snang ba rten 'brel mi 'gal yang / /nges pa'i don du 'di dag gang yang med/ /de ltar ston pa'ang bden pa gnyis ka la/ /brten pa'i dbu ma yin te thun mong lags/ /'bras bu don dang sku gnyis yon to 'a/sa/ khyab dang rtag pa'i don gyi dbu ma'o/ /med par smra ba chad ltar 'gyur ba ste/ /gnyis min smra ba de dag lta ci smos/ /zhes pa dbu ma'i rang bzhin ngos bzung ba'i rab tu byed pa ste dang po'o// //rgyal bas phung khams skye mched mtha' yas gsungs/ /de 'dir snang grags chos kyi dbye ba ni/ /rdzas kyi dngos dang brtags pa'i dngos po dang / /dngos po med pa zhes bya gsum du 'gyur/ /yang na gzugs phung yid kyi skye mched dang / /chos khams zhes bya gsum gyis bsdus pa ste/ /'gyung ba'i khams dang snod kyis bsdus pa dang / /bcud kyis bsdus pas gzugs can thams cad bsdus/ /'byung ba rgyu dang yul dbang la sogs 'bras/ /mtho dman la sogs bkod pa'i khyad par yod/ /bstan yod thogs bcas thogs pa med pa ste/ /dngos brtags ma phye de gsum dbye bar 'gyur/ /yid kyi skye mched phyogs mthun bcas pa ni/ /sems yid rnam par shes pa gsum du 'dus/ /— 15—

chos khams de la'ang mtshan gzhi'i chos rnams dang / /mtshan nyid chos dang dngos med dbye bas gsum/ /de yi dang po la yang phung po gsum/ /tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum du 'dus/ /'du shes phyin ci log dang dag pa ba/ /yang dag pa yi 'du shes zhes bya'o/ /bdag tu 'du shes gsher ba chur 'du shes/ /mi rtag pa ru 'du shes byed sogs yin/ /mi sdug la sogs log pa'i 'du shes kyang / /dgos pa'i dbang gis yang dag yin par 'gyur/ /de phyir de 'dra'i dbye ba rtogs par bla/ /g.yeng ldan mnyam gzhag phra bar dbye ba'ang yin/ /lus ngag yid kyis dbye bas 'du byed de/ /re re'ang dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan/ /nyon mongs lung ma bstan par bshad rnams kyang / /bsgribs subastan pas mi dge'i phyogs su bsdu/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dug gsum du/ /nyon mongs rigs rnams thams cad 'dus par 'gyur/ /nges 'byung snying rje tshul bzhin shes pa dang / /dad dang brtson 'grus mnyam par 'jog pa dge /'du shes yang dag las ni dge ba ste/ /phyin ci log las mi dge'i 'du byed skye/ /dag pa ba las lung bstan min 'du byed/ /'on kyang 'di ni phal cher grogs kyis bsnyur/ /yul dang dus dang dngos la brtags pa yi/ /mtshan nyid kun brtags rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /mtshan nyid chos kyi skye 'gag gnas dang rgas/ /nad dang 'gyur dang che chung mtha' dbus dang / /mtho dma' (〈dze+e〉dman )rgyu 'bras dus gsum dbye ba dang / /'gro 'ong shor thob mtshan nyid mtsho ni bya dang / /mtshan gzhi ming tshig yi ge la sogs dang / /rags dang dus kyi bkod pa'i khyad par dang / /rten dang brten pa rtsa ba yan lag dang /—16—

yan lag yan lag can dang tshig don dang / /'brel ba'i khyad par du ma 'dod rnams te/ /bdag gcig pa dang de las byung ba'am/ /nor dang bdag po'am rang bzhin 'gyur ba dang / /rgyu dang 〈rdza mkhan bum pa〉 rgyu can lhan cig 'grogs pa dang / /gtso 'khor dman dang khyad 'phags gsal mi gsal/ /phan bya phan byed gnod bya gnod byed dang / /mtshon bya mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi'i 'brel ba dang / /brjod bya rjod byed yul dang yul can dang / /dpe dang gtan tshigs chos don 'brel ba dang / /byed po las dang byed pa'i 'brel ba sogs/ /mdzes dang mi mdzes bar ma la sogs dang / /mtho dman bar ma la sogs rnam grangs dang / /myong ba po dang shes po mthong po dang / /byed po sems can gang zag skyes bu dang / /lha dang dmyal ba 'gro ba'i bkod pa dang / /skang lag mig sogs lus kyi bkod pa dang / /ri dang nags tshal khang khyim snod kyi bkod/ /snang mun la sogs nyer spyod bkod pa ste/ /'di dag rags pa dpyad pas dpyad 'gyur mod/ /ldog cha tha dad pas na so sor bzhag /de bzhin lo zla zhag dang bskal pa sogs/ /snga phyi'i mtshams sbyor gzugs kyi mtshams sbyor dang / /gzugs kyi nam mkha' yid ngo'i gzugs sgra sogs/ /bkres skom bza' dang longs spyod g.yo ba yang / /gnas skabs khyad par sna tshogs mang po dang / /grangs dang phyogs dus 'gal dang dgag dang ri sgrub/ /de dag thams cad rang rang ldog steng nas/ /dngos por yod min blos brtags tsam zhig go /phyogs dus la sogs gdags gzhi nges med dang / /bum pa'i skye sogs gzhi gcig la brten dang / /rgyu 'bras la sogs du mar brten pa ste/ /'dogs pa'i gzhi las dbye na —17—

gsum du 'dus/ /nam mkha' 'gog pa gnyis dang ma skyes dang / /zhig nas med sogs dngos po gzhan gyur dang / /bum pa'i spyi sogs dngos po la brten dang / /mi srid bum med spyi sogs dngos med gsum/ /kun kyang rnam par rtog pas brtags bya ( 〈dzaX〉 cha )tsam/ /yin phyir dngos po nyid dam dngos po yi/ /'brel ba'am mi mthun phyogs la blos bzhag pas/ /dngos po gzhan 'gyur kho nar 'dus pa yin/ /de ltar nyer gcig gzhi yi chos yin te/ /byis pa rnams ni med pa'i chos la spyod/ /shes bya'i mtshan nyid rtogs phyir bshad pa yin/ /lam la'ang rdzas gzhan de ru ma 'dus med/ /dgos pa'i dbang gis rnam grangs logs su phye/ /'jig rten lam ni thun mong chos yin te/ /thun mong min pa nyan rang theg dman dang / /thes zhe snye da rgyal ba'i gnas su bgrod byed do/ /dngos med 'dus ma byas su bshad pa rnams/ /rnam grangs pa yin brtags pa ba ru brjod/ /med pa'i phyir dang blo ngor dngos po la/ /brten pa'i phyir na 'dus ma byas dngos min/ /'dus ma byas dngos chos nyid don dam ste/ /'dus ma byas pa thob par gyis shig gsungs/ /med pa la ni ci zhig 'thob par 'gyur/ /'khrul ngo'i brtags cha thob kyang dgos pa ci/ /'dus byas nyer bzhi ma byas gcig nyid de/ /srid tshad mdo tsam bsdus pa nyi shu lnga/ /mya ngan 'das chen la sogs mthar thug gi /chos mchog rdzogs ldan lugs bzhin mdor bsdus pa'o/ /so so'i dbye ba mtshan nyid du ma rnams/ /gzhung lugs kun tu grags phyir 'dir ma bkod/ /'bras bu'i chos la kun rdzob gzhan snang dang / /gsar thob cha ni lam du 'dus pa yin/ /bde gshegs snying po 'bras bu —18—

dngos yin te/ /gzhi yang dngos yin chos min chos nyid yin/ /'on kyang gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dbye ba las/ /rigs su chad pa ma yin kun khyab po/ /snang ba gzugs can sems dang sems las byung / /ldan min 'du byed de bzhin 'dus ma byas/ /gzhi lnga shes bya'i gnas zhes phal cher 'dod/ /gzugs can snang ngo tsam yin don du med/ /phyi ma sel ngo bzhi pa'ang brtags pa tsam/ /'di dag kun la grags rung thun mong ste/ /don dam 'dus ma byas pa der ma 'dus/ /rang gzhan smra po phal gyis 'di ma rtogs/ /mu stegs dngos po rtag par 'dod pa dang / /rang sde dngos med rtag pa'i tha snyad byed/ /bden pa bzhi zhes rgyal bas kun tu bstan/ /skye ba sdug bsngal bden pa'i gtso bo ste/ /sred pa kun 'byung bden pa'i gtso bor 'dod/ /lam bden gtso bo yang dag lta ba yin/ /'gog pa de bzhin nyid du shes par bya/ /ma dag snod bcud sdug bsngal bden pa ste/ /ci tsam nyer len phung po de tsam du/ /sdug bsngal nyid yin dbye ba gsum dang brgyad/ /brten pa'i snod dang nyer spyod rgyu yi snod/ /nye bar spyad bya gsum ni snod kyi chos/ khams gsum gnas gsum dag gi dbye bas phye/ /gzugs med khams kyang dman pa'i sgra ru 'thad/ /zag bcas las kun khams gsum nyon mongs kun/ /kun 'byung nyid yin sdug bsngal kyang de yin/ /lam dngos 'phags lam yin te tshogs sbyor yang / /byang phyogs pha rol phyin sogs mtshan gzhir 'dod/ /lam gyi snang ba'ang lam bden gyis bsdus shing / /'gog pa spangs pa'i khyad par tsam yin zhes/ /'di dag thun mong rags pa'i dbang du byas/ /shes sgrib ma rig bag chags dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /nyon mongs —19—

dang ni zag med las de dag /kun 'byung phra mo rnam byang lam gyis bsdus/ /yid lus dbang bsgyur skye dang bsam mi khyab/ /'chi 'pho ba dang dag pa'i 'jig rten khams/ /rnam byang lam ste sdug bsngal phra mor brjod/ /chos nyid lam gyi rnam pa don dam lam/ /gdod ma'i chos dbyings ye shes 'gog bden te/ /theg chen thun mong min pa'i gsang gtam mo/ /chos sku'i zhing khams sku dang mdzad pa dang / /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yon to rang gnas pa'i/ /'phrin las 'dod yon mchod pa'i mtshan nyid sogs/ /rnam pa thams cad gdod ma'i 'gog bden yin/ /don dam 'gog bden mngon du gyur pa la/ /'bras bu thob ces skyes bu de la grags/ /rang gi rang bzhin rgyu lam 'bras las 'das/ /don dam lam dang don dam sdug bsngal dang / /don dam kun 'byung zhes bya 'gog bden yin/ /de de sdug kun lam gyi bden pa min/ /don dam 'gog pa 'gog yin gzhan ma yin/ /gdod nas bral zad 'gog pa'am 'gog gzhir 'dod/ rje btsun ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba mi pham mgon po byams pas gsungs pa/ yang dag min rtog yang dag min/ /yang dag ma yin min mi rtog /rtog min mi rtog ma yin pa/ khres bya thams cad yin par brjod/ /ces pa shes bya'i yul thams cad spyi ldog nas gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste gnyis pa'o// //yang dag pa'i mtha' las brtsam ste tshigs bcad du rje btsun gyis gsungs pa/ rtag tu gnyis bral 'khrul ba'i rten gang yin dang gang zhig rnam kun tu/ /brjod par nus ma yin zhing spros pa med pa'i bdag nyid de kho na/ /—20—

shes bya spang byar rang bzhin dri med 'dod gang rnam par sbyang bya ste/ /de ni nam mkha' gser dang chu ltar nyon mongs pa las rnam dag 'dod/ /'gro ba dag na de las gzhan pa'ang cung zad yod min la/ /'gro ba ma lus pa yang de la kun tu rmongs pa'i blo/ /yod pa kun nas spangs te med la mngon chen gang yin pa/ /'jig rten rmongs pa'i rnam pa tshabs chen 'di ko ji lta bu/ /zhes dbyings kyi don dang / de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la/ khyad par med kyang dag gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ /'gro kun de yi snying po can/ /zhes snying po'i don dang / skye ba med cing 'chi ba med/ / gnas (〈dze+e〉gnod )med rga ba med pa ste/ /de ni rtag dang brtan phyir dang / /zhi ba'i phyir dang g.yung drung phyir/ /nyes pa glo bur dang ldan dang / /yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes rtag pa'i don dang / ji ltar rtog med bdag nyid can/ /nam mkha' kun tu rjes song ltar/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dri med dbyings/ /de bzhin kun tu 'gro ba nyid/ /de spyi'i mtshan nyid nyes pa dang / /yon tan mthar thug khyab pa ste/ /gzugs kyi rnam pa dman pa dang / /bar ma mchog la nam mkha' bzhin/ /zhen/ pa khyab pa'i don dang / lus can la yod zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /nyon mongs sbrang ma dang 'dra de 'joms pa la mkhas pa'i rgyal ba skyes bu bzhin/ /zhes pa rig pa'i don dang / gang phyir de ni chos sku de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /de ni 'phags pa'i bden pa don dam mya ngan 'das/ /de phyir nyi dang zer bzhin yon tan dbyer med pas/ /sangs rgyas nyid las ma gtogs —21—

mya ngan 'das pa med/ /'od gsal byas min dbyer med par/ /'jug can ga d+ma'i klung gi ni/ /rdul las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos rnams kun dang ldan pa nyid/ /rgya mtsho che bzhin dpag med pa'i/ /yon tan rin chen mi zad gnas/ /dbyer med yon to dang ldan pa'i/ /ngo bo nyid phyir mar me bzhin/ /chos sku rgyal ba'i ye shes dang / /thugs rje'i khams ni bsdus pa'i phyir/ /snod dang rin chen chu yis 'di/ /rgya mtsho dang ni mtshungs par bstan/ /dri med gnas la mngon shes dang / /ye shes dri med de nyid dang / /rnam dbye med phyir mar me yi/ /snang dang dro mdog chos mtshungs can/ /de rnams 'dri byed gang yin pa/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod la sogs/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong pa nyid ni gzugs su brjod/ /ces pa rnam pa thams cad pa'o/ /yod min med min de bzhin min gzhan min/ /skye dang 'gag med 'bri bar mi 'gyur zhing / /'phel ba med cing rnam par dag pa'ang med/ /rnam par dag 'gyur de ni don dam mtshan/ /zhes pa spros pa med pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rin chen nam rma/kha' chu dag bzhin/ /rtag tu rang bzhin nyon mongs med/ /ji ltar nam mkha' kun song ba/ /phra phyir nye bar gos pa med/ /de bzhin sems can thams cad la/ /gnas 'di nye bar gos pa med/ /ces pa ma 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyis stong ma yin/ /zhes pa zung du 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rdzogang/ sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na lus can —22—

kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la/ /sbun la snying po mi gtsang nang na gser/ /sa la gter dang myug sogs 'bras phyung dang / /gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni/ /bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang / /sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji lta bur/ /glo bur nyon mongs dri mas sgrib pa yi/ /sems can rnams la de bzhin khams de gnas/ /zhes pas ris sa dang khams su yang bstan to/ /slob dpon klu yis bshad pa/de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gang / /'gro ba 'di yi rang bzhin yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin med/ /'gro ba 'di yi rang bzhin med/ /de skad bshad pa'i med pa spros med de/ /gzhan du khyad gzhi med par khyad chos dpyod/ /sgyu ma lta bu la yang dpyad pas ci/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin dngos por dogs pa bcad/ /chos dbyings de ni bde gshegs snying po ste/ /rtag pa kun khyab rang rig ye shes dang / /rnam pa thams cad pa ste yongs gcod mtshan/ /spros dang bral zhing ma gos rnam bcad don/ /zung 'jug rang bzhin rigs dang don dam khams/ /de ltar de yi mtshan nyid rnam pa dgu/ /'di la don dam dbyings kyi gnas tshul dang / /rnal 'byor can la ji ltar snang tshul lo/ /'gyur na dngos po yin phyir rdzun pa ste/ /'gyur ba med pa yod phyir shin tu rtag /cha dang bcas la kun khyab mi srid cing / /cha med nye ring med pas khyab par 'thad/ khres dang shes bya'i dbye ba med phyir dang / /rgyal bas mkhyen phyir rang dang rig par grub/ /rig kyang rig bya rig byed mi dgos te/ /gsher ba la yang gsher bya gsher byed med/ /gsher ba'i ngo bo tsam zhig 'jog pa ltar/ /—23—

rang nyid rig pa tsam 'di dgag nus su/ /rgyal ba'i mkhyen dang dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ /dbyings te rgyal ba'i mkhyen par tshad mas grub/ /de phyir yon tan mtha' yas ci phyir med/ /des ni shes bya mtha' dag shes pa'i phyir/ khres bya kun gyi don dam rnam pa 'dzin/ /de phyir de la 'khor 'das rnam kun 'char/ /pha rol phyin kun mthun pa'i chos nyid pas/ /de goms pa las 'di yang mngon du 'gyur/ /nyon mongs kun gyi mi mthun chos nyid pas/ /de sbyangs dbang las 'di mngon 'gyur ba yin/ /rtog pa'i yul kun dag las 'das pa'i phyir/ /de ni spros dang brjod pa kun dang bral/ /yang dag min rtog gdod nas med pa'i phyir/ /de la gos pa mi srid de ma gos/ /mtshan nyid khegs nas mchan gzhi khegs 'gyur te/ /lus bkag na ni lus ldan khegs 'gyur la/ /lus ldan bkag na mi la rbe(gas pa khegs/ /de khegs na yang nam mkha' mi khegs bzhin/ /skye ba bkag pas skye ldan khegs 'gyu/ra mod/ /skye med gnas lugs dgag par mi nus so/ /'di yi rigs pa gzhan rnams kun la sbyar/ /rtag khyab sogs dang spros bral 'gal ba med/ /stong dang stong min zung du 'jug pa ste/ /don la zung med phyir na 'jug pa'ang med/ /rnam dbyer med la de yi rnam gzhag byas/ /kun rdzob kyis stong ye shes kyis mi stong / /rnal 'byor can gyi blo dang go bstun nas/ /de ni rigs yin de ni khams kyang yin/ /thog med dus nas brgyud de 'ongs pa dang / /chos nyid kyis thob skye mched drug gi chos/ /de 'dra ba zhes khyad chos gsum ldan par/ gsungs dang dpe dgus snying po bstan pa'i tshul/ /phal cher sgrub po'i blo ngor mthun tshul yin/ /sems can re rer —24—

snying po re re dang / /rgyun ldan tshul dang sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /sku dang thugs su 'dra mtshungs tsam gyi rigs/ /de yang lam gyis 'phel par 'gyur tshul sogs/ /rnal 'byor can la ji ltar snang tshul te/ /de la'ang skye 'phags mthong tshul so sor yod/ /de dag gnas tshul dbang du byas pa min/ /'di ni dus gsum khyab kyang dus dang bral/ /de phyir rgyun zhes bya ba 'dir mi 'dod/ /rgyun ni 'khrul ngo tsam du zad phyir med/ /ye shes ma 'khrul ngo bor yod phyir ro/ /so sor yod na 'khrul phyir de mi bden/ /dper na go sa tha dad gnas rdul bzhin/ /lam gyis 'phel ba'ang rang bzhin ma yin pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes glo bur ba nyid skyon/ /kun khyab kun gzhi yin pas chos kun gyi/ khams yin rnam kun pas na rigs kyang yin/ khams don gser khams gser rdo la khyab bzhin/ /rigs ni 'dra dang yang na gcig pa'i don/ /sangs rgyas kun tu khyab pa yin mod kyang / /cha shas re res so sor khyab min te/ /sangs rgyas rdzogs pas sems can re rer khyab/ /sems can sgrib pas bsgribs phyir de ma mthong / /nyin byed sprin gyis nam yang ma bsgrib mod/ /sa gzhi sprin gyis khebs tshe skye bo rnams/ /nyi ma sprin gyi sbubs nang gnas zhes smra/ /'gro ba'i bde gshegs snying po'ang de dang mtshungs/ /snying po med na chos nyid med par 'gyur/ /chos nyid med na chos can ga la yod/ /de med na ni mtshan nyid 'dzin pa med/ /de yang med na shes bya rig bya dang / /rtogs bya mthong ba la sogs med par 'gyur/ /med na kun rdzob ji ltar snang tsam la/ /skur mi 'debs zhes zer ba'ang bslu tshig tsam/ /snang na shes rig rtogs mthong med par 'gal/ /—25—

ma brtags snang ba tsam du chos nyid ni/ /yod kyang don dam bden par med do zer/ /snang ngor de 'dra yod na 'jig rten pa'i/ /skye bo rnams la chos nyid snang bar 'gyur/ /bden par med cing snang yang mi snang na/ /yod pa'i tha snyad tsam yang ga la 'thad/ /bden med snang na bslu chos kun rdzob ste/ /don dam de ni chos can yin par 'gyur/ /des na 'jig rten snang ngor 'di med de/ /ye shes ngor ni snang zhing bden pa yin/ /'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi yin don dam phyir/ /kun gzhi ye shes nyid du dam pas dgongs/ /kun gzhi rnam shes snying por gsungs pa yang / /sor mo'i rtse mos zla ba mtshon pa dang / /gos dmar bstan pas skyes bu mtshon dang 'dra/ /blo zhan rnams kyis 'di don mi shes gsungs/ /rang gi ngo bor don dam mya ngan 'das/ /'di la dmigs pas zhi ba thams cad thob/ /gser yod na ni de yi g.ya' bzhin du/ /'khor ba thog tha med pa'ang de las shar/ /dbyings de 'khor ba'i rgyu ni min mod kyang / /de med na ni de yang mi srid pas/ /mkha' la rlung gi dkyil 'khor rten zhes ltar/ /'khor ba'i gzhir gyur zhes pa'i rnam gzhag byas/ /glo bur mya ngan 'das pa'i dmigs pa ste/ /de'i yang gzhi dang rgyu zhes mkhas la grags/ /rten dang gzhi dang rgyu dang rigs zhes pa/ /rnal 'byor can gyi blo la 'char tshul yin/ /de der bshad pas don dam dbyings de yi/ /gnas tshul rtogs pa'i dgos pa yod phyir gsungs/ /rang bzhin rigs la sad dang ma sad med/ /de yod rgyu mtshan rgyas 'gyur skyes pa la/ /de yang sad ces rnam gzhag byas pa tsam/ /'di 'phel de yang 'phel ba'i tha snyad btags/ /thob yul med na chos kun 'bras bu —26—

med/ /yod kyang dngos med thob pas dgos pa ci/ /gsar skyes de ni zlog dang rgyun chad srid/ /yon tan rgyu yang nyung las 'bras mang na/ /phal cher rigs 'dra gsar skyes cis ma yin/ /skyon rnams yon tan gyur yang mi mnyam ste/ /sangs rgyas ye shes yon to mtha' med phyir/ /de phyir gdod ma nyid la 'bras bur gzhag /sangs rgyas mi rtag chos sku med dgag dang / /snying po gtan med yang na bden med smra/ /snying po yon tan med dang chos 'dir smod/ /de dag tshe thung nad mang mdze nad can/ /nor nyams dbang thang nyams dang srid nyams dang / /blun lkug ngan 'gror skye zhes mdo las gsungs/ /'di don smra rnams tshe ring nad med bde/ /go 'phang mi g.yo rtag pa'i sku thob nges/ /zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po chos kyi dbyings gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste gsum pa'o// //slob dpon gyis bshad pa/ bdag dang chos su nyer 'dogs pa/ /sna tshogs dag ni gang byung ba/ /de ni rnam par shes par 'gyur/ /gyur pa de yang rnam gsum ste/ /rnam par smin dang ngar sems dang / /yul la rnam par rig pa'o/ /bag chags kun 'dus gsal rig tsam zhig dang / /bdag tu snang dang sna tshogs yul snang can/ /ji ltar chu phran du ma 'dus pa la/ /chu chen zhes grags de la rlabs 'khrugs na/ /rlabs dang chu bo'i khyad par dbye bar dka'/ /kun gzhi rnam shes chu bo chen po 'dra/ /thog med nas bsags bag chags chu kun 'dus/ /da lta'i bag chags gsar 'dres sa bon dang / /sngon dus 'dres pa'i rgyun ni rnam smin yin/ /rdzas kyi rnam dbye med sde chu dang —27—

mtshungs/ /rang bzhin gsal ba yin mod yul rnams kyi/ /rnam pa mi gsal dmigs pa kun la dmigs/ /snod bcud ma lus ston pa'i mthu can te/ /mtha' yas de ni kun la mtshungs par yod/ /rnam shes bdun ni chu bo'i rlabs dang 'dra/ /gsal zhing rig pa'i rnam 'gyur de dag kyang / /rig pa'i tshul du kun gzhi dang mtshungs kyang / /sems kyi mtshan nyid de dag rnams la med/ /chu rlabs chu bo chu ru mtshungs mod kyang / /de la de yi mtshan nyid med pa bzhin/ /yang bshad pa/ de la kun gzhi rnam shes ni/ /rnam smin sa bo ni thams cad pa/ /de ni len pa dag dang gnas/ /rnam par rig pa mi rig pa/ /rtag tu reg dang yid byed dang / /rig dang 'du shes sems par ldan/ /de la tshor ba btang snyoms te/ /de ni ma bsgrib lung ma bstan/ /reg la sogs pa'ang de bzhin no/ /de ni rgyu phyo/ 'bab chu bo bzhin/ /dgra bcom nyid na de bzlog go /de la gnas te rab byung zhing / /de la dmigs pas yid ces bya/ /rnam shes ngar sems bdag nyid can/ /bsgrib la lung du ma bstan pa'i/ /nyon mongs bzhi dang rtag tu 'grogs/ /bdag tu lta dang bdag tu rmongs/ /bdag rgyal bdag tu 'du shes pa/ /gang du skyes pa de 'o gzhan/ /reg sogs kyang de dgra bcom med/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug na med/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i lam na'ang med/ /gsum pa yul rnam drug po la/ /dmigs pa gang yin de dag ste/ /mi dge dge dang gnyis min pa'o/ /kun tu 'gro dang bye brag nges/ /sems las byung ba dge ba dang / /de bzhin nyon mongs nye nyon mongs/ /tshor ba gsum dang de mtshungs ldan/ /lnga rnams rtsa ba'i rnam shes la/ /ji lta'i —28—

rkyen las byung ba ni/ /rnam shes lhan cig gam ma yin/ /chu la rlabs rnams ji bzhin no/ /yid kyi rnam shes 'byung ba ni/ /rtag tu'o 'du shes med pa dang / /snyoms par 'jug pa rnam gnyis dang / /sems med gnyid dang brgyal ma gtogs/ /rnam shes sa bon thams cad pa/ /phan tshun dag gi dbang gis na/ /de lta de ltar 'gyur bar 'gro/ /des na rnam rtog de de skye/ /las kyi bag chags 'dzin gnyis kyis/ /bag chags bcas pa snga ma yi/ /rnam par smin pa zad ༷na ( 〈rdza〉 nas )gzhan/ /rnam smin bskyed pa de yin no/ /rgyal ba'i bka' bstsal pa/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /de yod pas na 'gro kun dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'ang thob par 'gyur/ /chos kun sa bon thams cad pa'i/ /rnam par shes pa kun gzhi ste/ /de bas kun gzhi rnam shes de/ /dam pa dag la ngas bshad do/ /len pa'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra/ /sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab/ /bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung zhes/ /'di ni byis pa rnams la ngas ma bstan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni/ /rnam shes bdun dang ldan par yang / /'dzin pa gnyis kyis rab 'jug ste/ /yongs su shes pas bzlog par 'gyur/ /sems ni rang bzhin dang ba ste/ /rnyog par byed pa yid yin no/ /rnam par shes dang bcas pa'i yid/ /rtag tu bag chags 'debs par byed/ /yid kyi shes las byung ba yi/ /bag chags dri ma bzhin du ltos/ /sems ni ras yug dkar po 'dra/ /bag chags rnams kyis mi mdzes so/ /〈ma stug las/〉 ji ltar zla ba skar tshogs dang / /lhan cig mkha' la gnas pa ltar/ /rnam shes rnams dang kun —29—

gzhi yang / /de dang lhan cig lus la gnas/ /ji ltar 'o ma gyur pa na/ /yon tan zho dang dar bar gnas/ /de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyang / /rnam par gyur na gzugs ltar gnas/ /theg chen mdo las rgyas par gzhan yang bstan/ /sde pa kun la grags pa'i mdo sde ni/ /gcig las 'phros par kun gzhi'i ming gis bstan/ /rtsa ba'i rnam shes phal chen sde lung las/ /'khor ba ji srid phung po sa ston sde'i/ /rnam smin rnam shes mang bkur gos dmar pa'i/ /srid pa'i yan lag rnam shes gnas brtan sde'i/ /de sogs theg pa che chung lung mang yod/ /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang bshad pa/ de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes kyang / /brdzun yang bden pa lta bur ni/ /'gro dang 'ong bas rnam g.yo zhing / /rtag tu srid pa gsum po len/ /kun gzhi yod de bag chags gnas yod phyir/ /bag chags 'jog pa las gzhan kun gzhi med/ /de yod na ni de nyid 'grub pa ste/ /ming tsam la ni mkhas rnams rtsod pas ci/ /'on kyang gzhan la rig pas 'thad pa med/ /med la gnod byed yod la sgrub byed ston/ /sa bon gnas med chags sogs 'byung mi rigs/ /'byung na dgra bcom la yang der 'gyur ro/ /nyon yid kun gzhi med na med phyir dang / /tshogs drug mi brtan yang yang rgyun chad phyir/ /dbang po gzugs bcas gzugs med khams gnas skabs/ /mi 'dod bem por shes pa'i sa bon ni/ /'debs na ha cang thal ba nyid du 'gyur/ /mer mer po yi shes pa yid min te/ /dus gsum 'dus ma byas sogs dmigs mi nus/ /sems yid med phyir de la rkyen ma tshangs/ /brgyal dang snyoms 'jug gnyis dang gnyid 'thug la/ /shes pa yod na 'di —30—

yod grub pa ste/ /gnyid dang brgyal la shes med mngon sum 'gal/ /shes med lus bcad na yang sdig med 'gyur/ /gzhan la'ang shes pa yod de sad 'gyur phyir/ /srog kyang sems dang lus kyi sbyor 'phrod de/ /dbang shes cha shas nyi tshe las gzhan med/ /yid shes gzugs ni rten pa min phyir ro/ /sems med/ skabs las sad pa'i sems de ni/ /kun gzhi med na nyer len med par 'gyur/ /dang por 'jug pa'i dus kyi de min te/ /'gags shing dus gzhan bar du chod phyir ro/ /de ni skad cig snga phyir mi mtshungs te/ /me yis bar med bsreg par byed pa dang / /bar med thos sogs brjed par mi 'gyur bzhin/ /brgyal sogs 'byung ba'i stobs las sems 'gag na/ /'byung gzhan dbang las skye bar thal 'gyur te/ /sems kyi dngos po 'byung ba'i byed can 'gyur/ /de phyir sems med sems kyi rnam 'gyur yin/ /tshogs drug med phyir kun gzhi las gzhan min/ /'di med na ni las 'bras mi rung ste/ /las ni byas ma thag tu 'gag phyir te/ /sa bon gnas med 'bras bu ji ltar myong / /'dod pa'i sem/sa las bsam gtan mi 'byung pas/ /'di med sa bon gnas med ji ltar skye/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das lam de dang 'dra/ kha cig kun gzhi rnam shes tshangs pa'am/ /gtso bo 'dod pa rnams dang mtshungs zhes smra/ /gtso bo dbang phyug byed po sems 'di la/ /btags zhes gsungs phyir phyogs mtshungs 'dod pa'ang yin/ /kun tu mtshungs min gtso bo bem po rtag /byed po lus sems gnyis tshogs 'gro ba rtag /'di ni gsal rig mi rtag bag chags can/ /rang gi 'dod pas min phyir khyad par che/ /sa bon kun ldan phyir na 'bras bu ni/ /—31—

snang ba thams cad rtag tu 'char 'gyur lo/ /thams cad pa ni rigs la brjod pa ste/ /gzhan tu phan tshun so so'i de ldan 'gyur/ /'di 'bral la sogs khyad par rnams la ni/ /bag chags sa bon logs su yod mi dgos/ /bag chags yod kyang rkyen gyis rim pas 'char/ kha cig rkyen de'ang rtag tu gnas dgos te/ /bag chags kun dang ldan pa yin phyir lo/ /de la rkyen gzhan gnyis pa'ang gnas mod kyi/ /sa bon yod pa kho nas gsal min te/ /rang las skyes pa'i yid byed des gsal 'gyur/ /rkyen sogs rgyu ni rang las byung mod kyang / /rkyen ni rtag tu rang la gnas pa min/ /chos kun sems 'di'i mthu las snang mod kyang / /de dag 'di dang gcig pa min pa'i phyir/ /khyod kyis smras pa'i skyon 'di gnas pa min/ /don dam dpyod byed rig ngor nged kyang 'gog /rgyu rkyen tshul la khyod kyis/ lhag brjod yin/ /skya rengs dang po'i dus na'ang sa bon kun/ /yod mod yid byed skyes pas mig gzugs shar/ /de shar bas na gzhan dag sad ma nus/ /de 'og sgra la yid ni gtad pa na/ /snga ma'i nus nyams phyi ma sad par byed/ /snod nang dngos po mi 'dra du ma bcug /gcig phyung thams cad phyung bar 'gyur ba dang / /gcig tshig na ni kun kyang tshig 'gyur sogs/ khyod kyi rig pa'i rnam 'gyur 'di la ltos/ /kun gzhi yod de chags sogs 'di dag la/ /dbang yul rnam shes las gzhan shes pa'i rgyu/ /yod de de dag tshogs kyang mi skye ba/ /mthong zhing res 'ga' de las skye mthong phyir/ /nyin re lan re yid la byas pa ni/ /dus gcig lan mang byas pa'i thos pa bas/ /lhag par byang ba la sogs mthong ba'i phyir/ /bag chags rnam par smin pa grub pa yin/ /de —32—
