bgeng bzhin —nges shes lan gcig skyes pa yang / /rkyen gzhan med kyang gal te mi mthun med/ /yun ring lon na lhag par brtan pa mthong / /bag chags rnying pa gso dang gsar ba ni/ /gnyis ka yod la dus mnyam bag chags bgo /de nus skad cig gnyis pa phan chad la'o/ /zhe sdang yod dus sems kyang de'i rnam par/ /'char gyi de yi rjes thogs de ma nges/ /de de'i rnam pa gsal dus mi 'jog rnga/ra/ /nub dus sa bon 'jog pa ngo mtshar rmad/ /ngo bo bskyed pa'i rgyu 'bras snga phyi ste/ khyad par bskyed dang rten la nges pa med/ /rgyu yi 'jog mtshams rnam pa du ma'i phyir/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug gzhung dang 'di mi 'gal/ /gcig car rigs mi mthun skye yang / ston na tu gsal ba'i sems gcig gis/ /nus pa nyams par byas pa'i phyir/ /kun gzhi las gzhan 'byung ba min/ /med pa sngar nus med phyir dang / /phyis kyang nye bar mi sbyor phyir/ /rgyu rnams thams cad sngar yod yin/ /zhes pa'ang ngo bo skyed byed do/ /gal te nyon mongs can yid med gyur na'ang / /'jig ltar mtshungs ldan dge ba mi srid 'gyur/ /snyoms 'jug gnyis la'ang khyad par med 'gyur ro/ /bdag 'dzin rgyun brtan pa yang mi 'thad 'gyur/ /mdo las/ nyon mongs can yi/da rtag tu ni/ /nyon mongs lhan cig 'byung zhing 'gag /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dag las/ /ma grol mi grol grol mi 'gyur/ /'phags pas bshad pa/ yang dag don la 'jug pa yi/ /sems kyi gegs su rtag 'gyur gang / /dus rnams kun tu 'byung ba de/ /ma 'dres pa yi ma rig 'dod/ /de phyir rnam shes brgyad po yod par 'dod/ /bag chags nus pa gnas ngan len zhes pa/ /rnam grangs nyid —33—

yin de 'dra rags pa ni/ /nang dang mi gsal ba yi sa bon dang / /rgyu dang sa bon skyed byed zhes brjod de/ /mngon par brjod pa'am spros pa'i bag chags ni/ /yid rtog yul la 'phro ba'i sa bon yin/ /'jig lta'am bdag tu lta ba'i bag chags ni/ /bdag 'dzin gyis bgos bdag 'dzin nyid skyed byed/ /las sam srid pa'i yan lag bag chags ni/ /skye 'chi 'byor rgud bde sdug sa bon no/ /nyon mongs la sogs ( 〈sbra〉 sa bon ) sna tshogs des shes nus/ /bsdu na kun byang sa bon gnyis su 'dus/ /'dzin gnyis bag chags zhes pa'ang gzung 'dzin no/ /yang na rgyu mthun rnam smin bag chags gnyis/ /dge las dge ba skye sogs rgyu mthun te/ /dge las lung ma bstan sogs rnam smin no/ /lung ma bstan dang nyon yid mtshungs ldan dang / /zag med dge rnams rgyu mthun kho nar 'dod/ /phyi ma la ni dbang sgyur ma gtogs so/ /'khor ba ji srid 'jug pa'i shes pa dang / /'khor dang lam gyi gzhir 'gyur kun gzhi ste/ /ngo bo nang gi gsal rig khyab pa'i dngos/ /rgyu ni bag chags gsar rnying kun 'dus pa/ /'bras bu gnas don lus su snang ba can/ /las ni sa bon gsar rnying thams cad 'dzin/ /rnam 'gyur rnam shes bdun sogs chos kun ldan/ /dmigs pa rang dang 'bras bu kun la dmigs/ /rnam pa thams cad nus pa'i tshul du gnas/ /dbye ba rnam smin sa bon gnyis su 'dod/ /kun gzhi rnam shes bdun gyi bdag po sa /dbang pos rnam rig dbang shes rnams kyi ste/ /yid shes la ni nyon yid bdag por 'dod/ /dmigs pa'ang yul lnga chos dang kun gzhi'o/ /gtod byed de ma thag yin rigs 'dra rnams/ /'das ma thag —34—

pa'ang der 'dod 'on kyang rgyu/ /rje btsun gyis kyang / yang dag ma yin kun rtog ni/ /sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa/ /de la don mthong rnam par shes/ /de yis khyad par sems las byung / /gcig ni rkyen gyi rnam par shes/ /gnyis pa nye bar spyod pa can/ /nye bar spyod dang yongs spyod dang / /de yi 'ju ga byed sems las byung / /rang gi khams la gnyis snang zhing / /ma rig nyon mongs lhan cig tu/ /'jug pa'i rnam rtog rab 'byung ste/ /rdzas gnyis rnam par spangs pa yin/ /dmigs pa'i khyad par thob pa ni/ /rang gi dbyings la gnas ldan phyir/ /de nyid gnyis su snang med pa/ /'jug ste pags dang mda' bzhin no/ /sems ni gnyis su snang ba ste/ /de bzhin chags la sogs pa dang / /dad la sogs par snang bar 'dod/ /nyon mongs dge chos yod ma yin/ /sems ni sna tshogs snang ba dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs can du 'jug /de la snang de yod dang med/ /de phyir chos kyi ma yin no/ /rnam par rtog las las dang sdug bsngal 'byung / /las dang sdug bsngal gyis kyang bag chags bskyed/ /dge chos rnam par rtog las mi rtog 'byung / /des ni gnyis su snang ba'i sa bon 'joms/ /ma rig rnam rtog las dang sdug bsngal bzlog /yang na gnyis snang bsrabs pas ma rig bzlog /de spangs las dang sdug bsngal bya byed bral/ /'khor ba 'jug ldog tshul ni de ltar shes/ /nges 'byung mthar thug bdag med gnyis kyi sgo/ /zhes pa rnam shes tshogs brgyad sgrub pa gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bzhi pa'o// //theg pa chen por chos lnga bstan pa ni/ /sgra dang yid kyi g.yo ba'i rang —35—

bzhin gyi/ /brjod pa'i gnas kyi spyi ni rgyu mtshan te/ /de la bla dwags tshig jiming du brjod/ /sems dang sems byung chos rnams rnam rtog yin/ /de bzhimyonyid ni brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ /'phags pa'i ye shes kho na'i spyod yulalo/ /yang dag shes pa mnyam bzhag rjes thob gnyis/ /bag chags snang brnyan sna tshogs mtshan ma dang / /kun brtags gang yin rgyu mtshan zhes bya ste/ /rang bzhin dang ni gzugs brnyan rgyu mtshan no/ /rtog dang ma rtog gsal dang mi gsal las/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med rgyu mtshan gnyis su 'dod/ /de bzhin chos lnga nyid kyi dbye bas lnga/ /dngos po'i ming dang de bzhin 'brel ba'i ming / /bsdus dang tha dad grags dang ma grags te/ /ming gi dbye ba drug tu ma 'dus med/ /rnam par rtog pa'i dbye ba mtha' yas kyang / /mtshan las byung dang mtshan med rnam rtog gam/ /nyon mongs can dang nyon mongs can min nam/ /yul la 'jug dang tshol ba po dang ni/ /so sor rtog pa'i rnam rtog gsum du 'dus/ /rtog dang shes pa rdzas su yod pa ste/ /ming ni brtags yod rgyu mtshan phal cher yang / /de bzhin nyid ni don dam yod pa nyid/ /phyi ma gnyis ni don dam bden pa dang / /mthun pa'i don dam tsam du yod pa ste/ /gzhan gsum kun rdzob nyid du yod par grub/ /ming dang rgyu mtshan de nyid gzhan nyid min/ /de bzhin nyid dang chos bzhi'ang brjod du med/ /rnam rtog spyod yul mtshan nyid rgyu mtshan te/ /ming gi tha snyad gnas kyi mtshan nyid do/ /rgyu mtshan yul du byed pa rnam rtog go /phyi ma gnyis kyang yul dang yul can mtshan/ /rgyu mtshan phal dang ming ni kun brtags yin/ /rtog dang shes pa gzhan dbang —36—

mtshan nyid can/ /de bzhin nyid ni 'gyur med yongs grub bo/ /rgyu mtshan rnam gzhag bden pa bzhi char la/ /ming ni sdug bsngal bden pa kho nas bsdus/ /'gog bden ma gtogs gsum gyis rnam rtog dang / /rnam par ma gzhag bden bzhis de bzhin nyid/ /kun la dmigs pa'i lam bden yang dag shes/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis gnyis don dam gcig yin te/ /dang po gnyis ni kun rdzob tsam yin la/ /gsum pa kun rdzob bden pa nyid du bshad/ /tha ma gnyis ni don dam dngos rnam grangs/ /chos zhes bya ba don chos go byed do/ /dngos po zhes kyang bya ste mtshan gzhi 'am/ /rten gyi shes bya kun yang lnga po 'di/ /chos lnga zhes ni rab tu brtags pa yin/ /mtshan gzhi kun la mtshan nyid gsum 'jug ste/ /brjod pas brtags pa'i brtags cha kun brtags dang / /rang gi rgyu rkyen las skyes rnam rig gzhan/ /gnas lugs gdod mar grub pa yongs grub bo/ /kun tu 'dogs byed yid shes rnam rtog ste/ /gzhan ni bag chas sa yin te de'i dbang las/ /kun gzhi rnam shes rnam rig bcas par snang / /gdod ma'i don ni chos nyid kho na ste/ /'brel ba'i tshul gyis kun la dbye bar 'gyur/ /rje btsun gyis tshigs su bcad pa/ ji ltar brjod don du shes kyi/ /rgyu mtshan de yi bag chags dang/ /de las kyang don snang ba ni/ /kun tu brtags pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /ming dang don ni ji lta bar/ /don dang ming du snang ba gang / /yang dag min rtog rgyu mtshan ni/ /kun tu brtags pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rnam gsum rnam gsum snang ba can/ /'dzin dang gzung ba'i mtshan nyid de/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog ni/ /gas gyi dbang gi maphywa nyid do/ /med dang yod nyid gang yin —37—

dang / /yod dang med pa mnyam nyid dang/ /ma zhi zhi dang rnam mi rtog /yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /brtags pa dang ni gzhan dbang dang / /yongs su grub pa nyid kyang ngo / /don phyir yang dag min rtog phyir/ /gnyis po med pa'i phyir bshad do/ /ngo bo nyid gsum rtag med dang / /yod kyang kho na ma yin dang / /yod dang med de kho na ste/ /ngo bo nyid ni gsum du 'dod/ /nā ga rdzu nas kyang / phyi yi las dang bya ba rgyu/ /de ni brtags pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de bzhin g.yin dbang nang gi ste/ /rnam shes lnga po 'byung ba'o/ /brtags bya min phyir don dam ni/ /yongs su grub par 'dod pa yin/ /slob dpon gyis bshad pa/ rnam par rtog pa gang gang gis/ /dngos po gang gang rnam brtags pa/ /de ni kun tu brtags pa yi/ /ngo bo nyid de de med do/ /gas gyi dbang gi ngo bo ni/ /rnam rtog yin te rkyen las byung / /grub ni de la snga ma'o/ /rtag tu med par gyur pa gang / /kun brtags de ni rnam pa gsum yin te/ /mtshan nyid chad dang rnam grangs ltos pa'o/ /bdag dang gzung 'dzin shar nub la sogs bzhin/ /'dogs gzhi kun tu rtog pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / /'dogs byed rtog pa'i dbye bar yang 'dod do/ /ngo bo nyid dang khyad par kun brtags gnyis/ /'dogs byed dbye bas mtha' yas dbye bar 'gyur/ /sa bon gzhan dbang kun nas nyon mongs dang / /kun byang ngo bor ma grub gzhan dbang ngo / /yang na ma dag dag pa'i 'jig rten gnyis/ /lang gshegs mdo las tshogs drug dbye ba gsungs//rnam rig bcu gcig 'di yi dbye bar gyur / /'phags pas gsungs pa/ dag pa de ni rang bzhin dang / /dri ma med dang lam dang dmigs/ /rnam par dag pa —38—

chos kyi rnams/ /rnam pa bzhi pos bsdus pa yin/ /rje btsun gyis kyang/ 'gyur med phyin ci ma log pa/ /yongs su grub pa rnam pa gnyis/ /dang po gnyis ni gang la der song ba'i/ /skyes bu'i ldog chas phye yi ngo bo gcig /phyi ma gnyis ni rjes mthun yin par 'dod/ /gzhan dbang nyid na'ang de yi gnyen por 'gyur/ /mtshan nyid gsum po de nyid gzhan nyid min/ /kun brtags btags cha gzhan dbang 'dog yul nyid/ /yongs su grub pa de de'i chos nyid yin/ /chos can chos nyid tshul du gnas pa dang / /yod dang med pas gcig pa bkag pa'i phyir/ /gnyis dang yongs grub gcig dang tha dad min/ /rnam par dpyad na gzhan dbang kun brtags su/ /'dus phyir mtshan nyid gnyis su 'gyur ba yin/ /gzhan dbang gi ni snang cha kun brtags te/ /'khrul ba'i snang ba bgrang yas bsam mi khyab/ /snang gzhi'i sems kyang sa bon thams cad pa/ /de de'i chos nyid du song de yang de'o/ /kun brtags med phyir gzung 'dzin spros dang bral/ /yongs grub dgu dang stong nyid bcu drug dang / rang bzhin yongs grub rnam dag yongs grub ni/ /'gog dang lam gyi dbye bas rab tu bzhag /re zhig gzhan dbang snang cha ma bral ba/ /de srid de yin de zhig de yang zhig /shel gyi sngon po bcom pas shel zhig ltar/ /de tshe chos nyid 'ba' zhig lus par zad/ /don la snang cha las gzhan snang ba med/ /gzhan dbang la ni rang ngo'i tshugs thub bral/ /de yi rang bzhin tshul du yongs grub gnas/ /rnam pa gang yin kun brtags tshul yin no/ /mdo las kyang / gang brtags pa yi dngos po 'di/ /gzhan gyi dbang yang de nyid de/ /brtags pa sna tshogs snang ba ni/ /—39—

gzhan gyi dbang zhes rtogs par byed/ rje btsun gyis bshad pa/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis ni med dang yod pa dang / /sgro 'dogs skur ba'i rtog dang gcig dang du ma nyid/ /rang dang khyad par rtogs dang ming don ji bzhin du/ /mngon par zhen pa'i rtog pa yang dag spang bar bya/ /de bcu rnam g.yeng rnam par rtog ri/ ste/ /rtsa ba'i rnam rtog kun gzhi rnam par shes/ /mtshan ma mtshan snang gzung bya 'dzin byed rig /mtshan 'gyur phan gnod rga sogs bde sdug sogs/ /de gnyis bsdoms pas snang 'gyur rnam rtog yin/ /tshul min rnam rtog chos min thos las te/ /tshul bzhin legs gsung chos thos rjes su 'gro/ /gnyis ka'ang gzhan bstan rnam par rtog pa yin/ /mngon zhes rnam rtog lta ba'i 'thibs po'o/ /lus dang lus can rnam rig dbang po lnga/ /za po yid dang nyer spyod yul drug dang / /nyer spyod 'jug shes de nas dus dang grangs/ /grong sogs yul dang tha snyad rnam rig ni/ /mngon par brjod pa'i bag chags las byung zhing / /bdag gzhan snang ba'i rnam rig bdag lta las/ /mtho ris ngan 'gro 'chi 'pho skye ba yi/ /rnam rig srid pa'i yan lag sa bon las/ /byung phyir thams cad rnam par rig pa nyid/ /rnam rig tsam ni snang zhing myong bas grub/ /de phyir kun rdzob bden pa'i tshul la gnas/ /ji ltar dwangs pa chu mtshor nyi zla sogs/ /gzugs brnyan rnam pa du ma shar gyur na/ /de dang chu la dbye ba med mod kyi/ /chu ni yod la gzugs brnyan med snang bzhin/ /gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs kun tu brtags pa'i chos/ /rnam shes tsam ni chu dang mtshungs pa ste/ /kun rdzob bden pa nyid kyi dbang du byas/ /dam pa'i don du de dag gang yang med/ /bum par —40—

snang ba'i dus na bum pa'i cha/ /kun brtags nyid yin shes pa snang ba tsam/ /gzhan gyi dbang ste de gnyis 'khrul ba yin/ /de de'i shul gyi ye shes yongs grub bo/ /chags sdang snang cha de yi rig pa dang / /de yi ro mnyam spros bral gsum po de/ /lam nyid gzhan dbang de yi rtogs pa dang / /chos nyid dmigs pa gzhan gnyis yin par shes/ /sgra rtog snang ba'i chos sku'ang kun brtags te/ /de yi rnam pa 'dzin pa'i sems gzhan dbang / /de 'dra dngos ni yongs su grub pa ste/ /rig 'di shes bya kun la sbyar bar bya/ /'on kyang tshig la 'chel ba yis/ /thob pa thug med smra ba ltar/ /ha cang thal ba'i rnam bzhag spangs/ /de phyir mtshan gzhi kun la sbyor/ /rje btsun gyis kyang / med pa'i stong pa nyid shes shing / /de bzhin yod pa'i stong nyid dang / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid shes na/ /stong nyid shes pa zhes brjod do/ /'phags pa'i zhal snga nas dang /slob dpon gyis kyang / ji ltar snang ba de ltar med/ /de phyir med ces brjod par mdzad/ /gang phyir de lta zi snang gyur pa/ /de phyir yod ces brjod par mdzad/ /rang dang bdag nyid med pa'i phyir/ /rang gi dngos la mi gnas phyir/ /gzung ba bzhin du de med phyir/ /ngo bo nyid med nyid du bzhed/ /ngo bo nyid ni rnam gsum gyi/ /ngo bo nyid med rnam gsum la/ /brten nas chos rnams thams cad ni/ /rang bzhin med par bstan pa yin/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang rten 'brel nyid du brjod/ /de ni gnyis te bskyed bya skyed byed dang / /gzhag bya 'jog byed dbang byas rten 'byung ngo / /dang po gzhan dbang gnyis pa kun brtags yin/ /rten 'brel don ni phrad 〈pra ti pa 〉nas 'byung 〈sa yi ta ba 〉—41—

ste/ /tshogs la ltos nas bzhag gam byung zhes pa'o/ /yang na snga ma la brten phyi mar 'brel/ /'di ni bskyed pa'i bya byed kho na'i ste/ /ngo bo nyid rnams thad pa'i rten 'brel ni/ /chos kun kun gzhi rnam shes las sprul pa'o/ /sdug mi sdug rnams 'byed pa bcu gnyis te/ /nyer spyod can ni tshogs drug 'jug tshul lo/ /rnam shes 'byung dang 'chi 'pho skye ba dang / /lo tog la sogs phyi yi rab dbye dang / /'jig 'chags la sogs snod kyi rten 'brel dang / /zas bzhis 'tsho dang 'gro ba rnam gnyis su/ /las kyi 'khrid pa 'dod dang mi 'dod 'gro/ /rnam dag rab dbye lam lngas thar ba sgrub/ /mthu stobs rab dbye mngon shes la sogs te/ /brgyad po 'di yang 'brel ba can rten 'brel/ /'chi 'pho skye ba yan lag bcu gnyis yin/ /de la'ang skad cig pa dang 'brel ba can/ /gnas skabs pa'am rgyun chags gsum du 'dod/ /gnas skabs pa yang skye ba gnyis dang gsum/ /rten 'brel tshar re rdzogs tshul so so ste/ /'phen 'grub bzhi ldan rgyu 'bras tshar gcig po/ /skye ba gnyis yin gzhan dang 'di mi bsre/ /sa bon 'debs dang gso ba rtogs phyir gsungs/ /tshe gsum la rdzogs rgyu 'bras tshar gnyis so/ /'phen 'grub dbye ba med par bsres pa ste/ /rmongs pa rnam gsum bzlog phyir 'di yang gsungs/ /tshe gcig la yang rdzogs pa yod pa ste/ /go rim dkrug na yan lag rdzogs pa 'gal/ /skad cig pa ni skad cig gcig la tshang / /'brel ba can yang de 'dra'i rgyun du bzhed/ /yang na yan lag re re skad cig pa/ /rim gyis mthud par bshad kyang rung bar mngon/ /rje btsun gyis kyang gsungs pa/ bsgribs pa'i phyir dang 'debs pa'i phyir/ /khrid pa'i phyir dang —42—

kun 'dzin phyir/ /rdzogs byed phyir dang gsum gcod phyir/ /nye bar spyod phyir bsdud pa'i phyir/ /sbyor ba'i phyir dang mngon du'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal phyir ni 'gro nyon mongs/ /rnam gsum rnam gnyis kyang nyon mongs/ /rnam bdun yang dag min rtog las/ /slob dpon gyis kyang bshad pa/ gang gis 'phen dang ji ltar gang / /de sgrub byed pa'ang de la yang / /nyes dmigs gang yin de dag rnams/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rnams kyis bstan/ /yan lag gnyis kyis gcig gis dang / /rnam pa bzhi dang gnyis kyis dang / /gcig gis gcig gis gcig gis ni/ /don bdun dag tu rab tu bstan/ /bden pa ji bzhin mi shes phyir/ /las kyis sems la bgo phyir dang / /yan lag bzhi ni rim gyis 'phen/ /de yi sa bon yongs brtas phyir/ /'phangs pa bzhin du skyes pa yi/ /tshor bas bskyed pa'i sred pa las/ /len pa byung bas de yi las/ /bgos pa mngon du gyur pa yin/ khrub pa skye yin de la yang / /rgas sogs nyes dmigs gang gi phyir/ /bden pa mthong la 'phen pa med/ /sred dang bral na 'byung ba med/ /de la rgyu rkyen dbye ba mdor bsdus tsam/ khres na rten 'brel don la nges rnyed 'gyur/ /ci phyir g.yo med mi rtag mthu ldan las/ /dngos po rnams kyi skye 'gags byed phyir ro/ /byed po'i blo dang gtso sogs rtag pa dang / /dus sogs mthu med mi mthun rgyu spangs phyir/ /rgyal bas rgyu rkyen 'bras bu'i dbye ba dang / /rten 'brel rnam pa du ma rab tu gsungs/ /rten 'brel thams cad bcos ma glo bur ba/ /du ba'i rnam rig mer shes las skyes dang / /nyon mongs snang bas las kyi rnam rig bskyed/ de las skyes pa'i rnam rig 'byung —43—

ba yin/ /rdul gyi rnam rig las ni rags snang skye/ /dbang bo'i rnam rig gzugs kyi rnam rig dang / /yid kyi g.yo las rnam shes 'char ba sogs/ /skye ba'i rnam rig de las skyes rnam rig /gnas pa'i rnam rig de las 'gag rnam rig /de las 'gags zin par snang rnam rig ste/ /dus gsum rnam par snang yang bden dngos med/ /bag chags gcig gsos de las snang ba 'byung / /snang ba des kyang bag chags gcig shos gso/ sa bon gso dang rnam rig rnam pa gnyis/ /phan tshun gcig gis gcig la phan 'dogs te/ /gso dang rnam rig rgyun dang rgyun du 'gyung / /'di dag kun rdzob gnas thabs mthar thug yin/ /rnam rig de yang rmi lam shes pa bzhin/ /gdod nas yod ma myong yang snang mi 'gag /rmi lam me las tshig par snang ba bzhin/ /yod med rtag chad kun las 'das pa yin/ /de ni don dam pa la 'jug tshul gyi/ /kun rdzob bden pa'i rim pa gcig tu 'dod/ /don dam la ni rten 'brel nam yang med/ /de la rgyu 'bras dang ni rnam gzhag bral/ /rten 'brel yin phyir bdag med rnam rig phyir/ /chos bdag med la rab tu 'jug pa yin/ /phung po'i rgyun dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes la/ /bdag dang sems can chos su 'khrul ba skyes/ /rten 'brel de dag kun rdzob rten 'brel te/ /de de'i rnam rig bdag med don dam 'jug /de 'dra'i chos dbyings de de'i snang brnyan can/ /de ni don dam kho na'i rten 'brel lo/ /de 'dra rten cing 'gyung ba'i chos nyid de/ /don dam rten 'brel de ni rten 'byung min/ /gang las kyang ni ma byung ma ltos la/ /mi 'gyur spros bral rtag pa yin phyir ro/ /rgyu drug rkyen bzhi 'bras bu lnga zhes grags/ /byed rgyu —44—

ngo bo nyid kyi rgyu yin te/ /lhan cig 'byung ba grogs te mthun par rtogs/ /mtshungs ldan rgyu ste rgyas pa skal mnyam yin/ /kun 'gro bar gcod rnam smin yongs 'dzin no/ /mtshungs ldan sems dang sems byung rgyu dmigs dang / /yul dang rnam pa gcig pa de yin pas/ /dgos pa'i dbang yin lhan cig 'byung bar 'dus/ /'di la phyi nang gnyis yod mtshan nyid dang / /mtshan gzhi sems dang sems byung 'byung sogs bzhin/ /de yang sa rdul skad cig dang po de/ /chu me rlung gsum gnyis pa'i lhan cig rgyu/ /de bzhin phan tshun re rer sbyar bar bya/ /'on kyang dngos 'bras dngos rgyu thogs med nus/ /dus mnyam 'byung bar snang ba'ang de yin no/ /kun 'gro nyon mongs las ni nyon mongs skye/ /nang tshan rigs dang sa sogs ma nges pa/ /'di yang skal mnyam khongs su phal cher 'du/ /de ni mthun pa'i rgyu ste dge sogs dge /sa mtshungs la sogs mtshungs pa bskyed par 'dod/ /mi mthun dge mi dge las lung ma bstan/ /skye 'gyur de ni rnam par smin pa'i rgyu/ /byed rgyu nus med 'thad pa ma yin pas/ /byed par bcas pa byed pa'i rgyu yin no/ /'bras bu 'byung dang 'tsho dang rten dang gnas/ /'gyur dang 'bral dang bzo dang gtan tshigs dang / /'bras thob 'phen dang 'grub dang bar chad byed/ /rnying par byed dang 'jig par byed pa dang / /nges par byed dang ma nges byed la sogs/ /mdor na rgyu kun byed pa'i rgyu yin yang / /skyes bus byed pa logs su sngar las dbye/ /kun gyi rgyu rkyen kun gzhi rnam shes te/ /lhan cig 'byung sogs rgyu lnga rgyu ru 'dod/ /nyer len rgyu ni nges par 'dir 'thad do/ /lhag ma rnams ni lhan cig byed rkyen yin/ /dmigs —45—

rkyen mthong dang dmigs pa'i yul yin te/ /bdag po zhes bya rten te byed rgyur 'dus/ /de ma thag rkyen rang mtshungs rgyur gcig pa'i/ /'das ma thag 'dod 'di dang dmigs pa'i rkyen/ /'dzin chos la yin gzhan la rkyen gnyis so/ /de ma thag pa go 'byed las can nam/ /yang na yul la phyogs par byed 'dod de/ /snga ma ltar na gzugs sogs la yod 'gyur/ /'dzin cha kun la'ang rkyen bzhir ma nges te/ /srid pa'i dbang byas bral 'bras bskyed rgyu med/ /brtags 'gog bral 'bras dngos yin kun rdzob ste/ /don dam bral ba dngos te 'bras bu brtags/ /bdag 'bras yul dang rnam smin rgyud kyis bsdus/ /byed rgyu'i sgo nas byung gang byed 'bras te/ /skal mnyam 'bras bu rgyu mthun zhes bya'o/ /gtso bor brjod kyis mtha' gcig kho nar min/ /rgyu rnams thams cad nges par gnyis su 'dus/ /rgyu las byung na de la lhos par 'gyur/ /ltos pa thams cad rang gi ngo bos med/ /rnam gzhag phan tshun ltos pas rnam gzhag 'jig /de tsam kho nas ngo bo ltos mi 'grub/ /ri gnyis phan tshun ltos pa med pa bzhin/ /g.yas kyi 'jog byed g.yon pa yin zhes pa/ /g.yas kyi rnam gzhag g.yon gyi rnam gzhag la/ /ltos par song gi dngos po ltos pa min/ /de phyir rten 'brel gtso bo bskyed par brjod/ /ces pa chos lnga dang rang bzhin gsum dang rten 'brel gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste lnga pa'o// //phyin log gzhan gsum bdag lta'i grogs yin te/ /bdag ni rtag tu'am re zhig gnas 'dod rtag /sngar gnas bden las gzhan du chad snyam pa/ /gang zag la ltos rtag chad mthar lta 'o/ /'dus byas nam yang rtag pa'i go —46—

skabs med/ /mi rtag pa las med dang sdug bsngal rtogs/ /sdug bsngal can ni byed por mi rung zhing / /mi rtag pa la bdag dang byed po 'gal/ /de ltar yang rje btsun gyis tshigs su bcad pa/ mi rung rgyu las skyes phyir dang / /'gal phyir rang nyid mi gnas phyir/ /med phyir mtshan nyid nges phyir dang / /rjes su 'jug phyir 'gag pa'i phyir/ /yongs su 'gyur bar dmigs phyir dang / /de rgyu nyid dang 'bras bu'i phyir/ /zin pa'i phyir dang bdag po'i phyir/ /dag dang sems can rjes 'jug phyir/ /dang po je bas je che dang / /rgyas dang rten gyi dngos po dang / /'gyur dang yongs su smin pa dang / /de bzhin dman dang khyad par 'phags/ /'od gsal ba dang 'od mi gsal/ /yul gzhan 'gro dang sa bon bcas/ /sa bon med pa'i ngo bo dang / /gzugs brnyan du ni skye ba ste/ /skye ba rnam pa bcu bzho la/ /rgyu dang tshad kyi khyad par dang / /rgyas pa don med mi rung dang / /rten nyid du ni mi srid dang / /gnas pa la ni mi srid dang / /dang po mi 'jig mthar mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin dman dang khyad par 'phags/ /'od gsal ba dang 'od mi gsal/ /'gro med gnas pa mi rung dang / /tha ma nyid ni mi srid dang / /sems kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir/ /'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma/ /'byung ba rnams dang don rnam drug /skad cig nyid du brjod pa ni/ /skam dang 'phel dang rang bzhin gyi/ /g.yo dang 'phel dang 'grib pa'i phyir/ /'byung ba de dang 'brel phyir dang / /yongs su 'gyur ba gzhi yi phyir/ kha dog dri dang ro dang reg /'dra phyir de ni de dang 'dra/ /bud shing rags las byung ba'i phyir/ /je bas je cher dmigs pa'i phyir/ /sems rjes 'jug phyir dri ba'i phyir/ /des na —47—

phyi yang skad cig ma/ /smras pa/ gang zhig gang na'ang yod min pa/ /rtag ces bya ba mi 'thad do/ /nam mkha' dang ni rigs spyi sogs/ /mkhas pas bshad kyang rtsod pa'i ngor/ /'gyur dngos gcod dang grags phyir yin/ /de rnams brtags yod nyid yin phyir/ /blo yis brtags pa kho nar zad / /'di dag 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ /rtag pa ci ste min snyam na/ /'di la khyad gzhi ma grub pas/ /'gyur ba med kyang 'gyur med min/ /gzhi med pa la skye 'gag sogan// /yod med gang yang mi 'thad do/ /mo bsham bu la skye ba ni/ /med ces bzhin te skye med min/ /chos dbyings ci yang ma yin pa/ /gnas lugs don dam zhes smra ste/ /de 'dra 'dod pa'i skye med ni/ /don dam min te 'di dang mtshungs/ /yod cing grub la skye ba ni/ /med na skye med ces brjod bya/ /ye nas grub na skye ba med/ /'byung min gnas— dang 'gag pa med/ /skye 'jig can la rdzas yod dang / /brtags yod gnyis su 'dod pa yin/ /gnas pa la ni rdzas dang btags/ /don dam zhes bya dbye ba gsum/ /'on kyang byung rjes gnas na gnas/ /gdod mar gnas la gnas pa med/ /'gog pa gnyis kyang byas par 'gyur/ /'di dag gsar ba skyes phyir ro/ /skyes la mi 'gag med pas na/ /skye 'jig can te 'dus byas yin/ /'gog pa skad cig gcig dang gnyis/ /bskal par lon sogs yod pa ste/ /thob pa po dang de 'brel phyir/ /dus kyi 'khrid pas 'gyur ba nyid/ /byung yang skyes pa min snyam na/ /gzugs sogs la yang thal bar 'gyur/ /skyes kyang mi 'jig srid snyam na/ /dngos po rtag pa yod par 'gyur/ /dngos med yin yang gsar ba skye/ /de yang rgyu can nyid 'gyur zo/ /de lta na ni —48—

dngos po dang / /khyad par med par 'gyur snyam na/ /chos can gang la nyer len nam/ /rdzas med mtshan gzhi'i dngos med de/ /ltos ngor 'dus byas mtshan nyid can/ /brtags pa tsam yang sel ngor skye/ /de la rdzas su skye ba med/ /kun rdzob bden par 'di mi skye/ /rdzas su skye 'jig yod pa ni/ /dngos po 'dus byas rnams la yin/ /rig dang snang ngor de dag la/ /skye 'jig 'gyur ba gang las 'grub/ /brtags pa 'khrul ba'i ngor byas na/ /dngos med rgyu dang bcas par 'dod/ /skye 'jig yod kyang 'dus byas ni/ /min na ha cang thal 'gyur te/ /'dus byas rang gi mtshan nyid dang / /ldan yang min zhes su zhig smra/ /rdzas med la ni nyer len dang / /lhan cig byed pa med mod kyang / /nyams par byed dang byed rgyu yod/ /bral ba'i rgyu yod kha cig la'o/ /'jog dang byed las rdzas mi skye/ /brtags pa'i ngor ni nges bskyed pas/ /ri bong rwa sogs blo ngo na'ang / /mi srid pa dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /'di rtag rdzas su rtag na ni/ /rtag pa'i dngos 'gyur mtshan nyid 'gal/ /'on te brtags par rtag na ni/ /blo ngor skye 'jig byed dang 'gal/ /gang zhig rnam par shes pa dang / /rtog yul thams cad 'dus byas dang / /ye shes kho na'i rang spyod yul/ /'dus ma byas pa don dam nyid/ /blo ngo'i chos las grol pa'o/ /zhes bya ba ni 'phros don gyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /mi rtag phyir na ga myo/sa pa'i go skabs med/ /gnas pa'i rang dbang med phyir sdug bsngal nyid/ /lam yang sdug kun rigs kyi khongs su 'dus/ /phun tshogs 'jig dang mi bsrun phrad pa dang / /rgyu las 'bras bur 'gyur te de yang 'jig /dri ma nus dang bag chags med las 'dzin/ /de las 'bras 'gyur —49—

de yang 'jig pas skrag /sdug bsngal thams cad mi rtag rgyu mtshan can/ /byed po rtag dang dbang sgyur yin 'dod na/ /sdug bsngal can phyir mi 'dod bab min nam/ /'bras tshe rang 'jig rtag min rang dbang med/ /bya byed las kyi byed po 'dod mod kyi/ /rtag dbang gcig pus dngos po gcig la yang / /byed mi nus na thams cad smos ci dgos/ /byed po rtag na rim pas 'gyung ba 'gal/ /'dod pas rim par bskyed na gcig pus 'gal/ /dbang phyug 'dod par gcig na du mar 'gyur/ /'dod pa byed por gcig na de yang brtag /tha dad rgyu 'bras yin na mi rtag nyid/ /rgyu mang gzhan yang yod na rten 'brel mtshungs/ /rtag pa'i rgyu 'bras yin na rim pa 'gal/ /'brel ba gnyis dang bral na byed pos min/ /de phyir bdag ni byed po'i bya ba 'dor/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin spong 'dod bdag len 'dod/ /mi rtag dus kyis 'khrid la bdag dbang med/ /chu thigs du ma'ang so so'i sar skams na/ /chu bor mi 'gyur mi rtag du ma la/ /bdag bya'i mtshan nyid nam yang yod ma yin/ /bdag po rang dbang rtag pa med/ /de las bde sdug sbyin bya'i yul/ /bdag kyang med par rtogs pa na/ khams gsum pa yi nyon mongs zlog /gang zag bdag med sgom pa yod med las/ /srid las grol ba yod med rjes su dpog /ma rig pa las 'jig tshogs lta ba ste/ /de las 'dod chags zhe sdang shugs drag 'byung / /bdag lta med na nyon mongs gzhan yod kyang / /yang srid 'phen byed las ni gsog mi nus/ /ngar 'dzin pa dang nga yir 'dzin pa dang / /de nyid gzhan la spos nas byed por 'dzin/ /de yi khyad par rtag gcig rang dbang can/ /rang —50— shā

bzhin gtsang bzang ma 'dres pa ru blta/ /blo dman rnams la dang por rig pa brtan/ /chos nyid dang yang rjes mthun yin par 'dod/ /dpal gyi mgur nas kyang / phung po rnams la bdag med de/ /phung po rnams kyang bdag la med/ /rnam rtog bzhin du de dag med/ /de dag med pa'ang ma yin no/ /rje btsun gyis tshigs su bcad pa/ bdag dang byed po 'gog pa yang 'di ltar/ /bdag tu lta ba'i bdag nyid bdag mtshan min/ /ngan par gnas min mtshan nyid mi 'dra'i phyir/ /gnyis las g.yin med de ni nor ba skyes/ /de phyir thar ba nor tsam zad pa yin/ /ji ltar 'khrul ba tsam brten skye bo yis/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin rgyun chags rtogs mi 'gyur/ /rig min rig nyid sdug bsngal sdug bsngal med/ /chos kyi rang bzhin de yi rang bzhin min/ /brten nas dngos rab skye ba mngon 'jug na/ /skye bo ji ltar gzhan gyi byas la brten/ /gang phyir yod pa mi mthong med mthong ba/ /'di 'dra'i mun nag rnam pa 'di gang zhig /gang zag rdzas su yod ma yin/ /brtags par yod pa nyid du brjod/ /mi dmigs phyin ci log pa dang / /kun nas nyon mongs nyon mongs rgyu/ /nyes pa gnyis phyir de las 'di/ /gcig dang gzhan du brjod bya min/ /phung po bdag tu thal ba dang / /de rdzas nyid du thal 'gyur phyir/ /mtshan nyid dang ni 'jig rten na/ /mthong phyir bstan bcos sgo nas kyang / /bud shing me bzhin gnyis su ni/ /brjod min mi rung dmigs phyir ro/ /gnyis yod rnam shes skye ba'i phyir/ /de rkyen ma yin don med phyir/ /de phyir lta ba po nas ni/ /grol ba'i bar du mi 'gyur ro/ /bdag po nyid gcig yin na ni/ /mi rtag mi 'dod 'byung mi byed/ /—51—

de las mtshan nyid sgrub dgos te/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub gsum la gnod/ /nyes pa gsum phyir lta sogs la/ /de yi byed par rang byung min/ /byed pa de yi rkyen can yang / /lta sogs byed pa med pa yin/ /byed po min phyir mi rtag phyir/ /gcig char rtag tu 'jug pa'i phyir/ /lta la sogs pa byed pa ni/ /rang byung nyid du mi rung ngo / /de bzhin gnas dang zhig pa ni/ /snga na med dang mi rtag dang / /phyogs gsum pa yang med pa'i phyir/ /rkyen nyid du ni mi rung ngo / /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang ba'i/ /gnas skabs gcod pa'i bye brag dang / /'jug dang rgyun gyi bye brag kyang / /gang zag gis ni nye bar bstan/ /gang zag yod na thams cad ni/ /'bad med thar pa'am thar ba med/ /gcig dang rgyu dang za ba dang / /byed pa dang ni dbang bsgyur dang / /bdag po'i don dang rtag pa dang / /nyon mongs pa dang dag pa'i gnas/ /rnal 'byor can dang ma grol grol/ /'di dag la ni bdag tu lta/ /gnyen por mkhas pa bcu gsungs so/ /bdag 'dzin 'di yi dmigs pa rang rgyud kyi/ /phung po lnga yin rnam pa bdag tu lta/ /'khrul phyir rnam rtog gting tshugs ma yin pas/ /gzhan gyi rgyud dang rgyud mi gtogs pa la'ang / /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'du shes skye ba srid/ /phung po ris gcig res 'ga' lnga la sogs/ /nges med tshul gyis 'jug pa'ang mthong ba yin/ /bdag gir 'dzin pa'ang 'jig tshogs lta ba ste/ /gtso bor rnam shes las gzhan rang gzhan rgyud/ /yo byad sogs la 'jug mod nges pa med/ /de de'i 'dzin stangs zhes yul dngos mi srid/ /ma dpyad 'jig rten ngor bstun gang zag 'dod/ /dngos po'i don du nam yang yod ma yin/ /yang dag kun rdzob tsam du brtags —52—

yod nyid/ /mthong po sems can sogs kyang de dang mthun/ /dngos dang don du yod par de 'dod 'khrul/ /log par rig pas ma rig khyad par can/ /ma rig du ma rjes su 'brel ba'i phyir/ /blo chen 'gas kyang ma rig tha snyad sbyar/ /nyon mongs gsum du bsdu bar sngar bshad zin/ /klu sgrub kyis kyang / gal te phung bo bdag yin na/ /skye dang 'jig pa can du 'gyur/ /gal te phung po rnams las gzhan/ /phung po'i mtshan nyid med par 'gyur/ /gal te lha de mi de na/ /de lta na ni rtag par 'gyur/ /gal te lha las mi gzhan na/ /de lta na ni mi rtag 'gyur/ / nye bar len nyid bdag ma yin/ /de dag 'byung dang 'jig pa yin/nye bar blangs pa ji lta bur/ /nye bar len po yin par 'gyur/ /( 〈dze+e〉 waṃbadag ni nye bar len pa las/ /gzhan du 'thad pa nyid ma yin/ /)skyes bu sa min chu ma yin/ /me min rlu/nga min nam mkha' min/ /rnam the/sa ma yin kun min na/ /de las gzhan don skyes bu gang / /brgya pa las kyang / gal te nang bdag bud med min/ /skyes min ma ning ma yin pa/ /de tshe mi shes 'ba' zhig las/ /khyod bdag pho 'o rnyam du sems/ /skyes pa bdag min mo gzugs mi 'dra'i phyir/ /bud med ma ning la yang de 'drar shes/ /mtshan nyid 'gal la dngos po gcig pa ci/ /'dod ldan bdag na chags bral der mi 'gyur/ /bcing ba bdag 'dod na ni grol ba min/ /mtshan nyid 'gal yang yin na sa sogs kyang / /bdag tu ha cang thal ba ma yin nam/ /de kho na nyid yin na sna tshogs 'gal/ /tshor bas myong phyir myong bo bdag yod min/ /de bdag yin na len po lag pa dang / /'gro bo rkang yin de ni len 'gro med/ /las ni lus ngag sems —53—

pas byed mthong phyir/ /bdag gis ma byas ci phyir 'bras bu myong / /cha shas las gzhan tshogs pa med pa'i phyir/ /lus ngag sems ni nam yang bdag ma yin/ /thams cad yin na gzhan dbang mi rtag 'khrul/ /du mar 'gyur phyir bdag ni yod ma yin/ /khyab pa'i tshul la khyab byar gcig yin na/ /sngar bshad skyon dang khyab byar mi gcig na/ /bde sdug bdag gis myong ba med par 'gyur/ /dge sdug sogs dang ma 'brel las 'bras dang / /bcings grol sogs kyang de la med par 'gyur/ /mchod sbyin bdag na yon tan bshes gnyen yang / /bdag gi 'du shes mchod sbyin la 'jug 'gyur/ /ri bo'i 'du shes bye brag med pa bzhin/ /sde snod kyi tshul las kyang / bdag ces bya ba bdud kyi sems/ khyod ni lta bar gyur pa yin/ /'du byed phung po 'dis stong ste/ /'di la sems can yod ma yin/ /ji ltar yan lag tshogs rnams la/ /brten nas shing rtar brjod pa ltar/ /de bzhin phung po rnams brten nas/ /kun rdzob sems can zhes bya'o/ /mchog gzhan don du gnyer phyir dang / /skye 'jig blo can nyid kyi phyir/ /skye bos 'di yi dbang sogs las/ /bdag ni tha dad gyur par shes/ /lus bdag yin na so sor phye ba dang / /sems bdag yin na'ang sems dang sems byung dbye/ /gnyis ka las gzhan yin na phyi nang tshol/ /tshogs spyi tsam zhig yin na rdzas su med/ /bdag la lus ldan mi rung mtshan nyid dang / /rgyu 'bras rten dang brten pa bdag po'i 'brel/ /gang yang 'thad pa ma yin skyon bcas phyir/ /mtshan nyid sngar bkag phan tshun bskyed pa min/ /bskyed na mi rtag de bzhin gzhan ltos 'gyur/ /lus rten yin na bdag ni skye dang —54—

'jig /bdag rten yin na lus ni rtag par thal/ /bdag lus phan tshun yod 'dod bdag po'i 'brel/ /gzugs la bdag ni phyi nang kun ma dmigs/ /bdag la gzugs gnas na ni 'bral ba 'gal/ /bdag gis bdag byas gzugs sogs 'dir len dbang / /dgos na de ltar min no gzugs min phyir/ /bla 'og sogs dang gnas gcig rung ma yin/ /rtswa shing sa la brten ltar ma yin te/ /de bzhin 'phel 'grib byed sogs ma dmigs phyir/ /byed kyang ma nges phyi rol la yod phyir/ /lus sems spyi bo bdag na'ang mi rung ste/ /gzugs sems gcig yin cig shos 'gal phyir ro/ /de ltar gang zag bdag med ni/ /theg pa che chung kun la yod/ /theg chen thun mong min lam du/ /bsgom bya chos kyi bdag med do/ /chos kyi bdag 'dzin dngos por zhen pa dang / /bden 'dzin dngos 'dzin ming gi rnam grangs so/ /med 'dzin tha snyad 'dzin pa tsam yin te/ /med la 'dzin rgyu med pas yod par 'dus/ /'dus byas ngo bos yod na chos bdag brjod/ /dang po gnyis pa'i dus gnas rtag pa'i ste/ /sngar ni bden yod 'gag pa chad par 'dod/ /bden min snang ba tsam la rtag chad med/ /gnas lugs sems dus kun rdzob yod lta rtag /don dam med par lta na chad pa'i mtha'/ /rnam par mi rtog la 'jug gegs kyi skabs/ /yod sogs sgrub rtog rtag dang dgag rtog chad/ /dgag sgrub thams cad don dam tshul la med/ /de kun chos kyi bdag 'dzin khongs su 'dus/ /don du 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa kun/ /de yi phyogs mthun nyid du shes par bya/ /dbye na zhen pa'i rtog dang mi rtog gnyis/ /gnyis pa'ang zhen par 'brel dang ma 'brel —55—

gnyis/ /sa thob zhen med g.yo dang mi g.yo ste/ /de ni dag pa'i sa na yod pa yin/ /zhen rtog de yang ngo bo nyid rtog dang / khyad par dang ni bsdus dang dbye bar 'dod/ /mdor na gnas tshul la ni chos yod 'dzin/ /bden par snang phyin de la 'dzin zhes bya/ /chos rtog mi g.yo snang yang bden snang med/ /snang ba'ang snga ma'i mthu yin de phyir te/ /chos bdag 'dzin pa'i cha shas bsgos par 'dod/ /de phyir 'di spangs rdzogs na sangs rgyas nyid/ /bden par ma yin sgyu mar 'dzin pa yang / /re zhig mi dgag spyir ni chos bdag lta/ /don dam bden 'dzin mnyam gzhag dus na spangs/ /gzhan du ma yin gnas tshul la zhugs phyir/ /kun rdzob bden par 'dzin pa nyon mongs dpung / /'di ni der 'gal dad sogs bskyed cing 'phel/ /ye shes bden grub chos kyi bdag ma yin/ /de ni med par 'dzin na log lta nyid/ /da ni rigs pa cung zad bshad bya ste/ /spyi rnams dngos po gzhan la ma 'brel zhing / /gang la rten dngos dang yang ma 'brel la/ /me spyis me yi don byed bsreg pa'am/ /de rgyu de 'bras khyad par la phan na/ /don nus yin yang de la med pas na/ /don byed nus min myong min gnas med pa/ /brtag pa las gzhan ma mthong de phyir med/ /gser bum la gnas bum chos gzhan mi 'gro/ /dngul sogs gzhan gyi bum chos de la min/ /re rer rang rang las gzhan spyi bum med/ /log na'ang spyi ni grub pa med phyir med/ /ming gi snga rol ming gi blo med pas/ /don med 'gyur las don ni sngar yod dang / /ming mang bzhin du don yang mang 'gyur dang / /gcig 'jug gzhan mi 'jug pa'i rgyu med dang / /ming gcig phyir na don mang gcig tu —56—

'gyur/ /sngar med na ni gzugs sogs mthong min 'gyur/ /ma brtags gong du'ang ming blor thal 'gyur bas/ /ming don 'brel med brjod du med pa yin/ /rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis bshad pa/ lag sogs g.yo na thams cad dag /g.yo bar 'gyur phyir 'gal ba can/ /las ni gcig tu mi rung phyir/ /gzhan du tha dad grub par 'gyur/ /gcig bsgribs pa na thams cad dag /sgrib par 'gyur ba'am ma bsgrib na/ /mthong 'gyur gcig tshon gyis bsgyur na/ /bsgyur ba'am ma bsgyur rtogs par 'gyur/ /de phyir tshogs pa gcig yod min/ /zhi ba lhas kyang / rgyud dang tshogs zhes bya ba ni/ /'phreng ba dmag la sogs bzhin brdzun/ /'das pa'i dngos yod na ni yang skyed dang / /slar yang 'jig 'gyur ma 'ongs dngos yod na/ /de ni rang rgyu sngon song yin par 'gyur/ /slar yang 'bras 'byin da lta'ang 'bras 'byin nam/ /'das pa rgyu na mes tshig sa bon las/ /myu gur thal 'gyur ma 'ongs 'bras yin na/ /byung dang skyes par thal te de dag med/ /snang du rung yang dmigs pa min phyir ro/ /gzugs 'das yod na gzugs sam gzugs min yod/ /gzugs na mthong 'gyur gzhan na srid min no/ /de phyir spyi dang rags pa rgyun dag dang / /ming don 'brel dang dus gnyis brtags pa tsam/ /ci tsam snang ba gsal bas sems yin te/ /rmi lam la sogs dag dang mtshungs phyir dang / /blo dang lhan cig kho nar dmigs pas kyang / /sems snang tsam yin gzhan du med par grub/ /yang 'phags pas gsungs pa/ yi dwags dud 'gro mi rnams dang / /lha rnams ji ltar rigs rigs su/ /dngos gcig yid ni tha dad —57—

phyir/ /don ma grub par 'dod pa yin/ /don ni don du grub gyur na/ khres pa rtogs pa med mi 'gyur/ /'di la su zhig blo ldan zhing / /zhi ba thob pa grub pa yi/ /chos kun yid la byed pa la/ /de ltar don rnams snang phyir dang / /mi rtog ye shes rgyu ba la/ /don kun snang ba med phyir yang / /don med khong du chud par bya/ /de lta bas na rnam rig med/ /slob dpon gyis bshad pa/ drug gis gcig char sbyar ba na/ /phra rab rdul cha drug tu 'gyur/ /drug po dag kyang go gcig na/ /gong bu'ang rdul phran tsam du 'gyur/ /de ni gcig na'ang yul min la/ /phra rab rdul du du ma'ang min/ /de dag 'dus pa'ang ma yin te/ /'di ltar rdul phran mi 'grub phyir/ /rnam pa'i grangs bzhin shes pa yod 'dod na/ /rags pa bzhin du dpyad pas 'jig par 'gyur/ /du ma shes pa gcig gi ngor bden na/ /sna tshogs ngo bor snang ba'i dngos gcig la/ /dngos gcig bden na rnam pa mang po brdzun/ /rnam pa bden na dngos gcig nyams par 'gyur/ /'phags pa nā ga rdzu nas kyang / /ji ltar skad cig mtha' yod pa/ /de bzhin thog dang dbus brtag dgos/ /de ltar skad cig gsum brtag phyir/ /'jig rten skad cig gnas pa min/ /thog ma dbus dang tha ma yang / /skad cig bzhin du bsam par bya/ /thog ma dbus dang tha ma dag /rang g.yin las kyang ma yin no/ khres pa cha med yul phrad shes na ni/ /phrad rjes rigs pas cha med 'gal ba yin/ /ma phrad shes par 'gal la gcig par zhugs/ /'jug dang zhugs zin phyir na cha bcas so/ /bdag med gtan tshigs gtso bo gnyis su mthong / /dngos rnams ngo bos ma grub gang phyir 'di/ /chos yin gcig dang du mar ma —58—

grub phyir/ /de ltar gtan tshigs rtsa sbyor 'god bya ste/ /phyogs chos gcig 'gog tshul rnams sngar bstan zin/ /du ma gcig gcig bsags las byung ba'i phyir/ /gcig med phyir na du ma khegs pa yin/ /de gnyis ngo bo phan tshun 'gal ba'ang ste/ /du mar snang ba du ma'i phyir na brdzun/ /gcig na bden pa srid kyang gcig mi srid/ /spyod yul gyur la phung gsum yod ma yin/ /gcig min du ma min pas brdzun par grub/ khyab sgrub dpe ni me long gzugs brnyan te/ /rang bzhin yod min de ni me long las/ /gzhan min gcig tu grub min phyir zhes 'god/ /mtshan nyid mi mtshungs phyir na gcig pa min/ /gcig gi go sar gnyis med phyir gzhan med/ /skabs 'di'i bden med don ni mngon sum grub/ /de phyir tha snyad rtags kyis sgrub par 'dod/ /gcig dang du mar med na rdzas dngos min/ /der yod gang rung las gzhan ma dmigs phyir/ /de gnyis phan tshun spangs te gnas phyir ro/ /zhes pas ldog pa sgrub par 'dod pa yin/ /gcig dang du bral rang bzhin med pas khyab/ /gzugs brnyan bzhin te phyi nang dngos 'di yang / /de dang bral phyir de med ces bkod pas/ /rig shes rjes dpag bskyed par 'dod pa yin/ /'on kyang lugs 'di don la ston pa'i phyir/ /don grub na ni tshig la khyad par med/ /yan lag gnyis lnga ci 'dod sbyor du wo / /ngo bo 'gog pa rigs pa'i rtsa ba 'di'o/ /khyad par 'gog pa mtha' bzhi skye 'gog ste/ /dngos rnams skye med bdag sogs mi skye'i phyir/ /mig sogs bdag las mi skye yod phyir dang / /skye ba rkyen gzhan la ltos mthong phyir ro/ /bdag gis byed na byed po ma skyes pas/ /med phyir de yis byed pa ga la —59—

rung / /rang nyid grub na bskyed byed dgos pa med/ /ma grub pas ni ji ltar bskyed par byed/ /gzhan las min te sa bon la ltos phyir/ /de mi ltos na rgyu dang rgyu min pa/ /mnyam gyur sa bon la phan mi dgos phyir/ /zhig zin gzhan las skye na rgyu med 'gyur/ /ma zhig las skyes dus mnyam phan tshun nyid/ /'gags dang ma 'gag las gzhan 'gag bzhin pa/ /med phyir de las skyes pa'ang mi rung ngo / /rkyen gzhan rnams las byung yang byed po min/ /gzhan skyes snang ba de ni brtags ngor yin/ /myu gu'i dus na med phyir sa bon te/ /rang min rgyud gcig gtogs phyir gzhan yang min/ /sa bon myu gu yod med phan tshun du/ /rnam par dpyad pas de la'ang skye ba med/ /gnyis skye 'dod la gnyis ka'i skyon yin te/ /sngo sogs bkag na khra bo mi 'grub bzhin/ /gnyis skye rang dbang ma yin ltos las grub/ khyu med nam yang skye dang nam yang min/ /res 'ga' skye mthong grags pas gnod pa'ang yin/ khyab sgrub dngos por skye na de bzhir nges/ /dngos la rang gzhan gnyis kyis khyab phyir ro/ /bzhi las mi skye rang bzhin skye med khyab/ /rus sbal sbu bzhin dngos po 'di dag kyang / /de med phyir na skye ba med ces bya/ /rtags grub dus na don ni grub zin pas/ /de de'i tha snyad dngos su gtso bor bsgrub/ /ltos grub rigs pas kun brtags khegs mod kyang / /dngos h+pha ngo bor dpyod na stobs ldan min/ kha cig gto med min te rten 'brel phyir/ /zer ba 'dis ni grub zin bsgrub par 'dod/ /yod med skye 'gog mu bzhi dpyod pa sogs/ /'phros don phra mo yin par shes par bya/ /'gag gnas med de skye ba med phyir dang / /tha dad min te gcig pa med —60—

phyir dang / /'ong ba med de song ba ma grub dang / /chad pa med de rtag pa med phyir zhes/ /'di rnams rtsa ba'i gtan tshigs bla na med/ /dbu ma'i gzhung gi gtan tshigs mtha' dag kyang / /'di rnams kho na'i rjes 'brang yin phyir ro/ /chos kun bdag med gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba yod min te/ /dgag bya log tshul sgo nas ldog pas dbye/ /theg pa chung dang chen po'i rigs so sor/ /rjes su bzung phyir rgyal bas 'di gnyis gsungs/ /'di yi yul gyi dgag bya dngos mi srid/ /yul can dgag bya log rtog yin phyir zlog /dngos na yod med su yis dgag sgrub nus/ /de bzhin nyid la kun rdzob chos kyi bdag /nam yang med pa chos kyi bdag med de/ /don dam las gzhan chos rnams rang ngo bor/ /gdod nas ma grub de yang rnam grangs pa/ /rnam grangs mngon lkog chos kun gang la yang / /bdag dngos nam yang mi srid de tsam la/ /gang zag bdag med zhes su tha snyad mdzode/ /chos rnams kun la 'di gnyis khyab pa'i phyir/ /chos kun gyi ni spyi yi mtshan nyid do/ /rje btsun gyis kyang / rang dang rang gi bdag nyid du/ /med phyir rang gi ngo bo la/ /mi gnas phyir dang 'dzin bzhin te/ /med phyir ngo bo nyid med 'dod/ /phyi ma phyi ma'i rten yin pas/ /ngo bo nyid ni med pa yis/ /skye med 'gag med gzod nas zhi/ /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa 'grub/ /thog ma dang ni de nyid gzhan nyid dang / /rang gi mtshan nyid rang dang gzhan du 'gyur/ /kun nas nyos mongs pa dang khyad par las/ /skye ba med pa'i chos la bzod par bshad/ /de dag skye ba gtan med rnam grangs te/ /ri mo'i dpe dang chu rnyog dwangs pa sogs/ /skye ba —61—

bden par med pa'i rnam grangs so/ /skye med dgongs pa'ang de ltar shes par byos/ /snying po rtag pa gang zag bdag med dang / /rnam pa kun ldan khyab pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /chos bdag med pa'i stong gzhir dgongs pa yin/ /'di ni sgra rtog dgag sgrub yul las 'das/ /gcig dang tha dad skye 'gag spros dang bral/ /de phyir sngar gyi rigs pas mi khegs te/ khang ba'i mtshan nyid bkag pas ljon shing bzhin/ /bdag med gnyis kyi dgag phyogs don dam pa'i/ /rnam grangs tsam yin stong gzhi don dam dngos/ /'di na gzhi lam 'bras chos 'ga' yang med/ /sangs rgyas chos sku kho na bden par gnas/ /don dam dpyod byed rigs pa kun gyi gnad / /gang gang de de'i ngo bo khyad par sogs/ /gcig dang tha dad dpyod dam 'gal ba tshol/ /yin phyir dpyod tshul thams cad de la 'dus/ /thal rang gzhus rnams bden pa'i de de med/ /yod na 'di ltar yod dgos zhes smra ba'i/ /gsang tshig 'di ni gang dgos kun la spyor/ /'di ni dpyad na rigs pa min pa mang / /bya byed bden pa mi srid ci ste bden/ /ltos med tha dad kho na dgos zhes pa/ /ri bong mgo la rwa med yod na ni/ /dkar por yod kyi gzhan min zer dang mtshungs/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka mi 'dod dngos mi srid/ /de 'dra'i mashaṃ nyid 'jog pa blun po'i lugs/ /brtags don tshol byed ltar snang kun bor nas/ /yang dag rigs pa'i lam la 'jug par byos/ /zhes pa bdag med gnyis gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste drug pa'o// //de ltar bshad pa'i grub don bden gnyis la/ /nges pa yang dag rnyed —62—

nas bsgom phyir yin/ /bden gnyis shes na lta spyod rnam par dag /drang nges don la blo mchog thob par 'gyur/ /rang gi ngo bo bden stong rnam shes kyi/ /yul ni kun rdzob tsam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ /rang gi ngo bo bden grub 'phags pa yi/ /ye shes spyod yul don dam bden par 'dod/ /rgyal tshab chen po nas kyang / byis pa yang dag nyid bsgribs nas/ /yang dag ma yin kun tu snang / /byang chub sems dpa' de bsal nas/ /yang dag nyid ni kun tu snang / /don med pa dang don yod dag /mi snang snang ba yin zhes bya/ /thog med bsags pa'i ma rig bag chags la/ /'phral gyi 'khru/la rgyus ma bslad gsal snang can/ /blang dor bya ba'i yul du 'os pa ni/ /yang dag kun rdzob ces byar mkhas rnams 'dod/ /sgra dang rtog pa'i dngos yul kun brtags dang / /'phral gyi 'phrul rgyus snang ba gang yin dang / /grub mtha' log pas btags pa'i don spyi rnams/ /log pa'i kun rjob nyid du nges par brjod/ /yang dag kun rjob 'jig rten rnal 'byor gnyis/ /ma brtags phyi nang snang ba 'jig rten pa'i/ /gzhan dbang rnam rig tsam ni rnal 'byor pa'o/ /de la rigs pa'i sgrub byed 'jug mod kyang / /gsal bar snang ba ma brtags ngor yin pas/ /snang ba sems ni dpyad ngo kho nar min/ /don dam rigs pas grub kyang de min bzhin/ /yang dag don la sgrib phyir kun rdzob dang / /mchog gi rtogs bya yin phyir don dam mo/ /kun rdzob bden pa kun rdzob kho nar bden/ /don dam kho nar bden pa don dam ste/ /zhen ngor bden snang ngor bden pa gnyis/ /kun rdzob yin phyir spyir ni brdzun pa nyid/ /kun rdzob yul can rnam shes 'khor dang —63—

bcas/ /don dam yul can ye shes kho na ste/ /lam ni yul can don dam rjes su 'jug /rtogs byed dngos ni rang yin dbye ba med/ /rjes dpag rigs shes dbang yid kun rdzob 'jal/ /don dam rtogs byed rnam par mi rtog nyid/ /dam pa'i don gyi spyi 'jal rigs shes yod/ /rang rig kun rdzob don dam gnyis su 'byed/ /'jig rten grags ngor kun rdzob bden pa gnyis/ /rang lugs kun rdzob tsam dang kun rdzob bden/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang gnyis la rim bzhin sbyor/ /kun rdzob la yang rang gi kun rdzob dang / /don dam gnyis yin gnyis dang rnam shes tsam/ /don dam dbye ba rnam grangs khyab pa gnyis/ /kun rdzob rang bzhin med tsam rnam grangs pa/ /spros bral tsam dang stong pa tsam po'ang de/ /bden med ji bzhin ma go tshig spyi tsam/ /ji bzhin go na spros par mi 'char bas/ /blo dman don du bden med sogs 'gog kyang / / bden med spros bral stong tsam dbye ba med/ khyab pa'i don dam snying po'i ye shes so/ /yang na don dam nyid la'ang bden gnyis dbye/ /gnyis bral cha dang ye shes ldog pas dbye/ /bden gnyis dbye gzhi srid tshad shes bya tsam/ /blo gnyis rtogs tshul gnyis dang 'khor 'das dang / /spyod po skye 'phags phyir ni dgos pas dbye/ /ye shes ngor byas bden pa gcig pu nyid/ /bden pa 'di dag gcig pa bkag pa ste/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas gcig dang tha dad min/ /gcig na kun rdzob mthong bas grol ba dang / /gcig shos nyon mongs dmigs par 'gyur ba dang / /de la dbye ba med ltar kun rdzob 'gyur/ /mthong thos las gzhan don dam btsal med 'gyur/ /gzhan na don dam mthong yang kun rdzob la/ /'dzin —64—

mi zlog dang chos nyid min pa dang / /kun rdzob med pa don dam mi 'gyur dang / /gnyis ka dus gcig dmigs par thal zhes gsungs/ /don dam mtshan nyid gnyis la ci rigs sbyor/ /bden gnyis rang bzhin rnam par gzhag pa ni/ /mgon po slob dpon gzhan dang bdag tshigs spel/ /chos can skyu ma lta bur bden stong snang / /chos nyid 'gyur med gnyis stong ye shes bden/ /gzung ba sgyu 'dra bstan pa'i dgos par bcas/ /'dzin pa sgyu 'dra sgyu ma'i dpe rnams so/ /ji ltar sgyu ma de bzhin du/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog brjod/ /sgyu ma'i rnam pa ji lta ba/ /de bzhin gnyis su 'khrul bar brjod/ /ji ltar de la de med pa/ /de bzhin du ni don dam 'dod/ /ji ltar de ni dmigs pa ltar/ /de bzhin du ni kun rdzob 'dod/ /ces pa'i don dam kun rdzob ni/ /gnas skabs pa la bzhag pa ste/ /rnam par rig pa tsam de yang / /gnas skabs pa yi don dam yin/ /de med na ni de yi rgyu/ /gsal bar dmigs pa ji lta bar/ /de bzhin gnas ni gzhan gyur na/ /yang dag ma yin rtog pa dmigs/ /ji ltar 'jig rten ma 'khrul ba/ /de yi rgyu la 'dod dgur spyod/ /de bzhin sdom brtson ma 'khrul ba/ /gnas gzhan gyur la dgyes dgur spyod/ /de lta bu ni de la yod/ /de yi dngos po yod ma yin/ /de ltas sgyu ma la sogs la/ /yod dang med pa nyid du brjod/ /de la yod pa med ma yin/ /med pa yod pa nyid ma yin/ /sgyu ma dag la sogs pa la/ /yod med khyad par med pa'ang brjod/ /de bzhin gnyis snang de la yod/ /de yi dngos po yod ma yin/ /de ltas gzugs la sogs pa la/ /yod dang med pa nyid du brjod/ /de la yod pa med ma yin/ /med pa yod pa nyid —65—

ma yin/ /gzugs la sogs pa dag la ni/ /yod med khyad par med pa'ang brjod/ /sgro 'dogs pa dang skur ba yi/ /mtha' rnams dgag par bya phyir dang / /theg pa dman pas 'gro ba dag /dgag pa'i phyir ni 'dod pa yin/ /'khrul ba'i rgyu dang 'khrul ba ni/ /gzugs kyi rnam par rig pa dang / /gzugs can min rnam rig par 'dod/ /med phyir gcig shos kyang med 'gyur/ /sgyu ma'i glang po'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /'khrul phyir gnyis su brjod pa ste/ /de la ji bzhin gnyis med kyang / /gnyis po dag tu nye bar dmigs/ /keng rus kyi ni gzugs 'dzin pa/ /'khrul phyir gnyis su brjod pa ste/ /de la ji bzhin gnyis med kyang / /gnyis po dag tu nye bar dmigs/ /'khrul pa'i mtshan nyid chos gang yin/ /de bzhin yod dang de bzhin med/ /yod med khyad par med pa'i phyir/ /yod dang med dang sgyu ma 'dra/ / gnyen po'i chos ni gang yin pa/ /de bzhin med dang de bzhin yod/ /de bzhin med phyir mtshan nyid med/ /sgyu ma dang yang 'dra bar bstan/ /sgyu ma'i rgyal pos sgyu ma yi/ /rgyal po gzhan zhig pham pa ltar/ /gang dag gis ni chos mthong ba'i/ /rgyal sras de dag nga rgyal med/ /sangs rgyas rnam sangs rgyas mchog rnams kyis de dang de las 'dus byas rnams/ /gsungs pa sgyu ma rmi lam smig rgyu gzugs brnyan dang 'dra mig yor dang / /brag cha lta bu dang ni chu zla'i gzugs 'dra sprul ba 'drar shes bya/ /drug dang drug dang gnyis dang drug tshan gnyis dang gsum por re rer 'dod/ /don dam mtshan nyid yod min med min sogs/ /spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba sngar bshad zin/ /rang rig la sogs mtshan nyid lnga dang gsum/ /slob dpon klu —66—

yis kyang ni bshad pa'o/ /gzhan las shes min zhi ba dang / /spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa/ /rnam rtog med don tha dad min/ /de ni de nyid mtshan nyid do/ /rgyu dang rkyen las byung ba yi/ /rang bzhin byas pa can du 'gyur/ /rang bzhin dang ni bcos min dang / /gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin/ /brjod par bya ba bzlog pas ni/ /sems kyi spyod yul bzlog pas so/ /gnyis dngos med pa'i dngos med pa'i/ /dngos po stong pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /yod pa ma yin med pa'ang min/ /tha dad gcig pa'i mtshan nyid min/ /stong pa nyid ni mdor bsdu na/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang / /chos kyi dbyings ni rnam grangs so/ /gzhan min phyin ci log ma yin/ /de 'gags 'phags rngo'i spyod yul dang / /'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /rnam grangs don de go rim bzhin/ /za ba bza' dang de yi lus/ /gnas kyi gzhi yi stong pa nyid/ /de yang gang gis ji ltar mthong / / gang phyir de yang stong pa nyid/ /dge gnyis thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu sems can phan bya'i phyir/ /'khor ba btang bar mi bya'i phyir/ /dge ba mi zad bya ba'i phyir/ /rigs kyang rnam par dag bya'i phyir/ /mtshan dang dpe byad thob bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams dag bya'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrub par byed/ /gang zag dang ni chos rnams kyi/ /dngos po med 'dir stong pa nyid/ /de dngos med pa'i dngos yod pa/ /de ni de las stong nyid gzhan/ /gal te nyon mongs de ma gyur/ /lus can thams cad grol bar 'gyur/ /gal te rnam dag de ma gyur/ /'bad pa 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /chos dbyings bden de grub dang brdzun min phyir/ /ye shes —67—

mthong ba brdzun par mi 'thad phyir/ /bden grub min yang bden zhes don bral smra/ /mi 'dod der thal de rig dgag bya'i phyir/ /bden de gnas tshul nyid la zhugs phyir ro/ /bden gnyis gnas tshul min na gnas tshul med/ /brdzun par mnyam na yin min khyad par ci/ /bden min rdzun pa rdzun min bden pa ste/ /sgra don gzhan med mthun dpe'i mtshan gzhi med/ /bden rdzun phung gsum nam yang mi 'thad do/ /yod na thams cad la yang ha cang thal/ /bden min mthong ba phyin ci log shes sam/ /brdzun pa zad mtha' don dam min par 'gyur/ /ye shes kyis ni chos dbyings ma mthong na/ /shes par 'gal te yul med kho na'i phyir/ blo rang skye med gyur la de 'dod na/ /byis blos rtogs 'gyur stong nyid yin phyir ro/ /rnam pa shar na bya byed dbye bar thal/ /bden par grub ste rgyal ba'i ye shes kyis/ khres rtogs mthong zhing myong ba'i yul phyir te/ /so so rang rig spyod yul yin phyir ro/ /yang na khyod la ye shes phyin log 'gyur/ /gnas lugs ma mthong 'khrul snang mthong phyir ro/ /rgyud chad med pa'i sangs rgyas chos kun gyi/ /rtsa ba brtan po yin phyir bden par grub/ /'khrul ba je che'i 'bras bur gyur ( 〈zhi〉 bu 'gyur )mang dang / /cung zad rje chung gyur la je brtan mthong / /spros kun bden dang 'gal bar grub pa ste/ /don dam dbyings ni gcig dang du ma sogs/ /spros pas gos pa mi srid bden par grub/ /za ba la sogs stong gzhi'i chos can la/ /kun brtags kyis stong rnam rig tsam yod pa/ /kun rdzob bden dang stong pa'i gzhi mthun pa'o/ /de dag nam yang bden par ma grub pas/ /chos kun de dag bden med mtshan nyid can/ /stong gzhi —68—

don dam de des stong pa ni/ /thun mong tsam du don dam bden par 'dod/ /ye shes rnam pa kun ldan kun rdzob kyis/ /stong la rnam pa mthun pa'i dri ma rnams/ /ngos 'dzin phyir yin thun mong min pa'i lugs/ /'dus byas sogs la re re'i dgos pa'ang yod/ /phyi ma gnyis ni bcu bzhi kun la 'jug /mi dmigs stong nyid dngos po stong nyid dang / /rang mtshan gzhan mtshan stong pa rnams kyang bsnan/ /dus dang dngos med stong pa kun brtags dang / /lhag ma gnyis ni gzhan dbang yongs grub bo/ /yongs grub rnam grangs dgus bstan pa/ /dam pa'i don gyi bdag nyid de/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma la sogs dgus/ /mtshon pa'i don las log par bzhed/ /de bzhin nyid dang ma nor dang / /gzhan min chos nyid chos dbyings dang / /chos gnas skyon med yang dag mtha'/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i dbyings zhes bya/ /'jig med phyin ci log min dang / /'gyur med ngo bo nyid dang ni/ /rnam byang chos kyi rgyu nyid dang / /dus kun pa dang phyir mi ldog /de phyir dus dang rtog las 'das/ /rmi lam sgyu ma smig sgyu dang / /chu zla dri za'i grong khyer dang / /brag cha mig yor gzugs brnyan dang / /sprul pa bzhin no brdzun pa dgu/ /de las log pa don dam yin/ /brtags na ji ltar snang bzhin min/ /kun brtags chos rnams rmi lam 'dra/ /de las log pa de bzhin nyid/ /rtag tu yod de mi 'jig phyir/ /nor bar snang phyir chos thams cad/ /sgyu 'dra de las log pa ni/ /ma nor phyin log gdod nas med/ /gzhan du gnas la gzhan snang phyir/ /smig sgyu 'dra ba'i chos spangs pa/ /gzhan min dus gzhan mi 'gyur phyir/ /bdag nyid min la bdag por —69—

snang / /chu zla lta bu dgag don du/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas tshul te/ /ngo bo nyid la chos nyid brjod/ /don med dri za'i grong khyer 'dra/ /stobs sogs rnam byang chos kun kyi/ /don dam rgyu ni dbyings su bstan/ /don yod phyir na de bcad do/ /brag cha lta bur yin thung ba/ /log pas gnas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /sangs rgyas byung rung ma byung rung / /dus thams cad du yongs su grub/ /ma nges ngo bo mig yor 'dra/ /de spong phyir du skyon med bstan/ /nges pa bden pa'i don can te/ /rtogs na byang chub la zhugs pa'o/ /gzugs brnyan bzhin du rnam 'pho ba/ /med phyir yang dag mtha' yin te/ /de kho na nyid don dam la/ /yul dang blo yi 'pho 'gyur med/ /rtog ge las 'das bsam mi khyab/ /so so rang rig sgra rtog spangs/ /sems yid 'du byed spyod yul chos/ /sprul pa lta bur gdod nas dag /mdo tshig la 'khrul 'jig rten stobs ldan zer/ /lus gtsang ba dang bdag yun gnas pa dang / /'jig rten byed pos byas par khas longs shig /kun la mthun par snang ba rnyed par dka'/ /nyon mongs ye shes zhes pa 'di la dpyad/ /chos kun ma lus rang bzhin ye shes la/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog kho nar dpyad pas ci/ /rang ldog nyid nas ye shes yin na ni/ /rjes mthud rnam rtog yod med khyad ci yod/ /gnyis pa de yang ye shes yin phyir dang / /de la'ang rjes mthud med na mtshungs phyir ro/ /gdod nas skad cig dang po'i de mi srid/ /skad cig de yang dus mtha' mi mngon pas/ /bya rdzogs yin na las byed mngon sum mthong / /dang po ye shes yin na des bsags pa'i/ /las rnams zog pa med pa'i las su thal/ /rang bzhin —70—

yin yang dgos pas logs su smos/ /snyam na mi 'gal 'on kyang brda don 'khrul/ /rang bzhin shes na de 'gag de yod na/ /rang bzhin mi shes phyir na de gnyis 'gal/ /chos de las gzhan chos nyid btsal med sogs/ /lung la 'khrul nas gnas lugs yin 'dod rmongs/ /thabs mkhas khyad par ldan pas bsgyur ba na/ /lam du 'gyur bar kun la grags bzhin 'dod/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog yod/ /de la gnyis po yod ma yin/ /'di ni rnal 'byor kun rdzob gyi/ /mtha' gnyis sel dang spong ba'i tshul/ /stong pa nyid ni 'di la yod/ /de la yang ni de yod do/ /'di ni bden gnyis dbyer med tshul/ /'khor 'das sogs la'ang 'di ltar sbyor/ /rnam dbyer bcas pa'i glo bur gyis/ /stong dang rnam dbyer med chos can/ /bla med chos kyi mi stong pa/ khen tu thun mong min pa ste/ /'di ni don dam kho na la/ /mtha' gnyis sel ba'i tshul yin no/ /yod la yod dang med la med shes pa/ /gnas lugs tshul la rjes mthun shes pa yin/ /rang gi mtshan nyid spyi yi mtshan nyid dang / /brda dang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /yod med la sogs khyad par dbye bar bya/ /dang po'ang don dam mtshan ma da lta bar/ /yod pa'i dbye bas gsum du 'gyur ba yin/ /mtshan ma ming las don ni ma nor dang / /brda ni don la ming du ma nor ba/ /ma skyes 'gags zin gcig la gcig med dang / /gtan med kun rdzob med dang don dam med/ /med pa'i tshul yang so sor dbye bar bya/ /sems ni rtag tu rang bzhin 'od gsal 'dod/ /de ni glo bur nyes pas ma rung byas/ /chos nyid sems las gzhan pa'i sems gzhan ni/ /'od gsal ma yin rang bzhin la —71—

brjod do/ /chos med pa dang dmigs pa dang / /kun nas nyon mongs med rnam dag /sgyu ma la sogs 'dra ba dang / /de bzhin nam mkha' 'drar shes bya/ /stso tshe myol kyis rab tu phye ba ni/ /'khor ba yin te chos nyid kyis/ /rab tu phye ba theg gsum gyi/ /mya ngan las ni 'das pa'o/ /de la chos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /gnyis dang ji ltar mngon brjod par/ /snang ba'i yang dag min pa yi/ /kun rtog pa de med snang phyir/ /des na yang dag min pa'o/ /de yang thams cad don med cing / /rtog tsam yin pas kun rtog pa'o/ /gzhan yang chos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa dang / /brjod par bya dang rjod par byed/ /khyad med de bzhin nyid yin no/ /brtags pa dang ni shes pa dang / /de bzhin brjod par rags pa yin/ /don dang thob dang sgrub pa ni/ /don dam rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /don dam gnyis kyang gnas skabs su/ /bslu ba med phyir don dam brjod/ /kun brtags gzung 'dzin med par bden/ /gzhan dbang kun brtags bral bar bden/ /zhes pa bden pa gnyis gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste bdun pa'o// //theg gcig nyid dang dgra bcom sems bslad dang / /gang zag brgyad med la sogs drang don no/ /mthar thug theg gsum kyang ste theg gcig nyid/ /sde snod dgongs gcig mthar thug bgrod bya gcig /lam gyi ngo bo gcig ste byang chub sems/ /gnyis ni stong pa'i ye shes snying rje che/ /gsum ni de steng thabs kyi tshogs sgrub pa/ /bzhi ni chos la mos pa la sogs te/ /rgyu gsum 'dod 'ga' klu yi tshig la 'khrul/ /rnam grangs brjod na thabs mkhas —72—

la sogs 'chad/ /gtso bo brjod 'dod na ni snying rje dang / /byang chub sems kyi dbye ba lhag par 'gyur/ /chags dang sdang dang rmongs dang de'i/ /kun ldang drag dang bag chags dang / /mthong sgom lam spangs ma dag dang / /dag pa'i sa la brten pa yi/ /dri ma rnam dgu pad+ma yi/ /sbubs sogs dpes ni rab bstan te/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs sbubs kyi ni/ /dbye ba bye ba mtha' las 'das/ /nges 'byung snying rje rten 'brel zhi gnas dang / /bdag med stong nyid rig pas sgom la sbyor/ /chags sogs bzhi dang gsum gnyis gnyen por sbyar/ /chos sku gsum shes chos la mos pa thob/ /de bzhin nyid shes shes rab dam pa ste/ /rigs gnyis shes na de la nan tan du/ /gnas pa dgos par rig nas bsam gtan sbyor/ /sku gsum rigs shes 'gro la snying rje 'jug /snying po nges shes de ston chos la mos/ /sangs rgyas la sogs rjes dran gsum gyi sgo/ /de las shes rab de rjes gnon pa ni/ /zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i bsam gtan yin/ /de ltar ma rtogs 'gro 'a snying rje skye/ /yul la spros pa 'gog pa'i shes rab dang / /yul can mtshan ma 'gog pa'i dbye bas phye/ /gzugs dang mig rten shes rab skye ba sogs/ /gnas lugs mthong tshul thun mong min par 'dod/ byis pa nyer spyod bsam gto dang / /chos rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan dang / /de bzhin nyid dmigs bsam gtan dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge bsam gtan/ /snying rje sems can chos dang dmigs pa med/ /chos ni mdo sder dmigs kyi gzhan ma yin/ /sdug bsngal bdag med stong pa'i rgyu can las/ /snying por la dmigs snying rje khyad par 'phags/ /mi rtag bdag —73—

med stong pa snying po rnams/ /stong nyid tshul la'ang phyi ma phyi ma mchog /sgom pa'ang sangs rgyas snying por dmigs pas 'phags/ /de phyir sa la'ang dbye ba'i khyad par che/ /'di ni nam yang 'dor min gzhan rnams 'dor/ /sems zhus sems can dman la brnyas pa dang / /yang dag min 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ /bdag chags lhags pa'i skyon lnga 'di la med/ /rang stong tsam gyis 'di dag sel mi nus/ /spro ba che dang ston pa bzhin gus dang / khres rab ye shes bdag mtshungs byams chen skye/ /de ltar dad pa spyi dang khyad par bcas/ /skyabs su song zhing byang chub sems bskyed blangs/ /bsgom bya stong nyid snying rje mi gnas sbyor/ /sgom tshul thabs ni zhi gnas lhag mthong sbrel/ /thun mtshams spyod pa chos spyod lhag ma dgu/ /thabs mkhas yi rang mos pa bsngo ba dang / /yan lag bdun gyis dge ba spel bar bya/ /rtag tu tshul khrims sdom pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /sdig grogs spangs dang bshes gnyen dam pa bsten/ /sems gnas pa yi thabs dgu brten pa dang / /nyes pa lnga bsal spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad/ /brten tshul la sogs spyi dang mthun par bya/ /zas kyi tshod rig mi nyal rnal 'byor brtson/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod kho nar spyod/ /de las dang po'i las can sa thob 'gyur/ /de nas de dag sngon rol du/ /phan yon lnga ni thob 'gyur te/ /des na rnam par dag pa'i snod/ /bla na med pa nyid du 'gyur/ /lus la gnas ngan len pa kun/ /skad cig re re la zad 'gyur/ /lus dang sems ni kun tu yang / khren tu sbyangs pas gang bar 'gyur/ /chos kyi snang ba thams cad du/ /yongs su chad pa med rtogs 'gyur/ /yang dag pa yi rgyu mtshan —74—

ni/ /ma brtags pa dag rab tu mthong / /mngon shes don du gnyer bas de/ /sbyangs na las su rung ba'i mchog /bsam gtan la thob mngon par shes/ /mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo nas de/ /sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la/ /mchod pa'i phyir dang bsnyen pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni rnams su 'gro/ /de nas de 'drar gyur pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' mnyam bzhag pas/ /yid kyis brjod pa ma gtogs pa/ /don kun rab tu mi mthong ngo / /chos kyi snang ba 'phel bya'i phyir/ /brtson 'grus brtan pa kun tu brtson/ /chos kyi snang ba 'phel nas ni/ /sems tsam la ni gnas par 'gyur/ /de nas don du snang ba kun/ /sems su rab tu mthong bar 'gyur/ /de tshe de yi gzung ba yi/ /rnam par g.yeng ba de spong 'gyur/ /de nas de la 'dzin pa yi/ /rnam par g.yeng ba 'ba' zhig lus/ /de tshe bar chad med pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la myur du reg /'di ltar de yi mjug thogs su/ /'dzin pa'i rnam par g.yeng ba spong / /'di dag go rim bzhin du ni/ /dro bar 'gyur sogs yin zhes bya/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas dpag med la/ /bskal dpag med par bsnyen bkur byas/ /de la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i phyir/ /sems ni las rung mchog tu 'gyur/ /de tshe chos kyi rgyun las ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams la zhi gnas dang / /ye shes yangs pa thob bya'i phyir/ /gdams ngag rgya chen rnyed par 'gyur/ /de yi chos kun sgyu ma lta bu dang / /skye ba skyed mos tshal 'gro ltar rtogs nas/ /'byor ba'i dus dang rgud pa'i dus na 'di/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal dag gis 'jigs pa med/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi spyod yul ni/ /bdag med rnam pa gnyis po dang / /bdag tu —75—

'dzin pa'i rten dang ni/ /de ༷rtag (〈j-i〉rten) nyer zhi yin zhes bya/ /rnam par mi rtog rgyab kyi phyogs/ /rtag tu dga' dang ldan pa'o/ /yongs su shes dang spang ba dang / /mngon sum du ni bya phyir te/ /sems can rnams la phan bzhed pas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu nyid du/ /chos kyi sdoms ni rnam pa bzhi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bshad/ /brtan pa rnams kyi bzhi po 'di/ /med pa'i don dang rnam rtog don/ /kun tu rtog don kho na dang / /rnam rtog nye bar zhi ba'i don/ /de yang ting 'dzin gzungs dang chos kyi shugs/ /yon tan mtha' yas mos spyod sa 'dir thob/ /stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi dang ma 'dres chos/ /bco brgyad la sogs sems dpa'i yon tan mang / /nyan thos sogs dang thun mong mthong sgom gyi/ /spang bya mngon rgyu phal cher 'dir zlog 'gyur/ /de nas de ni 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i ye shes bla med pa/ /rnam par mi rtog dri ma med/ /'dzin pa gnyis dang bral ba 'thob/ /de 'dir gnas yongs gyur pa ste/ /sa ni dang po yin par 'dod/ /'di de bskal pa dpag med kyis/ /shin tu rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /chos kyi dbyings ni mnyam pa nyid/ /rab tu rtogs nas de yi tshe/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad la/ /bdag dang mtshungs pa'i sems thob ste/ /sems can rnams la bdag med dang / /sdug bsngal dang ni don bya dang / /lan mi re la 'di sems snyoms/ /rgyal sras gzhan dang 'dra ba yin/ /ched du mi spong lam bsgyur ma gtogs pa'i/ khams gsum gtogs pa'i nyon mongs thams cad dang / /mthong spangs rigs gyur shes bya snyoms 'jug sogs/ /sgrib mang sa bon skabs der zlog par —76—

'gyur/ /'jigs pa lnga bral ma dag lus spong ste/ /dbang po lnga rnams gnas gyur thob phyir ro/ /mthong lam ngo bo mnyam gzhag rigs gcig mod/ /ldog cha'i sgo nas skad cig tha dad 'jog /sgom spang mi spong bar du de yin zhing / /bsam mi khyab phyir dus ring gnas pa'ang srid/ /de nas 'di ni lhag ma yi/ /sa rnams sgom pa'i lam 'di la/ /ye shes rnam pa gnyis po dag /bsgom phyir rab tu sbyor bar byed/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes de/ /sangs rgyas chos ni sbyong bar byed/ /gzhan ni ji bzhin rnam 'jog pa/ /sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed/ /bdag med ye shes thob kyang ltung ba yi/ /rnam rtog phra mo shes bzhin min srid par/ /dang po nyid yin de spangs gnyis pa'o/ /ting 'dzin 'jig rten pa kun gcig char nus/ /thos pa kun 'dzin gsum pa yin par 'dod/ /byang phyogs dbang thob ting 'dzin chos srid zlog /bden bzhi la brten sems la dbang sgyur bas/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das la mngon phyogs min/ /de bzhin rten 'brel ches sgom 'gog thob las/ /'khor bas mi skyo dbyings la mngon du phyogs/ /g.yin ni rtsol bcas mtshan med dbang thob dang / /lhun grub mi skye chos la bzod pa dang / /so so rig bzhis zhing kun dga' bskyed dang / /chos sku bde gshegs snying po yongs rtogs pa/ /de dag yod med thob dang ma thob las/ /sa rnams gong nas gong du 'pho tshul shes/ /ji srid ji lta ji snyed shes bya la/ /gcig char chags thogs med pa'i ye shes ni/ /ma thob bar du byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /'on kyang 'di ni rjes mthun rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /kun tu 'gro don mchog gi don/ /rgyu mthun don gyi mchog nyid dang / /yongs su 'dzin —77—

pa med don dang / /rgyud rnams tha dad med don dang / /nyon mongs rnam dag min don dang / /tha dad med pa'i don nyid dang / /bri med 'phel ba med don dang / /dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yi gnas/ /de yang rnam par mi rtog bcas/ /zhing la dbang ba brgyad pa yin/ /dgu pa mnyam gzhag ye shes dbang / /bcu pa rjes thob las la dbang / /phyin bcu'ang sa bcur spyod pa dang / /zhing rnam du mar rnam smin tshul/ /'dzam gling dbang phyug nas brtsam nas/ /gnas gtsang bdag po'i bar du'o/ /so skye'i bskal pa'i bar gyi tshogs kyi tshad/ /sa thob pas ni skad cig re rer bsgrub/ /bdun pa man chad bskal pa stong gi tshogs/ /dag pa'i sa la gnas pas skad cig la'o/ /dbang bskur ma thob bskal pa grangs med pa'i/ /tshogs kyang de thob skad cig re rer bzlums/ /gsum pa'i 'jig rten ting 'dzin bsam gtan yang / khams gsum gyi min byang sems kho na'i yin/ /nyan thos rang rgyal thams cad rmongs 'gyur ba'i/ /ting 'dzin 'bum phrag bcu ni bdun par thob/ /spyod yul shes pas nyan rang kun zil gnon/ /dbang bsgyur ma gtogs nyon sgrib bag la nyal/ /thams cad sa 'dir shin tu rnam par dag /'di yi mthar ni mtshan 'dzin dag 'gyur bas/ /kun gzhi rigs mthun gcig gis zhing kun 'gro/ /dbang bskur thob la mthun mi mthun dbyer med/ /dbang bcu phra mo rab dga'i sa la thob/ /chen po phyag gi dbang bcas mi g.yo la'o/ /brgya dang stong phrag 'bum dang khrag khrig dang / /rab bkrams che dang dkrigs dang ded 'dren gyi/ /yon to rnams ni ma dag sa la 'dod/ /stong gsum sa ya grangs med sa ya dag /sa gnyis po la —78—

tshad de mos ngor gsungs/ /ting 'dzin sangs rgyas zhing g.yo der 'gro dang / /'od dang yongs smin bskal gnas mngon shes dang / /chos sgo 'khor bcas lus kyang ston par byed/ /chos sprin yon tan tshad las 'das pa ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang rjes su mthun/ /bstan dang gzugs sku dag dang ni/ /spyod dang spyod lam gyis kyang rung / /gang zhig ji ltar gang gis 'dul/ /des de de lta nyid du shes/ /de ltar nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /'gro la rtag tu lhun grub par/ /thogs med blo ldan de yis ni/ /sems can don ni yang dag 'grub/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'di ni/ /rjes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dang / /sems can yang dag sgrol ba la/ /'jig rten na ni mnyam pa nyid/ /sa rnams kun la blo ldan gyi/ /rab byung len pas thob pa dang / /chos nyid kyis ni thob pa gzhan/ /rab tu byung bar ston byed yin/ /blo ldan rnams kyi las dang ni/ /gzhan yang smon lam dag dang ni/ /ting nge 'dzin dang dbang 'byor ba'i/ /dbang gis skye bar 'dod pa yin/ /mos spyod par ni ting 'dzin lus thob la/ /'phags sar dbang lnga gnas gyur yid lus te/ /ting 'dzin bde la snyoms 'jug sa bdun la/ /chos kyi de nyid khong chud gnyis la'o/ /ris su lhan skyes 'du byed bde ba ni/ /dbang bskur mchog thob sangs rgyas sar brjod do/ /don dam 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug thob pa dang / /bdag lta'i bag chags yid ni log gyur pas/ /rtsa ba sprul pa'i dbyer med zhing kun tu/ /lus dang yo byad zhing khams dpag med ston/ /dman pa'i dgra bcom phung po rags pa bor/ /dang por yid lus der thob 'od kyis bskul/ /de tshe mthu ldan yid —79—

lus thob ces bya/ /lhag bcas rnams kyi dbang po'i lus de yang / /theg chen lus thob tshe ni bskal par gnas/ /de la brten nas yid kyi lus bsgrub bo/ /slob pa 'dod par smon lam sprul pas bsgrub/ /lhag med rang gis mi shes mthu dang bral/ /mos spyod rags lus gzhan du ma gyur pas/ /de dag yid lus dngos su mi 'jog la/ /rdzogs sangs sku ni ye shes nyag gcig yin/ /yid lus de dag bco brgyad khams dang bral/ /ye shes dbang pas ye shes 'dod yon spyod/ /bsam gyis mi khyab 'chi 'pho skye ba ston/ /'jig rten 'das de'i bla ma'i dge rtsa las/ /byung zhes mdo las zhing khams mang la gsungs/ /bde ba can sogs lam gyi bden pa dang / /'og min chen po 'gog pa'i snang bar 'dod/ /ting 'dzin lus thob mngon par dga' ba dang / /yid lus dang po bde ba can zhing dbang / /gnyis pa rnam snang zhing gnon gsum pas ni/ /'og min chen po la yang dbang ba yin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /thun mong dge las de snang ste/ /rgyal ba kho na'i dge ba ni/ /rang snang 'og min r+ṣa po'o/ /mi mthun pa dang gnyen po dang / /de bzhi nyid dang rtog pa yi/ /rags 'bring phra mo ring rjes 'brel/ /rtog pa bzhi ni rim gyis spong / /sgra yi rjes 'gro bzod pa 'di bstan te/ /bsam pas sgom pa rjes su mthun pa dang / /thos pa las byung de ni skye ba med/ /'di la gang bslabs de ni byang chub lam/ /dang po mos spyod gnyis pa rab dga' dang / /gsum pa mi g.yo'i sa yin de gsum la/ /rang dang 'tsham par rgyal bas der lung ston/ /rgyas par mdo nyid gsal ba mnyan par bya/ /dbang rnon sems ma bskyed pa'ang lung ston —80—

srid/ /dbang rtul sems bskyed lung ston nga rgyal can/ /lkog tu lung ston de gsum ma nges la/ /bzod thob dngos su lung ston rgyas gsal nges/ /grangs med gnyis ni rdzogs pa yis/ /sgom pa yi ni mthar phyin te/ /sgom pa'i tha ma thob nas ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbang bskur ba/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ /rtog pa'i mi shigs thob nas ni/ /gnas gzhan gyur pa mthar thug pa/ /sgrib pa kun gyi dri med pa/ /gang la gnas na sems can kun/ /phan phyir rab tu sgrub byed la/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /go 'phang bla na med pa 'thob/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ /spros bral ye shes don dam rnam kun can/ /kun rdzob snang ba med kyang kun mkhyen pa/ /chos nyid gdod ma de ni chos kyi sku/ /bden phyir snang dang gcig phyir ji lta bas/ /rang nyid rang snang rang rig tshul du mkhyen/ /rnam pa thams cad pa ni ji snyed mkhyen/ /kun rdzob ji snyed pa yi chos nyid du/ /song ba'i tshul gyis de dang de mkhyen te/ /dngos su snang ba min yang 'gro rnams la/ /de der snang ba nges par mkhyen pa nyid/ /mngon shes ldan pas gzhan gyi rmi lam bzhin/ /de nyid rang snang zhing dang sku dang 'khor/ /ma chod pa gsung dbyangs bcas pa longs sku dngos/ /stug po'i zhing na nges pa lnga ldan pa/ /de ni gzhan don snang tshul longs spyod rdzogs/ /gnas gtsang chen por sprul pa'i sku re las/ /'dzam gling sogs su bye ba phrag brgya ston/ /mchog gi sprul sku rtsa ba yan lag gnyis/ /sprul ba po ni thugs rjes dbyings nyid du/ /rang snang mdzad pa ston pa de nyid yin/ /stong dang gsal dang snying rje'i ye shes las/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul —81—

pa shar/ /chags rtog gnas gyur bde chen sku yang 'dod/ /rnam shes rigs rgyun gnas gyur ye shes lnga/ /gzhan snang 'gro don rgyu yin dus mnyams 'dres/ /skad cig gnyis pa gsar thob rnams la 'jug /dngos la kun rdzob chos ni der gnas min/ /rtsa ba'i rnam shes chos dbyings 'dra mtshungs dang / /me long dngos ni rnam smin cha ru 'dod/ /chos dbyings ye shes don dam kho na ste/ /gzhan rnams kun rdzob don dam gnyis su dbye/ /don dam ye shes lnga ni ngo bo gcig /phung po lnga sogs chos dbyings kho nar gnas/ /chos kyis phye na rnam shes me long lta/ /mnyam nyid tshor dang 'du shes so sor rtog /'du byed bya sgrub gzugs ni chos dbyings sbyor/ /don dam chos kun gzigs dang spros pas dben/ /rnam kun mkhyen dang mdzad 'phrin don kun mkhyen/ /rnam par mi rtog rnam pa thams cad pa'o/ /gsar thob cha ni ye shes bzhi la yod/ /ji lta mkhyen dang ji lta'i cha nas mnyam/ /ji snyed mkhyen dang kun rdzob las kun mkhyen/ /sems yid yid shes dbang rnams gnas gyur te/ /lam bden dang pos chos nyid yul du byas/ /de 'og gsar byung lam bden gzhan la 'dres/ /de phyir 'di ni dngos po yin phyir 'jig /chos dbyings gdod ma yin la 'jig pa med/ /kun gyi rang bzhin yin phyir sku gsung sogs/ /kun khyab drang gis rang bzhin min na min/ /sangs rgyas don dam yin yang de thob pa/ /kun rdzob blo dang sbyar nas rnam par gzhag /ngo bo dbyer med rnam pa kun 'char ba/ /rtag la rim pa lta bu mang mtha' yas/ /don dam phyogs la 'gal 'dus skyon med de/ /bsam gyis mi khyab spyod yul kho na'i phyir/ /yon tan sde —82—

tshan bcu dgu la sogs te/ /mkhyen pa'i phyogs nas stobs bcu gtso bor smros/ /gzhan la phan mdzad thugs rje chen po ste/ /rnam grangs sgo nas bcu drug dbye bar 'dod/ /thugs rje de las 'phrin las zad med 'byung / /'gro rnams sdug bsngal chung dang zad par mdzad/ /'khor ba'i bde dge nyan thos rang rgyal dang / /byang chub mchog la dbang po'i rim pas 'god/ /skal ldan mchog la mi sbyor mi srid de/ /skal dman rnams ni rang gi las dang sbyor/ /cho 'phrul gsum ni sngon du 'gro ba ste/ /don dam bde mdzad 'phrin las mthar thug go /brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs pa dang / /nyi ma nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra brnyan bzhin/ /nam mkha' dang ni sa bzhin no/ /ston dang gsung dang khyab pa dang / /sprul dang ye shes spro ba dang/ /thugs gsung sku yi gsang ba dang / /thugs rje rnams kyi 'phrin las dpe/ /de ltar sku dang ye shes dang / /snying rnams kyi ni khyad par dang / /yon to rnams dang 'phrin las te/ /don 'di 'bras bur shes par bya/ /zhes pa lam dang 'bras bu gtan la dbab pa'i rab tu byed pa ste brgyad pa'o// //gzhung lugs shin tu rgya che'i nang nas 'di/ /mdo tsam blangs te gzhan la phan par nus/ /bdag gi rnam par rtog pa'i rigs pa'ang 'ga'/ /don dang mthun na 'gal ba med snyam bris/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos 'di skal ba mchog /blo ldan 'ga' yis spyod yul kho na las/ /grub par rlom dang mkhas pa cher grags pa/ /mang po'i bsod nams skal bar 'di ma shong / /don dam rang stong lta ba'i sher phyin mdo/ /skye bar sbyangs pa bas kyang tshul 'di la/ /mos —83—

pas lan cig bklags pa'ang ches mchog nyid/ /mi mthun bgegs rnams sel bar kun tu mthong / /rang stong mkhas pa'i gzhung la thos bsam sgom/ /lo brgyar 'bad las byams pa'i gzhung lugs kyi/ /glegs bam spyi bor blangs ba'ang byang chub nye/ /der 'bad ngan 'gro'i lam yang ma khegs dang / /'dir mos brtson pa bral ba'ang lhar 'gro ba'i/ /mtshan ma mngon gyur grags shing grub phyir te/ /bde dang phun tshogs thar ba'ang de dang mtshungs/ /skal bzang yod na lam 'dir 'bad par rigs/ /de skad smra ba tā ra nā tha ste/ /blun yang mos pa'i dge ba phun tshogs kyis/ /gya nom thob pas chos la dad pa dang / /phan sems brtse bar ldan pa'i dbang gis so/ /zhes theg mchog shin tu rgyas pa'i dbu ma chen po rnam par nges pa las/ rtsa ba'i grub mtha' bstan pa 'di ni/7kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal rtag brtan dam pa'i chos kyi gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gtsug lag khang chen por sbyar ba'o/ /gcig zhus/ dge'o/ /maṅga laX/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /'di bzhengs dge ba'i zla zer gyis/ /bstan 'gro'i legs dge kun mud tshal/ /yongs rgyas dga' ston gsar ba'i dpal/ /srid mtha'i bar du nyams med shog/ //—84—

pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnad bstan bcos yid bzhin nor bu lta bu snying po nges pa zhes bya ba grub mtha'i mthar thugs bzhugs/na mo gu ru bzhi bo dhi satwa ār+ya ga ṇi khyuX gdod ma'i sangs rgyas mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs snying po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun khyab chos sku de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi bzhugs tshul rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen pa'i dngos/ /brtse ldan dol po pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /yang cig gsol ba 'debs so nges don gyi/ /chos 'di srid gsum kun tu dar bar shog /klu rgyal rgya mtsho'i gting nas mtho ris 'dzegs/ /tshangs pa'i rnam 'phrul sa 'og bar du 'bab/ /bcom ldan sa steng bzhugs nas srid gsum khyab/ /rigs dang chos sku rang bzhin gsum gyi dpe/ /sangs rgyas rigs la de 'dras nyer btags pa/ /kun rdzob gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas thabs yin/ /chos dang chos nyid dbye ba mi 'byed par/ /sems sam sems can sangs rgyas rigs su 'dod/ /nges pa'i don du rigs mchog chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam shes brgyad po ye shes rnam bzhi dang / /chos dbyings dag pa gnyis ldan ye shes dang / /phung po lnga yang ye shes rnam lnga dang / /sngags kyi theg par de dag rigs lnga dang / /dbang po yul bcas —85—
