sems dpa' yab yum dang / /'byung ba rnam lnga bcom ldan 'das ma dang / /lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs gsum dang / /bzhi pa'i thig le ye shes rdo rje sogs/ /gnas gyur dbye ba rnam pa du ma dang / /sgrib bral dbye ba'ang ji snyed gsungs gyur pa/ /gnas gyur thams cad kun rdzob kho na'i yin/ /sgrib bral zhes pa gnyis ka'i phyogs la brten/ /dngos rgyun gcig la mtshan nyid ngan pa dor/ /bzang po'i gnas skabs 'dzin pa gnas gyur te/ /sra ba'i dngos po gcig la lcags kyi mdog /spangs nas gser du gyur pa lta bu yin/ /sgrib bral zhes pa dngos de ma 'gyur yang / /phyi rol sgrib byed glo bur spangs pa'i don/ /rang bzhin mi 'gyur don dam phyogs yin te/ /glo bur spangs pa kun rdzob phyogs la brten/ /gnas gyur la ni 'gyur bar byed po dang / /sgrib bral la yang bral byed lam yin te/ /de yang gzhi 'bras gnyis dang mthun pa zhig /bsgom na nges pa'i don gyi lam du 'gyur/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal tshad med bzhi la sogs/ /dmigs pa kun rdzob yin yang de kho na/ /cung zad yid la byed phyir 'dres mar yod/ /de bzhin bskyed rim phra thig las rgya sogs/ /phal cher mos pa yid byed drang don lam/ /'on kyang cha shas tsam gyis nges don 'dres/ /de phyir gnas lugs rtogs pa'i ring rgyu yin/ /rjes dpag rigs pas dpyad pa'i stong nyid dang / /kun rdzob rang sor 'jog pa'i rtog med kyang / /don spyi tsam dang dngos la dmigs pa'i phyir/ /nges don de nyid kho na yid byed min/ /rang bzhin bde gshegs snying po bsgom pa dang / khyad chos rgyal ba'i yon tan bsam pa gnyis/ /rnam rtog bral ba'i yid kyis 'go bsdus —86—

na/ /de ni nges don bde gshegs lam mchog yin/ /kun rdzob gzhi de 'bras bu'i kun rdzob dang / /'dra bar gnas pa'ang lam 'dis rgyas par byed/ /don dam la ni 'phel 'grib med mod kyi/ /sgrib g.yog bral bar byed pa'ang sgom 'di yin/ /gzhi dang 'bras bu 'dra chos yod pas na/ /gzhi la bcos na de rgyun 'bras bur 'gyur/ /gser phye mchod sdong rang bzhin 'dra ba la/ /bcos pas sngar gyis mchod sdong 'dra bar 'byung / /de bzhin rnam shes ye shes phyogs 'dra dang / /rnam shes thabs kyis bsgyur na sngar yod kyi/ /ye shes rnams dang 'dra bar 'gyur pa'i phyir/ /rigs zhes zer te kun rdzob kho na'i yin/ /nyer len rgyu dang rigs mthun 'dra chos rigs/ /de sgra phyogs mthun de yi rang bzhin dang / /de dang de dbyer med la rigs so zhes/ /'jog pa 'di ni don dam phyogs la 'o/ /don dam rigs ni skyed byed don min te/ khyu yi ming yang rang bzhin nyid la 'dogs/ /nye ring med pa'i dbyings de rgyu dang rigs/ /gcig nyid blo la 'dra bar snang ba yin/ /'jig rten na yang gcig la 'dra ba'i sgra/ /yod phyir tha snyad tshul dang 'gal ba min/ /'di rgyu gser las grub ces zer ba ltar/ /chos dbyings de ni rang bzhin phyir na rgyu/ /chu shing snying po med la 'bras snying dpe/ /thos dang zag med sa bon gsal stong rigs/ /de yi 'khor ba zad na mi slob lam/ /'di la'ang kun rdzob nyid las snying bor btags/ /zhes pa ni rigs kyi rnam par bzhag pa'o// //yang cig shes rab rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /snying por sangs rgyas bzhugs tshul 'dir bshad bya/ /don dam snying po gtan la 'beb pa na/ /go —87—

bas blo yis rtogs tshul rnam pa gnyis/ bral 'bras chos sku 'bras bur smos ci dgos/ /lam dang 'khor ba'i chos la mar 'gebs dang / /gzhi yi chos nyid 'khor bar smos ci dgos/ /lam dang 'bras bu la yang yar snyog go /sangs rgyas ye shes sems can tshogs zhugs ni/ /tshangs pa'i sprul ba sa la 'bab pas mtshon/ /skabs 'dir don gyi gtso bo 'di yin te/ /bcom ldan shākya seng ge'i chos sku de/ /sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi rgyan dang ldan/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid la de nyid khyab/ /lus ngag yid ni log snang 'khrul snang tsam/ /bag chags yid kyis 'khrul ba'i snang ba bskyed/ /sgyu ma'i rgyu las sgyu ma'i 'bras bu 'byung / /snang tshul kho na yin gyi gnas tshul min/ /bdag la khyab pa'i shāka thub chos sku de/ /'gro la snang tshul ma yin gnas tshul yin/ /bdag rang med pa'i gnas na de nyid yod/ /bdag ni 'khrul snang de ni ma 'khrul ba/ /bdag ni rdzun pa de ni bden par grub/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal de ni bde ba'i mchog /bdag ni mi rtag de ni rtag pa'i gtso/ /bdag ni kun btags de ni yongs grub yin/ /shāka thub chos sku de ni sangs rgyas dngos/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las thams cad de yi yin/ /stobs bcu mi 'jigs la sogs lta ci smos/ /mtshan dpe la sogs yon tan kun dang ldan/ /de la sku yod gsung dang thugs kyang yod/ /sku gang yin pa gsung dang thugs kyang yin/ /bdag dang bdag la bzhugs pa'i shāka thub dang / /g.ya' dang gser gyi tshul du gnas pa yin/ /na bun ri bo'i dpe yis mtshon pa yin/ /de la sogs pa dpe ni mtha' yas yod/ /bdag la de 'dra'i shāka thub bzhugs pa de/ /bdag gis ma mthong grogs kyis mi mthong —88—

la/ /'khor ba'i sems can kun gyis mthong mi 'gyur/ /nyan thos sogs kyis dad pas rtogs bya tsam/ /sa bdun gnas pas kyang ni mngon sum min/ /mdzod nang nor bzhin phyogs 'go things pa tsam/ /dag sar gnas pas zur tsam 'ol spyi tsam/ /mtha' dag ma lus gzigs pa sangs rgyas nyid/ /chos sku de ni gdod nas spros dang bral/ /spros dang bral ngo shes pas bden par grub/ /ci yang min pa'i spros bral zhes bya ba/ /yid la byas na rtag tu spros pa yin/ /nam yang blos ma byas par grol 'gyur na/ /'khor ba snod bcud thams cad rang grol 'gyur/ /don spyi sgom pa thams cad rtog par zad/ /spros med dngos ni rang rig ye shes so/ /de ltar bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ shwakya thub pa mnyam par bzhag pa bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor mchog dang ldan pas sangs rgyas mthong / /'di thos rtog ge ba rnams khro zhing 'khrug /tshangs par gyur kyang chos spong las kyis bsregs/ /de bas grong ba'i skye bo phal ba rung / /ji ltar bdag la shākya'i rgyal po yi/ /ye shes sku de bzhugs pa ji bzhin du/ /pha ma phu nu 'khor g.yog kun la'ang yod/ /gnyen la de yod dgra la de yod de/ /lha dang dmyal ba dud 'gro kun la'ang yod/ /'gro drug sems can kun la'ang de 'dra bzhugs/ /byung dang 'byung 'gyur sems can thams cad la'ang / /lha mo sgyu 'phrul sras de rtag tu bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor can 'gas de dag so sor mthong / /sangs rgyas nyid kyis gzigs na thams cad gcig /bdag la bzhugs pa'i go tam de kho na/ /sems can kun la khyab par bzhugs pa yin/ /gzhan la bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan bde gshe/gas las/ / gzhan pa bdag —89—

la'ang med de ngo bo gcig /chos sku shin tu rgya che sna tshogs 'di/ /de yi khongs su chud par gyur na yang / /chos rnams kun gyi nang na de mchog phyir/ /gtso dang gces pa'i don gyi snying po yin/ khres bya kun la nye ring med phyir dang / /chos rnams thams cad gnas tshul gcig phyir dang / /sems las gzhan du phyi rol med phyir dang / /sems kyi chos nyid sems la khyab pa'i phyir/ /bdag la bzhugs pa'i nyi ma'i gnyen mchog de/ /brtan g.yo srid zhi kun la khyab pa yin/ /bgrod bya lam lnga sa bcu kun la khyab/ /bsgom bya byang phyogs phar phyin kun la khyab/ /phung po khams dang skye mched kun la khyab/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis bden pa rnam bzhi dang / /rags dang phra ba mtshan mtsho ni gzhi gsum sogs/ /kun gyi srog dang dwangs mar 'di nyid bzhugs/ shwakya'i rigs kyi thig le'i chos sku de/ /bcom ldan 'od srung chos sku'ang de kho na/ /rnam gzigs mar me mdzad kyi'ang de kho na/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi chos sku de/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i chos sku yin/ /bde gshegs go tam chen po'i chos sku las/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku g.yin yod min/ /'od dpag med dang mi 'khrugs la sogs pa/ /da lta'i sangs rgyas kun gyi chos sku dang / /byams pa snang mdzad la sogs ma 'ongs pa'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku'ang de dang 'dra/ /kun rdzob sangs rgyas dus gsum byung ba rnams/ /lam bden nyid yin de dag thams cad kyi/ /spyi nor don dam chos kyi sku yin pas/ /chos sku gnyis su med de kun la khyab/ /chos sku 'di ni 'das pa'i dus tshad yod/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis 'di mngon mdzad/ /'das pa'i dus kyis 'di la ma gos pas/ /—90—

da ltar phyi ma'i dus la 'di nyid gnas/ /'das dus bzhin du dus gnyis po la'ang sbyar/ /dus tshad kun na yod kyang dus spangs pa/ /da lta'i sangs rgyas kun gyis 'di rtogs shing / /ma byon sangs rgyas kun gyis shāka thub kyi/ /chos sku 'di nyid mngon du mdzad 'gyur gyi/ /chos sku gzhan zhig mngon du 'gyur ba min/ /dus la ji bzhin phyogs la'ang sbyar bya ste/ /yul tshad kun la yod kyang yul dang bral/ /sangs rgyas skyes bu ji snyed thams cad kyi/ /spyi nor yin pas shākya seng ge'i yang / /yin phyir shāka thub chos sku zhes su grags/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas kun la'ang bsgre bar bya/ /spyi nor de ni brtan thub nor gyi mchog /sgos nor lam bden chos rnams ya ma brla/ /de phyir shes bya kun gyi gnas tshul ni/ shwaka thub yin te 'od srung sogs kyang yin/ /sangs rgyas gcig kyang yin la kun kyang yin/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas tshul sangs rgyas yin/ /de nigatsang bde rtag bdag pha rol phyin/ /'bras bu'i sangs rgyas zer yang gnas lugs yin/ /snod bcud 'khor 'das rten 'brel chos rnams kun/ /rang tshugs mi thub bdag med snang tshul tsam/ /sangs rgyas de yi 'od kyis dge blo 'byung/ /dge ba rgyas pas 'khrul snang rang sar sangs/ /de tshe sangs rgyas skyes bu chos skur reg /de la snang tshul gnas tshul tha dad med/ /rang snang dang po grol lam khyad par bcas/ /de rjes chos sku'i ngo bor de nyid thim/ /de nas gzhan snang gzugs sku rtag tu 'byung / /gzugs sku gnyis dang lam bden gyis bsdus pa'i/ /bde gshegs de ni sangs rgyas tsam po ba/ /sangs rgyas dngos rang de ni chos sku'o/ /zhes pa ni sangs rgyas nyid snying por rnam par bzhag pa'o//—91—

da dung kun mkhyen che la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo yi rtogs tshul gnyis pa 'di ltar go /rang bzhin dri med de ni gnyis med de/ /bcom ldan sa steng bzhugs pa'i dpe dang 'dra/ /bum pa'i rang bzhin chos nyid ces bya ba/ /gdod nas gzung 'dzin gnyis bral ye shes te/ /de ni don dam de ni stong nyid dang / /de ni brjod bral de ni spros bral dang / /de ni mtha' bral rang bzhin sher phyin no/ /de nyid rtag chad mtha' las gdod nas 'das/ /yod mtha' med mtha' yin min mtha' dang bral/ /rgyu 'bras ma yin gcig min du ma min/ /yul dang yul can dbye ba 'di la med/ /rtogs bya rtogs byed rim pa kun bral yang / /ci med cang med ci yang ma yin tsam/ /gang du'ang mi gnas tsam gyi stong nyid min/ /de 'dra yin na dngos med tsam du 'gyur/ /de yang 'dod na mngon sum rtogs mi srid/ /rtog pas rtogs na spros pa'i tha shal yin/ /ma rtogs par 'dod 'bad pa don med 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di ni spros kun gyis dben pa'i/ /rang rig rang gsal gdod ma gcig tu yod/ /de yi khyad par rnam pa thams cad pa/ /srid 'das kun gyi rnam pa yod tshad du/ /gdod nas rtag tu gcig char shar bzhin pa/ khar yang de rnams kun gyis ma gos pa/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i yul spangs kyang / /ye shes gzugs sogs kun tu yod yod pa/ /mig sogs dbang bo'i lus ni spangs gyur kyang / /don dam mig sogs kun tu gnas gnas pa/ /tshogs brgyad sems byung rnam rtog kun bral yang / /chos nyid rig pa mtha' yas shar shar ba/ /de sogs shes bya kun la sbyar bar bya/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med par dgongs/ /phyogs kyis ma gos —92—

dus kyis ma gos kyang / /phyogs dus kun gyi rnam pa 'char ba'i phyir/ /dus gsum dus med rtogs pa'i ye shes so/ /dus rnams kun tu byung yang rtag pa dang / /rnam pa kun tu byung yang spros bral ba/ /'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab mtshan nyid de/ /'phags mchog rnams kyis mngon sum nyid du gzigs/ /rgya bod yul gyi skal chad thos rlom can/ /thams cad 'di thos tsam na snying khrag bskam/ /de phyir ri chos gsang ba zab mo yin/ /srid tshad kun gyi rnam par gnas pa'i phyir/ /skyob pa kun gyi yon tan 'di la yod/ /'di nyid bde gshegs chos sku dngos nyid yin/ /bde gshegs snying po yon tan can zhes bya/ /bum pa'i dngos la bde gshegs snying po bzhugs/ /gnas tshul chos nyid de yin bum pa min/ /bum pa zhes bya nam yang yod ma myong / /bum par snang ba de ni 'khrul snang tsam/ /de yi shul na gnyis med ye shes yod/ /de ni rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung nyid/ /bum pa'i chos dbyings de ltar yin pa bzhin/ /ka ba sogs kyi dbyings kyang de dang 'dra/ /de yi rigs pas 'byung ba 'byung gyur dang / /gtso bo rnam shes 'khor dang bcas pa dang / /yul dus skye 'gag la sogs chos kun gyi/ /rang bzhin gnas lugs bde bar gshegs pa yin/ /de ltar yin na sems can thams cad kyi/ /gnas lugs bde gshegs yin pa smos ci dgos/ /gnas lugs gzung 'dzin gnyis bral ye shes kyi/ /cha nas 'phags mchog kun gyis gcig tu gzigs/ /de nyid yon tan can gyi snying po sa /gzigs pa rnams la'ang so sor snang ba yod/ /sgrib kun bral na tha dad snang ba med/ /so sor snang ba thams cad 'khrul ba ste/ khres bya'i sgrib pa yin —93—

pas de zad na/ /rang snang nyid la chos sku las gzhan med/ /sangs rgyas ye shes kho na'i spyod yul na/ /sangs rgyas las g.yin snang ba cung zad med/ /de nyid phyin ci ma log rang snang ste/ /chos sku las gzhan gang mthong log snang yin/ /bdag gzhan 'khor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa/ /nges par yod kyang mthong ba ma yin pas/ /sbas pa'i tshul du 'dug phyir snying por 'dod/ /de ni sems can rnams kyis rgyu mtshan la/ /brten nas snying por 'jog tshul gcig yin no/ /chos nyid dge ba yin pas dge sems 'byung / /lam rnams 'di las byung zhing 'di yis khyab/ khres bya kun gyi chos kyi dbyings 'di la/ /rtogs pa po ni sangs rgyas kho na'i phyir/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi chos skur mtshan yang gsol/ /dam pa'i don gyi sems can sangs rgyas gcig /lus ngag yid gsum 'dus pa'i phung po ni/ /brda tsam dbang gis kun rdzob sems can te/ /skyes bur 'jog pa kun rdzob sgo nas brjod/ /chos can ming gis sbyor na kun rdzob gtso/ /sangs rgyas sogs la don dam gtso bor rig /rdzogs sangs rgyas la kun rdzob mi snang yang / /rnam pa thams cad nyid kyis ji snyed mkhyen/ /'khor 'das de bzhin nyid dbyer med ces pa/ /phan tshun 'dra ba tsam la 'jog pa 'khrul/ /dngos med yin na ldog rkyang tsam du zad/ /de la tha dad 'dra mtshan ji bzhin med/ /gal te dngos yin ngo bo tha dad na/ /rnam pa kun tu 'dra ba srid ma yin/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis kyang de nyid 'di/ /mi rtag du ma nyid la shin tu 'gal/ /dri bcas 'khor ba la 'brel zhi la med/ /dri med srid —94—

la nam yang ma 'brel na/ /snga ma ji bzhin phyi ma gang na ci/ /dri bcas dri med dngos tha dad phyir ro/ /skad cig yin na dus rdzo so sor 'brel/ /so so la yang rang ngo tha dad phyir/ /phan tshun mtshan nyid mi 'dra du mas gos/ /phan tshun ji bzhin 'dra zhes zer ba blun/ khyad par mi 'dra ci yang mi srid na/ /de ni ngo bo gcig pa'i dan rtags yin/ /'dra bzhin mnyam mtshungs thal ches gcig tu go /chos dbyings gdod nas dri med dri bral yin/ /de bzhin nyid la dri bcas nam yang med/ /sems can la bltos dri bcas rnam bzhag tsam/ /dag pa gnyis ldan zhes byar don la med/ /sangs rgyas skyes bu'i ngos nas bzhag pa tsam/ /chos kyi dbyings la 'khor 'das yod min pas/ /dri mas bcing dang gsar du grol ba med/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos kun la/ /chos sku 'di ni mgon du yod pa'i phyir/ /brtags ngor de bzhin nyid la gnyis so zhes/ /dpyad pa med pa'i tshul du 'jog pa yin/ /ngo bo gcig dang tha dad las grol kyang / /du mar med phyir gcig gi ming 'jug pa/ /de bzhin nyid de shes bya kun la khyab/ /kun gyi spyi la bzhugs pa nyid kyi phyir/ /lha mi dud 'gro ri dang thang la sogs/ /so so tha dad bye brag snang grags pa/ /re re kun gyi'ang de bzhin nyid du 'gyur/ /'on kyang so sor med de spyi la khebs/ /rtag nyid phyir na dus gsum kun khyab cing / /cha med nyid phyir yul kun gcig car khyab/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin/ /sems can kun gyi'ang de bzhin nyid du yod/ /de phyir sems can snying po can du gsungs/ /dngos kyi sangs rgyas de bzhin nyid phyir ro/ /de bzhin nyid de 'gyur med rtag pa'i phyir/ /mngon —95—

du gyur ram ma gyur gang yin yang / /snying po nyid de sra ba'i don phyir ro/ /zhes pa ni de bzhin nyid rnam par gzhag pa'o// //slar yang rton pa bzhi ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /rigs nyid phyir na rigs de 'phel ba'i phyir/ /drang don thabs kyi lam la 'jug kyang dgos/ /spyo da pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo yang de/ /sangs rgyas khyab pa'i phyir na rjes dran sgoms/ /yon tan mtha' yas de las mos pa skye/ /'khor 'das kun la de bzhin nyid gcig pas//dmigs pa tha dad med de chos dbyings nyid/ /chos la mos pas sangs rgyas rjes dran bsgom/ /de yang snying por yon tan nges pa yin/ /chos nyid yul du byed pa shes rab dang / /de bsgom mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis su dbye/ /mnyam gzhag zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'jug /zhi lhag gnyis kar rtog bral ma 'khrul ba/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i sgo nas dbye ba yod/ /rjes thob rang bzhin snang ba'i dbye ba shes/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu gtso bor sgormes/ /shes rab bsam gtan zhes bya de la 'dus/ /mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis kar snying rje che/ /phal cher de yi spyod pa rjes thob na'o/ /'di la rnam kun rdzogs pa'i sgrub pa dang / /cha shas tsam la dpyad kyang don ldan 'gyur/ /rtsa ba'i tshul khrims byang sdom spyod la gnas/ /thub pa'i bstan la so sor thar pa bzhi/ /de yang de yi sngon 'gro rten du 'gyur/ /gal te gsang ba'i theg pa la mos na/ /dam tshig gis ni de nyid mchog tu byed/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la yid ches mos ldan pas/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /rjes dran gzhan dag de yi rjes 'gro nyid/ /chos nyid don la rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /gal te mtshan mar —96—

'dzin na gnyen po bsten/ /snang bar bcas dang snang ba med par spyod/ /'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can yin pas/ /gang zag med cing phung sogs chos med kyang / /bdag mtshungs byams dang snying rje phyogs med sgoms/ /ji srid 'byung ba yod cing rnam rtog yod/ /de srid brtson 'grus drag pos dge la sbyor/ /de nyid gzhan gyi don du byang chub bsngo/ /ring por mi thogs bzod pa thob par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan mchog bzhi rim dang gcig car 'grub/ /rang ngam gzhan la sangs rgyas rtag bzhugs na/ /de mi bzhugs par lta ba log lta yin/ /thogs med spyan ldan sangs rgyas drung 'dug kyang / /rang gis ma mthong bag med spyod dang mtshungs/ /'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can yin na/ /snying po med snyam skur 'debs chad par lta/ /sems can rgyu yi rigs la dmigs pa dang / /'bras bus sangs rgyas chos la dmigs nas skur/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis ka'i phyogs la skur pa btab/ /dngos la yod kyang med par lta ba ni/ /bden gnyis gnas skabs gang du'ang skur 'debs nyid/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas min snyam pa/ /rgyal la rnam mkhyen med par smra dang mtshungs/ /rtag pa 'jig par smra ba chad lta ste/ /cho 'phrul che tshe mu stegs ston pa drug /go tam me yis tshig ces zer dang mtshungs/ /sangs rgyas rtag pa la dang sems can rnams/ /snying po can du smra la skur 'debs pa/ /de dag phal cher mi bzad dmyal bar 'gro/ /'jim gzugs tsam la'ang co 'dri skur 'debs pa/ /de yang ngan 'gror 'gyur na 'dir ci smos/ /sangs rgyas la dmigs 'jig dang sdug bsngal zer/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu tshe thung ba dang —97—

nad/ /de bas sdig lta mi bzad spangs byes nas/ /bde gshegs snying po dad pas rtogs par bya/ /gal te zab mo'i don la mos shing sgoms/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba smin na gcig car rtogs/ /gzhan du rnam kun spyod pas rim gyis 'thob/ /cha shas kyis kyang don chen 'gyur ba ste/ /sngon du mtshams med byas pa'ang 'di yis grol/ /sdig la spyod bzhin pa yang 'dir dad na/ /rnam smin ring du skrod cing zad par byed/ /bag med sred pa'i dbang gyur yul lnga la/ /rtag tu bsten pa'ang mi 'ching grol ba yod/ /brtul zhugs nyams pa'ang lha yul 'gro ba dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku yi snang ba 'byung / /'di la dad pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sman dang sngags kyi sbyor ba 'ga' yis kyang / /lan rer sdig can mtho ris gnas 'gro srid/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan bsam yas la mos na/ /phan yon de dag ci phyir 'gyung mi 'gyur/ /kun mkhyen mchog de'i bzhed dgongs 'khrul med 'di/ /gzhan gyis ji bzhin smra ba ma byung ngo / /rig 'dzin theg par sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /'phrin las rnams kyi rnam pa mtha' yas sgoms/ /snang med tsam zhig chos sku yin gyur na/ /de kun log pas rnam par brtags par 'gyur/ /bcos ma'i rim pas gzugs sku lam du byed/ /'on kyang ji bzhin ma yin rjes mthun tsam/ /grub pa'i rim pas sku gsung thugs rnam pa/ /'di dag gtso bor chos sku lam du byed/ /las dang pos kyang snying po cung zad mthong / /gsang sngags thun mong min pa'i thabs las so /las rlung rnam rtog gcig tu 'jug pa ni/ /ji ltar rigs par 'gog pa thabs kyi mchog /rtogs dang rtsol ba'i gzhan dbang dang bral ba/ /snang brnyan sgra —98—

dbyangs bde stong chos skur mtshungs/ de phyir chos sku lam du byed par nus/ /'ga' zhig don dam chos sku'i snang ba nyid/ /kha cig nyams snang yin yang de yi lam/ /mnyam gzhag de dang rdo rje slob dpon mchog /mchod cing mnyes pas tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas/ /gdod ma'i rdo rje bzhi po mngon du 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas skyes bu gcig gis chos dbyings rtogs/ /de rgyu nyid las sems can mtha' yas la/ /gang 'dul 'phrin las mkha' khyab rtag tu 'jug /nyi dang 'od zer bzhin du lhun gyis grub/ /ces pa ni nges par 'byung ba dang 'byin pa gtan la dbab pa'o// //da ltar sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes nyid/khres bya kun la khyab cing bzhugs pa'i phyir/ /de nyid chos dbyings yin te bdag la sogs/ /srog ldan kun la'ang mgon dang bcud du bzhugs/ /de ni spros bral yin phyir rgyu 'bras min/ /'on kyang de yod na ni 'khor 'das 'byung / /med na min pas kun gzhi ye shes zer/ /de 'dra'i nye ba'i mdangs 'od lam yin te/ /de yang 'khor ba'i chos dang 'dzom las 'byung / /de lta na yang de yis 'khor ba spong / /gang zag 'khrul pa zad na de sangs rgya/ /'khrul spangs gang zag nyid kyang spang gyur mod/ /snga ma'i shugs las gnas gyur ye shes 'byung / /de ni sangs rgyas skyes bu zhes su brjod/ /rig pa lam g.yin 'dres shing dbyings ni gcig / tshigs bcad 'di bzhi po la don kun tshang / /gzhan smra'i rjes su skyor zlos ma byas par/ /'chad tshul go bde sngon med smra ba3 spobs/ /nges pa'i don gyi gsang ba zab mo 'di/ /gsal zhing ma sbas gol sa chod par smras/ /go ba'i dus na ma —99—

'thor gcig tu 'gril/ /smra ba'i dus na ngag don khar longs shing / /'bel gtam byed na klan ka'i gnas med pa/ /ji bzhin smra ba 'di yang mgon gyi mthu/ /lta ba'i phyogs la mang du bshad zin mod/ kha chem snying la cen pa 'di las med/ /spros pa'i chos skad rnam pa sna tshogs rnams/ /lung rigs gnyis dang mthun na gang dgar gyis/ /'di med bshad rlabs bzang yang khog stong yin/ /phyag rgya 'dis btab kun kyang bdud rtsi nyid/ /'dir bshad 'di la dge ba mchis so cog /jo bo sems can don gyi mchog tu bsngo/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnad sngon med pa'i bstan bcos yid bzhin nor bu lta bu snying po nges pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs rjes mtshams sbyar bas/ dol po sangs rgyas de'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs te/ rgyal ba rgyal sras thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i gnad phyin ci ma log pa la nges pa rnyed nas/ kha ba can gyi sham+bha lar thun gcig la nges par brjod pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ da ni lang tsho yol gyur pas/ /mang du smras pas ci zhig bya/ /gces pa'i snying di 'phyung gyur kyang / sha dum cir mi rung du zad/ /bcom ldan de la yid ches pas/ /bdag ni srog dang snying dang tshe/ /kun las gces pa gsang ba'i tshig /'di las gzhan du smra rgyu med/ /mkhas sam shin tu blun yang rung / /nus pa ldan nam mi ldan rung / /spyod pa bzang ngam ngan yang rung / /'di bzhin 'bad na don wo thob/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shes rab yod rlom dang / /khi tig ngom pa'i mgo stsegs tshul 'chos dang / /rtsing chos phaṭa ral grub par bkur ba yang / /zab mo 'di ma rtogs pas g.yang sar —100—

lhung / /grub mtha' 'di ni mdo rgyud kun gyi don/ /'chad tshul 'di 'dra bdag gi blo la shar/ /'phags mchog kun gyi dgongs pa'ang 'di yin la/ /sngon med legs brjod ces kyang 'gal ba med/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod pa gcig gyur/ khres bya skyos kyi gnas lugs 'khrul med/ /snying gtam 'di ni de ring bshad do/ /blo sna ma mang rtse gcig sgrubs shig /gcig zhus/ maṅga laX/bla ma'i zhal lung rgyal kun thugs kyi gsang / /'dir 'bad dge las skye ba thams cad du/ /'di nyid thos shing 'di don nyams su myong / /'di nyid rtogs nas kun kyang 'dir 'jug shog khu bhaX ma stu sarba dzā ga taX/ yang zhus//—101—

oṃ swā sti/ na mo brnya ya/ gang gi ye shes rdo rje'i me lce yis/ /bdag tu lta ba'i ri dang nags bcom ste/ /rnam shes bdun gnas sa 'og 'jig rten skyong / /lha yi lhar gyur rgyal ba'i dbang por 'dud/ /gang de'i bstan pa gnas skabs tha dad tshul/ /thams cad chos nyid 'di la 'bab tshul ston/ /'on kyang byis pa mi mthun rtsod gyur la/ /yang dag rigs pa'i gdams ngag sbyin par bya/ /gangs can 'di na mu stegs grub mtha' dang / /nyan thos tshul lugs gtso bor 'dzin pa med/ /de de'i bag chags sad rnams theg mchog gi /gzhung don log par 'grel 'di bzlog par bya/ /'phags yul mkhas rnams rgyal bas gsung phyin chad/ /lung de tshad ma nyid du khas len te/ /rigs pa nyes pa zad pa rdzun gyi tshig /mi gsung zhes 'dod de phyir nyan thos pa/ /theg chen rgyal ba'i bka' min zhes zer zhing / /bka' ru grub na de yang khas len pas/ /theg chen bka' sgrub bstan bcos rnams las mdzad/ /bod rnams rang 'dod dang mtshungs lung 'ga' zhig /'dod kyi gzhan kun thams cad drang don te/ /'gro la phan don yin pas ngo mtshar mod/ /ngo bo don la mi gnas rdzun du 'dod/ /'di ltar 'dod la tshad ma'i lung mi 'grub/ /nyes pa kun zad rgyal ba rdzun gsung na/ /phyogs re spangs pa'i slob pa 'phags rnams dang / /nyes kun dang bcas so skye smos ci dgos/ /rdzun dang bcas pa skyes bu tshad ma min/ /don —102—

gyis sangs rgyas tshad ma min 'dod pa'i/ /nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba des ci rung / /zhes pa ni rgyal ba'i bka' tshad ma'i lung du bstan pa'o// //bod rnams phal cher 'khor lo rim gsum yang / /dang por chos kun bden grub bstan phyir rdzun/ /bar pa stong nyid bstan pas nges don te/ /phyi mar yod pa bstan phyir drang don lo/ /spyir ni drang don thams cad rdzun tshig min/ /gnas lugs mchog la 'dren pa'i lam stegs la/ /kun rdzob bden pa ston pa drang don dang / /don dam dngos po'i gnas lugs ston pa la/ /nges pa'i don du gsungs shing mkhas rnams 'dod/ /chos de gsungs pa'i dgos pa bstan pa kun/ /drang don yin par 'dod mod dam chos kun/ /gdul bya'i don phyir drang don nyid du 'gyur/ /klu sgrub dang ni thogs med sku mched kyis/ /'khor lo rnam gsum dgongs pa gcig tu bsgrubs/ /'khor lo dang por kun rdzob gsungs pa yang / /ji ltar snang ba de la de ltar gsungs/ /gnas lugs dpyad pa'i don la bden grub tu/ /bstan pa med pas de la rdzun tshig med/ /bar bar 'khor 'das chos kun bkag pa yang / /kun rdzob kun te bde gshegs snying po sogs/ /yod med gang yang ma gsungs dpyad pa med/ /de phyir de gnyis tha ma don mi 'gal/ /'on kyang dang por kun rdzob gtso bor bstan/ /bar du nges don phyed tsam tha mar ni/ /nges don don dam rdzogs par bstan pa yin/ /nad pa'i sman dang yi ge slob pa'i dpe'i/ /dgongs don 'di yin gzhan la 'gal ba yod/ /dang por chos kun tshugs thub yin no zhes/ /ston na ka tu ya na'i gdams ngag gi /mdo sde sogs dang nang 'gal yod par 'gyur/ /bar bar —103—

don dam dbyings sogs 'gog na ni/ /byams zhus sogs dang nang 'gal yod par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni 'khor lo rim pa gsum gyi ston tshul la yang dpyad pa'o// //gzhan yang chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i le'ur ji skad du/ rab 'byor 'di ltar chos thams cad ni sprul pa ste/ de la la la ni nyan thos kyi sprul pa'o/ /la la ni rang sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'o/ /la la ni byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa'o/ /la la ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /la la ni nyon mongs pa'i sprul pa'o/ /la la ni chos kyi sprul pa'o/ /rab 'byor rnam grangs des na chos thams cad ni sprul pa lta bu yin no/ /zhes pa dang / gsol pa/ gang ma sprul pa'i chos de gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gang la skye ba med pa dang /'gag pa med pa de ni ma sprul pa'o/ /gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das de gang lags/ rab 'byor de ni mi bslu ba'i chos can mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ chos de ni ma sprul pa yin no/ /zhes mdo gsum du mthun par gsungs so/ /'dis ni bden gnyis yod mnyam dang med mnyam du 'dod pa bsal ba'o/ /'o na stong pa bde bar gshegs pas bstan pa ltar/ nges don mdo sde dag gi bye brag shes/ /gang las sems can gang zag skyes bur bstan/ /chos de thams cad drang ba'i don du shes/ /zhes pa 'di mi 'dod dam zhe na/ nges par 'dod do/ /'khor lo tha mar snying po bstan pa yang / /stong par ston gyi spros par mi 'chad la/ /dam pa'i bdag sogs gang zag tu mi ston/ /'di dang bstun na'ang tha ma mchog tu shes/ /dbang phyug sogs kyang 'phags par bshad mod —104—

kyi/ /ston par mi rung de tshig tshad mi bya/ /ci phyir zhe na dkon mchog las gzhan du/ /bstan phyir thar 'dod rnams kyis dor bya yin/ /'di na rgyal gsung tshad ma min pa dang / /slob dpon 'ga' zhig tshad mar 'dod pa yod/ /de dag mu stegs rnams dang blo gros mtshungs/ /'phags pa yin pas skyon de med snyam na/ /dbang phyug sogs la'ang rigs pa de mtshungs so/ /sangs rgyas las lhag 'dod phyir nang pa min/ /de tshig rgyal ba'i gsung las lhag pa'i phyir/ /skyes bu'ang de nyid mchog tu cis mi 'gyur/ /de dag rton pa bzhi yang log par smra/ /kun rdzob tu ni yod pas yod par 'dod/ /kun rdzob tu ni med na'ang med par 'dod/ /don dam du ni med kyang yod par 'dod/ /don dam mi rton kun rdzob la rton no/ /rnam shes ngo bor yod na yod par 'dod/ /rnam shes ngo bor med na med go gcod/ /ye shes snang ngor med kyang yod ces zer/ /ye shes spangs nas rnam shes tsam la ston/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos rnams phal cher rdzun/ /dgongs 'grel chad ldan thams cad bden no lo/ /rtsa ba rdzun na dgongs 'brel bden mi srid/ /chos ni spong zhing gang zag rnams la rton/ /dgag pa gnyis kyi rnal mar go ba sogs/ /rtog ge ba bzhin tshig la rton pa'ang yod/ /rang stong smra ba phyis byung phal cher ni/ /rton pa bzhi las ring du byol ba yin/ /rgyal ba'i bka' las rton pa bzhi po bsngags// zhes pa ni drang nges las brtsams te rnam par dpyad pa'o// //skabs kyi don la slar yang brjod par bya/ /bar ba nges don phyi ma drang don du/ /ston byed mdo sde gsal po gang na'ang med/ /bar ba drang don phyi ma —105—

nges don du/ /dgongs pa nges 'grel myang 'das chen po dang / /sor 'phreng sogs kyi mdo las gsal bar bshad/ /lang kar gshegs par snying po drang don du/ /gsungs par 'dod pa ri bong cal dang mtshungs/ /mu stegs bdag dang mtshungs sam zhus pa la/ /stong nyid yin phyir mtshungs pa min zhes gsungs/ /stong nyid thams cad bden med med dgag la/ /'dod pa rang stong smra ba'i blo skyon yin/ /de bzhin nyid kyi stong nyid ye shes de/ /med dgag stong nyid bem stong kun rdzob bo/ kha cig phung po rnam dpyad stong nyid ni/ /chos kun med par 'dod pa yin no lo/ /de nyid rnam kun mchog ldan sgrub thabs su/ /de ma thag tu gsungs dang 'ga' bar 'gyur/ /rnam dpyad rigs pas dpyad pa'i stong nyid de/ /de nyid thabs su 'gyur la dgongs pa yin/ /'jug pa sogs su drang don du bkral yang / /rgyal bas nges pa'i don du bkral ba'i phyir/ /chos 'khor phyi ma nges pa'i don du grub/ /bar ba'i gleng gzhi dang por mthun pa mang / /tha ma'i gleng gzhi sngags dang mthun pa mang / de de'i phyir yang phyi ma mchog tu grub/ /drang don yin na zab par ga la 'gyur/ /khyad par bar ba (〈rja〉tha ma )drang don yin gsungs pa'ang / /drang don yin na ha cang thal bar 'gyur/ /nges don mthar thug bstan pa'i rjes su yang / /gdul bya drang ba'i don la bkri ba ni/ /drang nges ston pa'i go rim shin tu 'khrugs/ /gang zag gcig la ston pa'i rim min na/ /bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung ba'i/ /rnam par dpyad pa 'thad ldan min par 'gyur/ /myang 'das gzung dbang gis zhus mdo la sogs/ /kun tu'ang gang zag bkri ba'i tshul la sbyar/ /'o ma'i sman gyi —106—

dpe dang nor bu'i dpe/ /gcig nyid sems kyi dri ma sbyong tshul lo/ /myang 'das chen por phyin ci log brgyad gsungs/ khyad par rgyal ba'i sku ni gtsang ba dang / /sangs rgyas zhing sogs bde dang don dam dbyings/ /rtag dang sems nyid dam pa'i bdag yin pas/ kha khrag lus dang sdug bsngal bden pa dang / /skad cig cha bcas rang bzhin bden med du/ /rtog na log lta phyin ci log bzhir gsungs/ /'khor lo dang po 'jig rten pa dang mthun/ /bar bar kun rdzob rang bzhin med pa dang / /rgyal ba sras bcas yon tan bgrang yas sogs/ /mang pos nyan thos lugs las ches lhag mod/ /phal cher theg dman mdo dang mthun shas che/ /tha mar rang bzhin med tshul bar dang mtshungs/ /gzhan du nam yang yod par ma gsungs pa'i/ /khyad chos mang pos 'dir ni yod par bstan/ /chos lnga rang bzhin gsum dang rnam shes brgyad/ /theg chen thun mong min pa'i chos skad rnams/ /'khor lo tha ma'i mdo sder shin tu rgyas/ /bar bar mi gsal la lar bsdus te gsungs/ /dang po drang don tha ma'ang drang don can/ /yin na de gnyis mthun shas che dgos na/ /dang po tha ma ston tshul ches mi 'dra// zhes pa ni 'khor lo rim gsum gyi drang nges las brtsams te phyi ma mchog tu bsgrubs pa'o// //'khor lo rnam gsum dgongs pa'i gnad gcig kyang / /nyan thos rnams dang rang stong smra ba dang / /sems tsam pa dang gzhan stong smra ba rnams/ /'dod tshul tha dad khyad par shin tu che/ /zhi 'tsho grol sde rjes 'brang bcas pa las/ /gzhan pa'i rang stong smra rnams kun rdzob ni/ /nyan thos sde gnyis po dang —107—

mthun par smra/ /sems tsam gzhan stong kun rdzob rnam gzhag mthun/ /rang stong smra ba nyan thos dang mthun la/ /gzhan stong smra ba sems tsam dang mthun mang / /de dag nyan thos pa dang sems tsam min/ /lang kar gshegs mdor sems tsam las 'das gsungs/ /sems tsam lta ba rnam shes bden grub yin/ /chos dbyings rnam shes min phyir 'di mi mtshungs/ /mthar thug theg gsum rgyan du ma bshad mod/ /theg gcig theg gsum rigs chad yod med dang / /mtshan nyid gsum dang bden gnyis 'dod mi 'dod/ de dag sems tsam dbu ma'i khyad par min/ /grub mtha' bzhi kas bden gnyis rnam gzhag byas/ /mtshan nyid gsum po sher phyin las kyang bstan/ /'phags pas byang chub sems 'grel du yang gsungs/ /gnas skabs rigs chad kyang ni mdo der bshad/ /'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can gsungs phyir/ /mthar thug rigs chad mdo sde rgyan na'ang bkag /mthar thug phyir na theg gcig nyid ces gsungs/ /gnas skabs theg gsum rang stong smra ba'ang 'dod/ /byams zhus le 'ur yang ni de mthun gsungs/ /kun rdzob sems tsam rang stong smra ba 'ga'/ /'dod phyir blun po'i rnam dbyes ci zhig bya/ /rgyal bas sems tsam las 'das ma 'das dang / /'jam dbyangs kyis gsungs 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / de bzhin 'phags pa lha dang dze tā ri/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel du/ gsungs pa rnams ni rnam gzhag gcig tu 'bab/ /gzung 'dzin snang ba can gyi rnam shes de/ /ngo bo gzung 'dzin las grol bden grub dang / /don dam dang ni de bzhin nyid 'dod cing / /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam pa bden —108—

grub ste/ /de la snang ba'i gzung 'dzin bden med lo/ /'di dag sems tsam pa yi grub mthar bshad/ /don la sems tsam du grub dngos po rnams/ /'dod na sems tsam pa yin gzhan ci zhig /dngos rnams log snang sems su'ang bden med pas/ /sems tsam las ni ci yi phyir ma 'das/ /rnam shes rnam pa bden med rtogs pa na/ /kun rdzob snang ba med phyir dbu mar gsungs/ /don dam snang ba yod phyir de min na/ /'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes de dag kyang / /dbu ma rtogs pa'i ye shes min par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni dbu sems kyi dbye ba las brtsams te/ gzhan stong dbu mar bsgrubs pa'o// //rang stong smra rnams 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi/ /lung tsam khas len par ni mthun mod kyang / /kha cig phyi don 'dod la kha cig 'gog kha cig rang rig 'dod la kha cig 'gog /'ga' zhig rnam shes brgyad 'dod la la 'gog /theg dman pas kyang bdag med gnyis rtogs dang / /ma rtogs la sogs rtsa ba'i grub mtha' kun/ /rang bzo'i dbang gis tha dad rnam par 'khrugs/ /chos kun bden med tsam du mthun mod kyang / /shing rta'i srol wod 'di yi rjes 'brang zhes/ /blo gtad med par rang blo'i lam du 'dren/ /rang stong smra la rang rkang tshugs pa yi/ /theg chen mngon pa dang ni 'dul ba dang / /mdo sde'i dgos 'grel rgyas pa med pa'i phyir/ /lta ba kho na logs su dpyad byas nas/ /sde snod gsum gyi gzhung lugs 'chad pa'i tshe/ /la la bye smra kha cig mdo sde ba/ kha cig rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung lugs len/ /gzhan stong smra rnams byams pa'i chos lnga dang / /thogs med mched kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtshor 'jug /de phyir rtsa ba'i —109—

grub mtha' mi mthun med/ /theg chen sde snod 'grel pa'i gzhung kun la/ /rnal 'byor spyod gzhung gzhan drang mi 'jog pas/ /ri bor ma rabs brgya phrag du mas kyang / /'khor los sgyur rgyal zil gyis mi non bzhi/ /rang stong gzhung gis 'di dag zil mi non/ /kha cig mdo sde gdul bya sna tshogs la/ /dgongs pas gsungs phyir bstan 'chos dbang btsan lo/ /gong du bkag mod gal te bden srid na'ang / /rgyal ba'i dgongs 'grel byams pa las lhag pa/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kun btsal kyang med/ /'phags pa klu sgrub tshad mar sgrub pa'i phyir/ /zla bas lang kar gshegs mdo'i lung bstan drangs/ /dkar po rnam par 'char ba'i khyi ka sa /rigs tshogs gzhan stong tshul du bkral zhes grags/ /ga las 'jigs med sogs kyang mthun shas che/ /bzhi brgya pa ni gnas brtan chos skyong gis/ /rnam rig dbu mar bkral zhes zla grags gsungs/ /de phyir 'phags pa yab sras gzhung 'di dag /rang stong ston par cung zad nye mod kyang / /'di dag bsgrub bya yin gyi sgrub byed min/ /zla grags phyogs kyi glang po'i phyis byung zhing / /'phags pa'i dngos slob rnams la grub mtha' ni/ /tha dad 'byung don med pas thal rang gi /rtsod pa phyis byung yin phyir dpang po min/ khyad par bstod tshogs rnams dang rim lnga dang / /byang chub sems 'grel sogs su gzhan stong bstan/ /de phyir klu sgrub dgongs pa gnyis kas len/ /klu sgrub thogs med grub mtha' mtshungs so zhes/ /rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas gsal bar bshad/ /zhi 'tsho sogs kyang 'di dang phyogs mthun gsungs/ /'ga' zhig rang rig 'gog pa ltar na ni/ /so so rang rig theg pa —110—

gsal ba dang / /rang stong phal cher thal rang rtsod pas 'jug /rtog ge'i spyod yul min zhes 'di mi 'thad/ /chos lnga rang bzhin gsum sogs mi bzhed na/ /bla med theg chen 'chad ces mi rung bas/ /lung bstan ltar na'ang g.yin stong bzhed par 'thad/ /gal te rang stong kho na bzhed srid kyang / /mi pham mgon pos gzhan du bkral ba'i phyir/ /dgongs 'grel mkhan po lugs 'di lhag pa yin/ /klu sgrub nyid kyi yi dam yin phyir dang / /theg chen pa kun rgyal bar 'dod phyir dang / /gsang sngags rgyud las dkyil 'khor gtso bor bstan/ /mdo sde phal cher du yang bstan pa dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi nye ba'i sras gyur dang / /tshul ston la yang sa bcu'i dbang phyug yin/ /nyan thos rnams kyang rgyal tshab yin par 'dod/ /klu sgrub mir gyur sa ni dang po brnyes/ /rgyal ba'i drung na mi yi skye bor bstan/ khungs kyang ma 'ongs lung bstan tsam yin zhing / /nyan thos pa rnams rtog ge 'chal ba zer/ /dgongs 'grel mkhan po bzang ngan legs dpyod cig /gsang sngags la brten sangs rgyas brnyes srid mod/ /dam pa'i don du mi pham mgon po yang / /bskal pa tshad med sngon nas mngon byang chub/ kha cig byams pas gzhan stong bshad mod kyi/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rang stong gsungs so lo/ /'jam dbyangs kyis mdzad de gzhung gang na yod/ /rdo rje theg pa'i zab lam ston pa yi/ /zhal lung dang ni 'jam dpal grags pa yi/ /lta 'dod mdor bstan las ni gzhan stong gsal/ /gzhan ni da lta ma dmigs rdzun gyis ci/ /rang gi lugs la khungs gsal med bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi gzhung mchog rnams la bskur 'debs pa/ /phyogs 'dzin —111—

gdon gyis bslad pa ma yin nam/ /'ga' zhig byams chos rang stong yin zer ba/ /rang gi 'khor nang dbang che'i tshig tu zad/ /rgya bod phol cher de mi 'dod pas bla/ /bod rnams thog tha rang stong yin zer ba/ /gzhung gcig nyid la grub mtha' gnyis yod skyon/ khyad par rang rang gzhung dang dngos su 'gal/ /thogs med rgyal bas drang nges 'byed pa yi/ /dgongs 'grel mchog tu lung bstan gsal bar bzhugs/ /gzhan yang dbyig gnyen phyogs kyi glang po dang / /chos grags rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba sogs/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis mchog tu lung bstan la/ /ye shes snying po dang ni sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /legs ldan zla grags 'phags seng la sogs pa/ /mdo rgyud gang nas lung bstan bshad par mdzod/ /dbyig gnyen sogs la ye shes rnyi nga po yis/ /shing rta cher bsgrags dpal ldan zla bas kyang / /mang du thos shing mkhas par dag pa sbyin/ /mir skyes dgongs 'grel mkhan po dgos na ni/ /rgyal bas lung bstan de rnams gzhan stong smra/ /gzhan de rnams kyang dam pa mchog yin mod/ /lung bstan brnyes pa rnams dang 'gran mi nus/ /dper na zla bas lang kar gshegs mdo la/ /brten nas sems tsam dgongs pa can du bshad/ /dbyig gnyen gyis ni dgongs pa nges 'grel la/ /brten nas ngo bo nyid med rnam gsum la/ /dgongs nas ngo bo nyid med bstan ces bkral/ /mdo yi lung dang rigs pa mtshungs mnyam la/ /mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen zhabs kyi lung rigs btsan/ /'dzam gling rgyan drug dang mtshungs mkhas pa gzhan/ /'phags pa'i yul du bstan 'chos byed po su/ /rang stong gzhung lugs tshad ma mchog yin —112—

dang / /khyad par thal 'gyur smra ba mchog yin kyang / /sa bon thams cad pa yi kun gzhi ni/ /bkag mod kun gzhi'i ngo bo bkag pa med/ /rig bya rig byed gsal bya gsal byed dang / /dran myong nus pa rang rig la bltos pa/ /bkag gis rang rig tsam zhig bkag pa med/ /gzhan dbang bden grub bkag mod yongs grub min/ /rang sems rang bzhin 'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad/ /'di 'dra dbu ma'i gzhung las bkag pa med/ khyad par kun gzhi ye shes ma bshad pas/ /yod med gang yang der lung ma bstan no/ /mtshan dpe can gyi snying po drang don du/ /'dod kyi bde gshegs snying po tsam ma bkag/ ces pa ni srol 'byed dang / gzhung lugs dang / grub mtha'i khung che chung dang / phyis kyi bod rnams la dpyad pa ste/ de dag ni lung gi sgrub pa las 'phros pa go bde bar brjod pa'o// //yang 'ga' zhig gzhan stong gi lugs ni mu stegs grangs can dang mtshungs pa'i phyir lta ba 'khrul pa'o zhes zer ro/ /sems tsam yin na mu stegs lugs su 'gal/ /mngon pa mdzod sogs legs bshad chen por rlom/ /then chen gzhung lugs mu stegs dang mchungs 'dod/ /phrag dog gdon gyis zin pa'i spyon gtam yin/ /kun mtshungs na ni mu stegs lugs yin phyir/ /grub mtha' bzhi yi rnam gzhag med par 'gyur/ /phyogs re 'dra bas de der 'gyur na ni/ /nyan thos sde gnyis bye brag pa dang mtshungs/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa grangs can dang mtshungs mod/ /gcer bu spyod pa'ang dge slong rnams dang mtshungs/ / casnying rje sgom pa'ang mu stegs lugs su 'gyur/ gsang sngags spyod pa dbang phyug —113—

pa dang mtshungs/ /khyab 'jug gi zhig lnga pa las kyang / ming tsam las ni rab 'das shing / /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /dbyung dang bsdu las nges grol ba/ /de ni nor lha'i bu zhes bya/ /dngos la dngos nyid yod ma yin/ /dngos rko med la'ang dngos nyid med/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam grol bar/ /gang gis shes de de nyid rig /ces pa dang / dbang phyug gi mdzes pa sbyar ba las kyang / bu gcig tshangs pa mchog tu bden/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug mu mtha' yas/ /'ba' zhig yod pa nyid smra ba/ /de yang zhags par rab tu brjod/ /ces 'byung bas/ 'di dag dang rang stong smra ba yang cung zad gcig ma gtogs pa lta ba ches mthun no/ /de'i phyir bye brag med do/ /mu stegs kyi lung 'di ni dbu ma rgyan gyi rang 'grel du drangs so/ /kho bos lha khyab 'jug gi mtshan stong dang / snying po'i glu che chung dang / legs ldan gyi glu dang srid sgrub kyi glu dang /dbang phyug gi sam ba da zhes pa dang / grangs can pa'i gzhung ci rigs pa bram ze'i paṇ+ḍi ta 'ga' la (〈rgya〉las )thos mod kyi/ grangs can rnam rdzun gnyis po phyogs mthun las/ /brda chad tsam yang phal cher mi mthun no/ /brda chad 'ga' zhig sngags gzhung rnams dang mthun/ /khyab 'jug gzhung ni thal 'gyur pa dang mthun/ /dbang phyug pa yang rang rgyud pa bzhin sgrogs/ /byed por smra ba tsho de de'i khyad chos yin/ /gnyis na phyogs mtshungs tsam zhig mnyam po la/ /mu stegs grub mtha'i mchog gyur grangs can du/ /grags phyir sangs rgyas pa'i yang 'di mchog go /'ga' zhig yod smras 'ching bar 'dod pa dang / /yongs grub yod smras 'ching bar 'dod pa gnyis/ /rgya bod ma gtogs khyad par ci 'dug —114—

ltos/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i lung dang bstun na ni/ /g.yin stong 'thad kyi rang stong de ltar min/ kha cig lung la nges pa med pa'i phyir/ /da lta rigs pas grub pa dgos so lo/ /lung rigs gnyis ka med pa'i rang lugs 'jog /rigs pas grub pa shin tu dgos mod kyi/ /zab mo'i gnas lugs tshad ma'i lung gis sgrubs/ /grangs med gsum sgom mthong ba'i lung rdzun na/ /so skye mno bsam ci phyir tshad ma yin// g.yin yang shin tu lkog gyur la lung tshad ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bsam dgos so/ zhes pa ni gzhan stong mu stegs dang 'dra ba'i rtsod pa spangs pa'o// //gcig dang du mar ma grub rnam dpyad pa/ /'di dag 'dus byas chos la 'jug 'gyur gyi/ /'dus ma byas chos gcig min du ma min/ /nam mkha' la sogs dbye ba des mi 'jug /'on kyang 'khrul blos brtags pa tsam nyid las/ /ngo bo ci yang med phyir de med yin/ /khyod lugs chos nyid med par dgag pa'i phyir/ /ci yang med phyir de la 'gyur ba med/ /phyogs dang dus kyi cha shas rnam dbye ba/ /yod na de la mi 'gyur mi srid de/ /phyogs yod dbang shes yul min med pa dang / /dus ni 'das sogs dus gsum phyir 'gyur bcas/ /skye sogs bkag pas chos dbyings 'di mi khegs/ /ye shes 'di yang skye med 'gag med yin/ /'phags pa'i dbu ma'i gzhus lugs che chung du/ khyu rkyen dang ni 'gro 'ong mtshan mtshon dang / /sngon dang phyi mtha' rgyu 'bras rten 'brel sogs/ /rigs pa'i dpyad pa mtha' yas de kun yang / /kun rdzob kho na la 'jug gzhan la min/ /rgyu sogs de dag kun rdzob kho na'i phyir/ /chos nyid —115—

du 'gyur chos can la mi ltos/ /tha snyad chos can la ltos rang ngos med/ /chos nyid rang ngos rnam par gzhag 'jog gi khyu 'bras ltos grub med phyir rten 'brel min/ /zhes pa ni rang stong gi rigs pa las grol bar bstan pa'o// //chos kun stong pa gzhan stong lugs nyid yin/ /chos kun ngo bo nyid med gzhan stong lugs/ /rang stong smra la gsal cha dang snang cha/ /stong bar mi 'dod phyir na tshig tsam len/ /bum sogs snang ba stong pa nyid yin na/ khyed kyi lugs la don dam bden par 'gyur/ /stong nyid min na chos kun stong par 'gal/ /g.yin stong pa rnams stong nyid rnam gsum dang / /ngo bo nyid med rnam pa gsum 'dod cing / /de de don dam kho nar mi 'dod pas/ /nang 'gal med cing grub mtha' khyad 'phags byung / /kun rdzob kyi ni stong cha don dam min/ /don dam gyi yang snang cha kun rdzob min/ /zhes pa ni chos kun stong nyid rang stong kho na dang 'gal bar bstan pa'o// //rang stong sems tsam las ni 'das pa'i phyir/ /dbu ma yin mod dbu ma'i mthar thug min/ /stong nyid tsam yin stong nyid mthar thug min/ /nges don yin yang nges don mthar thug min/ /rgyu mtshan rang stong smra rnams dbu ma yang / /mthar thug khas mi len phyir dbu ma ci/ /rang stong gzhung la dpyad tshe dbu ma med/ /g.yin stong pa ni dpyad kyang dbu mar 'dod/ /rang 'dod mthar thug dbu ma mi 'dod pa'i/ /dbu ma chen po de 'dra mtshar gyi med/ /de yang yod na sems tsam mi 'dod pa'i/ /sems tsam pa dang theg dman mdo sde'i tshogs/ /mi 'dod mdo sde pa dang bye smra yang / /bye brag bshad pa mi len yod —116—

dam ci/ /kun tu rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa ma yin nam/ /rang stong lugs la stong nyid yod mi srid/ /don dam du ni med phyir mthar thug min/ /med dgag tsam la mthar thug ma thug dang / /dbyings dang dbyings min la sogs med pa'i phyir/ /don dam dbyings zhes bya ba'ang srid min 'gyur/ /yang na stong nyid dang ni don dam dbyings/ /kun rdzob nyid du ci yi phyir mi 'gyur/ /rtog ngo'i yul dang mthong ba rdzun pa'i yul/ /dpyad ngor med dang bden med kun rdzob tu/ /'jog byed min na kun rdzob gang gis 'jog /yin na don dam dbyings ni bden par 'gyur/ /kun rdzob min pas bden yod dpyad ngor yod/ /yongs grub 'dod phyir dbu ma min na ni/ /spros bral 'dod pa'ang dbu ma min par 'gyur/ /bden 'dod mi 'dod khyad par yod ce na/ /mtshan ma spros pa'i bden par nged mi 'dod/ /spros pas dben pa'i bden tshul 'di lta bu/ /rang stong smra bas phyogs kyang ma go na/ /de la dgag pa nam yang byas pa med/ /bden grub 'gog tshad spros pa'i bden 'gog ste/ /kun rdzob 'gog pa'i rigs pa 'dir sbyar phyir/ /de ni nged kyi lugs la'ang 'dod pa ste/ /yongs grub de la spros pa'i bden pa med/ /spros pa'i bden pa yod na kun rdzob ste/ /don dam ngo bo nyid med ces bshad do/ /nyan thos pa rnams theg gsum spangs pa gcig /ces 'dod thal 'gyur ba yang de rjes 'brang / /rgyu mtshan bdag med gnyis rtogs mtshungs phyir ro/ /'di la ngo bo nyid sku nyan rang la/ /yod par thal ba bzlog med 'jug par 'gyur/ /ngo bo nyid sku dang mtshungs de min pa/ /srid na sku gsum gzhan la'ang rigs pa mtshungs/ /sangs rgyas dang mnyam sangs rgyas —117—

min pa sogs/ /ha cang thal ba mang po 'jug par 'gyur/ /'di yang theg dman grub mtha' 'dres pa'i skyon/ khres sgrib kyi ni spangs pas khyad ce na/ /'di yang spangs pa'i khyad par nyid bstan gyis/ /ngo bo dbye ba med phyir zlog mi nus/ /ston pa thams cad smon lam dbang gis yin/ /ye shes snang med 'dod pas lhag med dang / /khyad par med phyir chos skur mtshungs par 'gyur/ /dman pas chos kun bdag med gnyis rtogs na/ /chos sku mthong phyir de ni theg dman gyi/ /'phags pa rnams dang thun mong 'bras bur 'gyur/ /bum la ka ba med tsam ka ba la/ /bum med tsam ni dbye ba yod min pas/ /med dgag tsam gyi spangs pa kun gcig 'gyur/ /kun gzhi med phyir sa bon 'jog gnas med/ /sems dang sems byung bem po'i cho se 'gags phyir/ /theg gsum lhag med ci phyir mtshungs mi 'gyur/ /med dgag tsam la shes bya'i sgrib pa'ang ci/ /lung gsal med cing gzhan la lung gsal yod/ /de phyir theg dman 'phags pas chos thams cad/ /chos bdag med par rtogs zhes 'di mi 'thad/ /rdzas dang brtags yod kun rtog rgyas pa ste/ /de ma rtogs na chos kun rtogs par 'gal/ /gsal min zhe na mngon sum la mi 'thad/ /rgyu mtshan ma shes phyir na de ma rtogs/ /rtogs pa khyad zhugs tsam gyis dbyer mi nus/ /phyi don 'dod dang rnam shes drug nges dang / /kun gzhi 'gog dang rang rig 'gog pa dang / /nyan rang skyabs kyi yul du 'dod pa sogs/ /rang stong pa la theg dman grub mtha' 'dres// zhes pa ni rang stong dbu ma mthar thug tu 'dod pa dgag pa'o// //—118—

gal te rang stong lugs kyi spros bral de/ /med dgag phyir na sus kyang myong mi srid/ /dngos med myong ba gang du'ang yod ma yin/ /rtog pas don spyi yul du byed pa yi/ /sel ngo tsam la rtogs par 'dogs na thogs/ /de 'dra 'khrul ba yin phyir don mi rtogs/ /spros bral de 'dra bden na bden grub ste/ /min na kun rdzob rnams dang bden med mnyam/ /rgyal sogs ye shes mchog la spros bral de/ /snang na de ngor yod phyir de bden 'gyur/ /mi snang na ni kun rdzob don dam gnyis/ /'phags pa'i gzigs ngor med pa mnyam por 'gyur/ /ye shes ma 'khrul ba yis med gzigs phyir/ /spros bral 'khrul 'gyur des na 'khrul bar mnyam/ /de ni kun rdzob don dam dbye mi nus/ /kun tu mtshungs shing gnyis na don dam las/ /kun rdzob dngos la zhugs shing bzang bar 'gyur/ /yang dag don du med mnyam kun rdzob ni/ /'khrul ngor don byed don dam de yang min/ /da ni khyed cag kun rdzob tshad mas grub/ /don dam med nges yin zhes 'dod la rag /ngo tshe'i lta ba 'di 'dra smad par 'os/ /'jig rten ma brtags ngor ni dngos kun yod/ /dpyad ngor med ces bya ba 'di dpyad bya/ /kun rdzob don dam du med kun rdzob tu/ /yod ces bya ba 'di ni dpyad ngo ste/ /'jig rten kun rdzob don dam dbye ba med/ khyed lugs ltar na kun rdzob don dam yod/ /de gnyis bden gnyis gang du'ang med 'dod dgos/ /snang ba kun rdzob de yis stong pa ni/ /don dam yin la kun rdzob snang mi 'gags/ /nges ngor bden 'dzin spangs phyir mtha' gnyis spangs/ /zhe na don dam snang ba khyod mi 'dod/ /mnyam bzhag ngor ni snang ba de med phyir/ /med mthar 'gyur —119—

bas de phyir dbu ma min/ /bden gnyis kun rdzob don dam skabs kun tu/ /yod mnyam med mnyam mtshungs pa yin zhes zer/ /don dam du yod mi srid kun rdzob tu/ /thams cad yod ces bya ba 'di nyid 'gal/ /don dam kun rdzob tu ni yod pa'i phyir/ /kun rdzob kyang der yod 'gyur kun mtshungs phyir/ /don dam kun rdzob tu ni yod gyur na/ /don dam kun rdzob yin par thal 'gyur te/ /mi ru yod pa'i 'gro ba mi yin bzhin/ /gzhan yang don dam don dam par grub dgos/ /min na grub phyir kun rdzob tu grub 'gyur/ /yang na don dam gzhi ma grub par thal/ /de phyir don dam dam pa'i don du grub/ /don dam 'khrul ngor snang bas der yod na/ /don dam rtogs pa'i shes pa 'khrul ba dang / /'khrul bas stong nyid rtogs par thal bar 'gyur/ /phyis kyi dbu ma'i 'dod pa 'di ltar na/ /kun rdzob yod phyir ye shes 'khrul bar 'gyur/ /mnyam gzhag 'khrul na rjes thob lta ci smos/ /ye shes de ngor kun rdzob snang na ni/ /kun rdzob bden 'gyur gal te snang na yang / /bden snang med zer kun rdzob med snang ba/ /kun rdzob snang ba min zhing kun rdzob yod/ /ye shes la ni med par snang phyir 'khrul/ /de ngor yod snang na ni de bden 'gyur/ /rgyu mtshan phyin ci ma log yul yin phyir/ /bkag pa 'gog pa sgrub par 'dod pa yi/ /rang stong pa la 'di skad brjod par bya/ /chos nyid bden med de ni gal te bden/ /gzhan stong smra ba rnams dang cis mi mtshungs/ /de mi bden na dgag pa'i tshig gnyis kyis/ /rnal mar go phyir bden yod kho nar 'gyur/ /don dam du med dpyad ngor med sogs mtshungs/ /zhes pa ni rang stong smra ba 'ga' zhig — 120—

gis grub mtha' dpyad cing / de nyid kyi rigs pas gzhan stong du bsgrubs pa'o// //chos nyid 'gyur ba med phyir chos kyi sku/ /sem can rnams la nges par yod par 'gyur/ /dang por chos sku min pa phyis der 'gyur/ /de ni ngo bo 'gyur bcas kho na yin/ /'dus byas nam yang mi gnas de phyir med/ /de bzhin nyid 'di nges par 'dus ma byas/ /dngos po dngos med las 'das shes pa yin/ /'gog byed med dang ma 'khrul ye shes kyi/ /gzigs ngo yin phyir 'khrul yang ma 'khrul bas/ /don dam dbyings ni bden par grub pa yin/ /kun rdzob kyi ni shes pa bslu ba'i chos/ /bems po dang ni dngos med myong bya min/ /de phyir dbyings de shes pa don dam yin/ /dbyings kyi de bzhin nyid de dge ba ste/ /don dam dge ba yin phyir dge ba'i mchog /kun rdzob dge ba dge ba nyid yin na/ /don dam dge ba ci phyir dge ba min/ de skad du rgyan stug po'i mdo las kyang / sa rnams sna tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ /bde gshegs snying po dge ba'ang de/ /kun gzhi de la snying po'i sgras/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ston par mdzad/ /ces gsungs la/ chos mngon pa las/ don dam pa'i dge ba gang zhe na/de bzhin nyid do/ /zhes bshad do/ /'dis ni kun gzhi ye shes bstan pa ste/ /de bzhin nyid phyir ye shes kho na dang / /dge bar bshad pas kun gzhi rnam shes min/ /kun gzhi dang ni bde gshegs snying por bstan/ /mngon par de bzhin nyid de byang chub kyi/ /rgyur gsungs 'dus ma byas su'ang bshad pa'i phyir/ /don dam 'gog pa'i bden pa bden gcig pu/ /dngos med min zhing kun rdzob las —121—

'das pa'o/ /gzhan stong 'di ni gcig gis cig shos stong / /de phyir stong nyid tha shal yin snyam na/ /mdo las stong nyid rnam pa bdun du gsungs/ /mtshan nyid stong dang dngos po'i rang bzhin stong / /srid pa'i stong nyid mi srid stong nyid dang / /brjod du med pa'i stong nyid zhes pa dang / /'phags pa'i ye shes don dam stong chen dang / /gcig gis gcig stong stong pa bdun pa'o/ /dngos rnams rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis stong dang / /dngos rnams rang bzhin skye bas stong pa dang / /phung po bdag gis stong dang phung po sogs/ /myang 'das kyis stong kun brtags ngo bos stong / /don dam ye shes lta nyes bag chags kyis/ /stong dang dngos po so so'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gcig gcig stong pa rnams la rim bzhin bshad/ /drug pa mchog ste bdun pa tha ma yin/ /gang zag bdag med rtag tu gzhan stong ste/ /'on kyang tha shal stong nyid min pa bzhin/ /de bzhin nyid dang chos sku lam bden gsum/ /don dam zhes bshad 'gyur med yongs grub ni/ /'dus ma byas dang don dam bden pa yin/ khrer phyin lnga brgya par yang stong nyid gsum/ /mtshan nyid gsum yang gsungs phyir yid ches bya/ /zhes pa ni rang lugs kyi 'thad pa cung zad nye bar bstan pa'o// //'dir ni gzhan stong spyi la rgol ba dag /lung rigs dang bcas drang pos rnam par dpyad/ /gzhan du zhib mor dpyad pa ji snyed dang / /rang lugs rnams ni gzhung du shes par bya/ /gcig dang du bral rigs pa'i rtsa ba yang / /'dus byas gnas pa med pa la thug pas/ /de dang bdag 'gog ci rigs rgyan na gsal/ /nyi shu pa ru phyi don 'gog pa bstan/ /rang lugs dbus mtha' rnam —122—

'byed gtsor gyur pa'i/ /rnal 'byor spyod gzhung kun na gsal bar bzhugs/ /rigs pa rgyas pa bstan 'chos rgyas par gsal/ /'di kun dbu ma'i gzhung lugs zla med pa'o/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis yang yang bshad mod kyang / /gzhung lugs chen po'i nang du 'thor bas na/ /nyer mkho go bar sla ba 'ga' zhig bshad/ /rigs pa gsar ba du ma'ang rnam par spel/ /theg pa che tshul thun mong min pa 'di/ /sems tsam yin 'dod grags ngan spang phyir dang / /khyad par lung tsam skyabs gyur yin zer ba/ /de dag 'joms pa'i rigs pa 'di nyid sbyar/ /da dung dpyad pa phra mo grangs med pa/ /spro bar nus mod 'gro bas rtogs dkar 'gyur/ /gal te gzhan la phan thogs nus med na/ /dgos pa dang bral de phyir 'dir ma bris/ /'di bshad dge bas mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /theg mchog dam pa'i chos 'dir yongs zhugs te/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob cing / /zag med chos kyi dga' ba la spyod shog/ ces pa gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan zhes pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bkod pa ste/ rang lo sum cu pa la jo nang gi ri khrod du'o// //dge legs 'phel/ tshigs bcad gsar pa brgya nga bdun yod do/ /maṅga laX/ zhus dag /

zhes bya ba bzhu yi / sa/na mo gu ru bzhi sa te khyuX phyag 'os rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /gzhan stong dbu ma'i gzugs bzang mdzes byed rgyan/ /rnam par bkod zin de la nyer mkho ba'i/ /lung gi mchog gyur mdo tsam bsdu bar bya/ /de la nges pa'i don du gsungs shing mkhas rnams 'dod/ /ces pa'i skabs su/dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper bgyi na/ nam mkha' ni thams cad la ro gcig pa dang / bstsal pa thams cad la sgrib par mi 'gyur ba lags so/ /de bzhin du chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa nyid dang / rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa nyid kyi bar las brtsams nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nges pa'i don bstan pa 'di yang drang ba'i don gyi mdo sde thams cad la ro gcig pa dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / theg pa chen por bstsal ba thams cad la sgrib par mi 'gyur pa lags so/ /zhes gsungs te/ don dam ston pa nges pa'i don du dngos su bshad pas/ cig shos zhar la go nus pa nyid kyi dbang du mdzad pa yin no/ /blo gros mi bzad par bstan par yang / mdo sde gang dag kun rdzob sgrub par bstan pa de ni drang ba'i don zhes bya'o/ /mdo sde gang dag don dam sgrub par bstan pa de dag ni nges pa'i don zhes bya'o/ /mdo sde gang dag lam la —124—

'jug pa'i phyir bstan pa de dag ni drang ba'i don zhes bya'o/ /mdo sde gang dag 'bras bu la 'jug pa'i phyir/ bstan pa de dag ni nges pa'i don zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin du mya ngan las 'das pa chen por yang / nges pa'i don la gnas pa gang zhe na/ nges pa'i don zhes bya ba ni chos shes pa ste/ nam du yang sgyus mi 'tsho/ spyod lam mi 'chos nga rgyal mi byed/ rnyed pa dang grags pa la mi chags/ de bzhin gshegs pas sbyor ba'i thabs su gsungs pa'i chos la chags par mi byed pa ste de ni nges pa'i don zhes bya'o/ /gang zhig de la gnas na gang zag de ni don dam pa la gnas pa zhes bya ste/ de bas na nges pa'i don la gnas so/ /bkri ba'i don la mi gnas pa gang zhe na/ bkri ba'i don ni mdo sde dag las thams cad gdung ba can/ thams cad mi rtag pa/ thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ thams cad stong pa/ thams cad bdag med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni bkri ba'i don zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa dang / g.yin yang nyan thos kyi theg pa ni bkri ba'i don zhes bya'o/ /bla na med pa'i theg pa chen po ni nges pa'i don zhes bya'o/ /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtag go /'gyur zhing 'pho ba'o zhes smra ba ni bkri ba'i don to/ /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa ni rtag pa'o/ /mi 'gyur mi 'pho ba zhes smra ba ni nges pa'i don zhes bya'o/ /gang nyan thos kyi theg pas chud cing rtogs pa ni bkri ba'i don no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bstan pas chud cing rig pa ni nges pa'i don zhes bya'o/ /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa la zhal zas kyis gso dgos zhes smra ba ni bkri ba'i don no/ /gang zhig rtag pa gnas pa mi 'gyur mi 'pho ba'o zhes smra pa ni nges pa'i don zhes bya'o/ /gang zhig —125—

de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das pa ni ji ltar shing zad na me shi ba bzhin no zhes smra ba ni bkri ba'i don no/ /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa ni chos kyi dbyings nyid la zhugs so zhes smra ba ni nges pa'i don zhes bya ste/ zhes gsungs so/ /dbye ba rgyas pa blo gros mi zad par bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs so/ /bstan 'chos 'ga' las dgongs pa gzhan du drang du yod pa drang don la bshad pa'ang slar nges don du 'dren pa'i lam stegs yin pa'i phyir 'di dag mi 'gal lo/ /klu sgrub dang ni thogs med sku mched kyis/ /'khor lo rnam gsum zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ rtsa shes las/ bcom ldan dngos dang dngos med pa/ /mkhyen pa ka khya ya na yi/ /gdams ngag las ni yod pa dang / /med pa gnyis ka bkag par mdzad/ /ces 'khor lo dang por yang mtha' bral bstan par bsgrubs shing / mya ngan 'das pa bden gcig pu/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ 'khor lo bar ba'i yang dgongs pa mthar thug gzhan stong du bstan pa'i phyir dang / byams chos dang thogs med mched kyi gzhung thams cad 'khor lo gsum car gyi dgongs pa gcig tu dril ba yin te/ dper na mdo sde rgyan gcig pus kyang 'khor lo gsum car gyi dgongs pa 'grel zhing lta ba dang grub mtha' mi gcig pa gsum mi ston par gcig nyid ston pa'i phyir ro/ /nad pa'i sman dang zhes pa'i skabs su/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ ji ltar nad pa nad pa la/ /sman pas sman ni ga|nga ba ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la/ /sems tsam du yang ston par mdzad/ /ces so/ /yi ge slob pa'i dpe/ zhes pa'i skabs su/ klu sgrub kyis rin chen 'phreng bar/ brda sprod pa dag ji lta —126—

bar/ /yi ge phyi mo klog 'jug ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas gdul bya la/ /tsi tsam bzod pa'i chos ston to/ /zhes so/ /ka tu ya na'i gdams ngag gi zhes pa'i skabs su/ ka kyi ya na gang gi phyir/ 'jig rten 'di ni yod pa nyid dang med pa nyid la mngon par zhen te/ des na skye ba dang rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba dang /mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba dang 'khrug pa dag las yongs su grol bar mi 'gyur/ 'gro ba lnga'i 'khor ba las grol bar mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dbang phyug sogs kyang 'phags par sogs kyi skabs su/ phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs dag gis/ /rig pa'i dbang phyug chen po ni/ /sa r+ṣa po ni yang dag thob/ /ces rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las gsungs so/ /gzhan yang de lta bu ches mang ngo / /de dag rton pa bzhi yang zhes pa'i skabs su/ myang 'das chen po las/ dge slong rnams ni chos rnam pa bzhi po la gnas par bgyi'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ chos la gnas kyi gang zag la mi gnas pa dang / don la gnas kyi tshig la mi gnas pa dang / ye shes la gnas kyi rnam shes la mi gnas pa dang / nges pa'i don la gnas kyi bkri ba'i don la mi gnas pa ste/ chos rnam pa bzhi po 'di ni rtogs par bgyi ba lags kyi skyes bu rnam pa bzhi ni ma lags so/ /zhes gsungs la rton pa rnam pa bzhi shin tu rgyas par blo gros mi zad par bstan pa nas 'byung ngo / /bar ba drang don phyi ma nges don du/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyi skabs su/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' don dam yang dag 'phags kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dang po —127—

yul wā rā ṇa si drang srong smra ba'i ri dwags kyi nags su nyan thos kyi theg pa rme yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rnam nga ra bstan pas chos kyi 'khor lo ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sngon lhar gyur pa'am mir gyur pa sus kyang chos dang mthun par/ 'jig rten du ma bskor ba gcig rab tu bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de yang bla na mchis pa skabs mchis pa drang ba'i don rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su gyur pa lags la/bcom ldan 'das kyis chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa nyid las brtsams/skye ba ma mchis pa dang 'gag pa ma mchis pa dang gzod ma nas zhi ba dang / rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa nyid las brtsams nas/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la stong pa nyid smos nga/'i rnam pas ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de yang bla na mchis pa skabs mchis pa drang ba'i don rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su gyur pa lags kyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa las brtsams/ skye ba ma mchis pa nyid dang 'gag pa ma mchis pa nyid dang gzod ma nas zhi ba nyid dang / rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa nyid las brtsams nas/ theg pa thams cad la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la legs par rnam par phye ba dang ldan pa shin tu ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsum pa bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba 'di ni bla na ma mchis pa skabs ma mchis pa nges pa'i don lags te rtsod pa'i gzhi'i gnas su gyur pa ma lags — 128—

so tsho / / che/ nas dang/ myang na las 'das pa chen po'i mdo las/ mdo sde bcu gnyis las ni mdo'i sde 'byung ngo / /mdo'i sde las ni shin tu rgyas pa'i sde 'byung ngo / /shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo'i sde las ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'byung ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las ni yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po mar gyi snying po lta bu 'byung ngo / /mar gyi snying po zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi rang ba'in gyi dpe'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes dang / sor mo'i 'phreng ba la phan pa'i mdo las/ de nas yang sor mo'i 'phreng bas/ gang po byams ma'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /sangs rgyas kun dang nyan thos kyis/ /gang de kun tu ma brnyes pa/ /chos de mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /srog chags rnams la bstan par bya/ /de skad gsungs pa'i don ci/ gang bos smras pa/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang chos thams cad la sems can gyi dbyings dang bdag dang / srog dang gang zag dang shed las skyes pa dang shed bu shin tu nan tan du btsal kyang ma rnyed nas bdag med pa ni sangs rgyas kyi tshig go snyam ste 'das so/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ da ltar dang ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang mi brnyes brnyes par mi 'gyur/ de bzhin du nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad la yang sbyar te gsungs nas/ de ltar srog dang gang zag dang shed can dang shed bu dang sems can dang bdag gi dbyings med par ston te de ltar bdag med par sto/ de ltar stong par ston te/ de lta bu'i chos kyi gtam ston to/ /sor mo'i 'phreng bas gang po byams ma'i bu la slar 'di skad —129—

ces smras so/ /kye ma btsun pa gang po khyod ni sbrang bu'i spyad pa spyod de chos kyi gtam ston mi shes so/ /sbrang bu yang zi zi zhes sgra 'byin shes kyis sbrang bu ltar blun po khyod cang ma zer cig /gang po de bzhin gshegs pa'i ldem po'i ngag mi shes pas bdag med pa la chos su sems pa ni/ gti mug gi chos kyi mar me'i nang du phye ma leb ltar lhung ngo / /gang de sangs rgyas kyis ma brnyes zhes bya ba ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po med pa ma brnyes nas 'das so/ /da ltar gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang sems can thams cad la bdag gi khams med pa ni mi brnyes so/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang sems can thams cad la sems can gyi khams med pa brnyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos rnams kyis kyang dus gsum du sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po med pa ma brnyes mi brnyes brnyes par mi 'gyur te/ tshigs su bcad pa de'i don ni 'di'o/ /yang sangs rgyas kun gyi gang ma brnyes zhes bya ba ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang chos thams cad la nan tan du btsal kyang 'jig rten pa'i bdag mthe bo tsam dang ci tshe'i 'bru dang 'bras dang yungs 'bru dang til gyi ril bu tsam dmar po dang sngon po dang ser po dang dkar po dang thung ngu dang ring po dang shin tu ring po la sogs pa snying kha na 'bar zhing 'dug ces bya ba dang / zhes pa nas gang de dag gi rtag pa brtan pa ther zug ste bdag de ni 'di 'dra'o/ /zhes bya ba sangs rgyas thams cad dang nyan thos thams cad kyis ma —130—

brnyes nas mngon par sangs rgyas nas srog chags rnams la bshad do/ /zhes bya ste tshigs su bcad pa de'i don ni 'di yin gyi/ gang po yis ni phyin ci log tu rnam par brtag pas na de'i don ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gang ma brnyes zhes bya ba de ni/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po byas pa ma brnyes nas 'das te/ ma byas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi khams mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po mtha' yas pas brgyan pa sems can thams cad la yod do/ /da lhar gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po byas pa ni nan tan du btsal kyang ma brnyes te/ sems can thams cad la ma byas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dbyings mtha' yas pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa yod do/ /dus gsum du nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas sbrang ma lta bu rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yod ces grags te/ mig gis ni blta mi nus so zhes 'dri ba de la byed pa'i rgyu ni bstan to/ /'di lta ste sgra gcan zin dpal gyi bslab pa dang tshul khrims lhur byed pas srog chags can gyi chu la shin tu nan tan du blta ste/ srog chags yin nam ma yin 'on te rdul 'dra ba zhig ste thams cad ma yin no snyam pa las/ rim gyis brtags na srog chags phra mo yin par mthong ba de bzhin du/ sa bcu thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' stag rnams kyis rang gi lus la bdag gi dbyings yod par bdag nyid kyis mthong ste/ 'di 'dra ba de lta bu mtha' yas pa'i dbyings su mthong ngo / /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la 'jug pa ni shin tu dka' ba byed pa yin te/ gang dag kun tu 'bar ba dang rab tu 'bar ba —131—

lta bu'i 'jig rten du rang gi srog kyang btang ste ston par 'gyur ba ni rab tu dka' ba byed pa phan par ston pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' stag de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ston gyi gzhan la mi ston to/ /sems can dag ni bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa yin no/ /dper na 'phrul gyi mig dang ldan pa'i nang na ma 'gags pa bzhin te/ ma 'gags pa dang lhan cig tu byis pa sha'i mig can song nas nam mkha' la bya song pa'i rjes la bltas na byis pa sha'i mig can gyis ci nam mkha'i bya rjes mthong ngam/ gnas brtan ma 'gags pas ni gsal bar mthong ste/ skyes bu sha'i mig can yang gnas brtan gyi drin la rab tu yid ches nas 'gro ba de bzhin du/ byis pa sha'i mig can dang 'dra ba nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis mdo sde thams cad kyi tshul la yid ches nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yod par shes kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul gyi dbyings lta yang dag par ga la mthong / de ste nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas gzhan gyi dring la 'jog na mi dmus long tsam lta yid ga la ches/ sngon byung ba sa 'di mngar sna bzhi can du gyur to zhes sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan du mi gsung ba rnams las kho bos thos te/ sems can gang dag gi mngar sna bzhi myong ba'i sems can de dag da dung yang / byis pa'i tshe sa za ste gang gi yun ring po nas bsnyen por zhim po de sems can rnams da dung yang gtong mi nus so/ /de bzhin du sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mang po'i drung du gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la sgom zhing / mang du byas pa'i sems can de dag ni da dung yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la — 132—

yid ches te/ sems can de dag ni yun ring po nas sgom zhing de bzhin gshegs pa la byas pa gzo ba ste gzhan ma yin no/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na yang sems can gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ston pa dang thos nas yid ches par 'gyur ba'i sems can de dag ni gzhan ma yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras sa la za ba lta bu de bzhin gshegs pa la byas pa gzo ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lang kar gshegs par snying po drang don du/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su/lang kar gshegs pa las/ blo gros chen pos zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo gzhan brjod pa las de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po gsungs pa de bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba rnam par dag pas thog ma nas rnam par dag pa nyid mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi nang na mchis par brjod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rin po che rin thang chen po gos dri ma can gyis yongs su dkris pa ltar phung po dang / khams dang skye mched kyi gos kyis yongs su dkris pa 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi zil gyis non pa/ yongs su rtag pa'i dri ma'i dri ma can du gyur pa rtag pa brtan pa ther zug par ni brjod na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por smra ba 'di ni mu stegs byed kyi bdag tu smra ba dang ji ltar mi 'dra ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das mu stegs byed rnams kyang rtag pa byed pa yon tan med pa khyab pa mi 'jig pa'o zhes bdag tu smra ba ston par byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsal pa/ blo gros chen po nga'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa ni mu stegs can gyi bdag tu smra ba dang mtshungs —133—

pa ma yin te/ blo gros chen po de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni/ stong pa nyid dang yang dag pa'i mtha' dang mya ngan las 'das pa dang ma skyes pa dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa la sogs pa'i tshig gi don rnams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por bstan par byas nas byis pa rnams bdag med pas 'jig par 'gyur ba'i gnas rnam par spang ba'i don du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i sgo bstan pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i gnas snang ba med pa'i spyod yul la ston te/ 'di la blo gros chen po ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis bdag tu mngon par zhen par mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /'o ma'i sman gyi dpe dang nor bu'i dpe'i/ /zhes par/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo las/ 'di lta ste dper na rgyal po mi mkhas pa shes pa chung ba la/ sman pa yang mi mkhas pa glen pa zhig yod na/ rgyal pos ma rtogs pas/ sman pa de la bya dga' cher stsol to/ /sman pa glen pa des ni nad thams cad la sman du 'o ma gtong ste/ nad thog ma ci las gyur pa yang mi shes la/ sman du 'o ma gtong pa la yang mi mkhas pas/ rlung nad dang pad kan dang 'khris pa'i nad thams cad la yang sman du 'o ma gtong ste/ rgyal pos ni sman pa nyid kyang ma rtogs la 'o ma bzang ngam ngan pa'i bye brag kyang mi phyed do/ /de la sman pa mkhas pa rig pa brgyad dang ldan pa nad thams cad gso bar shin tu mkhas pa dpyad thams cad khong du chud pa zhig yul gzhan nas 'ongs nas/ de'i tshe sman pa mi mkhas pa des mkhas pa de la 'dri ba'am slob par ni mi byed kyi phyir nga rgyal kyi sems —134—

bskyed do/ /de'i tshe sman pa mkhas pa de mi mkhas pa de la bsten nas slob dpon du bzung ste/ sman dpyad gsang ba dag bslab pa'i phyir sman pa glen pa de la bdag ni khyod la slob dpon du gsol gyis/ dpyad rnams bstan zhing bshad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab na sman pa glen pa des mkhas pa de la 'di skad ces dam 'cha' 'o/ /khyod ci ste lo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi bar du kho bo'i g.yog bya na/ dpyad rnams bstan to zhes bsgo'o/ /de nas sman pa mkhas pa des mi mkhas pa de'i lung bzhin du bdag gis de bzhin bgyi'o/ /bdag gi rngo ci thogs khyod kyi g.yog bgyi'o zhes smras so/ /de nas sman pa glen pa des sman pa gsar ba khrid nas rgyal po'i pho brang du chas so/ /rgyal po dang phrad nas de'i tshe sman pa gsar pa des rgyal po la dpyad rnam pa sna tshogs dang / gzhan yang sgyu rtsal mang po'i gtam dang / yul gyi srid bzung ba dang / nad pa gso ba'i thabs 'di'o/ /rgyal po chen po thugs su chud par gyis shigatsos gtam byas so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po de'i de skad smras pa thos pa dang / sman pa rnying de mi mkhas par shes nas yul de nas bskrad do/ /de nas kyang sman pa gsar ba de la lhag par rim gro dang bkur sti bskyed do/ /de'i tshe sman pa gsar de 'di snyam du rgyal po 'di la bstan pa'i dus la bab po snyam du bsam nas rgyal po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rgyal po chen po bdag la dgongs pa mang na/ bdag gi gsol ba cig gnang bar mdzode cig /rgyal pos smras pa/ kho bo'i lag pa g.yas pa nas lus kyi yan lag thams cad kyi bar du yid bzhin du slong shig dang / thams cad sbyin par bya'o/ rnga na pa des gsol pa/ 'di ltar rgyal po'i lus kyi yan —135—

lag thams cad kyang bdag lwa bstsa la bar gnang mod kyi/ bdag thugs mi thub la mang po yang gsol na/ deng slan chad yul mi thams cad kyis sman pa rnying gi dpyad/ sman du 'o ma gtong ba shos gcad par bkar ༷gtags su (btag tu kag sol/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ sman de ni gdug pa dang bcas pas mang du 'chi ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te sman de gtong ba yod na yan lag gi dam pa mgo gcad do/ /zhes bkar btag na/ sman 'o ma las gtong ba chod pas dus ma ran par 'chi ba med do/ /thams cad bde zhing skyid par 'gyur gyis bdag gi gsol ba 'di gnang bar mdzod cig /de nas rgyal pos smras pa/ khyod gsol ba 'di shin tu phan par 'gyur ba yin te/ deng phyin chad yul mi las na ba zhig yod na/ sman 'o ma gtong du mi gnang ngo / /gal te 'o ma gtong ba zhig yod na/ yan lag gi dam pa mgo gcad do zhes bkar btags so/ /de'i tshe sman pa mkhas pa de tsha ba dang kha ba dang skyur ba dang mngar ba dang bska ba la sogs te ro rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sman te/ nad gsos pa gang yang ma gsos pa med do/ /de nas phyis ring bo ma lon par rgyal po de nad kyis btab nas sman pa de bkug ste/ 'di ltar nga ni nad kyis shin tu sdug bsngal bar gyur na/ ji ltar gso zhes smras pa dang / sman pa des rgyal po'i nad bltas nas sman du 'o ma dgos pa 'dra nas/ rgyal po la gsol pa/ rgyal po'i nad thabs dang sbyar na sman du 'o ma btang 'tshal te/ bdag gis sngar sman du 'o ma btang du mi rung zhes gsol ba rdzun du gyur te/ sman du 'o ma las bzang ba ma mchis la/ rgyal bo'i nad kyang tsha ba las gyur pas sman du 'o ma btang na bzang ngo / /rgyal pos —136—

smras pa/ sman pa khyod 'on te myos sam tsha ba'i nad kyis btab na nad 'di la 'o ma phan no zhes smra/ khyod kyis sngar 'o ma la dug yod do zhes smras na/ da ji ltar btung khyod kyis nga la bag bgam mam/ sman pa snga mas bsngags pa la dug yod do zhes byas pas/ sman pa cig bskrad pa'i 'og tu da yang na ba la sman du 'o ma bzang ngo zhes khyod smra ba dang sbyar na/ de'i sman pa rnying (ba 3ni khyod pas mkhas nges so/ /de nas sman pas yang rgyal po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rgyal po de skad ma gsungs shig /dper na srin bu shing zan gyi rjes la yi ger rung ba yang yod de/ srin bus ni yi ge yin nam ma yin pa mi shes kyi/ de la mkhas pa shes rab can gyis mthong nas srin bus yi ge shes so zhes ngo mtshar du mi 'dzin to/ /rgyal po chen po sman pa snga ma yang de dang 'dra ste/ nad rnams mi rtogs pas thams cad la sman 'o ma gtong ba ni/ ji ltar srin bu'i rjes las yi ger 'gyur ba bzhin te/ sman pa snga mas ni 'o ma bzang ngan dang rung mi rung mi shes so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ sman pa snga mas ji lta bur mi shes/ sman pas smras pa/sman 'o ma zhes bya ba ni/ gdug pa yang lags la bdud rtsi yang lags so/ /de la ji ltar na 'o ma de gdug pa yang yin la/ bdud rtsi yang yin zhe na/ gal te ba nyid sbang ma dang rtsa sbyin pa dang / phub ma zos la be'u yang shin tu dul zhing /'tsho ba'i sa yang ri mthon po'i steng ma yin/ grong ma yin pa na 'tsho zhing / chu yang 'bab chu dwangs pa la blud de drag tu mi bda'/ khyu mchog dang khyu gcig tu mi 'tsho bar bag yangs su za zhing 'thung la/ 'gro ba dang sdod pa yang bag yangs su gyur pa'i ba'i 'o ma ni nad rnams la phan pas bdud rtsi zhes bya'o/ /'o —137—

ma de ma yin pa ni thams cad kyang gdug pa dang bcas pa zhes bya'o/ /de'i tshe na rgyal po chen pos de skad ces smras pa thos nas sman pa legs so shin tu legs par smras so/ /da slan chad 'o ma bzang ngan dang rung mi rung yang shes so/ /de nas sman du 'o ma btang na nad kyang byang bar gyur te/ yul mi thams cad la da phyid chad sman du 'o ma thongs shig ces bka' btangs so/ /yul mi rnams kyis de skad thos nas/ thams cad gshe rgya ste/ rgyal po 'di ni yi dwags kyis brlams sam smyos sam ci nyes na/ bdag cag bslus te sman du 'o gru/ thongs shig ces gsungs/ yul mi thams cad khros bzhin du rgyal po'i spyan sngar lhag go /de la rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ khyed nga la ma gshe zhig sman du 'o ma btang du rung mi rung ni sman pa 'dis dpyad yin gyis ngas ma nyes so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po chen po dang yul mi thams cad kyang shin tu dga' zhing mgur bar gyur nas/sman pa de la lhag par rim gro dang bkur sti bskyed de/ nad pa thams cad la sman 'o ma btang bas nad kyang byang bar gyur to/ /dge slong khyed kyang de lta bu'i tshul du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa mkhyen pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten rig pa bla na med par skyes bus 'dul zhing kha lo bsgyur ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la de ltar rig par bya ste/ sman pa chen po lta bur 'jig rten tu blta skegs nas/ mu stegs can ngan par lta ba'i sman pa thams cad btul/ nas rgyal po thams cad la nga ni sman pa'o/ /zhes brjod de/ mu stegs can dag 'dul ba'i phyir/ 'di skad du bdag med do/ /gang zag med do/ /sems can — —138—

med/ 'tsho ba med/ shed can med/ shed bdag med/ shes pa dang / bya ba dang /byed pa po med do zhes brjod par gsungs so/ /dge slong dag mu stegs can gyi bdag ces brjod pa ni/ srin bu'i rjes las yi ger gyur pa dang 'dra ste/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pas ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la bdag med do zhes gsungs te/ de ni sems can gdul ba'i phyir dus mkhyen pa'i phyir/ de ltar bdag med ces gsungs pa yang rgyu yod rkyen yod pas na bdag yod ces gsungs pa ni/ ji ltar sman pa mkhas pas 'o ma la sman du rung ba dang mi rung ba shes pa dang 'dra ste/ byis pa ma rabs kyis bdag tu 'dzin pa lta bu ni ma yin no/ /byis pa ma rabs kyis bdag tu 'dzin pa ni mthe bo tsam zhe'am/ yungs dkar tsam zhe'am/ rdul phra mo tsam du 'dzin to/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bdag ces brjod pa ni de lta bu ma yin pas/ chos thams cad la bdag med do zhes gsungs kyang yang dag par na bdag med pa ma yin te/ bdag ces bya ba ni chos gang bden pa yang dag pa/ rtag pa gnas pa bdag por gyur pa mi 'gyur mi 'pho ba de ni bdag ces bya ste/ ji ltar sman pa chen po de sman 'o ma la mkhas pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin gzhags pa yang de dang 'dra ste/ so so'i skye bo'i phyir chos thams cad la yang dag par bdag yod do zhes gsungs kyis khyed la sogs pa 'khor rnam bzhi yang de lta bu'i tshul du chos thams cad la nan tan du gyis shig ces dang / gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po bstan pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na nor bu mkhan mkhas pa nor bu sbyong ba'i tshul legs par shes pa des/—139—
