nor bu rin po che'i rigs nas yongs su ma dag pa'i nor bu rin po che blangs te lan tshwa'i chu rnon pos sbangs nas skra'i re bas yongs su sbyong bas yongs su sbyong bar byed do/ /de tsam gyis brtson pa 'dor ba yang ma yin te/ de'i 'og tu zas kyi khu ba rnon pos spangs nas bal gyi lwa ba'i yongs su sbyong bas yongs su sbyong bar byed do/ /de tsam gyis brtson pa 'dor ba yang ma yin te/ de'i 'og tu sman chen po'i khu ba la yang sbangs nas ras srab mos yongs su sbyong bas yongs su sbyong bar byed do/ /yongs su sbyangs te dri ma dang bral ba ni bi rje rla'i rigs chen po zhes brjod do/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa yang yongs su ma dag pa'i sems can gyi khams mkhyen nas/ mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang bdag med pa dang mi gtsang par yid 'byung ba'i gtam gyis/ 'khor ba la dga' ba'i sems can rnams skyo ba skyed par mdzad de 'phags pa'i chos 'dul pa la 'dzud par mdzad do/ /de tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa brtson pa 'dor ba yang ma yin te/ de'i 'og tu stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smod pa med pa'i gtam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul rtogs par mdzad do/ /de tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa brtson pa 'dor ba yang ma yin te/ de'i 'og tu phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i gtam 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i gtam gyis/ rang bzhin sna tshogs kyi rgyu can gyi sems can de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la 'jug par mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /myang 'das chen por phyir ci log brgyad gsungs zhes pa'i skabs su/ mdo las/ khyed smra ba ltar na bdag cag kyang mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med —140—

pa'i 'du shes la nan to byed do zhes bya ba ni yang dag par don med do/ /nan tan byed pa gsum po de la yang dag pa'i don med pas/ de ma yin pa nan tan byed pa'i chos gsum po las lhag pa ngas bshad par bya'o// sdug bsngal ba la bde bar 'dzin pa dang / bde ba la sdug bsngal du 'dzin pa ni phyin ci log gi chos so/ /mi rtag pa la rtag par 'dzin pa dang / rtag pa la mi rtag par 'dzin pa ni phyin ci log gi chos so/ /bdag med pa la bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / bdag la bdag med par 'dzin pa ni phyin ci log gi chos so/ /yongs su ma dag pa la yongs su dag par 'dzin pa dang / /yongs su dag pa la yongs su ma dag par 'dzin pa ni phyin ci log gi chos so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lang kar gshegs mdor sems tsam las 'das gsungs/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ mdo de nyid las/ sems tsam la ni brten nas su/ /phyi rol don du mi brtag go /snang ba med pa la brten nas/ /sems tsam las ni 'da' bar bya/ /yang dag dmigs pa la brten nas/ /snang ba med las 'da' bar bya/ /rnal 'byor snang ba med gnas na/ /theg pa chen po mi mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs des na gang dag bdag nyid kun rdzob 'jig rten phal ba dang bstun pa dang / nyan thos sde gnyis bzhin smras nas theg chen gyi dgongs pa 'chad pa la skyon gyi phung po nye bar gnas pa ma shes par/ kun rdzob 'jog pa sems tsam dang mthun pa tsam la skyon du lta ba ni mon sba gro ba'i zhus dag gam/ lwa ba can gyi rgyal khams kyi dpe ste ches ga zha'i rgyu'o/ /mtshan nyid gsum po sher phyin las kyang bstan/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ byams zhus kyi le'u las/ byams pa shes rab kyi —141—

pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing chos rab tu 'byed mkhas pa la gnas pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam pa gsum gyis gzugs rab tu dbye ba gdags pa rjes su shes par bya'o/ /tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa nas sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi bar du rab tu dbye ba gdags pa rjes su shes par bya ste/ 'di ltar 'di ni yongs su brtags pa'i gzugs/ 'di ni rnam par brtags pa'i gzugs/ 'di ni chos nyid kyi gzugs so/ /'di ltar 'di ni yongs su brtags pa'i tshor pa/ 'di ni rnam par brtags pa'i tshor ba/ 'di ni chos nyid kyi tshor ba'o/ /'di ltar 'di ni yongs su brtags pa'i 'du shes/ 'di ni rnam par brtags pa'i 'du shes/ 'di ni chos nyid kyi 'du shes so/ /'di ltar 'di ni yongs su brtags pa'i 'du byed/ 'di ni rnam par brtags pa'i 'du byed/ 'di ni chos nyid kyi 'du byed do/ /'di ltar 'di ni yongs su brtags pa'i rnam par shes pa/ 'di ni rnam par brtags pa'i rnam par shes pa/ 'di ni chos nyid kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba nas/ 'di ltar 'di dag ni yongs su brtags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos/ 'di dag ni rnam par brtags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos/ 'di dag ni chos nyid kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos so zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das yongs su brtags pa'i gzugs gang lags/ rnam par brtags pa'i gzugs gang lags/ chos nyid kyi gzugs gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das yongs su brtags pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa —142—

gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das yongs su brtags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos gang lags/ rnam par brtags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos gang lags/ chos nyid kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ byams pa 'du byed gyi mtshan ma'i dngos po/ de dang de dag la gzugs so zhes ming dang / 'du shes dang /brda dang / gdags pa dang / tha snyad du bya ba la brten nas/ gzugs kyi ngo bo nyid du yongs su brtags pa gang yin pa 'di ni yongs su brtags pa'i gzugs so/ /byams pa 'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po de dang de dag la tshor ba dang 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnam par shes pa nas sangs rgyas kyi chos zhes bya ba'i bar du ming dang 'du shes dang brda dang gdags pa dang tha snyad du bya ba la brten nas tshor ba'i ngo bo nyid dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa nas sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi ngo bo nyid du yongs su brtags pa gang yin pa 'di dag ni yongs su brtags pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang /rnam par shes pa nas sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi bar du 'di dag ni yongs su brtags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos so/ /'du byed kyi mtshan ma'i dngos po de dang de dag la rnam par rtog pa'i chos nyid tsam du gnas pa'i rnam par rtog pa la brten nas mngon par smra ba gang la 'di ni ming dang / 'du shes dang / brda dang /gdags pa dang / tha snyad kyi gzugs so/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa nas sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi bar du'o zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni rnam par brtags pa'i gzugs so/ /'di ni rnams par brtags pa'i tshor ba/ rnam par brtags pa'i 'du shes/ rnam par brtags pa'i 'du byed/—143—

rnam par brtags pa'i rnam par shes pa/ rnam par brtags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi bar du'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'byung yang rung / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ma byung yang rung / chos nyid dang chos kyi gnas nyid kyi dbyings 'di dag ni gnas pa nyid de/ brtags pa'i gzugs gang yin pa des rnam par brtags pa'i gzugs de rtag cing rtag pa'i dus brtan cing brtan pa'i dus su ngo bo nyid med cing chos bdag med pa dang / de bzhin nyid dang yang dag pa'i mtha' gang yin pa 'di ni chos nyid kyi gzugs so/ /'di ni chos nyid kyi tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa nas 'di dag ni chos nyid kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos so zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gzugs 'di gsum las/ gzugs gang rdzas ma mchis par lta bar bgyi/ gang rdzas mchis pa lags/ gang rdzas mchis pa yang ma lags/ rdzas ma mchis pa yang ma lags la don dam pas rab tu phye ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das tshor ba 'di gsum dang / 'du shes 'di gsum dang / 'du byed 'di gsum dang / rnam par shes pa 'di gsum nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di gsum gyi bar du sangs rgyas kyi chos gang rdzas ma mchis par blta bar bgyi/ gang rdzas mchis par blta bar bgyi/ gang rdzas ma mchis pa yang ma lags/ rdzas mchis pa yang ma lags par blta bar bgyi zhing don dam pas rab tu phye ba lags/ de skad ces gsol ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la bka' stsal pa/ byams pa yongs su brtags —144—

pa'i gzugs gang yin pa de ni rdzas med par blta'o/ /rnam par brtags pa'i gzugs gang yin pa de ni rnam par rtog pa rdzas su yod pa'i phyir rdzas yod par lta ba'i rang dbang du 'jug pa ni ma yin no/ /chos nyid kyi gzugs gang yin pa de ni rdzas med pa yang ma yin rdzas yod pa yang ma yin te/ don dam pas rab tu phye ba yin par blta'o zhes gsungs so/ /gnas skabs rigs chad kyang ni zhes pa'i skabs su brgyad stong pa las/ shā ri'i bu de lta bu'i gang zag de dag ni chos la sun 'byin par rig par bya'o/ shwa ri'i bu gang zag de lta bu de dag ni shing rul pa lta bur gyur pa yin no/ shwa ri'i bu gang zag de dag ni nag po'i rang bzhin du rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnas skabs theg gsum rang stong smra ba'ang 'dod/ /ces pa ni/ bye mdo gnyis ni theg pa gsum gar mthar thug tu 'dod/ klu sgrub dang thogs med rjes 'brang ma yin pa'i dbu sems kyi theg chen pa mang po zhig /gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dbye ba med par theg pa gcig kho nar 'dod mod/ thal rang gi slob dpon rnams ni gnas skabs theg gsum du mi 'dod mkhan med la/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i le'u gnyis pa brgya byin gyi le'u las gang dag yang dag pa nyid du nges pa la zhugs pa de dag ni bla na med pa yang dag pa pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i skal ba med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag gis 'khor ba'i rgyun las mtshams bcad pas de dag yang dang yang du 'khor zhing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i skal ba med do zhes gsungs shing /'bum dang khri brgyad stong pa dang nyi khri rnams su'ang gsungs te yul nges pa dang sgyu —145

zhes pa'i skabs kyi mdo yin no/ /des na zhi ba bgrod pa phyogs gcig pa sher phyin du'ang gsal lo/ /byams zhus le'ur yang ni de mthun gsungs/ /zhes pa ni/ de nyid las/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ nyan thos thams cad phyogs gcig pa'am/ shin tu mya ngan las 'das pa la gnas pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byams pa de ma yin no/ /de'i ci phyir zhe na/ byams pa/ 'jig rten pa 'di dag ni khams sna tshogs pa khams du ma pa ste/ khams sna tshogs khams du ma pa'i 'jig rten pa de dag la sems can gyi rigs dang /rang bzhin rab tu mang po yod de/ byams pa sems can gyi rus dang rigs dang po nas bzang po'i khyad par 'dod cing bzang po'i khyad par nyid thob pa de lta bu yang yod do/ /sems can gyi rus dang rigs dang po nas khyad par ngan pa 'dod cing ngan pa nyid thob ste/ de nyid kyis mgu bar 'gyur ba de lta bu yang yod do/ /rus dang rigs gang thog ma nas ngan pa'i bye brag 'dod cing ngan pa nyid 'thob ste/ ngan pa thob nas/ de tsam gyis mgu bar mi 'gyur zhing de nas phyis gong du bzang po'i khyad par 'dod cing bzang po thob par 'gyur ba de lta bu dag kyang yod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na thogs med sku mched rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams dbu ma kho na la yongs su spyod do zhes shes par bya'o/ /ga las 'jig med sogs kyang mthun shas che/ /zhes pa'i skabs su 'grel pa de nyid las/ don dam pa'i bden pa ni 'phags pa rnams kyis chos thams cad phyin ci log /thugs su chud pas skye ba med par gzigs pa gang yin pa ste/ de ni de dag nyid la don dam par bden pa yin pas don dam pa'i bden pa'o/ /zhes —146—

pa dang / khyad par bstod tshogs rnams dang zhes pa'i skabs su/ chos dbyings bstod pa las/ gang zhig kun tu ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor ba/ /sems can kun la nges gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /de nyid sbyang ba byas pa las/ /dag pa de nyid mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi sku yang de nyid do/ /zhes dang / ji ltar rin chen biḍar+ya/ /dus rnams kun tu 'od gsal yang / /rdo yi nang na gnas gyur na/ /de yi 'od ni gsal ma yin/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis dkris pa'i/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med pa'ang / /'khor bar 'od ni gsal ba (ma ka yin/ /mya ngan 'das na 'od gsal 'gyur/ /zhes dang / chos dbyings 'di med dgag ma yin par ye shes yin pa dang / stong pa nyid bstan pas chos dbyings 'di bkag par mi 'gyur pa yang / stong pa nyid ni ston pa'i mdo/ /rgyal bas ji snyed gsungs ba gang / /de dag kun gyis nyon mongs bzlog /dbyings de nyams par byed ma yin/ /sa yi'i dkyil na yod pa'i chu/ /dri ma med par gnas pa ltar/ /nyon mongs nang na ye shes kyang / /de bzhin dri ma med par gnas/ /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas bden grub tu ston pa yang / ji ltar yi dwags rnams kyis ni/ /rgya mtsho skam par mthong ba bzhin/ /de bzhin mi shes pas sgrib pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni med par blta/ /dman pa bsod nams dman pa la/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ci bgyir mchi/ /zhes so/ /don dam par bstod pa las kyang /chos rnams kun la mi gnas pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dngos gyur cing / /mchog tu zab pa nyid brnyes pa/ /zab mo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes chos can la mi —147—

gnas par chos dbyings la gnas par bshad pa dang / dpe med par bstod pa las kyang / rtag cing brtan la zhi ba yi/ /chos kyi rang bzhin khyod kyi sku/ /zhes chos sku rtag brtan ther zug tu bstan pa dang / 'jig rten 'das par bstod pa las kyang / kun rtog thams cad spang ba'i phyir/ /stong nyid bdud rtsi ston mdzad na/ /gang zhig de la zhen gyur pa/ /de nyid khyod kyis shin tu smad/ /bem po g.yin dbang stong pa nyid/ sgyu ma bzhin du rkyen 'byung bar/ /mgon po khyod kyi chos kun gyi/ /dngos med goms par mdzad pa lags/ khyod kyis cung zhig ma bskyed cing / /'ga' yang bkag pa ma mchis la/ /sngon gyi de bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /de bzhin nyid ni thugs su chud/ /ces stong nyid tsam po la zhen pa'i skyon dang / kun brtags gzhan dbang rten 'brel bden med dang / chos nyid 'phel 'grib dang bral ba rang bzhin 'gyur med du gsungs so/ /gsang 'dus rim lnga'i dgongs pa bla na med pa'i rim pa las kyang / stong pa gsum ni rnam dag gang / /'od gsal bar ni 'dir bshad de/ /thams cad stong par de brjod do/ /zhes pa dang / thams cad stong pa smad po che/ /dwangs shing gsal ba ye shes che/ /bla ma nyid kyi drin gyis ni/ /de ni de nas gsal mthong 'gyur/ /zhes stong nyid ye shes su bshad pa dang / rim pa bzhi pa las kyang /nang gi bde ba rnyog bral sangs rgyas byang chub skad cig dag gis thob par 'gyur zhes/ don dam pa bde chen du gsungs pa dang / zung 'jug gi rim pa las kyang / gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa zhes/ /rnam gnyis blo ni yod min gyi/ /gang du mi phyed blo yod pa/ /de ni zung 'jug ces byar bshad/ /ces —148—

gnyis snang can gyi shes pa bden med dang / gnyis med kyi ye shes bden yod du bshad do/ /byang chub sems 'grel las kyang / kun brtags dang ni gzhan dbang dang / /yongs su grub pa nyid dag ni/ /stong nyid bdag nyid gcig pu yi/ /ngo bo sems la brtags pa yin/ /zhes stong nyid sems don dam yongs grub tu bshad pas so/ /'on kyang 'khrul gzhi 'byung ba ni bden te cung zad mi gsal ba dang / bsdus pa'i tshul gyis gzhan stong bstan pas so/ /de'i phyir tsan+d+ra go mi dang zla ba grags pa'i rtsod pa lo bdun du byung ba la/ mkhas pas ched du brjod pa 'di yun ring mor ma ga dha'i grong khyer gyi khye'u bu mo tshun chad kyang glur len te/ kye ma 'phags pa klu sgrub gzhung / /la la'i sman la la la'i dug /mi pham 'phags pa thogs med gzhung / /skye bo kun la bdud rtsi nyid/ /ces sgrog go /lung bstan ltar na'ang zhes pa'i skabs su/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ so so rang rig theg pa ni/ /rtog ge ba yi spyod yul min/ /mgon po 'das pa'i 'og tu ni/ /'dzin par su 'gyur bshad du gsol/ /bde gshegs mya ngan 'das pa'i 'og /tshul rnams 'dzin par 'gyur ba ste/ /dus dag 'das nas 'byung ba de/ blo gros chen po khyod shes byos/ /lho phyogs be da'i yul du ni/ /dge slong dpal ldan cher grags pa/ /de ming klu zhes 'bod pa ste/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'jig pa/ /nga yi theg pa 'jig rten du/ /bla med theg chen rab bshad nas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa bsgrubs te/ /bde ba can du de 'gro 'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsang sngags rgyud las dkyil 'khor gtso bor bstan/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ khro bo khams gsum rnam —149—

rgyal gyi rtogs par/ ji skad du/ de nas dkyil 'khor 'byung ba ste/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khore bri pa der/ /byams pa bzhag ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi dang /byang chub sems dpa' bzhi bya ste/ go cha bstan pa'i phyag rgyas zhugs la 'di zhes brjod do/ /badz+ra ḍi dhi tiṣ+ṭha zhes pa nas byams pa'i rtogs pa'o zhes pa'i bar du rgyas par gsungs so/ /gzhan yang mang ngo / /zhal lung dang ni zhes pa'i skabs su/ gzugs la sogs nas kun mkhyen gyi/ /bar gyi chos rnams rang bzhin ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ltar rnam dag pa'i/ /zab gsal gnyis med ye shes te/ /zhes gsungs/ lta 'dod mdor bstan las ni zhes pa'i skabs su/de nyid las/ phung po rnam dpyad stong nyid ni/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /khyad par rang rang gzhung dang dngos su 'gal/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs/ /dag pa nyid de gang gi phyir/ /de gnyis tha dad ma yin zhing / /dpyad du med pas dag par brjod/ /ces dang / 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni/ /rnam par rtog rigs ci zhig zad/ /skye med rnam pa ci zhig thob/ /ces pa dang / de bzhin du/ zab pa de ni sgro 'dogs dang / /bskur ba'i mtha' las grol ba nyid/ /ces pa dang / dngos po brjod du med pa la/ /nyams pa dang ni 'phel mi rung / /bsgom zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni/ /ci zhig nyams shing ci zhig 'thob/ /byang chub ji ltar de bzhin du/ /'di ni 'dod pa'i don sgrub byed/ /byang chub de bzhin nyid mtshan nyid/ /de 'ang de'i mtshan nyid —150—

bzhed/ /ces gsungs pa la/ rang stong smra ba da lta'i rnams kyi ltar na/ bden pa'i spang thob med pa dang bden pa'i zad med dang skye med du 'dod pa sogs ni/spyir bden pa bkag pas khegs pa'i phyir/ dgos su dpyad pa 'di dag mi dgos shing / rang stong pa'i lugs kyi stong nyid dam/ dag pa de yang rigs pas dpyad mi bzod cing / 'thad pa sgrub pa'i rigs pa'i yul las ma 'das pa'i phyir dpyad du me/da pa zhes pa dang yang 'gal/ des na dpyad pa'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir/ rigs pas dpyad bzod bden grub bo/ khres bya 'dir chos can rang stong pa'i lugs la stong nyid de dpyad du yod pa yin te/ gcig du bral dang rten 'brel gyi rigs pa sogs kyis dpyad pa'i tshe/ bden med du gtan la 'bebs thub pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub dang de bzhin nyid ngo bo gcig par bshad cing / de nyid 'dod pa'i don sgrub byed yin par bshad pas/ med par dgag pa ni ci yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i don ji ltar sgrub/ gzhan yang 'di nyid las/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /rigs ni tha dad rung ma yin/ /brten pa'i chos kyi bye brag gis/ /de'i dbye ba yongs su brjod/ /ces gsungs pas/ med dgag la rten brten pa dang rigs kyi don mi rung la/ chos dbyings la rigs dang rten brten pa'i rnam gzhag 'thad pa'i phyir chos dbyings gzhan stong kho na'o/ /rgyud bla ma las kyang / rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyis stong ma yin/ /zhes gsungs shing gnyis kar du/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la —15/—

yang dag blta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /thogs med rgyal bas drang nges 'byed pa yi/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ thogs med ces bya'i dge slong ni/ /bstan bcos de ni don la mkhas/ /mdo sde nges don drang ba'i don/ /rnam pa mang bo'ang rab tu 'byed/ /'jig rten rigs pa ston bdag nyid/ /gzhung byed ngang tshul can du 'gyur/ /de yis rigs pas grub pa 'di/ /swā la'i pho nya mo zhes brjod/ /de yi sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /blo ni bzang po skyes par 'gyur/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas bya'i phyir/ /mdo yi de nyid don sdud byed/ /lo ni brgya dang lnga bcur 'tsho/ /de lus zhig nas lha yul 'gro/ /'khor ba rnams su 'khor ba na/ /yun ring bde ba rjes myong nas/ /bdag nyid chen po mthar gyis de/ /byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang dbyig gnyen sogs kyi skabs su/ yang de nyid las/ gzhan gyi grub mtha' sun 'byin pa/ /sna khri ba sngon dang sman pa sngon/ /gnyis ka spyin byed sna tshogs byed/ /ye ge pa zhes sdom brtson grags/ /zhes pas slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang / blo ldan dang po yi ge ma/ /de bzhin sdom brtson dad pa 'byung / /zhes slob dpon blo gros bstan pa dang / yi ge nga dang la dang por/ /sdom brtson gang zhig rab gsungs dang / /zhes phyogs kyi glang po dang / yi ge dha zhes sdom brtson nyid/ /lho'i phyogs su rnam par grags/ /pha rol rgol ba bzlog nas kyang / /de bzhin sdom brtson sngags kyang 'grub/ /ces slob dpon chos kyi grags pa dang / rin chen 'byung zhes bya ming dang / /zhes slob dpon sharnyi pa rnams te/ de dag gi mjug tu/ sdom brtson —152—

thams cad bsgrags pa yang / /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed pa/ /zhes bstan pa gsal byed kyi dgongs 'grel mchog dang / de yis byang chub mchog thob 'gyur/ /zhes byang chub tu yang lung bstan to/ /nag po chen po'i rgyud rwa chos rab kyis bsgyur ba las kyang / paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi gtso bor gyur pa chos kyi grags pa zhes par yongs su grags pa 'di dang / skyes bu drug bstan pa la phan pa tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa rnams kyi grub pa thob bo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang dul ba lha dang / yon to 'od sogs 'gran zla med pa'i shing rta wo po mang po dang / tsan+t+ra go mi/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ kun dga' snying po/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ mi tri pa sogs/ rig 'dzin grub brnyes mtha' yas pa dag 'di bzhed do/ /brten nas ngo bo nyid med rnam gsum la/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ don dam yang dag 'phags pa chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid med pa nyid rnam pa gsum po 'di lta ste/mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa nyid dang / skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa nyid dang / don dam pa ngo bo nyid med pa nyid la dgongs nas/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pa'o zhes bstan to/ /zhes mdor bstan nas rjes su rgyas par gsungs so/ /'ga' zhig gzhan stong ni mu stegs sogs kyi skabs su/ myang 'das chen po las/ gzhan yang rnam par grol ba ni mi stong pa'i stong pa'o/ /stong pa'i stong pa zhes bya ba ni ci yang med pa'o/ /ci yang med pa ni mu stegs gcer bu pa rnams kyi rnam par grol ba lta bu'o/ /zhes pa dang / sor mo'i 'phreng ba la phan pa'i mdor yang / 'jam dpal gyis/ thar pa nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /nam mkha' —153—

la yang mtshan nyid med/ /thar pa sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs/ /stong pa ci yang med pa dag /sor 'phreng khyod kyis ga la shes/ /zhes rang stong bstan pa la/ /sor 'phreng gis dgag gzhag rgyas par brjod nas mthar 'di skad ces gcer bu pa yang thams cad stong par sgom ste/ gcer bu pa'i sbrang ma khyod cing ma zer cig ces gsungs pas/ mu stegs ( 〈dze+e〉 rtse pa )dang mtshungs par sangs rgyas kyis bshad pa ni rang stong pa'o/ /khyad par kun gzhi ye shes ma bshad pas/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ 'ga' zhig kun gzhi ye shes gang du yang bstan pa med do snyam na/ ma yin te/ rgyan stug po'i mdo las/ nyi ma zla ba'i nor bu dag /yongs su dag pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /nyi zla'i zer gyis 'phog pa dang / /de dag rang gi yon tan 'byin/ /de bzhin kun gzhi'i shes pa rab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dge /zag med legs dang ldan gyur te/ /gzhan du gyur na rab tu 'byin/ /zhes kun gzhi'i shes pa kun gzhi rnam shes las gzhan pa zag med kyi rang bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid 'byin par bshad pas/kun gzhi yang yin la ye shes yang yin pas kun gzhi ye shes las gzhan du ci zhig gzhan la lung gsal yod ces pa'i skabs su/ rgyan stug po las/ phung po gang zag bdag med par/ /rab tu rnam phye mthong gyur cing / /chos kyi dngos yod ma bshig par/ /nyan thos de dag mngon rtogs 'gyur/ /bdag med gnyis la mkhas pa rnams/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams sgom par byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /dam chos pad dkar las kyang 'od srung chen pos/ chos 'di thams cad zag med zhi ba ste/ /'gog pa dang ni skye ba rnam par spangs/ /'di na chos rnams —154—

gang yang ma mchis zhes/ /de ltar bsam na dad par ma gyur to/ /zhes so/ /lang gshegs las kyang / gzhan yang blo gros chen po/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad ni shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / las kyi bag chags ma spangs pa'i phyir/ chos la bdag med pa ma bsgoms shing / bsam gyis mi khyab par 'gyur ba'i shi 'pho ba ma thob pas/ nyan thos rnams la theg pa gsum du bstan te/ theg pa gcig tu ma yin no zhes so/ /don dam 'gog pa'i bden pa bden gcig pu/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ dpal phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'di dag las bden pa gsum ni mi rtag pa lags so/ /bden pa gcig ni rtag pa lags so/ /zhes dang / bcom ldan 'das 'di la bden pa gcig ni 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid kyi yul las 'das pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'das gang 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid kyi yul las 'das pa de ni rtag pa lags so/ /gang rtag pa de ni mi bslu pa'i chos can lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang mi bslu ba'i chos can de ni bden pa dang rtag pa dang skyabs lags so/ /zhes gsungs shing mtha' gnyis sel tshul yang /bcom ldan na 'das gal te 'du byed rnams la mi rtag par lta na de ni de'i chad par lta ba ma lags te/ de ni de'i yang dag pa'i lta ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te mya ngan las 'das pa la rtag par lta na de ni de'i rtag par lta ba ma lags te/ de ni de'i yang dag pa'i lta ba lags so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdo las stong nyid rnam pa bdun du gsungs/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ lang kar gshegs pas las/ blo gros chen po de la mdor na stong pa nyid rnam pa bdun —155—

te/ 'di ltar mawo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po'i rang bzhi stong pa nyid dang / srid pa'i stong pa nyid dang / mi srid pa'i stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad brjod du med pa'i stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa 'phags pa'i ye shes stong pa chen po nyid dang / gcig gis gcig stong pa nyid dang bdun no/ /zhes dang /phyi ma gnyis kyi rgyas bshad kyi skabs su/ blo gros chen po don dam pa 'phags pa'i ye shes stong pa nyid chen po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bdag gi so so rang gi 'phags pa'i ye shes khong du chud pa ni lta ba dang nyes pa'i bag chags thams cad kyis stong ste/ de'i phyir don dam pa 'phags pa'i ye shes stong pa nyid chen po zhes bya'o/ /blo gros chen po gcig gis gcig stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ni gcig la gcig med de/ /de'i phyir gcig gis gcig stong ba nyid ces bya'o/ /blo gros chen po gcig gis gcig stong pa nyid 'di ni kun gyi tha shal te/ de ni khyod kyis spangs bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ khrer phyin lnga brgya par yang stong nyid gsum/ /mtshan nyid gsum yang gsungs phyir yid tshes bya/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ mdo de nyid las/ rab 'byor gzugs la stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ rab 'byor gang gzugs la dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / de ltar dngos po yod pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid la dmigs nas/ sems rtse gcig tu byed pa 'di ni stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i de ltar gzugs la stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin yongs su shes par bya'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpas tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam —156—

par shes pa la stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin yongs su shes par bya'o/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ rab 'byor gang rnam par shes pa la dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / de ltar dngos po yod pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid la dmigs nas/ sems rtse gcig tu byed pa 'di ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin te/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' de ltar rnam par shes pa la stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin yongs su shes par bya'o/ /zhes stong nyid gsum dang / rab 'byor gzugs ni dngos po med pa dang / dngos po ngan pa dang / dngos po yod pa'o zhes pa nas/ yid kyi rnam shes kyi bar rgyas par gsungs nas/ de ltar gzugs de le'u gsum du byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mi shes pas/gzugs de la mngon par zhon to/ /mngon par sgrib bo/ /sgrib par byed do/ /de dag gzugs de la mngon par zhen cing / mngon par sgrib ste sgrib par byed pas/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas kyang nges par 'byung bar mi 'gyur na/ theg pa chen pos lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes mtshan nyid gsum gsal bar bstan to/ /'o na lang kar gshegs pa las/ kun rdzob tu ni thams cad yod/ /dam pa'i don du yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir bden gnyis yod mnyam dang med mnyam du mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ 'di ni kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad 'khrul ngor yod kyang / don dam du med par bstan pa yin te/ de nyid las/ chos rnams rang bzhin med pa la/ /dam pa'i don du 'dod na ni/ /dmigs pa rang bzhin med pa la/ /de bzhin kun rdzob bstan pa —157—

yin/ /zhes rang bzhin med tsam don dam ma yin par bshad pa dang / yang dag ye shes de nyid ni/ /yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes ye shes de bzhin nyid du bshad pas so/ /gzhan yang / yang dag nyid kyang skabs der min/ /gang phyir skabs der yang dag na/ /nor ba yang dag nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang / 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes kyi ngo na/ yang dag tu yang 'dzin pa dang bral bar bshad pa yin gyi/ yang dag pa med par bshad pa ma yin no/ /de ltar na/ gzhan stong dbu ma'i tshul mchog 'di ni 'khor lo gsum char gyi dgongs pa mthar thug tu 'gyur mod kyi/ gang la gtso bor bstan pa'i mdo sde ni/ shes phyin nyi khri lnga stong pa'i byams zhug kyi le'u dang / sher phyin lnga brgya pa dang / dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa dang / lang kar gshegs pa dang / rgyan stug po dang / phal bo che rnams su thun mong dang go bstun pa rnams bshad/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo dang / dpal phreng seng ge sgras zhus pa'i mdo la sogs pa 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i nang tshan 'ga' zhig dang /rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs dang / gser 'od dam pa dang / gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa dang / yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug pa dang / sor mo'i 'phreng ba la phan pa'i mdo dang /'phags pa sprin chen po dang / 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin dang / 'phags pa rnga bo che'i le'u zhes bya ba'i mdo dang / mya ngan las 'das pa chen po dang / rab tu zhi ba rnam nges kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo la sogs pa rnams dang / sngags kyi rgyud sde phal cher nas ches thun mong ma yi/na pa'i don rnams shin tu gsal bar —158—

gsungs pa rnams la brtem pa yin no/ /'khor lo bar ba'i dngos bstan phal cher/ mnyam gzhag zab mo'i dbyings la mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshe/ gang du'ang mi dmigs par 'jog pa la gtso bor sbyor zhing / shes bya gtan la 'phebs pa'i sgo nas gsungs pa rnams ni/ byams zhus kyi le'u dang / sher phyin lnga brgya par ston pa nyid kyis bkral ba ltar g.yin stong du 'grel bar byed do/ /dkon mchog ta la la sogs pa'i mdo sde 'ga' zhig rang stong ston par 'khrul ba'ang yod mod kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag gtso bor ston pa'i mdo sde 'byams klas pa rnams ni gnyis kar dang 'brel la/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa dang chos yang dag par sdud pa la sogs pa lhag ma phal cher dbu ma'i lugs 'di dang mthun pa mang pa yin no/ /'o na sems tsam gyi mdo dang bstan bcos logs na med par 'gyur snyam na/ mdo sde ni logs su yod pa ma yin te/ dper na bye mdo gnyis la yang mdo sde tha dad med pa bzhin no/ /sems tsam pa'i bstan bcos thor bu 'ga' zhig ni yod par gsal na yang / byams chos dang / thogs med sku mched kyi gzhung gi rjes su 'brang ba ni ma yin te/ byang chub sems 'grel sogs thogs med kyi sngon du byung ba'i bstan bcos nas bkag pa sogs kyis 'phags pa nā ga rdzu na'i snga rol tu byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na btsun pa chen po a bi tarka dang / dzñā na ta la sogs pa rnal 'byor spyod pa ba'i slob dpon lnga brgya byung bar grags pa ltar yin par mngon no/ /de dag gi bstan bcos ni bod du ma 'gyur ba yin te/sde ba bco brgyad kyi bstan bcos rnams bzhin no/ /des na lang kar gshegs —159—

pa las/ /rgyu med par ni smra bas na/ /rgyu med par ni lta bar rtogs/ / phyi rol dngos po ma rtogs phyir/ /dbu ma 'jig par byed par 'gyur/ /zhes don dam dbu ma 'gog pa'i lugs rang stong pa dang / yang / chad pa'i lta bar 'gyur snyam pas/ /dngos po 'dzin pa mi stong ste/ /zhes kun rdzob tshad grub tu 'dod pa rnams te/ de bzhin du/ skur pa dang ni sgro 'dogs pas/ /dbu ma dag ni ston par 'gyur/ /zhes de dag dbu ma chen po ma yin par gsungs/ sems tsam du ni rtogs pa dang / /phyi rol dngos po rnam gsal bas/ /rnam par rtog pa rnams bzlog ste/ /lam de nyid ni dbu ma'o/ /zhes phyi don dang rnam rig gnyis ka bkag pa dang / gzhan yang / yod dang med pa spangs pa yi/ /grub pa yi ni dngos po yod/ /dngos po yod med rnam grol ba'i/ /rang bzhin gnyis su ji ltar 'gyur/ /zhes yongs grub gzung 'dzin gnyis las 'das pa yod par gsungs te/ gzhan stong dbu ma'o/ /des na/ sems tsam yin te snang ba med/ /snang ba med pas mi skye ste/ /dbu ma yi ni lam 'di yang / /nga dang gzhan dag gis kyang bshad/ /ces 'khru / la snang med pas grub mtha' bzhi'i sems tsam las 'das pa/ sems las gzhan du med par yang 'dod pas sems tsam dang yang mthun pa'i dbu ma'i lam de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs par bshad do/ /zab cing rtogs dka' theg mchog dam chos 'di/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyis myur rtogs nas/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras spyod yul rlabs chen la/ /spyod pa'i don du dge ba 'di dag bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan la nye bar mkho ba'i lung sbyor mdo —160—

oṃ swā sti/ 'dir theg pa chen po nges don gyi dbu ma'i ngo bo ngos gzung bar bya ste/ grub mtha'i rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / dbu ma'i rnam gzhag ngos bzung ba dang / de la gzhan gyis brtags pa'i mtha' bsal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhan sde mu stegs byed kyi lta grub ni thar ba'i lam dang bral ba yin la/rang sde sangs rgyas pa'i lta grub ni thar pa'i lam dang 'brel ba yin no/ /mu stegs pa la thar lam med kyang / mtho ris kyi mngon par mtho ba'i chos ni yod med gnyis te/ rgyang 'phen pa sogs med nga ra lta ba can las 'bras la skur ba 'debs pa sogs dang / 'tshe ba chos kyi gtso bor smra ba rnams la mtho ris kyi lam rnam dag med cing / grangs can pa dang / gcer bu pa dang / lha'i mchog gi rjes 'brang 'ga' zhig dang / mu stegs bsam gtan pa rnams la ni mtho ris kyi lam ni yod de/ sdig pa spong zhing dge ba bsgrubs pas mi dang 'dod khams pa'i lhar skye zhing / bsam gtan bzhi bsgoms pas gzugs khams su skye ba dang / gzugs med kyi ting 'dzin bzhi bsgoms pas gzugs med khams su skye bas so/ /mu stegs rnams la thar lam med pa'i rgyun mtshan ni/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin ces bya ba/ nga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo 'di spong par mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin te/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas brgyud de 'ongs pa'i nga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo brtan po yod pa'i steng du/ grub mthas kyang / nga bdag de nyid —162—

khyad par mang po dang bcas te yod par bsgrub cing / de'i don bsgom pa dang /bdag 'dzin de la gnyen po gzhan yang med pa'i phyir bdag 'dzin spong mi nus shing / bdag 'dzin de ni nyon mongs gzhan thams cad kyi yang rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang mu stegs bzang ba de rnams la skye rga na 'chi sogs mi rtag pa rags pa bsgom pa dang / tshe 'di dang 'dod khams sdug bsngal du shes pa dang /gzugs sogs dngos po rags pa rnams bden med du 'dod pa dang 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa dang / byams snying rje dang / dgra gnyen mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa'i btang snyoms sogs dang / rtsa ba bzhi spong ba sogs lta sgom spyod pa legs po yang yod pas mtho ris kyi lam ni yod do// //sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ bye brag tu smra ba dang /mdo sde ba dang / sems tsam pa dang / dbu ma pa'o/ /de la dang po gnyis ni theg dman nyan thos pa dang / phyi ma gnyis ni theg chen pa'o/ /de rnams la theg pa che chung du 'jog pa yang theg pa chung ngu'i sde snod sangs rgyas kyi bka'i mthar thug tu 'dod pa dang / theg pa chen po'i gsung rab sde snod rnams bka'i mthar thug tu 'dod pas de ltar btags pa yin pas/ theg dman smra ba dang theg chen smra ba zhes bya ba'i grub mtha' theg dman pa dang / grub mtha' theg chen pa zhes grags pa ltar yin la/ gang zag de nyid theg chung ngam theg chen par 'jog pa la ni grub mtha' la mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi bsam sbyor rgyud la skyes pa ni theg chen pa yin la/ theg dman gyi bsam sbyor rgyud la skyes pa ni theg dman pa yin zhing / de gnyis gang yang rgyud la ma skyes na/—163—

gsung rab gang klog gzhung ci bzung grub mtha' ji ltar byed kyang gang zag theg chen pa yang ma yin gang zag theg dman pa yang ma yin no/ /g.yin yang grub mtha' theg chen 'dzin la/ lam theg dman du zhugs pa yang yod/ grub mtha' theg dman 'dzin la lam theg chen du zhugs pa yang yod/ gnyis ka theg chen pa yang yod gnyis ka theg dman pa'ang yod/ grub mtha' 'dzin cing lam du ma zhugs pa ni shin tu yang mang la/ lam du zhugs pa'i gang zag la grub mtha' med pa ni ye mi srid do/ /de dag las bye brag tu smra ba ni/ shes pa sems sems byung gnyis/yul gzugs sogs bcu/ skye 'jig sogs ldan min 'du byed/ nam mkha' sogs 'dus ma byas gsum dang / 'das ma 'ongs kyi dngos po rnams rang rang so so nas rdzas su grub par 'dod cing bden grub kyi cha re yang yod par 'dod la/ rags pa'i dngos po dang rgyun gyi dngos po sogs ni bden med du 'dod cing / yul dang dbang po bden grub las rnam shes skye mig gis gzugs dngos su mthong zer ro/ /'di'i nang tshan kha che bye brag tu smra ba sogs grub mtha' bzang ba rnams ni/ 'dus byas thams cad skad cig gis 'jig pas mi rtag par 'dod pa dang / gang zag gi bdag ni blos btags pa tsam ma gtogs rdzas su med par 'dod/ mang pos bkur ba'i sde ba sogs grub mtha' ngan pa rnams ni/ 'dus byas rnams mthar 'jig pas mi rtag pa yin kyang / skad cig gis 'jig pa min zhes zer zhing de phyir rgyun gyi dngos po yang ci rigs par 'dod la/ mu stegs pa rnams kyis btags pa'i nga bdag rtag pa gcig pu rang —164—

dbang can de 'dra med kyang / spyir nga bdag tsam zhig rdzas grub dang bden grub tu 'dod/ 'di la bdag lta'i skyon gyis dngos su thar ba'i lam med na yang /dkon mchog la skyabs su song zhing / thar 'dod kyi kun nas bslangs pa'i tshul khrims dang thos bsam sgom gsum yod pas/ rim pas thar pa 'thob pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur ro/ /bye brag tu smra ba 'di ni mngon pa sde bdun bkar 'dod cing / mdo sde rnams dgongs pa can dang / drang don gsungs pa mang bas lta grub rnams bstan bcos kyi lugs bzhin du khas len dgos par 'dod la/bstan bcos kyang bye brag tu bshad pa la ngos 'dzin to// //mdo sde ba ni/ gong du bshad pa'i chos de rnams las/ 'dus ma byas dang ldan min 'du byed ni btags yod ces bya ba blos btags pa tsam yin pas bden par med cing / gzugs sogs la rags rgyun dang shes pa la rgyun bden par ma grub/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi chos kyang btags yod tsam yin la/ da ltar ba'i rdul phran tsam dang shes pa skad cig ma tsam cha med bden grub yin/mig gis gzugs mi mthong mig shes kyis kyang gzugs dngos su mi mthong ste/mig shes kyis mthong ba de ni mig shes nyid la gzugs snang shar ba de gzugs kyi rnam par grags pa shes par gyur pa de yin la/ 'on kyang rnam pa 'char ba de la rnam pa gtod byed gzugs sogs phyi rol (na ka yod par 'dod do/ /mngon pa sde bdun sogs ni bka' ma yin zhing / bye brag bshad pa sogs bstan bcos la 'khrul ba yod pas grub mtha' ni mdo sde dang bstun dgos par 'dod do/ /grub mtha' smra ba'i sde 'di gnyis kas kyang sangs rgyas kyi —165—

bka' ni/ nyan thos kyi ched du gsungs pa'i sde snod 'di rnams kho na yin zhing /sher phyin dkon brtsegs phal chen sogs theg chen gyi mdor grags pa 'di kun ni rgyal ba'i bka' ma yin no/ /theg pa che chung ni gang zag gi bya ba'i khyad par yin gyi gsung rab tha dad med do zhes zer ro/ /de rnams kyi gang bden grub tu 'dod pa de kun dang theg chen 'gog pa ni grub mtha' nor 'khrul gyi skyon yin la/ gang zag gi bdag med dang skad cig gis 'jig pa sogs gzhan rnams ni rang sa der ma nor ba yin no// //sems tsam pa ni/ gzugs sogs phyi rol gyi yul rnams rmi lam gyi gzugs sogs ltar shes pa nyid dang der snang ba tsam yin gyi/ phyi rol na de ltar snang ba med de dper na gzugs la mtshon na/ mig gi dbang por grags pa yang / mig gi rnam par snang ba'i sems yin pas/ mig rang mtshan pa zhig med la/ gzugs su grags pa yang gzugs kyi rnam par snang ba'i sems yin pas gzugs rang mtshan pa med cing / de dag las mig gi rnam par shes pa skyes par snang ba tsam yin pas/ gsum kar yang tha dad par snang ba ni 'khrul ba yin zhing shes pa'i ngo bor rdzas gcig pas/ mig shes kyis gzugs mthong ba ni rang gis rang nyid mthong ba yin zhing / gzugs kyi rnam pa 'char ba'i rgyu shes pa las gzhan phyi rol tu rnam pa gtod byed gzugs su grub pa ni gtan nas med do/ /'on kyang ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i ngor mig gis gzugs mthong zhes sogs 'dod kyang dpyad na gzugs ni ma grub/ gzugs su snang ba'i shes pa de ni bden par grub bo/ /des na 'di ni rnam shes sogs shes pa thams cad —166—

kyi ngo bo bden par grub la/ yul phyi rol na yod pa ltar snang ba gzung cha dang /rig pa nang na yod pa ltar snang ba 'dzin cha ste de gnyis 'khrul ba yin pa'i phyir gzung 'dzin gnyis med la/ gzung 'dzin gnyis spangs pa'i rnam par shes pa ni bden par 'dod do/ /zhes 'dod pas gzung cha dang 'dzin cha gnyis tha dad du ma grub pas gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi go chod pa dang / rnam shes kyi rang ngo tsam ye shes su 'dod pa yin no/ /sems tsam pa khong gi rang lugs kyi gzung 'dzin bkag par rlom yang grub mtha' gong mas gzhal na/ gzung 'dzin bkag par ma song ste gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan med pa tsam zhig khas blangs pa yin kyang 'dzin pa rang ngos nas yod par khas blangs par song bas so de ltar na 'dis 'dod pa'i gzugs sogs phyi don du snang ba'i rnam rig bden grub dang / rnam shes kyi ngo ldog tsam gzung 'dzin gnyis min gyi ye shes su 'dod pa dang / 'dzin pa'i ngo bo rnam shes nyid la mi 'dod par yul du snang ba'i rnam rig las tha dad par snang ba'i cha tsam la 'dod pa ni 'khrul ba yin la gzhan rnams ma nor pa'o// //dbu ma pa la dbu ma phal pa dang / dbu ma chen po gnyis kyi phal pa ni bod yul 'dir rang stong du grags shing rgya bod gnyis kar du ngo bo nyid med par smra ba zhes grags pa ste/ slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs dang / legs ldan dang / rnam grol sde dang / zhi ba 'tsho rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams kyi lugs so/ /de dag la grub mtha' nang sel mi 'dra ba mang yang / thams cad mthun par gzugs sems gnyis dang ldan min 'du byed de 'dus byas kyi dngos po —167—

thams cad dang / nam mkha' sogs 'dus ma byas dang dngos med thams cad de chos 'di dag thams cad ni kun rdzob yin la/ de rnams kyi rang bzhin bden med tsam ni don dam yin zhing / de gnyis ngo bo gcig dang tha dad gang du yang brjod du med / rnam gzhag tsam tha dad de don dam dbyings kyi ngo bo ni gang yang med pas spros bral nam mkha'i dpes bstan/ kun rdzob snang dus na bden pas stong yang snang ba ma 'gag pa sgyu ma'i dpes bstan/ de gnyis kar yod med yin min sogs spros pa thams cad las 'das par 'dod do/ /grub mtha' 'di la yang don dam chos nyid de spros pa bkag tsam gyi nam mkha' lta bu la 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes sogs kun rdzob yin zhing bden par med zer ba dang / don dam bden pa yang bden med du 'dod pa dang / khyad par thal 'gyur ba rnams ni grub mtha'i rnam gzhag 'jog bzhin du/gzhan gyi rtsod pa la 'dzem pa'i phyir gang yang khas mi len pa dang / nges shes ma skyes kyang log rtog zlog par 'dod pa sogs 'khrul ba yin la/ gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad bden par med pa dang / bden med tsam de yang bden par ma grub pa sogs ni ma nor ba yin no/ /sems tsam pa dang / rang stong smra ba'i dbu ma pa 'di gnyis kyi bde gshegs snying po'i nges gsang dang / don dam ye shes rang rig rang gsal ni rang lugs la mi 'dod cing de dag gi gnas tshul ma go bas/ slob dpon snga ma rnams kyis gzhan stong la dgag pa byas pa ni med la/ rjes 'brang phyis byung ba rnams kyis dgag pa byed mod kyang / gzhan stong gi grub mtha'i gnad —168—

go ba ni gcig kyang med pas phyogs snga ma longs pa'i dgag pa sha stag go/ //gnyis pa dbu ma chen po ni/ bod du gzhan stong du grags pa rnam rig gi dbu ma ste/ rje btsun byams pa'i gzhung dang / 'phags pa thogs med dang /mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis gsal par mdzad cing / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis chos dbyings bstod par yang ches gsal bas/ 'phags mchog gnyis car gyi bzhed pa gzhan stong yin no/ /'di'i lugs la sems tsam man chad du 'dod pa'i 'dus ma byas gsum sogs 'dus ma byas brtags pa ba dngos med rnams dang / gzugs sogs phyi don du grags pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig sogs mdor na gzhi phyi 'khor ba'i chos thams cad dang / gnas skabs lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad dang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sas sdus pa'i nang nas gsar du byung ba'i cha rnams dang gdul bya gzhan snang gis bsdus pa ste/ snang grags kyi chos sam chos chos nyid kyi zlas phye ba'i chos sam gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos sam/don dam gto la 'bebs pa'i skabs 'dir dngos po dngos med thams cad 'dus byas dang / glo bur bar gzhag pa de rnams thams cad ni bden med yin la/ dbyings dang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rang rig rang gsal ni don dam bden pa chos nyid 'dus ma byas zhes bya ba ste/ 'di ni rigs pas dpyad bzod bden grub kho na yin no/ /rang stong pa rnams 'dod pa'i nam mkha' lta bu de ni rnam par dpyad na dngos med yin pa'i phyir/ don dam bden pa ma yin no zhes bzhed la/ grub mtha' 'di ni skyon med yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i grub —169—

mtha' 'o/ /theg chen pa de rnams thams cad theg chen gyi mdo thams cad bkar 'dod kyang / sems tsam pa rnams ni mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel dang / lang kar gshegs pa dang / rgyan stug po dang / phal po che ste mdo bzhir grags rnams nges don du 'dzin te/ gzhan rnams drang don du 'dod la/ grub mtha' byed pa po ni sngon gyi slob dpon lnga brgya lnga'o/ /dbu ma phal ba 'dzin pa rnams ni 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo thams cad drang don yin zhing / 'khor lo bar pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo rnams nges don mthar thug go zhes smra/ grub mtha' byed pa po yin nges ni sangs rgyas bskyangs sogs gong du smos pa de rnams su zad la/'di rnams kyi rang rig gi 'dod pas sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po sogs ngo bo nyid med smra ba brgyad dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyang grub mtha' 'di kho na 'dzin pa li ra no zhes 'dod do/ /dbu ma chen po ni 'khor lo rim pa gsum gyi mdo mtha' da rga/ /rī brten cing / khyab par du ka kyi ya na'i gdams ngag gi mdo dang / mdo sde chen po stong pa nyid sogs 'khor lo dang po'i mdo mang po dang / byams pas zhus pa'i le'u dang sher phyin lnga brgya pa sogs 'khor lo bar ba'i gnas skabs mang po dang / mdo bzhi sogs tha ma'i mdo mang po la yang brten nas chos nyid don dam bden grub tu ston pa'i grub mtha' rags pa thun mong ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo dang / rnga bo che'i mdo dang / sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa'i mdo dang / dpal phreng gi mdo dang / mya ngan las 'das pa chen po dang / dkon mchog sprin dang / rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul la sogs pa nges don mthar thug ston pa mang po la brten nas yang dag pa'i —170—

dbyings de nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang / chos kyi sku dang / rtag brtan g.yung drung dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan don dam pa thams cad gdod ma nas rang chas su bzhugs pa'i grub mtha' thun mong ma yin pa zhib mo rnams gsang gtam du mdzad pa yin la/ mdo don gsal byed kyi gzhung byed pa po ni/rgyal tshab 'phags pa byams pa yin te/ des mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan du chos skad rags pa de nyid mdo tsam du gsungs/ mdo sde rgyan dang / dbus mtha' rnam 'byed dang / chos nyid rnam 'byed du gsal zhing rgyas par bshad/ snying po'i mdo'i don thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha' zhib mo de rgyud bla mar gtan la phab bo/ /gzhung gi dgongs 'grel byed pa po ni thogs med sku mched de/thogs med kyi rgyud bla ma'i 'grel par/ thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha' de shin tu rgyas shing gsal ba dang / spyir gzhan stong gi dbu ma ni sku mched gnyis kyi bstan bcos mtha' dag na gsal zhing dbyig gnyen gyi nyi khri'i 'grel pa gnod 'joms dang / chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa na shin tu gsal zhing rgyas pa'o/ /gzhan stong gi grub mtha' spyi de ni/ phyogs glang dang blo gros bstan pa la sogs pa'i slob ma slob rgyud mang la bzang ba rnams kyis rgya cher bshad cing / thun mong ma yin pa de ni gzhan gyi blor shong ba dka' nas slob ma mchog rnams la snyan nas snyan du brgyud tshul gyis dar bar mdzad do/ /phyis gzhan stong gi dbu ma 'di dang / sems tsam gyi grub mtha' 'dra 'dres su byas pa rgya gar du mang du byung ba la brten bod pa phal cher gyis gcig par 'khrul lo/ /bod du ni lo paṇa du mas gzhung rnams bsgyur kyang / grub mtha' gtsang mar —171—

'dzin pa lo tsā ba gzu dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / btsan kha bo che sogs byams chos sgom lugs pa rnams yin zhing / khyad par du gzhan stong zab mo seng ge'i sgras sa steng khyab par mdzad pa po ni/ kun mkhyen chen po rdol bu shes rab rgyal mtshan yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ yang dag ma yin kun rtog yod/ /de la gnyis po yod ma yin/ /stong pa nyid ni 'di la yod/ /de la yang ni de yod do/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /de lta bas na thams cad bshad/ /yod pas med pas yod pas na/ /de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ kun rdzob bden pa gtan la 'bebs pa'i dbang du byas nas/ snang ba sna tshogs par 'char ba'i shes pa yang dag min rtog tsam ni kun rdzob tu yod la/de la snang ba'i gzung cha dang 'dzin cha ni blos btags pa tsam yin pa'i phyir kun rdzob tu yang yod pa ma yin no/ /des na kun rdzob bden pa yang mtha' gnyis las grol ba yin te/ kun rtog kun rdzob tu yod pa tsam khas blangs pas med mtha' dang chad mtha' las grol la/ gzung cha 'dzin cha sogs ltos chos sgro btags thams cad las 'das pas/ rtag mtha' dang yod mtha' las grol ba yin no/ /spros bral stong pa nyid kyi ye shes de ni/ rnam shes yang dag min rtog de la chos nyid kyi tshul du bden par yod cing / dri bcas kyi skabs na chos nyid de la rnam shes de chos can dri ma glo bur ba 'bral rung / spang bya dri ma bden med kyi ngo bor yod ces bya ste/ des na don dam bden pa yang mtha' gnyis dang bral ba zhes bya ste/ stong nyid bden grub dang / kun rtog sogs gzung 'dzin —172—

gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad bden med yin pa'i phyir/ yod med rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das pa yin no/ /de lta bas na kun rdzob gzung 'dzin gnyis ni 'khrul ba'i snang ba shar ba tsam ma gtogs rang gi ngo bos grub rgyu med pa'i phyir rang gi ngo bos stong la/ rang gzhan gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i gzhan gyi ngo bor grub pa shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir/ rnam pa kun tu stong pas mi stong pa min la/ ye shes chos nyid de ni rang gi ngo bos gdod ma nas grub cing nam du yang 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir rang gi ngo bos stong pa ma yin zhing rtag tu yod pa'o/ /'o na mdo rnams su chos dbyings de yang stong par gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ spyir stong pa dang stong nyid yin kyang / rang gi ngo bos stong pa yin mi dgos te/ ye shes rang las gzhan gyi mtshan nyid can spros pa'am gzung 'dzin thams cad kyis stong pas stong nyid ces bya'o/ /de la kun brtags/ gzhan dbang / yongs grub ste/ mtshan nyid gsum las kun btags ni nam mkha' la sogs pa dngos med thams cad dang / rnam rtog la shar ba'i gzugs sogs yul gyi snang cha rnams dang / ming la don du zhen pa dang don la ming du 'khrul ba'i ming don gyi 'brel ba dang / phyi nang mtha' dbus che chung bzang ngan mchog dus sogs blos sgro btags kyis gzung bya thams cad do/ /gzhan dbang ni gzung 'dzin gyi dngos por snang ba'i rnam par shes pa tsam ste/ ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi gzhan dbang du gyur pas snang ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yongs grub ni rang rig rang gsal spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de yin te/ chos nyid dang chos dbyings dang / de bzhin nyid dang / don dam bden pa rnams ming gi rnam grangs so/ /de —173—

la gzhan dbang dang kun brtags gnyis bden par med mnyam dang / 'khra/la snang yin mnyam dang / kun rdzob dang rdzun pa yin mnyam yin kyang / mtshan nyid so sor dbye dgos pa ni/ kun brtags kun rdzob tu yang med/ gzhan dbang kun rdzob tu yod pa yin zhing / yongs grub ni kun rdzob tu med la don dam du yod pas bden par yod pa'o/ /de bzhin du kun brtags ni btags pas yod pa dang / gzhan dbang ni rdzas su yod pa dang / yongs grub ni de gnyis su yod pa min yang spros med du yod pa'o/ /kun brtags ni med pa'i stong nyid/ g.yin dbang ni yod pa'i stong nyid/ yongs grub ni don dam stong nyid do/ /rje btsun gyis/ med pa'i stong pa nyid shes shing / /de bzhin yod pa'i stong nyid dang / /rang bzhin stong ba nyid shes na/ /stong nyid shes pa zhes brjod do/ /kun brtags ni mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa/ gzhan dbang ni skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa/ yongs grub ni don dam ngo bo nyid med pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid ni rnam gsum gyi/ /ngo bo nyid med rnam gsum la/ /brten nas chos rnams thams cad ni/ /rang bzhin med par bstan pa yin/ /'di'i lugs la shes bya thams cad la stong nyid kyis khyab pa dang / ngo bo nyid med pas khyab la/ des na chos thams cad stong nyid dang chos thams cad stong nyid med par khas len pa gzhan stong lugs yin gyi/ rang stong par grags pa'i lugs la nang 'gal yod do/ /des na sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i rang stong rnam dag ni kun rdzob rang stong du gnas pa 'di yin zhing / ngo bo nyid med pa yang gsum po 'di yin pas rang stong ma nor bar smra ba dang / ngo bo nyid med smra ba yin nges ni gzhan stong smra —174—

ba rnams yin la/ legs ldan dang / sangs rgyas bskyangs sogs rang stong smra ba dang / ngo bo nyid med smra bar grags pa ni 'jig rten phal pa la grags pa gtso bor byas pa yin no/ /yongs grub bden grub tu yod na de la skye 'gag gnas gsum/ 'gro 'ong 'gyur ldog phyogs dus gcig dang du ma sogs yod dam zhe na ma yin te/ de rnams yod na bden med yin pas khyab cing / 'di ni skye med 'gag med gnas med/ 'gro med 'ong med/ gcig min du ma ma yin/ rgyu min 'bras min/ rang gi ngo bos mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum spangs pa/ phyogs dus thams cad dang bral ba/ rang gi ngo bos kun rdzob kyi chos nyid dang ma 'brel ba yin no/ /de la dum bu tha dad dbye rgyu med pa'i phyir cha med yin la/ chos nyid kyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir kun 'gro dang kun khyab yin no// //gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i don ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la/ khyad par med kyang dag gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ /'gro kun de yi snying po can/ /zhes de bzhin nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ngo bo gcig cing de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'o zhes pa'i don te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang / bde gshegs snying po dang /sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes pa rnams don gcig cing / de nyid sangs rgyas dang sems can sogs chos nyid la mnyam pa nyid du bzhugs kyang / sems can rnams la snying po'i tshul gyis bzhugs shing / sangs rgyas rnams la mngon sum gyi tshul du bzhugs pas/ don dam pa'i sangs rgyas nyid sems can gyi sems rgyud kyi dbus na snying por yod pa dang 'dra ba yin pas/ sems can thams cad —175—

de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can zhes bya zhing / bde gshegs snying po de yang sems can la yod pa dang / sems can gyi de la rang bzhin gnas rigs dang khams zhes kyang bya'o/ /des na sangs rgyas la de bzhin nyid snying po'i tshul du bzhugs pa ma yin zhing / sems can gyi de snying po'i tshul du bzhugs pa yin pas de bzhin nyid gnyis su 'gyur ram snyam na/ mi 'gyur te sangs rgyas ni de bzhin nyid rang yin la sangs rgyas zhes pa skyes bu'i don can du 'chad kyang /rang nyid rang la ma sbas par mngon du gyur pa yin pas/ snying po'i don khong na gnas pa dang sbas pa la byas na/ khong na sbas pa'i snying po'i sgra bshad ma tshang la/sangs rgyas kyi de bzhin nyid de kho na sems can la gnas kyang sems can rang gi ngos nas ma mthong bas sems can la sbas pa'i don gyi snying po yin pas/snying po'i don mi 'gyur ba la 'chad pa'i tshe sangs rgyas nyid kyang sangs rgyas kyi snying po can te/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po 'di ni dngos po dang dngos med gnyis car las grol pas 'dus ma byas dngos don dam pa'i 'dus ma byas so/ /de yang gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i gnas lugs ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos dbyings de sangs rgyas kyi yon to thams cad kyi ngo bor yod pa la rtsod pa med la/ de ka sems can gyi chos dbyings dang dbye ba med pa'i phyir/sems can gyi rgyud kyi bde gshegs snying po de yang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad kyi ngo bor gnas pa la mi rigs pa ci zhig yod/ des na 'od gsal byas min dbyer med par/ /'jug can ga sde'i klung gi ni/ /rdul las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos rnams kun dang ldan pa nyid/ /ces rgyud bla ma las —176—

gsungs te/'dus ma byas kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gsungs pas/ don dam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad yod do/ /des na chos dbyings ye shes la don dam bden pa kho nas khyab la ye shes gzhan bzhi la gdod ma nas gnas pa'i don dam gtso che yang / lam bsgoms pas gsar thob kun rdzob kyi cha shas cung zad re yod cing / stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa yang de dang 'dra zhing mtshan dpe sogs sku'i yon tan dang / yan lag drug cu sogs gsung gi yon tan la kun rdzob dang don dam ni cha mnyam zhing / de bzhin du ngo bo nyid sku don dam kho na dang /chos sku don dam shas che ba dang / longs sprul gnyis la dngos btags ma phye na cha mnyam zhing / 'phrin las kyang gzhan ngor snang ba ni kun rdzob yin la/ nus mthu'i ye shes ni don dam yin pas/ sku dang ye shes yon tan 'phrin las don dam gyis bsdus pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la gdod ma nas gnas pa yin la/ gang zag gcig sang sa rgyas pa'i tshe de gsar thob ma yin zhing de la sgrib byed kyi dri ma bral ba tsam yin mod/ kun rdzob kyi de rnams ni gsar du thob pa yin no/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam pa'i de rnams smra pa bo gcig cing / kun rdzob kyi de rnams kyang sangs rgyas thob pa phan chad nas ni rang bzhin (la 1dbye ba med la/ thob mtshams ni tha dad pa'i phyir gcig dang tha dad gang du yang mi brjod do/ /des na lam bsgoms pas bskyed rgyu 'bras bu gsar thob rnams ni skyed 'bras yin pas bden par med la/ gdod nas gnas pa'i sangs rgyas ni lam bsgo myo/sa — 177

pa'i sangs rgyas de'i sgrib g.yogs bral ba tsam yin pas bral 'bras zhes bya zhing / lam yang de'i bral rgyu zhes rgyu 'bras btags pa tsam yin gyi dngos ma yin no/ /bral 'bras 'di yang mngon pa nas bshad pa'i/ bral ba blo yis zad pa'o/ /zhes pa'i so sor brtags 'gog ma yin gyi/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ gdod nas zad pas de phyir zad ces bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar don dam pa'i bral 'bras dang 'gog bden yin no/ /lam gyi mthus sgrib pa spangs pa yin pas blos zad pa dang don gcig par 'gyur ro snyam na/ sgrib pa ni chos dbyings ngos nas spangs pa ma yin gyi/ gang zag gi ngos nas spangs pa yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgya mkhan gyi gang zag de nyid la blos zad pa'i bral ba thob bo zhes tha snyad tsam thob kyang / chos dbyings la gdod ma nas dri mas ma gos pa'i phyir blo yis gsar du zad pa ma yin no/ /des na chos nyid la mnyam pa nyid du khyab pa'i gnyis med kyi ye shes bde gshegs snying po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan don dam thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ spros pa thams cad dang bral yang ye shes kyi rnam pa kun ldan 'di nyid 'gyur med yongs grub chen po yin zhing / 'di kho na phyin ci ma log pa'i gnas lugs dang / 'phags pa'i ye shes ma 'khrul ba'i myong bya yin pa'i phyir bden par grub la 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir rtag brtan ther zug go/ bde gshegs snying po mtshan dpe sogs yon tan can du bzhugs pa 'di gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag las rnam grangs du mas gsungs so/ /kun rdzob ces kyang bya gzung 'dzin zhes kyang bya/ 'khrul ba'i snang ba zhes bya ba mdor na snang grags kyi chos gang gis kyang yongs grub de —178—

la ma gos shing / ma gos pa de yang kun rdzob de dngos gnas la yod kyang chos dbyings la gos ma thub par so sor tha dad na yod pa ma yin gyi/ kun rdzob ni 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam yin pas/ gnas lugs la ri bong rwa bzhin ma grub pa'i phyir gos rgyu med nas ma gos pa yin no/ /des na yongs grub bde gshegs snying po de ni rang gi ngo bos nam yang mi stong la/ gzhan kun rdzob kyis gdod nas stongs pa'i phyir/ yongs grub don dam bden pa de ni gzhan stong yin gyi rang stong min no/ /de'i phyir kun rdzob rnams gas gyi ngo bos stong pa'i steng du rang gi ngo bos kyang stong pa dang don dam gzhan gyi ngo bo kho nas stong ba'i phyir tshul 'di smra ba ni gzhan stong dbu ma'o/ /de la 'khor ba'i chos la zhen pa ci rigs pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal gyis nges 'byung bsgom pa dang / rang don yid byed spong zhing byang chub kyi sems rgyud la bsten par bya/kun rdzob la zhen pa rags pa rnams spangs ba'i phyir kun rdzob bden med du gtan la phab nas bsgom/ zhen pa phra bo rnams kyang spong ba'i phyir kun rdzob kyi rnam rtog dbyings su bsdus nas mi rtog pa bsgom/ des bde gshegs snying po mi rtog pa dang rim pas zhal mjal bar 'gyur bas/ lam bsgom tshad yongs grub dang mjal ba'i phyir yin no//gsum pa gzhan gyis brtags pa'i mtha' bsal ba ni/ gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan du yang shes par bya la/ rgyas par gzhan du 'chad par yang 'gyur mod/snying po bsdus pa ni/ gzhan dag la skor gshegs pa las/ bde gshe/gas snying po mtshan dpe can yod na mu stegs pa'i bdag dang mtshungs par 'gyur ba min —179—

nam zhes zhus nas/ lan du mi mtshungs te stong pa nyid yin pa'i phyir zhes gsungs pas/ bde gshegs snying po bden med yin zhing / mtshan dpe sogs yod na mu stegs pa'i lugs su 'gyur pas/ nam mkha' ltar cir yang ma grub pa zhig la bde gshegs snying po zhes bya'o/ /zhes zer ba ni stong nyid yin tshad bden med kyi don dang / rnam med cir yang ma grub pa tsam la ngos 'dzin pa rang gi grub mtha' ngan pa la zhen pa'i blo skyon yin zhing / mdo las kyang / mu stegs dang mi mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan stong nyid yin par bkod kyi mtshan dpe med pa ma bkod pa'i phyir/ mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi bde gshegs snying po drang don du bshad zer ba yang rdzun gyi 'jig rten bslu ba tsam du zad do/ /yang snying po rtag par 'dod pa mu stegs kyi lugs so zer ba yang snying po'i mdo rnams la dgag pa byed par zad la/ rtag pa'i don rgyun gyi rtag pa la 'dod pa yang mi 'thad de/rgyun gyi rtag pa tsam ni 'khor ba dang gzung 'dzin kun kyang yin pa'i phyir dang /rgyun gyi rtag pa tsam gyis rtag pa'i go chod na 'dus byas thams cad kyang rtag par 'gyur ro/ /dang po dri bcas yin pa phyis dri med du 'gyur bas mi rtag pa yin no snyam na/ chos dbyings kyi ngos nas dang po dri bcas ma yin la/ phyis dri med du song ba yang ma yin mod/ dri bcas dang dri med du 'gro tshul ni gang zag gi rgyud la bltos nas yin pa'i phyir/ sems can gnas skabs 'gyur bas chos nyid gnas skabs 'gyur bar mi 'gro'o/ /sems can gyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yod pa ni mi 'thad do snyam na/ sangs rgyas ye shes sems can tshogs zhugs phyir/ /zhes dngos su gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /sems can gyi —180—

rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yod pa mi 'thad de/ dper mtshon na/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs sems can gyi rgyud la yod na/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa thams cad sems can gyi shes par thal lo zhes zer pa yang yang dag pa ma yin te/ sems can gyi rgyud yin tshad sangs rgyas yin no zhes kho bo cag ni mi 'dod pa'i phyir dang / sems can gyi rgyud la sangs rgyas dang de'i yon tan bzhugs pas der thal na/ gdan khri la sangs rgyas bzhugs pa na/ gdan khris kyang shes bya thams cad shes par thal bar 'gyur ram/ des na sems can gyi rgyud rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad sangs rgyas ga la yin zhing / de la bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang kun rdzob rten brten pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa ma yin la/ don dam chos nyid kyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa yin no/ /skabs 'dir nye bar mkho ba'i brda chad cung zad brjod na/ chos snyen ra rim pa gsum ni/ dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor/ bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor ro/ /dang po nyan thos la gsungs pa'i sde snod theg dman gyi mdo/ bar ba theg wo gyi rtsa ba'i mdo lta bu yin yang dgongs don gab par yod/ tha ma ni de'i bshad rgyud lta bu ste nges don shin tu gsal bar bstan to/ /kun brtags g.yin dbang yongs grub gsum las/ kun brtags la gzung ba'i kun brtags dang 'dzin pa'i kun brtags gnyis/ gzhan dbang la ma dag pa'i gzhan dbang dang dag pa'i g.yin dbang gnyis/ yongs grub la 'gyur med yongs grub dang phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub gnyis yod pa las/ kun brtags dngos gzung ba dang / yongs grub —181—

dngos 'gyur med yin la/ 'gyur med dang ngo bo gcig pa'i phyin ci ma log pa cig yod pa de min phyin ci ma log pa dag pa gzhan dbang du bsdu/ 'dzin pa kun brtags dang gzhan dbang ngo bo gcig go /rigs pas rnam par dpyad pa'i tshe g.yin dbang dngos ni kun brtags su 'du zhing / de'i chos nyid kyi gnas tshul ni yongs grub yin pas/ kun brtags dang yongs grub gnyis su chos thams cad 'dus so/ /'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la mtshan nyid gsum gyi dbye ba'am/ kun rdzob rnam shes dang 'brel ba dang / don dam ye shes kyi phyogs gnyis gnyis bzhag nas/ gzugs sgra dri ro sogs kun rdzob rnam shes kyi phyogs yin pa'i phyir bden med dang / chos nyid kyi gzugs sgra sogs ye shes kyi phyogs yin pas bden grub dang / kun rdzob kyi phyogs tha dad dang / don dam gyi chos rnams 'gal 'dus skyon med do/ /zhes pa 'di yang don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gis bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa ste/ chos lung byang rtse'i dben gnas su'o// //bkra shis/ gcig zhus//—182—

ngogs zhes bya ba nyung ngu rnam gsal dag cing tshang ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ skabs kyi dgongs don la/ theg pa chen po la tshul rnam pa gnyis las/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung lugs/ rje btsun byams pa dang /'phags pa thogs med sku mched/ phyogs glang chos grags sogs rnam rig smra ba'i gzhung lugs rnams kyi grub mtha'/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel sogs bka' 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo sde rnams kyi dgongs don dang / dbu ma ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i gzhung lugs slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dbu ma rigs tshogs rnams kyi dgongs pa/ sangs rgyas bskyangs legs ldan zla grags pa la sogs pa rnams kyi bzhed pa bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan gyi rim pa gnyis las/ bod 'dir dbu ma rang stong du yongs su grags pa'i dbu ma ngo bo nyid med pa'i gzhung lugs 'dzin pa rnams ni/ lugs snga ma de la sems tsam lugs dang / phyi ma la dbu ma'i lugs zhes gsungs shing / gzhan stong smra bar yongs su grags pa 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo nges don mthar thug tu bzhed pa rnams ni/ lugs phyi ma de spyir dbu ma'i grub mtha' yin yang / dbu ma la gnas skabs pa'i nges don dang mthar thug gi nges don gnyis yod pa las/ de gnas skabs pa'i nges don yin zhing / lugs srol snga ma de la gnas skabs kyi —183—

grub mtha' gzhan dbang bden grub tu 'dod pa dang / gzhan yang rnam pa bden par smra ba'i lugs kyi grub mtha' rnams ni sems tsam yin la/ kun btags dang gzhan dbang gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad bden par med cing / yongs grub gnyis med kyi ye shes bden grub tu ston pa'i grub mtha' bod gzhan dag sems tsam rnam brdzun zhes zer ba 'di ni nges don mthar thug gi dbu ma chen po yin no zhes brjod do/ /des na rang stong smra ba rnams ni/bka' 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor ni drang don dang / bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor ni nges don mthar thug /tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor gnas skabs kyi nges don te drangs don yin par bzhed la/ gzhan stong smra ba rnams ni dang po drang don dang / bar ba gnas skabs kyi nges don/ tha ma mthar thug gi nges don ston par bzhed/ de yang 'khor lo dang po nyan thos dang thun mong gi sde snod yin pas kun rdzob kyi chos rnams yod par gsungs la/ bar pa sher phyin gyi mdo rnams su ni/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad rang gi ngo bos ma grub cing yod pa'i chos rdul tsam yang med par bshad/ tha ma nas ni 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs ngo don dam bden pa dbyings rig dbyer med ni/ ngo bo gdod ma nas 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ rtag brtan ther zug pa 'di ni bden par yod la/ dngos med rnams dang / gzugs sogs yul mig sogs dbang po sems sems byung ste/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig la sogs pa gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa rnams ni/ don dam de'i rnam 'gyur tsam me long gi gzugs brnyan —184—

ltar gdod nas ma skyes pas bden med du gsungs/ des na mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ nyan thos kyi theg pa la zhugs pa la 'khor lo dang po dang /theg pa chen po la zhugs pa la bar pa dang / theg pa sna tshogs la zhugs pa la tha ma gsungs bar bshad cing / dang po dang bar pa gnyis bla na mchis pa/ skabs mchis pa/ drang ba'i don rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur pa dang / tha ma ni bla na ma mchis pa/ skabs ma mchis pa/ nges pa'i don rtsod pa'i gzhi ma yin pa dang / gzhan yang 'khor lo bar par chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par gsungs pa ni/ kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum la ngo bo nyid med pa rnam pa gsum spyor ba la dgongs nas de ltar gsungs kyi/ don dam du yod pa'i chos gto nas mi srid pa la dgongs pa ni ma yin pa dang / len pa'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra/ /sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab/ /bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung zhes/ /'di ni byis pa rnams la ngas ma bstan/ /zhes 'khor lo dang por thams cad yod par gsungs pa'i rjes thog nyid du don dam bden grub 'di yod par gsungs na/ sems can rnams la thog ma nyid nas bdag tu lta ba'i bag chags yod pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rkyen gyis gang zag gi bdag tu rtog par 'gyur ba'i gnas yod pas/ 'khor lo bar par zag med kyi dbyings 'di yod ces ma gsungs par/ chos thams cad ma grub pa ltar gsungs pa yin pa'i tshul zhib rgyas su gsungs so/ /de la rang stong pa rnams ni spyir 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo dang / khyad par mdo 'di nyid kyang drang don yin zhing /de ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang bar pa gdul bya theg chen gyi rigs 'ba' zhig —185— —ri

la gsungs par snang bas nges don dang / tha ma theg pa sna tshogs la zhugs pa'i bsam pa tha dad pa mang po 'dul ba'i phyir bstan pas drang don yin par yang grub la/ rigs pas kyang 'thad de dper na gcig du bral gyi rigs pas bum pa lta bu zhig bden med du gtan la 'bebs nus na/ rigs pa des gnyis med kyi ye shes kyang bden med du gtan la 'bebs nus te/ bden pa'i gcig dang du mar ma grub pa sogs dpyad pa thams cad mtshungs par 'jug pa'i phyir bden med du grub la/ gzhan yang rnam rdzun gyi grub mtha' de dbu ma yin na/sems tsam pa'i mdo sde dang bstan bcos med par 'gyur ba sogs kyi skyon yod gsung ngo / /gzhan stong smra ba rnams ni/ 'khor lo rim pa gsum po 'di yang dus thog mtha' ni ma yin te/ 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo phal po che'i le'u shas che ba zhig bden bzhi'i chos 'khor ma bskor ba'i sngon rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas ma thag tu lha'i rgyal po dbang sgyur gyi gnas su gsungs pa yang yod la/ mdo sde myang 'das lta bu mya ngan las 'da' khar gsungs pa yang yod/ de bzhin du mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo la sogs pa 'khor lo dang po'i mdo la la mya ngan las 'da' khar gsungs pa yang yod pas so/ /des na 'di ni brjod bya'i don gyi go rim mam/ gdul bya'i rgyud sbyong tshul gyi rim pa gsum yin pas de lta bu'i rim pa tha ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor lo tha ma nges don du grub ste/ brjod bya'i don gyi mthar thug drang don yin pa mi rung zhing / gdul bya nges don la khrid zin pa'i 'og tu slar yang drang don la khrid pa mi rung ba'i phyir/ 'khor lo bar pa theg —186—

chen la zhugs zhes gsungs pa yang theg chen gyi theg pa'i rim pa mang po la blo ma sbyangs pa'i gang zag dbang po shin tu smin pa ma yin pa rnams la gsungs pas mthar thug gi nges don ma yin zhing / 'khor lo tha ma gsungs pa'i yul theg pa sna tshogs la zhugs pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ la la nyan thos kyi theg pa la zhugs pa/ la la rang rgyal la zhu / /sa pa/ la la theg chen/ la zhus/sa pa/ la la dbang po rno/ la la dbang po rtul zhes bya ba'i don ma yin te/ de ltar yin na bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung ste/ /zhes gsungs pa yang mi 'grig ste/ nyan thos kyi theg pa ba theg chen la gsar du 'jug pa'i skabs zag med kyi dbyings 'di yod par gsung na bdag tu lta ba 'byung ba'i gnas srid pa dang / de ltar yod pas re zhig zab mo'i don de ma bstan par chos thams cad bden med du gsungs par bshad pas/ 'khor lo bar pas blo sbyangs zin pa'i gang zag la lam 'di ston rgyu yin pa'i phyir sngar theg chen la ma zhugs pa dang / 'khor lo bar pas rgyud sbyangs pa gnyis 'gal bas so/ /des na theg pa mtha' dag la yang dag par zhugs pa'i don theg pa mtha' dag la zhugs pas rgyud sbyangs zin pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbang rnon gdul bya shin tu smin pa rnams la gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir 'di nyid nges don du grub la/ yang rnam pa gcig tu rang stong pa rnams kyi lugs de ltar na/ 'khor lo dang po dang 'khor lo tha ma gnyis mthun pa shas che dgos pa las 'dir ni de ltar med par 'khor lo bar pa dang po dang mthun shas che zhing / 'khor lo tha ma theg dman dang shin tu 'gal ba'i phyir 'di nyid mthar thug yin la/ de ltar yin pa ni mngon sum —187—

gyis grub ste/ 'khor lo dang po gnyis char du snang ba sems su ma gsungs pa dang / rnam shes tshogs brgyad ma bshad pa dang / chos lnga dang rang bzhin gsum sogs kyi rnam bzhag kyang dang po nas gtan nas ma bshad cing / bar pa nas kyang rgyas par ma byung ba dang / gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi ye shes 'di lta bu 'khor lo de gnyis char nas ma bshad cing nyan thos rnams de lta bu gtan nas med par 'dod la/ dbu ma rang stong pa rnams kyang skabs 'dir nyan thos sde gnyis dang mthun par khas blangs pa'i/ chos thams cad bden med du 'dod mi 'dod tsam ma gtogs grub mtha' la khyad chen po ma zhugs shing / chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa theg pa che chung gi 'dod pa thams cad la yod par 'dod pa ltar na/ nyan thos sde gnyis dang rang bzhin med rtogs kyi lta ba'i khyad par tsam ma gtogs/ theg pa gsum bsgom bya'i lam gcig par 'dod pa sogs phal cher mthun zhing / des na spyod pa'i khyad par ma gtogs/ lta ba'i sgo nas nyan thos dang theg chen yang nyams len gcig par don gyis khas blangs pa yin no/ /'khor lo tha ma ni 'khor lo dang po dang shin tu khyad che ste/snang ba sems su gsungs pa dang / rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang chos lnga rang bzhin gsum sogs rgyas par bstan pa dang / nyan thos rnams yod par 'dod pa'i phyi don 'dir gtan nas med par gsungs shing / nyan thos rnams gtan nas mi 'dod pa'i gnyis med kyi ye shes bden grub tu gsungs la/ nyan rang dang theg chen gnyis la lta ba'i khyad par shin tu che bar gsung bas so/ /de'i phyir rang stong pa rnams kyi lugs ltar na/ nyan thos kyi mdo rnams nges don —188—

shas che zhing / sher phyin tsam ma gtogs theg chen gyi mdo sde 'byams klas pa rnams drang don 'ba' zhig yin no zhes theg pa che chung la drang nges go log tu 'gyur ro/ /gzhan stong 'di bka' tha mar ma zad/ bar pa'i yang dgongs pa yin pa par sher phyin gyi byams zhus kyi le'ur/ mtshan nyid gsum khas blangs phyin/ chos thams cad bden med du khyad par med par 'dod na/ mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag byas pa dgos med du 'gyur ba dang / mdo sde rgyan las kyang / ji skad bshad bzhin don min bcom ldan dgongs pa shin tu zab/ /ces pa'ang sher phyin gyi mdo tshig gis dngos bstan tsam mthar thug gi nges don du bzung rgyu min pa'i don du snang bas/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos rnams kyi steng gi kun brtags dang gzhan dbang gnyis bden med du gsungs nas/ yongs grub la re zhig btang snyoms su mdzad pa yin no/ /dbu sems gnyis la mdo sde tha dad du med par ni 'dod de/ mdo sde gcig la dgongs pa 'grel lugs kyi khyad par tsam yin pas 'di la mi 'thad pa med de/ bye mdo gnyis la yang mdo sde tha dad med kyang dgongs pa len lugs kyi khyad par tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir sems tsam rnam bden pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa mang du byung phyin chad na/ bstan bcos kyi po ti yod med la ma reg cing / glegs bam yod kyang bod du 'gyur ni mi dgos te/ dgos na nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad kyi nang nas gos dmar sde ba ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams kyi sde snod gsum dang mdo sde ba'i gzhung lugs kyang med par 'gyur te bod na mi 'dug pa'i phyir zhes par mi 'gyur ram/ des na tshad ma rnam 'grel spyir mdo sde ba'i bstan bcos — —189—

ma yin zhing / yin du chug kyang chos skad zar zur tsam las grub mtha' rdzogs par med pa dang / mdo sde ba'i lta ba'i rnam gzhag tsam byung bas de yod par 'gyur na/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhud thams cad du rnam bden gyi lta ba'i rnam gzhag byung bas sems tsam gyi gzhung yang yod par ci'i phyir mi 'gyur/ g.yin yang 'khor lo bar pa nges don dang / tha ma drang don du bstan pa'i mdo'i lung yang med cing / dgongs 'grel du bar pa drang don dang tha ma nges don du gsungs pas drang nges so sor phye zhing / drang don dgongs pa can du bkral bas mdo sde 'di nyid kyang dgongs pa can du 'grel dgos na ha cang thal ba dang /rang phyogs la drang nges dgongs pa can du phye ba'i ma sto lung med bzhin du/gzhan lugs kyi lung dgongs pa can yin no zhes zer ba dbang che ba'i spyod pa tsam yin pa'i phyir dang / klu sgrub kyi rig tshogs su rang stong gsungs kyang /bstod tshogs su gzhan stong gsungs pa'i phyir phyogs gnyis char la rjes su 'gro zhing / gzhan legs ldan 'byed dang zla ba grags pa la sogs pa rnams spyir paṇ+ḍi ta mchog yin yang / rgyan drug gi nang du tshud pa sangs rgyas nyid kyi bstan pa 'dzin par lung bstan pa thob pa'i/ thogs med sku mched phyogs glang chos grags dang do brdo ba'i yul ma yin zhing / khyad par 'phags pa thogs med ni mdo sde drang nges 'byed par sangs rgyas nyid kyis lung bstan la/ dbyig gnyen 'bum sde dgu bcu go dgu thugs la bzhugs pa dang / dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos skyong rnams la/ zla ba grags pa dang ye shes snying po sogs kyis kyang rang las mkhas shing gsan rgya che ba dang / shing rta chen po yin par dag pa —190—

byin pa'i phyir/ zla grags sogs kyi lung la brten te thogs med sku mched 'gog pa ni gzu lum yin no zhes gsung ngo / /gzhan yang grub mtha'i steng nas phyogs 'di gnyis la dgag sgrub shin tu mang bar 'dug na'ang ye ge mangs par 'gyu/ra ching / re zhig gzigs mi bde bar snang bas ma bris lags la/ de la rang stong gi don ni kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i chos thams cad rang gi ngo bos stong zhing bden par med pa'i phyir chos thams cad rang stong yin zhes 'dod pa'i don yin la/ gzhan stong ni kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad bden med rang gi ngo bos stong pas rang stong yin yang / don dam gyi dbyings ni bden par grub pa'i phyir rang gi ngo bos mi stong la/ 'on kyang stong nyid ni yin te gzhan gzung 'dzin sogs spros pa thams cad kyis stong pa'i phyir don dam ni gzhan stong yin no/ /zhes bzhed pa'i don yin pas kun rdzob rang stong yin pa la mthun yang /don dam rang stong du bzhed mi bzhed kyi khyad par yin no/ /kun rdzob dang don dam yang 'jog lugs mi 'dra ste/ rang stong pa rnams ni 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos 'di ltar snang ba ni kun rdzob yin la/ de rnams rang bzhin med pa gang yin pa de ni don dam bden par 'jog ste/ don dam de yang spros pa thams cad dang bral tsam la 'jog /gzhan stong ba rnams ni dngos po dngos med gzung 'dzin sogs gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ni kun rdzob yin la/ don dam pa'i dbyings gnyis stong gi ye shes rang rig pa ni don dam du 'jog pas/ don dam spros pa dang bral tsam la mi 'jog par gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi spros pas dben pa'i rig pa la 'jog /spros pa dang bral tsam —191 —

nam mkha' lta bu ni bem stong dang chad stong yin par 'dod/ des na rang stong pa rnams kyi don dam med dgag dang dngos med la 'jog /gzhan stong pa rnams kyi don dam dngos po yin pa rgyu rkyen gyis gsar du 'dus byas pa ma yin pa/ snga phyi thams cad 'gyur ba med la rtag brtan g.yung drung yin pa'i phyir chad mthar mi 'gyur/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir rtag pa'i mthar mi 'gyur ba tshig gis brjod pa'i yul las 'das shing / rnam rtog gis 'di lta bu'o zhes bzhag tu med pas rtog ge'i yul las 'das pa dang / so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi myong bya yin par bzhed do/ /des na mtshan nyid gsum ka la las gzhan dbang ni 'khrul snang can gyi shes pa yin la/ kun brtags de la snang ba'i 'khrul ba yin zhing / yongs grub ni shes pa de gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi 'khrul bas stong zhing rang rig gi ngo bos mi stong pa 'di yin pas/ kun brtags brda' dang tha snyad kyis bzhag pa tsam ma gtogs gtan nas med pa dang / gzhan dbang kun rdzob tu yod don dam du med pa dang / yongs grub don dam du yod pa ste/ kun brtags mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa dang / gzhan dbang skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa dang / yongs grub gzung 'dzin gyi ngo bor med pas don dam ngo bo nyid med pa'o/ /des na rang stong ltar na chos de dang de'i ngo bo nyid med pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du 'dod mod kyang / kun rdzob kyi chos de dang de'i ngos nas stong nyid du mi 'jog ste/ dper na bum pa rang bzhin med pa'i cha nas bum pa stong pa nyid yin par yang 'don mod/ kun rdzob bum pa rang gi cha de stong nyid du mi 'dod de/ bden gnyis gcig tu 'gyur ba sogs kyi skyon yod —192—

pas so/ /gzhan stong ba rnams ni stong nyid la don dam bden pa'i ma khyab ste kun brta ga ni med pa'i stong nyid dang / gzhan dbang ni yod pa'i stong nyid dang /yongs grub ni rang bzhin stong nyid du bzhed pas gzhi grub na stong nyid yin pa'i khyab pa 'cha' ba yin no/ /des na rang stong pa rnams ni gzhi grub na stong nyid kyi khyab mtha' mi 'cha' zhing / stong nyid don dam gcig pa dang rang stong nyid yin na spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings tsam po yin pas khyab par 'dod/ gzhan stong pa rnams de las zlog pa yin te/ don dam stong nyid kyi gtso bo shes rig gi cha nas 'jog /don dam gyi dbyings de ni gcig du bral la sogs pa rigs pa'i lam las 'das pa/ kun rdzob kyi chos rnams dang mi 'dra bas rigs pa des gnod pa med de/ kun rdzob kyi chos dngos med rnams ni ngo bos med cing /dngos po rnams ni dus dang phyogs kyis bsdus pa yin pas rigs pa de 'jug la/ gnyis med kyi ye shes de ni phyogs dus kyi ma bsdus pas rigs pa de mi 'jug ste/ ye shes de la skad cig mang por dbye pa dang / skad cig de'i thog mtha' bar gsum dpyod pa sogs ni ye shes de dus las 'das pa yin pa'i phyir/ de la dus gsum gang yang med pas de'i skad cig sogs shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir/ rig pa de'i rtsa ba stong pa yin la/ de bzhin du don dam de rten 'brel du yang mi bzhed do/ /des na shes pa la rnam shes dang ye shes/ rig pa la rang rig dang gzhan rig /stong pa la rang stong dang gzhan stong / chos la chos can dang chos nyid sogs zhib mor phye nas snang ba thams cad sems su 'dod pa dang / gzugs sku gdul bya gzhan snang gis bsdus kyi sangs rgyas ma yin —193—
