par bzhed pa dang / sems spros bral sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yin par ma zad/sems kyi gsal ba ma 'gags pa la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad dbyer med kyi ngo bos gnas pas sems can gyi rgyud la/ mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs yon tan drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan dbyer med kyi tshul gyis yod/ mngon gyur gsar thob kyi sgo nas yod par mi 'dod pas spyir sems can tsam sangs rgyas su thal ba'i skyon med/ sems can gyi chos nyid sangs rgyas yin pa dang / chos nyid de spros bral gyis khyad par du byas pa'i gsal cha ma 'gags pa la bzhed 'dir zag med kyi sems rgyun mdo nas bshad pas kyang grub/ sems can dang sangs rgyas gnyis ka sems kyi rgyun la 'jog /bem shes gnyis tshogs pa ma yin te/ dngos gnas la bem shes gnyis tshogs pa dang de 'dra mi srid pa sogs kyis phyir ro/ /des na de dag la sogs pa ni gzhan stong gi grub mtha'i mthil yin zhing / sdug kun lam bden gsum po kun rdzob 'dus byas bden med/ 'gog bden don dam 'dus ma byas pa bden grub sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi lam bden gyi ming can/'gog bden dang dbyer med yin pas don dam 'dus ma byas yin la/ de 'dra'i 'gog bden de yang stong pa nam mkha' lta bu la mi 'jog par rang rig chen po yin pas sdug bsngal bden pa'i rang bzhin 'gog bden dang / kun 'byung bden pa'i rang bzhin lam bden/ 'gog lam spangs rtogs ngo bo dbyer med ces kyang gsung ngo / /kho bo phyogs su lhung ba ma lags te/ 'di dag nges pa'i don la ni shin tu 'byor bar sems lags/ dbu ma ngo bo nyid med pa —194—

rnams kyi nang nas kyang rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma 'di nges don la lhag par 'byor par sems shing / rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud rnams kyi dgongs pa'ang gzhan stong gsal ba dang / rang stong gis kyang rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma 'di'i phyogs su lhan pa kho na mthong ngo / /rang stong gzhan stong gi khyad par gsal la go bde ba zhig ye ger bris gsung ba re zhig de tsam mo/ /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas phul ba'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po bla chen byams pa ngag dbang gis bskul ba yin/ dge'o/ /gcig zhus dag /

oX swā sti/ zab mo gzigs pa rnams la ni/ /bzhed dgongs 'gal ba mi srid snyam/ /'on kyang gdul bya tha dad dang / /dgos pa'i dbang gzigs tha dad bsnyad/ /'dir chos rje kun mkhyen chen po rton pa bzhi ldan dang / paṇ+ḍita chen po rgyal ba shākya mchog ldan gnyis/ gzhan stong dbu ma'i lta sgom gyi gnad gcig kyang / gnas skabs lta ba de gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs/ grub mtha' mi 'dra ba than thun mang dag yod pa rnams 'dir ngos bzung bar bya ste/ de la shākya'i mtshan can ni/ thal rang gi lta ba 'di kun 'khor lo bar pa dang / rig tshogs kyi dgongs don 'thad ldan yin zhing / bar pa'i dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin pa yang yin/ rig tshogs dang 'khor lo tha ma'i dngos bstan mi mthun par bzhed la/ kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen po ni/ thal rang gi lta ba 'di 'khor lo bar pa dang rig tshogs kyi dgongs par rlom pa yin kyang / dgongs pa rma med pa ma yin la/ rig tshogs dngos bstan gyi tshig phal cher la 'byor ba ltar snang yang / mi 'byor pa yang mang du yod la/ 'khor lo bar pa'i gzhung tshig mang pos gzhan stong gsal bar ston pas 'khor lo bar pa dang rig tshogs kyi dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin no/ /de la 'khor lo bar pa dang rig tshogs kyi tshig phal cher gyi dngos bstan ni/ thal rang dang gzhan stong gnyis ka la mi 'gal yang / rang stong par grags pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha'i khungs —196—

la 'dren pa rnams ni/ de rnams nyid la 'khrul gzhi byung ba yin gyi/ grub mtha' de dang de mi ston zhing de las gzhan de'i lugs dang 'gal zhing / gzhan stong kho na ston pa thun mong ma yin pa'i tshig kyang du ma yod pas/ bar pa dang rig tshogs kyis kyang ga po stong dbu ma nyid ston to/ /'on kyang de dag nas/ 'khor lo tha ma dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa tsam du gzhan stong thun mong ma yin pa rnams gsal zhing rgyas par 'byung ba yin la/ thal rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha' deng sang rang stong gi lta bar grags pa de mi ston kyang / rgyal ba sras bcas kyi dgongs pa'i rang stong de rgyas par bstan to zhes gsung ngo / /khyad par dang po'o/ /yang snga mas ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyis/ rang stong gzhan stong gi grub mtha' gnyis ka ston pa ni lta bas spros pa gcod pa la thal rang gzhung phyi gsum gyi rang stong dang / sgom pas nyams len gzhan stong dgos pa la dgongs la/byams chos lhag ma bzhis gzhan stong kho na ston mod/ de la'ang rigs gnyis te/ rgyud bla mar mthar thug theg gcig bshad/ rigs chad bkag gzhung gzhan gsum du mthar thug theg gsum dang rigs chad bshad gsung / phyi mas ni/ byams chos sde lnga la grub mtha' so so ba ye med/ rang stong par grags pa'i grub mtha' mngon rgyan nas kyang ma bshad/ mdo rgyan sogs nas kyang gtan nas rigs chad pa dang mthar thug theg gsum ma bshad/ zhes gsung ngo / /gnyis pa'o/ /yang snga ma so/ lta bas spros pa gcod pa la rang stong zab/ sgom pas —197—

nyams su len pa la gzhan stong zab ces te/ de'i rang stong yang thal rang gzhung phyi gsum gyi lugs la ngos 'dzin/ phyi mas ni/ rgyal ba sras bcas bzhed pa'i rang stong gi lta ba de spros pa gcod byed mchog yin kyang / gzhan stong du 'dus pas lta grub logs logs pa min la/ deng sang grags pa'i rang stong thal rang gzhung phyi gsum gyi lta ba don dam bden med du 'dod pa ni nor ba yin pas/lta bas spros pa gcod pa la bzang pa min te/ skur 'debs su 'gyur ba'i phyir yin zhes gsung / gsum pa'o/ /yang snga mas/ gzhan stong sems tsam las 'das pas dbu ma go chod po yin kyang / lta ba'i ngos nas de bas kyang rang stong mtho/ 'on kyang snga ma de nor bar mi 'gyur te/ sgom don dang mthun pas so gsung / yang phyi mas ni/ rang stong yang sems tsam las 'das pas/ grub mtha' bzhi'i dbu mar bsdu ba tsam yin kyang rnam dag mthar thug min la/ lta ba'i mtho shos gzhan stong kho na yin no gsung / bzhi pa'o/ /yang snga mas de'i rgyu mtshan du/ byams chos rjes 'brang dang bcas par/gnyis med kyi ye shes la dpyad pa mi byed pa yin la/ spyi ldog nas de yang rigs pas dpyad na dpyad mi bzod pas/ don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pas dpyad bzod mi srid pas lta ba rang stong zab/ dpyad ma bzod kyang ye shes de nyams myong rgyun mi 'chad pas/ sgom don gzhan stong ltar gnas gsung / phyi mas ni/ gnyis med ye shes rigs pas dpyad bzod yin pas/ de la dpyod pa de rang gi 'khrul gsung / lnga pa'o/ / —198—

yang snga mas ni/ gnyis med ye shes de rig pa skad cig ma yin/ rtag pa min/ gnas pa'i go skabs med pa cig yin gsung / phyi mas ni/ de skad cig ma ma yin/ dus gsum las grol bas rtag pa brtan pa yin gsung / drug pa'o/ /de bzhin du shes pa yin pa'i phyir dngos por bzhed pa dang / dngos po dngos med gnyis ka las grol bar bzhed pa ste/ bdun pa'o/ /de bzhin du 'dus byas su bzhed pa dang / 'dus ma byas su bzhed pa yang ste/ brgyad pa'o/ /yang snga mas bod spyi dang mthun rung du shes pa thams cad kyi rang ldog gsal rig tsam 'di ka gzhan dbang gi dngos po yin la/ de nyid la shar ba'i gnyis snang kho na'i rang ldog nas kun btags yin no/ /gsal rig de gnyis snang de dang bcas pa'i cha nas gzhan dbang dang / gsal rig de la gnyis chos kyis gdod nas ma gos pa'i cha nas yongs grub yin pas/ gzhan dbang yongs grub ldog cha nas tha dad cing / mtshan nyid kyi cha nas tha dad kyang gzhan dbang gi dngos po de nyid dang / yongs grub ngo bo gcig par bzhed do/ /phyi mas ni/blo rnam rtog sna tshogs pas brtags pa'i brtags cha dang / phyi don du snang ba'i snang cha ste/ gzung ba'i rang ldog kun btags dang / sems sems byung shes pa'i rang ldog kun rdzob pa'i shes pa'am rnam shes kyis bsdus pa'i shes pa gzhan dbang dang / spros pa dang bral pa'i rang bzhin gsal rig yongs grub ste/des na kan btags ni gzhan dbang las rdzas tha dad du med kyang / mtshan nyid —199—

kyi sgo nas ni shin tu tha dad do/ /yongs grub dang gtī dbang ni/ ldog cha dang mtshan nyid tha dad par ma zad/ ngo bo gcig pa yang ma yin no/ /snga mas rnam gzhag ni sems tsam dang mthun shas che la/ dbu ma'i lugs ni 'di kho na'o zhes dgongs so/ /dgu pa'o/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir snga mas ni kun btags la bden med kyis khyab/yongs grub la bden yod kyis khyab/ gzhan dbang la cha gnyis mdzad/ phyi mas ni/ kun btags gzhan dbang gnyis ka la mtha' gcig tu bden med kyis khyab par mdzad do/ /bcu pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ snga mas rang rig thams cad rang rig gi rang ldog nas don dam kho na yin gsungs la/ phyi mas ni/ kun rdzob rnam shes kyi rang rig rnams kun rdzob kho na yin pas/ rang rig la— yang kun rdzob don dam gnyis yod par bzhed do/ /bcu gcig pa'o/ /snga mas yongs grub stong pa nyid yin/ kun btags stong pa tsam yin kyang stong nyid min/ stong nyid la don dam gyis khyab par bzhed/ phyi mas chos dang chos nyid thams cad la stong nyid tsam du brjod dgos/ stong nyid la don dam gyis ma khyab ming gi rnam grangs la khyab mtha' mi brtsi/ gtso bo'i don du sbyor gsung / bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de bzhin du snga mas tshad ma'i gzhung dang mngon pa sogs spyi skad dang phal cher mthun par/ gzhi grub pa la dngos po dngos med gang rung gis khyab/shes pa la dngos pos khyab/ don dam dngos po min/ 'dus ma byas ni dngos —200—

med nam mkha' sogs yin/ de bzhin nyid la las nyon gyis 'dus ma byas dang gsal rig tsam gsar du 'dus ma byas sogs 'dus ma byas pa'i cha re yod pas/ rnam grangs kyi sgo nas 'dus ma byas su brtags pa yin gyi/ 'du byed dang mtshan nyid 'gal ba'i 'dus ma byas ma yin te/ des na 'dus ma byas btags pa ba yin gsung / phyi mas ni/ tshad mngon sogs su bshad pa de/ kun rdzob gtso bor gtan la 'bebs pa'i lugs yin/ don dam gtso bor gtan la 'bebs pa'i nges don gyi skabs 'dir/ kun rdzob la dngos po dang dngos med kyis khyab cing / dngos po dngos med la'ang kun rdzob kyis khyab/ don dam dngos po yang min/ dngos med kyang min pas gzhi grub la des ma khyab/ ye shes dngos po ma yin la shes pa yin pas shes pa la dngos pos ma khyab/dngos med don dam du 'dod pa ches mi rigs la/ don dam dngos por 'dod pa dngos smra ba'i lugs so/ /mngon pa ba rnams 'dus ma byas su 'dod pa'i nam mkha' sogs/ dngos med thams cad kyang skabs 'dir 'dus byas yin pas/ dngos po dngos med la 'dus byas kyis khyab/ don dam 'dus ma byas dngos yin/ nam mkha' sogs 'dus ma byas btags pa ba yin gsung / bcu gsum pa'o/ /yang snga mas stong gzhi gzhan dbang gi rang ngo de dgag bya kun btags kyis stong pa ste/ de nyid kun rdzob kyis stong pa'i don dam du mdzad do/ /phyi mas ni/ stong gzhi yongs grub/ dgag bya g.yin dbang kun btags gnyis kyis stong pa don dam kun rdzob kyis stong pa'i don yin la/ gzhan dbang kun —201—

btags kyis stong pa ni/ kun rdzob bden pa kho na gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs kho na yin par bzhed do/ /bcu bzhi pa'o/ /yang snga mas dag pa gzhan dbang zhes bod spyi la grags kyang / don la gzhan dbang min zhing phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub yin la/ phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub kyang yongs grub mtshan nyid pa yin zhing / dag pa gzhan dbang gi tha snyad la'ang khungs gsal med pas/ de'i brda chad byed pa mi legs par dgongs so/ /phyi mas ni/ dag pa gzhan dbang zhes pa'i tha snyad gzhung las gsal po ma byung yang / don tshang bas tha snyad byar rung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa don la rton pa yin pa dang / bod snga ma thams cad tha snyad de lta bu mthun par byed pas/ byams pa nas brgyud pa'i man ngag ma nor ba yin du rung bas so/ /de'i nang tshan 'phags pa slob pa'i ye shes 'ga' zhig phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub yin kyang / sa thob pa rnams la sa gzhi gser du snang ba sogs 'ga' zhig phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub yin pa'ang yod pas/ de'i tha snyad kyi rnam gzhag legs par dgongs so/ /bco lnga pa'o/ /yang snga mas phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub la/ yongs grub mtshan nyid pas khyab par bzhed/ phyi mas ni/ de ni rnam grangs kyi yongs grub tu bstan pa tsam ste/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyang yongs grub tu gsungs pa dang 'dra'o/ /des na 'gyur med yongs grub kyi zlas drangs pa'i phyin ci ma log pa de ni gzhan dbang dag pa ba yin zhing yongs grub btags pa ba yin/ 'gyur med nyid dang gcig pa'i yongs grub phyin ci ma log pa de la/ don dam pa'i phyin ci —202— ji

ma log pa'i yongs su grub pa zhes bya ste 'gyur med kho na'o/ /des na gnas tshul gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs su yongs grub de nyid kho na nyid yin la/rnam grangs rgyas par bshad pa'i skabs su gnyis kyi rnam gzhag byed do gsung /bcu drug pa'o/ /yang snga mas lam bden yang don dam bden par mdzad la/ phyi mas ni/bden pa bzhir phye ba'i 'gog bden don dam dang / bden pa gzhan gsum kun rdzob tu bzhed/ zhib mor na/ 'gog bden mtshan nyid pa gdod ma'i 'gog bden la don dam kho na dang / g.yin bden pa gsum dang so sor brtags 'gog la kun rdzob kyis khyab par don la gnas pas/ lam bden mtshan nyid pa la kun rdzob kyis khyab/ 'gog bden mtshan nyid pa la don dam gyis khyab/ don dam pa'i lam bden ni gdod ma dang gcig pa'i phyir/ 'gog bden nyid yin pas/ lam bden btags pa ba yin gsung / bcu bdun pa'o//yang snga mas sems can gyi rgyud la bde gshegs snying po med sems can gyi sems rang bzhin 'od gsal de/ bde gshegs snying po'i rgyu dang khams tsam yin pas/ rgyu bde gshegs snying po'am khams bde gshegs snying po sems can thams cad la yod kyang de ni de 'dra mtshan nyid pa min/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes nyid bde gshegs snying po'o/ /zhes gsungs/ phyi mas ni/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi de ka bde gshegs snying po mtshan nyid pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi de mtshan nyid pa yin na/ de gnyis ka sems can kyi chos nyid yin pas/ sems can bde gshegs snying po can du grub la/ khyad par lung mtha' yas pas grub —203—

bo/ /khams dang rgyur bshad pa yang / skyed rgyu dang skyed khams min par dbyings dang bral rgyu la dgongs pa'o gsung / bco brgyad pa'o/ /yang snga mas ni/ snying po la yon to ngo bo dbyer med rang bzhin nyid ldan du gsungs pa 'bras bu kho na'i skabs yin la/ rgyu'i skabs su yon tan 'byung rung gi nus pa sa bon tsam yod par bzhed/ phyi mas ni yon to ngo bo dbyer med nyid/ rang bzhin nyid ldan de gzhi bde gshegs snying po la yang yod de/ gsar du byung bas rang bzhin gyis ldan par mi 'gro ba'i phyir dang / gzhi lam 'bras gsum kun rdzob chos can gyis phye ba ma gtogs/ rang bzhin bde gshegs snying po gcig kho na yin pa'i phyir/ bde gshegs snying po yin phyin chad don dam pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa yin dgos par bzhed do/ /bcu dgu pa'o/ /yang snga mas/ chos sku'i yon tan la mtshan dpe sogs mi bzhed/ phyi mas ni/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi rigs thams cad la/ chos sku'i yon tan don dam pa sangs rgyas rang snang re dang / gzugs sku'i yon tan kun rdzob pa gdul bya gzhan snang gi cha re thams cad du yod pa yin la/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo dang / rgyud bla ma'i dngos bstan ni/ spyir sku gnyis ka'i yon to tshang dgos pa la gtso che chung gi dbang las/ grags pa spyi dang mthun pa dper brjod tsam du mdzad la/ mdo gzhan rnams dang rgyud sde sogs las gsungs pa ltar na/ gnyis ka la thams cad kyi cha re yod pa yin no gsung / nyi shu pa'o/ /da ni sngags kyi skabs su gzhan stong la mi 'dra ba ni 'di yin te/ snga —204—

mas ni/ sems rang bzhin 'od gsal la 'bras bu'i sa bon tsam rang chas su yod pa de lam bsgoms pas gong 'phel thob/ mthar 'bras bu mngon gyur du 'byur bar bzhed/ phyi mas ni/ gdod ma nas ye shes don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du lhun grub tu rdzogs pa de lam bsgoms pas dri ma bsal te mngon du gyur pa yin par bzhed do/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o/ /de ltar bzhed pa tha dad pa de dag bskyar ba la/ snga ma zhes pa gleng bslang ba'i tshul du bkod/ phyi ma zhes pa rnams gzhung 'dzugs pa'i tshul du 'gro bar sbyor 'dod nas/ bzhed pa dang po'i skabs su de ltar bkod pa'i go rim ltar 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar ba yin gyi/ grub mtha' mdzad pa po dus snga phyir byon pa'i go rim ni ma yin no/ /de la gnas skabs kyi bzhed pa mi 'dra ba de snyed 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / rtsa ba gcig las phal cher byung ba yin te/ gcig pu de gang zhe na/ paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan can ni/ gnyis med kyi ye shes de gcig pu ma yin pa du ma'i tshul can/ skad cig gis mi gnas pa mi rtag par bzhed pa dang / kun mkhyen jo nang pa ni/ de dngos gnas la gcig min du ma yang min par nges mod/ gnas skabs su gcig pu'i rnam gzhag 'thad ldan du mdzad cing / de rtag pa/ cha med kun khyab/ spros bral brjod bral yin par bzhed pa'i dbang las te/ mdor na mi rtag pa dang rtag par bzhed pa'i khyad par ro/ /dbyings de sgra rtog las 'das par bzhed pa dang / mi rtog ye shes ma 'khrul ba'i yul du bzhed par mtshus pas/ mthar gshugs pa'i gnad la mi 'dra ba med do/ /des na dpal jo nang pa chen pos de ltar mkhyen nas/ cha med —205—

yin pa'i phyir dang / kun khyab yin pa'i phyir/ snod bcud so so dang gzhi lam 'bras gsum sangs rgyas sems can thams cad la chos nyid gcig kho na yin pa dang / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis bde gshegs snying po yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa dang / rgyu mtshan des na/ rten 'brel dang gcig du bral sogs kyi rigs pas mi gnod pas dpyad bzod yin pa dang / de ltar yin pas/ de la dpyad pas 'jig par 'dod pa'i thal rang gi grub mtha' thun mong ma yin pa de nor ba yin pas/ thal rang lta ba ma dag pa dang / de'i phyir 'khor lo bar pa'i dgongs par mi 'gyur ba sogs rig pas dpyad pas shes te/ mdo rgyan nas theg gcig bstan/ phugs kyi rigs chad bkag par bzhed pa 'di ni/ sngar bshad pa'i khyad par gcig po de/ rang la bsten pa min gyi gzhan rnams snga ma'i gnad kyis so/ /de lta bu'i nges don mthar thug gi grub mtha' 'di bzung pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i mdzod bzung bar 'gyur zhing / kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen pos don dam seng ge'i sgra 'di bsgrags pa na/dus de skabs kyi skal ldan gdong lnga pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa thams cad ches spro ba thob mod kyang / phyis skal dman wa skyes thams cad/ zab mo ci yi phyir na rtog ge'i yul ma yin/ ci'i phyir zab mo'i don rig pa dag thar 'gyur zhes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skrag ste/ phyis byung ba sa dge bka' gsum/ zha lu bo dong gnyis/ /rnying ma pa 'ga' re dang bcas pa/ grub mtha' 'di thos pas snying gas shing / klad pa 'gems pa tsam du gyur pas/ log rtog gis myos te rmongs pa las skur 'debs dang rigs pa ltar snang gi nyes bshad brlab rdol du —206—

smras pas ca cor gyur to/ /'on kyang zab mo'i don la skal ba bzang po can 'ga' zhig ni/ mkhas pa rnams kyis tshul bzhin brtags na chos 'dis skrag mi 'gyur/ zhes pa'i tshul gyis yid ches rnam pa gsum thob pa dus mtha' 'dir yang 'byung bar snang ngo / /de yang 'dir yang dag pa'i rtag pa ni mi rtag pa log tsam gyi rtag pa dngos med rtag pa de ni min zhing / rgyun gyi rtag pa 'dus byas rtag pa de yang min/ mu stegs 'dod pa'i rtag dngos shes bya la mi srid pa de yang min/ dgag pa'i rtag pa bden spyi tsam de yang min/ sgrub pa rang dbang can gyi rtag pa de 'drar 'dod pa'ang min/ 'di ni spros bral te/ dngos po sgrub pa mi rtag pa dang / dngos med dgag pa rtag pa gnyis ka las grol ba'i dbyings 'gyur med de yin/ rtag pa'i mtshan ma las grol zhing / rtag pa'i spros pa las grol yang 'gyur med yin pa'i phyir rtag pa kho na yin no/ /'o na de mi rtag pa'i mtshan ma dang spros pa las grol bas mi rtag par yang ci'i phyir mi 'gyur snyam na/ rang bzhin de la 'gyur ba brtan pa'i cha yod na de ltar bden yang de 'dra med pas mi rtag par 'jog pa'i rnam gzhag mi byed de/ des rtag mi rtag gi spros pa dang bral/ spros pa'i rtag pa yang min/ spros pa'i mi rtag pa yang min mod/ spros bral gyi mi rtag pa mi srid pas de 'dra min la/ spros bral gyi rtag pa'o zhes bya ba ni/ snying po'i mdo zab mo rnams kyi dgongs don rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa las ches gsang pa'o/ /blo gros bzang zhing bsod nams dang / /byin rlabs stobs mchog 'dzoms gyur na/ /'di la yid ches thob par 'gyur/ khres rab cher rlom tsam gyis min/ /zab don khyad par nyer —207—

zhes bya ba bsdo/gan//lkoX gu ru bud+dhā bo dhi sa te spyo na mo na maX stong nyid kyi rab tu dbye ba khyad 'phags zhes bya ba/ pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i stong nyid zab mo la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /pad 'dab bcu drug dur khrod bcu drug dang / /phyag bcu drug dang ka ba bcu drug dang / /cha chen bcu drug stong nyid bcu drug la/ /bstud nas stong nyid dbye ba khyad 'phags bri/ /rdzogs ldan gyi gzhud lugs dri ma med pa rnams su stong nyid gsungs pa rnams la/ bden gnyis la sogs pa'i rnam dbye ma shes na gzhan stong gis stong nyid kyi go mi chod pas stong nyid thams cad rang stong kho na yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin nyid la sogs pa'i rnam grangs su gsungs pa'i stong nyid kyang rang stong kho nar 'dod pa'i lta ngan gyi dug sdong la brten nas/ lta log sna tshogs pa'i yal ga mang po rab tu rgyas par 'gyur bas/ de mi mkhas pa rnams la bstan pa'i don du 'di brtsam mo/ /stong nyid gsungs pa thams cad rang rnya nge kho na ma yin gyi/ gzhan stong zab mo yin pa'i stong nyid dang / rang stong mi zab pa yin pa'i stong nyid du dbyer yod do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te don dam yin pa'i stong nyid dang / kun rdzob yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ yongs grub yin pa'i stong nyid dang / kun brtags yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ dbus ma yin pa'i sto/nga —209

nyid dang / mtha' ma yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ rang bzhin gnyug ma yin pa'i stong nyid dang / bcos ma glo bur ba yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ chos nyid zab mo yin pa'i stong nyid dang / chos can mi zab pa yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ ma skyes pa'i stong pa nyid dang skyes pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ mi stong pa'i stong pa nyid dang / stong pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ gzhan gyi dngos po stong pa nyid dang / rang gi dngos po stong pa nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang / phung po rnam par dpyad pa chad pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/gzhan mchog pha rol dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas yin pa'i stong nyid dang / phyi nang kun rdzob glo bur ba 'di yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/stong gzhi yon tan mang po can ma yin dgag yin pa'i stong nyid dang / stong tsam sgrub chos tsam gyis dor ba med dgag yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /yang rnam pa gnyis te/ rang gis mi stong la chos gzhan thams cad kyis stong pa'i stong nyid dang / rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i stong nyid do/ /de bzhin du chos rnams kyi chos nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / chos kyi gnas nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / chos skyon med pa nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / de bzhin nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid yin min gyi stong nyid —210—

gnyis dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / yongs su mi nyams pa'i chos nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rtag tu btang snyoms su gnas pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'dus ma byas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / chos thams cad du ma ro gcig yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis dge ba/ kha na ma tho ba med pa/ zag pa med pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ rnam par byang ba/'jig rten las 'das pa/ 'dus ma byas rnams yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / dbye bsdu mang po can gyi rang bzhin gyi rigs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / yon tan mang po can gyi bde gshegs snying po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / de bzhin du dbu ma chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /phyag rgya chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / myang 'das chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'od gsal chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /byang chub chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sher phyin zab mo yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'gog bden zab mo yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / shin tu spros med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / shin tu rnal 'byor yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / lhan cig skyes sbyor yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas mnyam spyor yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi bde chen —211—

yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sbyang gzhi sbyangs 'bras yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gshi/sa lugs la yod med gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'gal 'dus skyon med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / blang bya'am thob bya yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / skad cig dang rten 'brel dang rnam shes las 'das pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rang byung ye shes yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i theg pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i lha yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i sngags yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /rdo rje'i rgyud yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i phyag rgya yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i rgyu skar zla nyi khu rdul yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / rdo rje'i rtsa rlung bshang gci yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / rdo rje'i sha khrag rus pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / rdo rje'i rkang tshil bu pags pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / rdo rje'i skra skru sen mo la sogs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / rdo rje'i skar ma phra sbom dang 'ja' tshon phra rags dang sa rdo yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / rdo rje'i char glog chu me yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / rdo rje'i gza' bcu dang rlud bcu yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / rdo rje'i lo zla ba bgrod pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / rdo rje'i dus drug dus bzhi dus gsum yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / rdo rje'i phyogs dang nyin mtshan dang chu tshod la sogs pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / rdo rje'i phyogs bcu dang dbyibs mdog la —212—

/gas pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / mdor na rdo rje'i phung po bams skye mched thams cad yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis gnyis dang / ye shes sku ste rang byung ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rgyud chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje 'chang chen gsang sngags 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gsang sngags rgyal po drug ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / mchod pa chen po zhe sdang che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / mchod pa chen po khro pa che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / mchod pa chen po chags pa che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'dod pa chen po bde ba che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /dga' ba chen po mgu ba che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gzugs che lus kyang che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / kha dog che zhing lus bong che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / ming yang che zhing rgya che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / dkyil 'khor chen po yangs pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /nyon mongs chen po lcags kyu'i mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /grags chen snyan grags chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / mi mngon mi snang gsal byed mi snang ba chen po gsal ba che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul chen po 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sbyin —213—

bdag chen po gtso bo yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / tshul khrims chen po 'chang ba'i mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / bzod chen 'chang ba brtan pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / brtson 'grus chen po brtul ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / bsam gtan chen po ting 'dzin gnas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / shes rab chen po'i lus 'chang ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / stobs po che la thabs che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / byams chen rang bzhin dpag med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / snying rje chen po blo'i mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / shes rab chen po blo chen ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / mkhas pa chen po thabs che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs dang ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / shugs chen mgyogs pa chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / mgon po rigs mchog chen po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / theg pa chen po'i tshul gyi mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / thub pa chen po thub chen ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gsang sngags tshul chen bdag nyid can yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / pha rol phyin bcu thob pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / shes bcu rnam dag bdag nyid can yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / thub dbang stobs bcu —214—

khyab pa'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / de bzhin nyid bdag dag pa'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / yang dag mtha' la rnam par gnas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / bdag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / kun tu 'gro ba'i don yod stobs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yid ltar mgyogs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rgyal ba dgra rgyal rnam par rgyal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / bde gshegs 'jig rten rig pa'i mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'khor ba'i pha rol mthar son pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / bya ba byas pa bskam sar gnas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / shes pa 'ba' zhig nges bsal ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / dam chos chos rgyal gsal bar ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'jig rten snang bar byed pa'i mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / legs pa'i lam ni ston pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / don grub bsam pa grub pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /kun tu rtog pa thams cad spangs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rnam par mi rtog dbyings mi zad yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / chos dbyings dam pa zad mi shes yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / ye shes ldan pa yod med shes yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / mchog gi dang po sku gsum 'chang yin min gyi —215

stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / khyab bdag ye shes lnga'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /sangs rgyas lnga bdag cod pan can yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / spyan lnga chags pa med pa 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gcig pu sra mkhregs rdo rje'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / skyes ma thag pa 'gro ba'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gsang sngags rgyal po don chen byed yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas kun bdag dngos po mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gtso bo dkon mchog gsum 'dzin pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / don yod zhags pa rnam par rgyal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gshin rje'i gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje shugs can 'jigs byed pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje grags pa rdo rje'i snying yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje las skyes rdo rje'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje snying po mkha' 'dra ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje kun 'chang rdo rje can yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje 'bebs pa 'bebs pa che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje phreng thogs dpal dang ldan yin min —216—

gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'jam dbyangs chen po sgra che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / yang dag bdag med de bzhin nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / yang dag mtha' ste yi ge med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / chos kyi dung ste sgra chen ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi sgra bo che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / phyogs bcu'i chos kyi rnga bo che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / skyabs dang skyob pa bla na med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtsho yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs 'byed pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / srid pa'i dra ba 'joms pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sgrib pa kun las nges par grol yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid la gnas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / khyab bdag dam shes dam tshig ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / skyabs kyi dam pa skyabs su 'os yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / grol ba thar ba rnam grol lus yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdul med rdul bral dri ma med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang/ nyes pa spangs pa skyon med pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / shin tu sad pa sad pa'i bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis —217—

dang / kun shes kun rig dam pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rnam par shes pa'i chos las 'das yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gnyis med ye shes tshul 'chang ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / dus gsum sangs rgyas sku 'a myong ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / ye shes mig gcig dri ma med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / ye shes lus can de bzhin gshegs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / dpal ldan pad+ma gar dbang phyug yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi sku 'chang ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rnal 'byor che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa gcig yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug kun gyi bdag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi rje yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs la gnas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung yang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /chags bral dang po chags pa che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / kha dog sna —2 8—

tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / dpal ldan pad+ma sangs rgyas skyes yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / kun mkhyen ye shes ma sgyu di 'dzin pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'gyur med mchog ste rnam par dag yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / theg pa chen po sdug bsngal gcod yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / pha rol phyin pa kun rdzogs pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / yang dag ye shes zla 'od bzang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / ye shes sku rnams ma lus 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / kun tu bzang po blo gros bzang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po che yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan mtsho yin min min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rnam dag phung po lnga 'chang ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / yan lag bcu gnyis srid rtsa bton yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /dag pa rnam pa bcu gnyis 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / de nyid rnam pa bcu drug yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa bas mngon rdzogs pa'i byang chub yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med yin min gyi stong nyid —219—

gnyis dang / stong pa chen po 'gyur med lnga yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /thig le stong pa 'gyur med drug yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / cha med cha las 'das pa po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo 'chang yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / ston pa gcig pu 'gro ba'i bla yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'dren yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mtha' yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /bdag rig gzhan rig thams cad pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / don gyi dam pa rnam dag dpal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / yang dag mthar gyur yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas byang chub yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / ye shes sku nyid yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / cha med kun 'gro yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / lus med rdo rje yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i khu rdul yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i phyogs gnyis yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i bgrod pa gnyis yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i ā li kā li yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i dbyangs dang gsal byed yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs ye shes yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i dga' ba bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i sku bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i gdan bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i de kho na nyid —220—

bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i skad cig ma bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i he ru ka bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /rdo rje'i e waX ma ya bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i sems dpa' bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i gsang sngags bzhi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje pad+ma yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje bha ga yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje bdud rtsi yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje huX mdzad yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /rdo rje rnam 'joms yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje sgrol ma yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /rdo rje bdag med ma yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje dbyings yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sngags kyi dbyings yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /chos kyi dbyings yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'khor lo rgyud drug yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /mkha' 'gro lnga yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / dpal mchog dang po yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / de nyid 'dus pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / khams gsum rnam rgyal yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / don thams cad grub pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'gro ba 'dul ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang —221—

chub pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / kyai'i rdo rje yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'khor lo bde mchog yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gsang ba 'dus pa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / dus kyi 'khor lo yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang /gzhi'i sangs rgyas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gdod nas grol ba'i de bzhin gshegs yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i thig le gru gsum yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i e waX yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje'i snya k+ṣa yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rdo rje a haX yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / 'khor 'das dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / bden gnyis dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / bden bzhi dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gzhi 'bras dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rgyu 'bras dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rnam shes ye shes dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / yul dang yul can dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / rten dang brten pa dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gtso bo gtso mo dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / gtso 'khor dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / yab yum dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / pho mo dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / theg gsum dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / skyabs gsum dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / dus gsum —222—

dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sku gsum dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sku bzhi dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / sku lnga dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis dang / dbu ma sems tsam dbyer med yin min gyi stong nyid gnyis la sogs pa stong nyid kyi dbye ba rgya che rab 'byams yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs nas mnyam gzhag la zlo ba'i gdams ngag zab mo la brten te/ don dam gzhan stong zab mo'i lam khyer dang / rjes thob shan 'byed pa'i man ngag la brten nas kun rdzob rang stong mi zab pa'i lam khyer nyams su len zhing gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston par gyur cig /gsum ldan mar bcad kyi chos slad can skyon can rang bzo can ma dag pa rnams la brten nas de ma yin la der 'dzin gyi gzhi lam 'bras bu lta sgom spyod pa dman pa rnams spangs te/ rdzogs ldan gyi chos mchog khyad 'phags rnams las gsungs pa'i gzhi lam 'bras bu lta sgom spyod pa rnam dag phun tshogs legs par rtogs shing nyams su len pa dang gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston par gyur cig /'di la brten nas kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen mo thams cad shin tu dgyes par gyur cigasangs rgyas sku gcig brnyes pas byin rlabs dang / /sangs rgyas sku gnyis brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /sangs rgyas sku bzhi brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /sangs rgyas sku lnga brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /sangs rgyas sku drug brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /sangs rgyas sku bdun brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /rgyal sku bco brgyad —223—

brnyes pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /smon lam 'di dag ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ye shes rnam bzhi brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /ye shes rnam lnga brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /ye shes rnam dgu brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /ye shes bcu bzhi brnyes pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /smon lam 'di dag ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig stong nyid kyi rab tu dbye ba khyad 'phags rdzogs ldan gyi lugs su bkod pa'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can thams cad la phan par gyur cig /bdag ni tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bstan pa gsal bar byed gyur cig /bstan pa gsal bar ma nus na'ang / /bstan pa'i khur chen 'khur bar shog /khur chen bkur bar ma nus na'ang / /bstan pa'i sems khral byed pa dang / /bstan pa ༷nyams kyis dogs pa yi/ /bya ra tsam yang byed par shog /zhus dag /maṅga la// //—224—

man ngag gi khrid yig bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/na mo bud+dhā bo dhi sa te khyuX rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa skyes bu gsum gyi man ngag gi khrid yig bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon to du ma'i nor gyis brjid pa yi/ /brgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma la bshud nas/ /mar me mdzad dpal bzhed gzhung snying po'i don/ khreng rta chen po'i lam mchog 'dir bshad bya/ /de la 'jir dus gsum du byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rang rgyal dang nyan thos su bcas pa theg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa thams cad lam 'di nyid bsgoms te/thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mchog brnyes pa lags te/ chos tshul 'di la bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa zhes kyang bya/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim zhes kyang bya/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa zhes kyang bya/ shing rta chen po'i 'jug ngogs zhes kyang bya ste/ chos 'di ston par byed pa la/ lam tha mas cad kyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang / lam rim dngos skyes bu gsum gyi bsam pa la bslab pa dang / de las 'bras bu bla na med pa'i byang chub la spyor tshul te gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid dang de la gus pas — 225 —

bsten tshul khong du chud par byas nas/ /mnyam bzhag thun gyi skabs su 'di ltar bya ste/ rkang pa skyil krung bca' lus drang por bsrang pa sogs spyod lam rags pa gtsang sang nge ba byas nas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mkha' dbyings gang ba la dmigs/ phyag 'tshal dang mchod pa rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa cig yan lag bdun pa las logs su byed dgos pas/ thog mar phyag mchod sngon du bto / de rjes bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa de don dran bzhin pas tshar gsum brjod/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la ches mtho ba'i steng gi phyogs su sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bzhugs/ mdun drang thad kyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba thibs se bzhugs par bsams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang /bla ma yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag la phyin ci log gi dri ma thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ phyin ci ma log pa'i rtogs pa thams cad bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ theg pa chen po'i chos bsgrub pa la bar chad thams cad sel bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab bo/ /mthar yang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa cig phul la/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs ste snying 'od kyi gur khang du bzhugs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams de nyid du mi snang bar mos/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang — 226 —

thob par gyur cig /ces pa dang / dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing / /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /ces pa lta bus dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su yang bla ma'i skyon la mi brtag /yon tan kho na dran par bya/ bdag la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i skal ba ni med/ dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshul du bstan pa yin pas/bdag gi bla ma 'di don la ni sangs rgyas dngos yin/ bdag la bka' drin gyi sgo nas ni sangs rgyas kun bas kyang ches lhag /mtho ris thar ba sangs rgyas gsum gang 'dod kyang thabs gang dgos bdag la ma sbas par gnang ba yin/bdag gi rgyud la yon tan sna gcig skyes pa dang / skyon sna gcig bri ba yang bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i chos zab mo 'di lta bu thob bka' drin re che snyam du bsam/ gzhan yang bdag gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad kyang bla ma'i phyir tu gtong dgos/ lus kyi sgo nas bla ma'i bzhed pa dang mthun pa'i bkur bsti rim gro 'phral g.yog gi bya ba thams cad kyang bsgrub dgos/ ngag gi sgo nas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsngags pa dang / zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba'i gtam kho na smra dgos/ spyod lam gyi sgo nas thugs gang la dgyes pa dang / gsung ci 'byon pa de bsgrub dgos snyam du yang yang bsam zhing lag len du thebs par bya'o/ /de la skabs 'dir gsol 'debs kyi don ni/ phyin ci log gi dri ma lnga ste/ tshe waṃ la mngon par zhen pa'i dri ma/ las rgyu 'bras la yid mi ches pa'i dri ma/ 'khor ba la bde bar 'dzin — 227 —

pa'i dri ma/ rang don la gces par 'dzin pa'i dri ma/ dngos po dang mawo ma la yang dag tu 'dzin pa'i dri ma'o/ /phyin ci ma log pa'i rtogs pa yang lnga ste/ tshe 'di las phyi ma gal che bar rtogs pa/ las 'bras la yid ches par rtogs pa/'khor ba sdug bsngal du rtogs pa/ rang don pas gzhan don gces par rtogs pa/ don dam stong nyid dang kun rdzob sgyu mar rtogs pa'o/ /chos sgrub pa'i bar chad la/ phyi mi dang mi ma yin gyis gnod pa/ bar 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi na tsha/ nang chos 'gal gyi rnam rtog nyon mongs rnams yin pas/ de gsum sel bar mdzad du gsol zhes pa'o/ /dmigs skor gcig go/ //gnyis pa lam rim dngos skyes bu gsum gyi bsam pa la bslab pa la/skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong gi rim pa la bslab pa/ skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong gi rim pa la bslab pa/ skyes bu chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rim pa la bslab pa ste gsum las/ dang po la spyir srol ka so so la 'khrid lugs mi 'dra ba du ma 'dug /rje btsun mar me mdzad dpal gyi bka' srol gdams ngag 'di la rang gi lugs kyis kyang / 'ga' zhig 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa las 'go 'dzin/ 'ga' zhig las 'bras nas 'go 'dzin/ 'ga' zhig dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas 'go 'dzin/ phal cher 'chi ba mi rtag pa nas 'go 'dzin par mdzad pa sogs sna tshogs yod kyang thams cad gnad gcig la 'bab/ don gyi steng nas khyad par med/ 'on kyang spyi khyab grags che bar mthun par dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas 'go bzung na/ de ka mi rtag pa sgom pa'i gzhi rten yin pas mi rtag pa bsgom pa'i 'go 'dzin pa dang / don la khyad nam yang med pa las — 228 —

'phral 'di dngos rnam pa bde bar snang bas de'i dbang du byas te bshad na/'di la dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal bsam pa/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa ste bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa sngar bzhin byas/ gong du bshad pa'i gsol 'debs de yang cung zad bya ste/ de rjes rang gi lus dang gnas dang longs spyod dang yul phyogs sogs thams cad la gzhigs 'grel zhigs btang ste/ bdag gis da res thob pa'i mi lus 'di 'dra ba lar nas shin tu rnyed par dka'/ 'di don med du mi gtong / chos la 'khol ba cig byed dgos snyam pa dmigs pa'i gzhi 'di spyi ldog nas thams cad kyi 'gor sbyar nas bsgom ste/ de la sdom ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni/ /log lta can dang sangs rgyas stongs/ /lkugs pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad/ /ces pa ltar las/ ngan song gsum du skyes na ni sdug bsngal dos drag pa dang / lus de chos kyi rten du shin tu ngan pas chos byed mi khom/ 'dod khams kyi lha rnams kyang 'dod yon la chags pas g.yeng / gzugs khams dang gzugs med kyi lha phal cher ting nge 'dzin gyis myos pas chos nyan pa'i skal ba med/ lha ma yin yang 'dod lha dang 'dra ba la lhag par ngan song bzhin du lus rten ngan/ sangs rgyas ma byon pa'i 'jig rten khams su skyes pa'am sangs rgyas byon pa'i zhing khams su yang chos dar ba'i sa cha ni rgya chung / chos med sa cha yul phyogs mtha' 'khob kla klor skyes pa'am/ chos dar ba'i yul phyogs su skyes kyang lo go lta can chos la sdang ba'am/ glen lkugs su gyur nas blang dor gyi — 229 —

gnas gang yang mi go bar song na chos byed pa'i skal ba mi 'dug pa las/bdag gis da res mi khom pa brgyad las log nas chos byed nus su rung ba'i lus zhig thob 'dug snyam pa dang / sdom ni/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang / /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad/ /sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs/ /bstan pa gnas dang de'i rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying ni brtse ba'o//zhes pa ltar te/ bdag spyir mi lus thob dgos su yul dbus chos dar bar skyes/ yang dgos su dbang bo sgo lnga tshang bas spang blang shes su rung / zhe dgos su lta ba log pa dang ma phrad tsam/ mtshams med lta bu log par lta ba'i las kyang ma byas tsam/ gnas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la dad pa skyer rung ba tsam du 'dug pas rang gi 'byor pa lnga tshang 'dug /'jig rten du sangs rgyas kyang byon zin/ dam pa'i chos kyang gsungs zin/ bstan pa yang ma nub par gnas/ chos la gsar du 'jug pa yang mang ba'i skabs su yod/ chos byed rnams la gzhan gyis snying brtse ba'i sgo nas/ zas gos yo byad sogs kyang ster ba po mang po snang bas chos mthun gyi 'tsho ba 'byor du rung ba'i skabs su 'dug pas gzhan tshos ra lnga bo yang bdag la tshang / de ltar na mi khom pa brgyad las log /'byor ba bcu tshang ba'i lus 'di lta bu shin tu rnyed dka'/ skabs 'dir chos la 'bad dgos par 'dug snyam pa rgyu mtshan dran pa'i sgom nas yang yang bsam/ rjes thun mtshams la 'jug na gong bzhin dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o// //yang sngon 'gro dang rjes snga ma bzhin las sems can rnams kyi nang na — 230 —

ngan song gi 'gro ba ni shin tu mang / dper na sa chen po'i rdul tsam yin/ mtho ris kyi 'gro ba ni shin tu nyung / dper na sen mo'i steng gi rdul tsam yin/ yang dmyal ba ni/ sa gzhi chen po'i rdul phran tsam/ yi dwags ni kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa tsam/ dud 'gro byings ni rgya mtsho chen po la chang gar ma'i sbang ma tsam/ dud 'gro kha 'thor ba ni sa gzhi ri klung bar snang thams cad khengs pa tsam/ lha dang mi'i 'gro ba ni de rnams la lhos na srid mtha' tsam yin par 'dugade las kyang spyir mi'i 'gro ba nyung / dgos su 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi nyung / yang dgos su chos byed pa'i mi lus ni srid mtha' tsam du 'dug ste/ da res cis kyang chos la 'bad dgos snyam pa dang / de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang sems can gyi nang na sdig pa'i las byed pa ni ches mang ste mtha' med/ dge ba'i las byed pa ni spyi tsam nas kyang shin tu nyung / dge ba'i nang nas kyang mi lus 'phen thub pa'i tshul khrims srung ba ni ches shin tu dkon pas/ de'i phyir mi lus rnyed dka' ba yin/ de'i steng du yang 'byor ba bcu tshang zhing chos dang mjal ba la bsod nams mang po gsog dgos pas 'di 'dra shin tu rnyed dka' ba yin yang / sngon stes dbang gis dge ba che rab cig lan gcig bsags yod 'dug pas da res dal 'byor gyi lus 'di thob 'dug /skabs 'dir chos la 'bad par bya snyam du bsgom/ dmigs skor gsum pa'o// //'dir kha cig dpe'i sgo nas rnyed dka' ba zhes zer zhing de ltar grags pa ni/ dkon pa'i dpe bstan pa tsam yin pas dmigs skor logs pa mi dgos so/ /yang sngon 'gro dang rjes sngar ltar las gong du bshad pa'i rgyu mawo — 231 —

rnams dran par byas nas/ de ltar shin tu rnyed dka' ba'i mi lus 'di lan gcig thob pa'i skabs 'dir don chen po zhig sgrub dgos par 'dug /skye ba nas skye bar 'khor ba'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa 'dod na yang mi lus 'di la brten nas 'bad med du sgrub nus/ 'khor ba las thar ba'i nyan rang gi byang chub sgrub na yang da res dka' tshegs tsam med/ bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub par 'dod kyang da res kyi skabs 'dir byed bla bsgrub bla ba yin la/ mi lus 'di 'dra ba zhig ma thob na/ thar ba dang sangs rgyas lta ci smos/ 'khor ba'i bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa gcig kyang sgrub mi shes pas da res rang mi lus la snying po len dgos snyam du sgoms/ de bzhin du gal te mi lus lan gcig thob pa 'di don med du song na shin tu god ka che ste/ ji skad du spyod 'jug las/'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed nas ni/ /bdag gis dge goms ma byas na/ /'di las bslus pa gzhan med de/ 'di las rmongs pa'ang gzhan med do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gis rang nyid la bslus tshabs che/ rin po che'i gling du phyin nas stong ldog byas pa dang 'dra/ 'dod don khyad par can gang sgrub kyang 'grub tu rung ba'i rten khyad par can lan cig thob pa la/ bya ba gang yang ma byas par don med du thal 'gro ba 'di rang skyon che bar 'dug /sngar de tsam zhig don med du song / da ni nyi ma de ring nas brtsams te don med du ma lus par chos la 'bad dgos snyam du yang yang bsam pa'o/ /yang tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang bya byed rnams blos mi thongs snyam na/ 'jig rten na yang phugs skyid yun ring ba cig yong na/'phral zhag 'ga' zla shas sos dal ba'i bde ba la mi lta bar/ phugs kyi de — 232 —

sgrub pa la 'bad rtsol byed dgos pa ltar skye ba gtan gyi bde skyid sgrub pa'i phyir/ tshe 'di'i bya ba la ma chags par chos kyi bya ba la 'bad dgos snyam du bsam pa'o/ /de dag gis ni/ dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed pa shin tu dka'/ /skyes bu'i don grub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na/ /phyis 'di yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar mi lus rnyed dka' zhing rnyed pa don dang ldan par bsam pa yin te/ dmigs skor bzhi pa'o// //gnyis pa 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa la gsum gyi dang po/ nges par myur du 'chi ba bsam pa ni/ mdo las/ byung dang 'byung bar gyur pa ji snyed pa/ /kun gyis lus 'di btang nas 'gro ba dang / /de kun 'jig par mkhas pas rtogs bgyi ste/ /chos la gnas bgyi nges par spyad pa spyod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gnas gang du gnas kyang 'chi ba las ma 'das/ grogs su dang 'grogs kyang 'chi ba las ma 'das/ sa steng gi 'gro ba sngar byung ba thams cad kyang shi/da gzod 'byung 'gyur thams ྅ da kyang 'chi/ da lta dngos su yod pa 'di thams cad kyang 'chi ba las grol ba su yang med/ rang re btsas nas nyi ma de ring yan chad du rang dang nye ba yang ci tsam zhig shi bar ma dang dgra yang ci tsam zhig shide rnams shi ste bdag la sdod pa'i gdeng yod pa'ang min/ spyir 'chi ba las 'os mi 'dug dgos su tshe la snon kha rgyag mkhan ni med/ dus skad cig kyang sdod pa med par tshe'i steng nas 'brid pa yin pas skad cig re re song nas 'chi ba la rje nye/ zhag re zhag re song nas de bas nye ru song / zla ba re re song gin lhag par nye ru song / lo gcig gcig song gin lhag par nye ru song / de bas na — 233 —

myur du 'chi ba yin/ bdag chos nyams su len dgos na/ da rung rgas pa la ni ma thug rim pas byas pas chog snyam na/ tshe thung 'di la de 'dra'i long yod byed mi nyan par 'dug dper na lo drug cu la gzhon pa'i dus su ni chos ma byung bar yar 'das/ rgas nas ni chos byed blo byas kyang lus sems kyi stobs zad pas bogs skyed mi 'byung / de'i lhag ma'i phyed ni gnyid kyis 'das/ gzhan yang lto rgyab kyi phyir dang / 'gro 'dug dang g.yeng ba sogs don med sna tshogs kyi dbang du 'gro bas/ 'dun pa dang brtson 'grus che ba gcig gi dbang du byas kyang /chos rang nyams len byas pa'i tshad la yun ring mi yong ba 'dug dam pa rnams kyi dus ji snyed cig 'bad pa byas te rtogs pa'i chos de bdag gis myur du rtogs dgos na/ tshe thung 'di la chos la phyi 'gyangs dang / le lo dang bar skabs su bsgo(la ba'i thabs ye mi 'dug snyam du bsam dgos/ de ltar rgyu mtshan bsam nas yang yang bsgom pa gal che/ dmigs skor lnga ba'o// //don tshan gnyis pa nam 'chi cha med bsam pa ni/ 'o skol rnams spyi tsam du tshe thung bar ma zad nam 'chi cha med pa yin/ gal te stes dbang legs na sngon gyi las kyis 'phangs pa'i tshe lo drug cu bdun cu tsam 'phangs pa srid kyang /rang re la phal du de tsam med de 'ong / yod du chug kyang nyi ma de ring nas rtsi rgyu min/ phyed tsam song zin nam phal cher song zin/ yang gcig tu na sngon gyi las kyis tshe lo sum cu'am bzhi bcu tsam las ma 'phangs yang srid/ 'chi bdag sgo drung na sleb tshar ba'i wo du gda'/ tshe 'di'i dgra gnyen nor rdzas 'khor g.yog grogs po/ bde sdug gtam gsum 'di kun dang yun ring 'grogs — 234 —

skabs mi 'dug cis kyang ci byed snyam pa dang / ji skad du/ sa dang lhun po rgya mtsho nyi ma bdun/ /'bar bas bsregs pa'i lus can 'di dag kun/ /thal ba yang ni lus par mi 'gyur na/ khren tu nyams chung mi lta smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes pa ltar lus sha khrag rnag gi phung po 'di ni nyam re chung / dbugs mi brtan ston ka'i na bun bzhin du nam yal 'gro cha med/ sems la rang dbang ma thob gang la yang gdeng mi 'dug pas nam 'chi cha med/ ji skad du/ de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes/ /bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin/ /bdag ni med par 'gyur ba'i dus/ /de ni gdon mi za bar 'byung / /zhes pa ltar bsgom pa dang / klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang ba ste/ /gson pa yi ni nyung zad cig /de dag nyid kyang 'chi ba'i rkyen/ /de bas rtag tu chos mdzod cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/phyi'i rkyen mi dang dud 'gro dang gdon la sogs pa sems can du gtogs pa dang / g.yang sa dang me chu la sogs pa snod dang 'byung par gtogs pa/ nang lus la nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la sogs pa mdor na 'chi rkyen la 'dis mi byed bya ba med/ mi 'chi ba 'tsho ba'i rkyen du 'dod pa zas gos gnas mal sman la sogs pa yin na/ kha zas ma 'phrod pa dang sman log pa sogs 'tsho ba'i rkyen de kun yang nam zhig na 'chi rkyen du 'gyur te/ lus srog la rgol ba'i rkyen ngan bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu'i dbus na bdag gnas pa yin na/ nam 'chi cha med snyam du bsgom/ dmigs skor drug pa'o// //don tshan gsum pa 'chi ba la chos ma yin pa cis kyang mi phan par bsam pa ni/ ji skad du/ zhi ba lhas/ gshin rje'i skyes bus zin pa la/ /gnyen — 235 —

gyis ci phan bzhas ci phan/ /zhes pa ltar 'chi ba'i dus na nor rdzas mang yang til 'bru tsam yang 'khyer dbang med/ gnyen grogs g.yog 'khor rje dpon sogs rtsa 'jing che yang bran gyi tha ma khye'u gcig tsam zhig rang la 'khrid dbang yang med/ kho la rjes su 'brang dbang yang med 'di thams cad bye bral byed pa'i chos nyid yin cis kyang phan pa med snyam skyug log ge ba bsgom/ dgra gnyen bde sdug gtam bzang ngan thams cad la de bzhin du sbyar/ 'o na 'di dag rjes su mi 'brang na su rjes su 'brang snyam na/ rang gis bsags pa'i las dge sdig gnyis po rjes su 'brang / sdig pa byas zin pa de yang shul du bzhag thabs med rtag tu gnod pa yin/ dge ba gang bsags pa des kyang bdag la phan pa yin shul du ni mi lus/ chos ldan rab 'byor gyi zhal nas kyang / dge dang sdig pa ma gtogs pa/ /'gro ba thams cad phyir ldog nas/ /'ga' yang khyod rjes mi 'brang bar/ /mkhyen par gyis la legs par dpyod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bsam pa dang / de ltar na nges par 'chi/ myur du 'chi/ nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi ba la gzhan cis kyang mi phan/ 'chi kha phan chad skye ba mtha' med du phan nus pa ni dam pa'i chos kho na yin na/ da lta nyid du chos la 'bad par bya'o snyam du bsgom/ dmigs skor bdun pa'o// //da ni 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i thon chos 'di bsgom ste/ 'di la rtsa ba'i tshig lnga zhes bya/ dang po mi sdod 'gyur ba bsam/ /gzhan dag shi ba mang du bsam/ /'chi rkyen mang po yang yang bsam/ /'chi khar ji ltar 'gyur snyam bsgom/ khre nas ji ltar 'gyur ba bsam/ /bya ba yin te rang re skyes nas ma — 236 —

shi'i bar du yang phung po'i rgyun 'di rtag tu 'gyur zhing 'gro/ bdag dang po bu chung gi dus na de 'dra/ byis pa'i dus na de 'dra/ lang tsho tsa na de 'dra/ da ni 'di 'dra snyam pa dang / 'chi ba la je nye je nyer 'gro ba der 'dug /cis kyang ma phan snyam du rig pa gcun la skyo lhang lhang ba la bzhag /rang res dran nas da lta yan chad la yul 'di na mi 'di 'dra cig yod pa yang shi 'dug /de na de 'dra zhig yod pa yang shi 'dug snyam du re re nas zhib tu bgrangs/ rang bas rgan pa yang ci tsam zhig shi 'dug /mnyam pa dang gzhon pa yang ci tsam zhig shi 'dug bsams na da lta yod pa bas shi ba mang / de dag kyang tshe tshad du thub nas shi ba tsam cher mi 'dug /phal cher dus min bar ma dor shi /bdag kyang de lta bu'i chos nyid yin/ de lta bu'i rang bzhin las ma 'das/ sngar de dag gi gseb tu ma song ba khar rje che/ ma shi gong du chos gsha' ma zhig mi byed pa'i thabs med snyam du bsam/ gzhan mi dang dud 'gro shi ba thos sam mthong ngam/ byis pa nas rgan po'i bar du lang tsho 'gyur ba mthong ngam/ ma shi ba nyid la yang kha drag po kha zhan por song ba dang / tī po drag por song ba dang / phyug po sprang por song ba sogs gang mthong gang thos kyang mi rtag pa lhang gis dran te/ bdag gam bdag gi phyogs dang / bdag gi longs spyod sogs kyang 'di lta bu'i rang bzhin yin/'di lta bu'i chos nyid yin snyam du bsam/ de nas gong bzhin 'chi ba'i rkyen mang ba bsams te/ rang gi gdong du byung ba'i dngos po thams cad la 'di kun gyis kyang bdag 'chi ba'i rkyen ji ltar byed mi shes/ da lta rang yang ji ltar 'gyur mi shes snyam du bsam/ 'chi ba'i tshe mi dge ba'i sems kyi 'chi na ni gnad gcod — 237 —

kyi las la sogs pa sdug bsngal 'jigs su rung ba yod/ 'chi ba de 'dod bzhin dga' bzhin du yod pa min/ mi 'dod bzhin du thog tu 'bab pa yin/dga' bzhin skyid bzhin du 'chi ba ma yin/ sdug bsngal shugs drag po dang bcas te 'chi ba yin/ 'jig rten pha rol cha rgyus yod nas ma yin/ cha med kyi yul du rgyus med 'khyam pa yin snyam pa dang / bdag shi zin pa'i gnas skabs na/ lus sems gnyis ni bye bral du song / lus 'di ni yang na sa la skungs nas srin 'bu'i phung po gcig gam/ yang na chu la skyur nas nya sram gyi zas gcig gam/ me la bsregs nas dras pa spar gang ngam/ ri 'am thang la bskyal nas bya khyi'i kha na phar yer re re ba gcig gam/ mthar zhag shas nas shul tsam yang mi lus/ da lta gces gces mor byas pa'i lus kyi tha ma ni de 'dra/ sems ni las kyi khur thogs nas gar skye nges pa med pa'i gnas su 'gro dgos na/ da lta chos mi byed pa'i thabs rang 'dug gam/ byas nas phyi bgol du 'jog pa'i thabs rang 'dug gam snyam du bsam/ de rnams kyi gzhug sdoms te/ da lta rang chos gsha' ma zhig byed snyam pa'i go cha yod pa bzhin chos kyi mgo thon gzhug 'khyongs nas/ rang yang dga' bzhin du tshe'i dus byed/ gzhan kun gyis kyang kho la chos gzha' ma zhig byung zer nas smon bzhin du tshe'i dus byed pa cig la gtad so 'tshol dgos/ de la chos bsgom dgos brtan pa thob dgos/ goms dgos lhongs su gyur dgos pa 'dug /brtan pa ni ma thob/ gal te na rkyen ngan dang phrad/ rang gi blo las su ma rung / chos kyi gzhug ma 'khyongs/ chos dang 'gal/ rang yang 'gyod/ gzhan kun gyis kyang smad ra dir re 'chi ba zhig yong — 238 —

nyen yod na/ de ltar song ba'i thabs mi 'dug pas chos gzha' ma cig la da lta rang zhugs te ma shi bar du 'byongs pa cig gzhan smon la rang bde ba cig mi byed re snyam du zhe mna' yang yang bskyal/ deng sang gi chos pa kun la gnyen po 'di ka gnad du che/ des mi rtag pa'i khrid tshar ba lags/ dmigs skor brgyad pa'o// //gsum pa ngan song gi sdug bsngal bsam pa la/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa/ yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa/ dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro dang rjes sngar ltar las/ bdag mi yul du yun ring bsdad dbang mi 'dug /'chi ba 'dis 'jigs so bsam/ nan tan na 'chi ba kho na la da ches 'jigs rgyu yang med de/ shi bas mi chog dbang med du skye ba len dgos pas 'di kho na skrag /dge ba ni ma byas sdig pa ni mang na ngan song gsum du skye ste 'ong ci rang grag snyam du bsam/ 'di ngan song gi sdug bsngal bsam pa'i dmigs pa thams cad kyi sgo yin/ de nas tsha dmyal gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la/ sdom ni/ yang sos thig nag bsdus 'joms dang / /ngu 'bod ngu 'bod chen po dang / /tsha ba rab tsha mnar med pa'o/ /de la tsha dmyal thams cad kyi gnas sa gzhi ri med klung med lcags sregs yin pa/ me lce khru gang tsam rtag tu 'bar ba/ ri rong ngam grog sal sul kho nas khyab pa/ zangs zhun nam khro chu'am zha nye bzhu ba dang / lan tshwa rnon po sogs 'gyur byed kyi chu tshan shin tu tsha ba dang / de 'dra'i rigs kyi 'bab chu dang mtsho yod pa/ shing rnams kyang lcags bsreg sogs las grub pa/ gdug pa'i bya dang gcan gzan — 239 —

dang las kyi srin po dang gshin rje du mas gang ba zhig yod do/ /der skye ba'i bar do (ba ka rnams char rlung gis bdas pa sogs grang ba'i rnam pa cher byung nas las kyi dbang gis tsha dmyal gyi gnas mthong bas/ de dro bar shes nas sred pas rgyugs pas gnas der tshud nas skye ba len par bshad/ de yang me phal ba bas tsan dan gyi me bdun 'gyur gyis tsha/ de bas kyang yang sos kyi me bdun 'gyur gyis tsha/ de bzhin du gong ma gong ma las 'og ma 'og ma bdun 'gyur gyis tsha bar grags/ dmyal ba'i 'gro ba thams cad rig pa tshor ngas skyen cing sgrin pa/ lus 'jam zhing mnyen la gzhon sha chags pa/ lus sems gnyis ka'i cha nas bzod sran chung ba zhig yod/ des kyang lhag par sdug bsngal che/ gnas de dag tu bzhin lag dbang po thams cad tshang pa skad cig la khrong (krong ka gis skye ste/ gnyid sad pa 'dra ba zhig yod par gda'/ dmyal ba thams cad rdzus skyes yin/ rdzus skyes phal cher gyi lugs la de bzhin du 'byung /sdug bsngal mi 'dra ba so so'i khyad par ni/ yang sos ni phan tshun dgra mi sha bo mthong pa bzhin zhe sdang skye la/ lag tu blangs tshad mtshon cha rnon por song nas gcig la gcig gis bsnun pas dum bu mang por song ba na/ re zhig shi ba bzhin du brgyal zhing 'gyel 'gro/ nam mkha' las rlung grang mo dang yang sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra byung ba na sos par 'gyur zhing / yang sngon bzhin 'thab pa sogs yang shi yang sos la zad pa med pa'i tshul du yod/ thig nag ni gshin rje rnams kyi dmyal ba'i sems can de'i lus la thig nag po mang po btab ste sog les gcod pa dang / ste'u pa gzhog pa dang mtshon cha rnon pos 'gra — 240 —

ba sogs yod de/ de yang stod btubs tsa na smad 'grig /smad btubs tsa na stod 'grig /tshul de kas grub zin med pa la dus 'da' ba'o/ /bsdus 'joms ni lug thug sogs srog chags chen po mi bzad pa 'thab pa'i bar du gcer ba dang / yang na brag ri lug gi gdong ngam ra'i gdong ngam ma he dang seṅge la sogs pa 'jigs su rung ba'i rnam pa can gyi bar du gcer ba dang / ri chen pos steng nas bcir zhing 'joms pa dang / lcags kyi gtan pa dpag tshad mang po can gyi steng du/ dmyal ba'i sems can mang po phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/ri bo tsam gyi ga a nam tho bas 'joms shing 'thag par byed do/ /ri kha gyes pa'am gtun shing sogs bteg na yang sngar bzhin sos par 'gyur la/ yang bsnun cing bcir ba na lus phye mar 'thag pa yin no/ /ngu 'bod ni/ srog chags 'jigs su rung ba du mas bdas pa na/ rgyang ring po nas khang ba dkar po zhig mthong nas de bde'o snyam nas der rgyugs te nang du phyin pa na/ lcags kyi khang pa sgo med du gyur nas phyi nang kun tu me 'bar zhing bsregs pas thar ba'i go skabs med cing drag tu ngu bar byed pa'o/ /ngu 'bod chen po yang de dang 'dra ba las lcags kyi khang pa nyis rim du yod pa'o/ /lcags kyi bum pa'i nang du 'tshed pa dang / zangs chen por 'tshed pa sogs kyang de dag na yod do/ /tsha ba ni lcags kyi gsal shing ngam mdung thung rnon po me 'bar bas spyi bo nas bshang lam mam/ bshang lam nas spyi bor thal byung du phug pas nang khrol thams cad ni tshig /bu ga dgu nas me dang dud pa bshud mar 'byung pa'o/ /rab tu tsha ba yang de dang 'dra ba las mdung rtse gsum pa la sogs pas bsnun pa'o/ /gong ma gong — 241 —

ma'i sdug bsngal thams cad 'og ma 'og ma la yod cing / 'og ma 'og ma'i sdug bsngal du bshad pa rnams lhag lnga'o/ /mnar med kyi gnas na ni sdug bsngal tshad bzung du med de bde ba'i go skabs cung zad tsam yang med do/ /gnas de na lcags sregs kyi 'dab ma la lus thams cad 'gril ba dang / lcags kyi zhib ma chen por bye tshan dang lhan cig 'khrab pa dang / lce la rmos dor lnga brgyas rmod pa sogs kyang yod par bshad la/ mar me'i sdong bu la me 'bar ba ltar lus kyi phyi nang thams cad la me 'bar bas me lce dang srog chags dbye ba mi phyed de/ smre sngags 'don pa tsam las sems can yod par rjes su dpog go de ltar sdug bsngal dos drag tshul de bzhin yin la/ yun tshad ring ba ni mngon pa las/ mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu la/ /'dod pa dag gi lha rnams las/ /'og ma dag gi nyin zhag gcig /des na tshe lo lnga brgya'o/ /gong ma gnyis gnyis 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/ /'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/ /zhes gsungs te/ mi lo lnga bcu la rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs kyi zhag gcig des brtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgya thub/ de yongs rdzogs yang sos pa'i zhag gcig tu byas/ de'i lo lnga brgya ni yang sos pa'i tshe tshad yin la/ 'og ma rnams lo grangs yang nyis 'gyur du 'phel zhing / zhag grangs kyang nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur gyi ring bas gong ma gong ma'i bzhi 'gyur 'og ma 'og ma la yod par shes par bya'o/ /dmigs pa'i mjug sdoms ni/ de ltar sdug bsngal dos ni drag yun ni ring / da lta me phra mo gcig la sor mo'i rtse mo tsam yang yud tsam re yang 'jog tu mi btub na nam zhig de lta bu rang gi thog tu babs na/ bzod — 242 —

pa'i go skabs cung zad kyang mi 'dug ste lan cig der skyes zin nas zlog pa'i thabs med/ da lta zlog pa'i thabs yod de der skye ba'i rgyu las ngan sdig pa dag sbyangs na zlog pa'i thabs de kho na yin/ der mi skye ba'i phyir chos la 'bad dgos snyam du bsam mo/ /dmigs skor dgu pa'o// //yang blo'i rim pa dang bstun nas so sor phral te dmigs skor 'ga' re byas kyang mi rung ba med pa lags/ da ni grang dmyal gyi sdug bsngal bsam par bya ste/ sdom ni/ chu bur chu bur brdol pa can/ /a chu kye hud so tham pa/ /ut+pal pad+ma pad cher gas/ /zhes so/ /grang dmyal thams cad mthun par sa gzhi ri klung thams cad gangs dang chu 'khyags kyi rang bzhin skyabs skyibs sal sul nyung ba/ rlung dang bu yug 'dres pa ches shin tu grang bas rtag tu khyab pa/rlung grang mo rnams sha lpags phug nas rus pa'i gting du yang 'gro ba yod/brgyad po yang gong ma gong ma las 'og ma 'og ma bdun 'gyur gyis grang bar bshad/ der skye ba'i sems can de yang bar do'i skabs su thog mar me nang du tshig pa lta bu'i nyams byung nas grang ba 'dod pa'i skabs su grang dmyal gyi gnas mthong / de phyogs su brgyugs pas der tshud nas skye ba len par bshad/de la chu bur can ni ches grang bas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad chu bur gyis gang ba'o/ /chu bur brdol ba can ni de bas kyang grang bas chu bur brdol te/ chu ser gyi lus g.yogs pa rnams kyang 'khyag par 'gro ba yin par bshad la/ slob spring las ni chu ser las skyes pa'i srog chags kyis lus 'bugs shing za bar yang zugad do/ /a chu zer ba ni skad shib shib por 'bru ngag can chung zad thon — 243 —

tsam gyi smre sngags 'don pa dang / kye hud zer ba ni de bas kyang grang bas 'bru ngag mi thon te nye na skad phra mo tsam 'byin pa'o/ /so tham tham pa ni de bas kyang shin tu grang bas skad mi thon par lus 'dar bas skos thag cing so 'dar sdeb pa'o/ /ut+pal ltar gas pa ni lus dum bu bzhi 'am brgyad la sogs par gas pa yin la/ pad+ma ltar gas pa ni lus dum bu brgya la sogs par gas pa dang /pad+ma ltar cher gas pa ni grang ba'i mthar thug pas lus kyi cha shas re re yang dum bu brgya tshal stong tshal du gas pa'o/ /tshe tshad ni chu bur can la khal brgyad cu 'gro ba'i snod chen po sbyangs zhes zer ba cig til gyis phyur bur bkang / lo brgya re nas til 'bru re phyir bskyur na de nam zad pa tsam chu bur can gyi tshe thub par bshad/ 'og ma rnams la nyi shu nyi shu 'gyur gyi 'gres rtsi ba yin/ 'di la yang dmigs pa'i gzhi dang 'jug sdoms tsha dmyal gyi skabs dang 'dra/dmigs skor bcu pa'o// //da ni nye 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsams te/ 'di ni mngon pa las/brgyad po kun las lhag bcu drug /de dag gi ni ngos bzhi na/ /me ma mur dang ro myags dang / /sbu gri'i lam sogs chu bo yin/ /zhes 'gyung / de yang dmyal ba'i dngos gzhi tsha dmyal brgyad po re re la yang so so'i phyogs bzhi po rnams su nye 'khor ba bzhi po 'di rnams cha tshang ba re re yod pa yin/ de yang me ma mur gyi 'obs ni 'obs me mdag gis gang ba kha zheng shin tu che ba yod de/ der dang po nas skyes pa'am tsha dmyal dngos gzhi nas 'khyams pa yin kyang rung / dmyal ba'i sems can rnams ni sdug bsngal che drags pas gcig tu blo chags nas — 244 —

sdod pa'i gnas med/ skabs der yang gar bab bab tu bros pas me mdag gi 'obs der tshud/ las che chung gi mthu las pus nub tsam mam sked pa nub tsam sogs ma nges par 'byung / 'bros par 'dod na yang mgo 'khor bas ldog gin yod pa dang / dmyal srungs 'jigs pa rnams kyis 'gram nas bsrungs te 'bros su mi ster ro/ /ro myags kyi 'dam ni yang bros pa na ro myags zhes bya ba mi gtsang ba btsog dgu'i 'dam la thebs te/ dri mi bzad pa tshor bas mgo 'gas pa tsam dran med du brgyal ba tsam 'byung / 'dam gyi dbus nas srin bu lcags mchu can dang zangs mchu can mang po byung ste/ shing srin gyis shing la za ba bzhin du lus 'bugs shing za bar byed do/ /skru gri'i gtams pa'i lam la sogs pa ni rgyang ring po nas ne gsing yid du 'ong ba ltar mthong nas/ der rgyugs pa na sa gzhi thams cad sbu gri sor bzhi bas gtams pa yin te/ rkang pa gcod pa la sogs pas sdug bsngal ba'o/ /sogs khongs nas bsdus pa ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal zhes pa ni/ tsha bas gdungs pa na rgyang ring po nas nags tshal sngon po mthong ste dga' bas rgyugs nas der phyin pa na/ lo 'dab thams cad ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon char yod pa de rlung gis bskyod pas char ltar babs te lus dum bu mang por byed pa'o/ khal ma li'i sdong po ni srog chags gdug pa can mang pos bdas pas shal ma li'i sdong po chen po mthong nas de la 'dzeg pa na/ lcags kyi tsher ma sor bcu drug pa kha 'thur du ltas pa mang po yod pa/ lus thal byung du phug rim pas rtse mor phyin pa na/ bya gdug pa can gyi tshogs kyis mig 'byin pa dang sha 'thog pa la sogs pa 'jigs pa du ma byung — 245 —

ste/ yang thur du babs pa na/ tsher ma kha gyen du ltas te lus 'bugs pa la sogs pa'o/ /gsum po de mtshon cha'i gnod pa yin pas gcig tu bsdoms so/ /bzhi pa thal tshan gyi chu bo rab med ni shin tu tsha bas gdungs ba de rgyang ring po na chu klung 'bab pa mthong ste der phyin nas tsham tshom med par mchongs pa na/ de ni me chu 'dres ma shin tu tsha ba gting zab la rgya che ba zhig yod de/ de'i lus chu nang du nub pa na shin tu tshos pas sha rus bral te/ sha rnams bud srog ni rus pa la gnas te keng rus su zang gi song ba de chu'i steng du thon yong / de ma thag sha sngar bzhin skyes nas yang nub pa sogs so/ /de dag la tshe tshad nges pa med kyang so sor lo brgya stong du mar gnas dgos pas dos ni drag yun ni ring ngo / /dmigs pa'i gzhi dang 'jug sdoms sngar bzhin no/ /dmigs skor bcu gcig pa'o// //da ni dmyal ba nyi tshe ba'i sdug bsngal bsam par bya ste/ de la gnas ni sa 'og dang sa steng gi ri dang thang dang chu la sogs pa nges med la gnas/ tshe yang nges pa med de 'ga' zhig dngos gzhi rnams las kyang tshe ring ba tsam yang yod kha cig tshe thung ba'ang yod/ sdug bsngal myong tshul yang ma nges pa sna tshogs pa ste/ mdo las/ nyin mo lha'i bde ba myong mtshan mo dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba sogs dang / dmyal ba gdan 'dra ba dang / rtsig pa 'dra ba dang / ga tsho/ bu 'dra ba dang / khru ba 'dra ba dang / ljon shing 'dra ba dang / phyag shing 'dra ba la sogs pa lus kyi rnam pa yang ma nges pa sna tshogs pa yod do/ /dmigs pa'i gzhi dang 'jug sdoms sngar dang 'dra/ dmigs skor bcu gnyis pa'o// //— 246 —

skabs 'di dag tu rna ba bye ba ri pa dang / 'phags pa dge 'dun mtsho'i rtogs brjod la sogs pas kyang nges shes bskyed par bya'o/ /gnyis pa yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ sngon 'gro dang dmigs pa'i gzhi sngar ltar byas/ yang 'di ltar bsam ste bdag dmyal bar ma skyes/ yi dwags su skyes pa'i tshe bde ba yod dam snyam na/ de na yang bde ba med de yi dwags la gnas na gnas pa dang kha 'thor ba rigs gnyis yod/ dang po ni sa 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya 'das pa na/ yi dwags kyi grong khyer ser skya bya ba na/ yi dwags thams cad kyi gtso bo gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal khab yod/ de'i nye skor na yi dwags bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig gnas/ kha 'thor ba ni bar snang la rgyu ba dang / sa steng na rgyu ba dang / sa 'og na rgyu ba bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig yod de/ gal te mngon shes dang ldan pas bltas na/ phyogs gang la phyin kyang yi dwags kyi 'gro bas khyab/ 'gro sdod kyi sa tsam yang mi rnyed pa'i tshul tsam du yod par gda'/ de dag las yi dwags rdzu 'phrul che ba re re tsam cung zad skyid/ gzhan thams cad ches sdug bsngal ba yin/ mdo sde chen po dran pa nyer bzhag las/yi dwags la rigs sum cu so drug gsungs/ 'dir bsdu na phyi'i sgrib pa can nang gi sgrib pa can/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can gsum du 'dus/ phyi'i sgrib pa can ni lo mang por zas skom ye mi rnyed/ rgyang ring po nas zas kyi phung po mthong yang drung du phyin na shul tsam yang med par song ba ltar mthong ba dang / chu klung chen po'i 'gram du phyin na gseg ma dang bye ma'i grog por 'gro ba dang / ljon shing 'bras bu rgyas pa'i drung du gshugs na'ang shing skam por 'gyur ba sogs — 247 —

yod/ 'ga' zhig la srin po mang pos bsrungs te mi gtong ba yang yod/ nang gi sgrib pa can ni kha khab mig tsam du gyur nas dang por bza' btung khar mi chud/cung zad chud na yang zas rnams 'gram phugs yangs po der stor/ skom rnams kha'i dug chen pos skam/ gal te bza' btung mid kyang mgrin pa gzhu rgyud ltar phra ba nas mi 'gro/ song yang lto ba ri'i gtos tsam yod pas lto khengs pa'i dus med pa yin/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can ni bza' btung zos tshad khong nang du me 'bar bar song nas tshig pa dang / dang po nyid nas kyang me mdag dang bshang gci dang rnag khrag la sogs pa ngan pa dang sdug bsngal skyed pa kho na za dgos kyi/ bzang po ye mi rnyed pa yin/ yi dwags de thams cad spyir na dus rtag tu bkyes pa dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa yin/ gos dang bral te tshad pas tshig pa dang grang bas sbrebs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ dgun grang dus nyi ma'i 'od kyis kyang grang reg byed/ sos ka tshad dus su zla ba'i 'od kyis kyang tshig ste 'ong / char bab na me char babs te tshig pa'i snang ba 'byung /dus rtag tu 'tshol 'gros kyi brel bas ngal zhing thang chad pa'i sdug bsngal dang zas skom ye ma byung bas lus skams pa lta bur gyur/ rus tshigs sum brgya drug cu 'khrogs pas rdo ngar ma 'thabs pa ltar me lce nyug nyug pa 'byung / phan tshun dgrar gyur pas bzung ba dang 'ching ba dang / brdeg pa dang / chad pas gcod pa'i 'jigs pa yang yod/ zhar ba rang 'brogs zer ba'i tshul gyis bsdad pa med par yang 'jigs skrag chen pos 'bros/ de 'dra ba'i sdu/ga bsngal dos drag pa dang / yi dwags phal mo che'i tshe tshad mi lo stong phrag bco lnga thub pas yun ring — 248 —
