dmigs pa'i 'jug sdoms dang rjes kyi bya ba sngar dang 'dra/ dmigs skor bcu gsum pa'o// //der ma 'dus pa min kyang da lta'i yi dwags kha 'thor ba mkha' la rgyu ba'i 'dre bkren 'di rnams la dgos su bsgom pa'i dmigs skor gcig mdzad pa'i srol yod/ de lta na gzhan la gnod pa byas pas slar yang ngan song du 'gro ba dang / shugs la ma bsam kyang dug chen pos gzhan la gnod pa 'byung ba dang / mthu bo ches rdung rdeg byed pa dang / ma nyes ma lan pa la 'dres byas so zhes khag ngan byung ba'i tshe/ sems la sdug bsngal skye ba sogs yod gsung /'di dmigs skor logs par ma byas kyang rung snga ma de'i nang du bltab pas chog go /gsum pa dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ dud 'gro la byings dang kha 'thor ba gnyis/ byings na gnas pa rgya mtsho chen po na yod/ skyob pa'i gnas med/ rlabs kyis bdas te 'gro bas nges med du 'khyams/ phan tshun gcig la gcig za rtag tu dgra byung gi dogs pas 'jigs shing skrag /gson bzhin du za ba sogs kyis sdug bsngal la bzod thabs med/ kha 'thor ba mi dang lha'i yul na yod pa 'di rnams yin/ mis bdag tu ma bzung ba rnams ni dgra byung gi dogs pas rtag tu sems la bde ba med/ mis bdag tu bzung ba rnams kyang spru 'dzings pa dang / sna 'bigs pa dang / brdeg pa dang / khur lci bas ngal ba sogs dang / sha dang khrag dang lpags pa dang rus pa'i phyir gsod pa sogs gsod gcod bkol spyad kyi sdug bsngal mang po dang / gzhan yang bkres skom — 249 —

tsha grang ngal dub la sogs pa dmyal ba'am yi dwags rnams dang sdug bsngal 'dra rung du yod/ gtso bor sdug bsngal gyi gtso bo shin tu rmongs pa dang gcig la gcig za ba yin te/ mi sha chags pa'i dgra la zon byed pa ltar rtag tu gnas dgos pa yin/ dmigs pa'i gzhi dang 'jug sdoms sngar dang 'dra/ sngon 'gro dang rjes kyang sngar dang 'dra/ dmigs skor bcu bzhi pa'o// //de rnams kyi gnad bsdus pa'i thun chos la/ de ltar ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsams tsa na bzod pa'i thabs mi 'dug /de las skyob pa'i skyabs zhig dgos par 'dug /skyabs sus thub na tshangs pa'am brgya byin nam 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal pos kyang skyob mi thub na/ gzhan 'di ba kun gyis ga la thub/ 'o na sus thub na dkon mchog gsum gyis thub/ bdag lha jo bo dkon mchog rin po che gsum la skyabs su 'gro sangs rgyas la ston par zhu/chos la ni nyams len zhu/ dge 'dun la ni de sgrub pa'i grogs zhu ba yin snyam du bsam/ yang skyabs pa sangs rgyas la bskyabs kyang / skyob pa chos kyis skyob bya ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi chus khyer ba skra nas 'dzin pa ltar bskyab tu mi btub/ chos bshad chos bzhin byed du bcug nas skyob pa yin/ sangs rgyas la dad pa bsgoms te des gsungs pa'i chos nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin bya//'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis ji 'dra mdzad 'dug pa de bzhin du rang re yang de'i lad mo bzlos te byed snyam pa rgyun du bsgom/ thun gyi 'go zhabs la skyabs 'gro dang 'brel ba'i ngag 'don gyi dge sbyor de kun yang 'grub par byed pa gnad che/ skyes bu chung ja'i lugs kyi skyabs 'gro rnam dag de mtshams — 250 —

'di nas skye ba lags so/ /zhes gdams te dmigs skor bco lnga pa'o// //skabs 'dir skyabs 'gro'i go ba rags rim zhig slob ma la nges par 'chad pa gal che/ slob mas kyang blo la bcags pa gal che'o/ /lam rim gyi yig rnying 'ga' zhig tu skyes bu chung ngu'i rim pa de yan gyis tshar bar mdzad/las 'bras seb tshags su gtong ba'i lugs kyang 'dug ste/ lam rim gyi yi ge phal cher gyi lugs ltar las 'bras la yang khrid logs pa skyong ba nyid legs so/ /bzhi ba las 'bras kyi 'khrid ni/ las 'bras spyir bsam pa dang / bye brag tu bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ las dkar po dge ba las 'bras bu bde ba kho na 'byung / las nag po sdig pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal kho na 'byung ste/dkar nag las 'bras so sor nges pas kyang spang blang byed dgos/ las dge sdig gang yin yang rung rgyu las kyi dus na chung ngu las med kyang 'bras bu rnam smin gyi dus na 'phel che ste/ 'gyur chung shos rang la yang brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur du 'phel/ 'gyur che ba la tshad bzung du med pas spang blang gal che/ rang gis byas pa'i las dkar nag rnams ni gnyen pos ma bcom na/ 'bras bu ma smin gyi bar du chud 'dza' ba mi srid/ rang gis ma byas na las dkar nag gang yang rang rgyud la 'byung ba mi srid pas/ rang nyid blang dor gyi gnas la bzab pa gal che snyam du sgoms/ dmigs skor bcu drug pa'o// //gnyis pa so sor bsgom pa la/ nag po'i rgyu 'bras bsam pa dang /dkar po'i rgyu 'bras bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro dang rjes sngar ltar — 251 —

las/ yan lag bdun pa'i mjug tu skyabs 'gro re yang nges par bya/ 'di prengan song gsum dang / mtho ris gyi sdug bsngal thams cad kyang rgyu med rkyen med pa las byung ba ma yin/ rgyu mi dge ba'i las las byung ngo snyam du dmigs pa'i gzhi bcas nas/ mi dge ba de yang rnam grangs mang mod kyi blang dor gyi gnas la gal che ba rags pa che long tsam du bsdus na/ mi dge ba bcu ste/ de la lus kyi las rnam pa gsum gyi srog gcod pa ni/ srog gcod 'dod kyis bsam bzhin du gsad bya ma nor bar bsad pa/ gsad bya de ma shi bar du gsod sems rgyun ma ldog pa'o/ /ma byin par len pa ni/ gzhan gyi nor rang la ma byin pa 'phrog pa'am brkus pa sogs ji ltar yin yang rung ste/ rang gis thob po snya ma pa'i blo skyes pa'o/ /'dod pas log par g.yem pa ni/ yul bsgrod par bya ba ma yin pa la mi tshangs par spyod pa 'khrig pa'i chos bsten pa ste/gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung ba'i bud med dang / bdun rgyud tshun chad kyi gnyen nye dur gyur pa dang / pha ma nye du rgyal po yul dpon sogs gzhan gyis bsrungs pa dang / myongs spyod kyi sdom pa blangs pa sdom pas bsrungs pa ste/ de dag la sogs pa yul gyi sgo nas bsgrod bya ma yin pa dang / nad bu can dang mya ngan can dang sbrum pa la sogs dus kyi sgo nas bsgrod bya ma yin pa dang / lha khang dang kun dga' ra ba dang mchod rten gyi gnas dang bla ma'i gnas sogs su bsten pa gnas kyi sgo nas bsgrod bya ma yin pa dang / nam yang 'dod pas chog mi shes shing / skye gnas las gzhan pa'i sgor bsten pa lam gyi sgo nas bsgrod bya ma yin pa ste/ dbye na bzhi'o/ /

de tsam ni khyim pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ tshangs par spyod pa'i brtul zhugs khas blangs pas ni/ mi tshangs par spyod pa ci 'dra zhig bsten kyang logs g.yem kho na yin no/ /ngag gi las bzhi las rdzun du smra ba ni 'du shes bsgyur nas shes bzhin du mi bden par smras la/ smra ba'i yul mi'i 'gro bar gyur pa des go ba na'o/ /phra ma ni mi mthun pa med pa'i 'gro ba gnyis 'khon par bya pa'i phyir du dkrugs kyi tshig smras shing pha rol gyi go ba na'o/ /tshig rtsub po ni dngos su thos par de'i skyon brjod pa sogs zhe la 'phog pa'i tshig smras shing des go ba'o/ /ngag 'khyal ni/ de gsum ma yin pa gzhan nyon mongs can gyi tshig thams cad de kha gsag dang gzhogs slongs dang / glu dang zlos gar dang dmag gi gtam dang smad 'tshong ma'i gtam dang tshong gi gtam la sogs dang / lta ba log pa'i chos kyi gtam la sogs pa'o/ /yid kyi las gsum las brnab sems ni/gzhan gyi nor dang bud med dang khyim dang 'khor g.yog dang yul la sogs pa rang gir byed 'dod pa'i bsam pa gting tshugs par byed pa'o/ /gnod sems ni/ g.yin la gnod pa byed 'dod dang sdug bsngal 'byung bar gyur cig pa'i bsam pa gting tshugs pa'o/ /log lta ni las 'bras mi bden pa dang / tshe snga phyi dang dkon mchog gsum sogs med par 'dzin pa dam po 'chang pa yin te/ de ltar bcu po de ni las lam rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas la/ bsam bzhin ma yin pa la nor bar bsad pa sogs bcu po'i phyogs mthun thams cad kyang nges par spong dgos pa'i las ni yin no/ /des na bdag gis thog ma nyid du — 253 —

nges par spong pa'i las ni/ 'di dag yin no snyam du yang yang bsgom ste dmigs skor bcu bdun no// //da ni mi dge ba de dag gi 'bras bu bsam par bya ste/ mi dge ba bcu po 'di rnams re re yang stobs chen po byas pa dang / yang yang byas na dmyal bar skye/ 'bring du byas na yi dwags su skye/ stobs chung ba dang nyung ngur spyad pas dud 'gror skye/ sdug bsngal can gyi 'gro ba de dag tu skye ba ni rnam smin gyi 'bras bu'o/ /srog bcad pas tshe thung ba dang / ma byin par blangs pas longs spyod chung ba dang / log g.yem gyis dgra mang ba dang / rdzun gyis rang la skur pa mang pa dang / phra mas grogs dang 'khon pa dang / tshig rtsub kyis gtam mi snyan pa thos pa dang / ngag 'khyal smras pas rang gi tshig la gzhan gyis mi nyan pa dang /brnab sems kyis re ba mi 'grub pa dang / gnod sems kyis sems la sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag 'byung ba dang / log ltas shin tu glen zhing gti mug par 'gyur ba ste/ de rnams ni myong ba rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu yin la/ byed pa rgyu mthun ni/ sngar las de dang de byas pas phyis kyang de dang de la dga' ba'o/ /bdag po'i 'bras bu ni/ phyi rol snod kyi 'jig rten la 'byung ste/ srog gcod kyis ni 'bru dang sman la sogs pa mthu chung ba dang / ma byin len gyis lo nyes pa dang / log g.yem gyis sa phyogs rdul tshub che zhing dring ba dang / rdzun gyis ni sa phyogs mtho dman can bgrod mi bde bar 'gyur ba dang / phra mas sa phyogs tsha sgo can du 'gyur ba dang / tshig rtsub kyis bye ma dang gseg ma sogs 'phel ba dang / ngag 'byal gyis dus log tu 'gyur te/ dgun ni rus/ dpyid — 254 —

ni rengs/ dbyar ni than/ ston ni zhod pa la sogs pa'o/ /brnab sems kyis 'khru phra bar gyur pa dang / gnod sems kyis ro mi zhim par 'gyur ba dang /log ltas ni 'bru tso ba nas mi chags par byed de/ de ltar na rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu 'di dag dang / bdag po'i 'bras bu 'di rnams las de dang de byas pa'i skye ba de nyid la 'byung ba'ang yod/ skye ba phyi ma'i gnas skabs mtho ris su skyes pa'i skabs/ dus nges med sna tshogs par yang 'byung ba'o/ /de ltar na mi dge ba bcu po 'di ni sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa sna tshogs pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i phyir/ 'di rnams phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bya/ sngar byas pa thams cad kyang sbyong ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos snyam du yang yang bsgom/ dmigs skor bco brgyad pa'o// //da ni dge ba'i las bsam par bya ste/ mtho ris kyi lus rten thob pa dang / gzhan yang 'khor ba'i bde ba gang ci yod pa thams cad dge ba'i las las 'byung / 'jig rten las 'das pa byang chub rnam pa gsum yang dge ba las 'byung ba yin na/ bdag gis sdig pa thams cad spangs dge ba thams cad la ci nus su slob dgos pa las bslab rgyu'i dge bar yang rigs mang mod kyi/ dge ba thams cad kyi thog ma'i 'jug sgo ni/ chos dkar po dge ba bcu zhes bya ba yin/ de ni sngar bstan pa'i mi dge ba bcu po de rnams yid kyis spangs nas/lus ngag gis slar log pa'i spong ba'i sems pa spyod lam dang bcas pa de yin na/ bdag 'di la rtag tu gnas par bya'o snyam du bsgom/ de la mi dge bcu yid kyis spangs pa'i go don ni/ de rnams nyes dmigs can dang skyon chen por — 255 —

shes nas nam du yang mi 'dod pa de yin la/ lus ngag gis slar log pa ni/bcu bo de dag dus rgyun du'am dal bar 'dug pa'i dus su mi byed par ma zad/de dag byas na khe yod pa ltar snang zhing 'bad rtsol mi dgos par byed thub pa skabs byung yang / sngar yid kyis spangs pa de dran pas bya ba ngan pa de la ye nas 'jug par mi nus pa ste/ lus ngag gi bdun po la ni 'di gnyis kar tshang ba dgos la/ yid kyi las gsum la yid kyis spangs pa kho nas chog go /mi dge ba la mi rung bar sems pa de ka spong sems yin la/ de ni mi rung ba yin pa la mi rung bar shes pa'i kun rdzob shes pa ma 'khrul ba yin pas lam gnyen po'i chos su 'gyur zhing / 'di tshul khrims kyi ngo bo yin/ spong sems shugs che ba lan 'ga' re byung na/ gnyid rmugs dang rnam g.yeng la sogs pas bar chod kyang / de lta bu'i rkyen dmigs pa'i tshe/ nyes spyod de skyon du shes nas mi byed cing sdom par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni sngar gyi sems pa de'i shugs las byung ba yin pa shugs de yang sa bon gyi mthu las yin te/ de'i phyir mi dge ba bcu spong pa'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa ni dge ba bcu'o/ /dmigs skor bcu dgu pa'o// //da ni dge ba bcu'i phan yon bsam par bya ste/ de yang las dge ba bcu cher spyad pa las rnam smin gyi 'bras bu lha'i skye ba len/ chung ngur spyad pa las rnam smin gyi 'bras bu mi lus 'thob/ dge ba yin yang bsam pa ma dag pa sogs sra bsre can gyis ni lha min du skye bar mdo las bshad/ rgyu mthun pa dang bdag po'i 'bras bu yang sngar mi dge bcu'i skabs su bshad pa de nyid phyin ci — 256 —

log tu 'byung ste/ tshe ring 'byor ba dgra spangs dang / /bstod dang grogs mang snyan pa'i gtam/ /tshig btsun bsam pa 'grub pa dang / /yid bde ba dang blo gros 'phel/ /'di dag dge ba'i rgyu mthun bcu/ /mthu che lo legs nyams dga' ba/ /mtho dman snyoms dang zhing sa gshin/ /rtsi shing rgyas dang dus tshigs ran/ /'bru spom ro zhim 'bras bu rgyas/ /dge ba bcu yi bdag 'bras yin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar dge ba bcu la gnas pa ni/ tshe 'di dang phyi mar rtag tu bde ba'i rgyu yin pas bdag dge ba bcu la rtag tu gnas par bgyi'o snyam du yang yang bsgom/ dmigs skor nyi shu pa'o// //'di dag gi skabs su las 'bras kyi dbye ba zhib mor shes pa gal che bas yang dang yang du bla mas bshad cing / slob mas blo la skyong ba dang / kha phyir ltas su ma song bar rang thog tu 'gel ba kho na gnad du che'o/ /da ni las 'bras bsams pa'i chos skor rnams kyi snying po'i grub don thon chos 'di yin te/ sngar ji skad bstan pa'i dkar nag gi las 'bras bsam/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las sngar byas zin la stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa 'bul ba gal che/rten gyi stobs skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs sdig sbyong gi dge ba gang 'grub/ sun 'byin pa'i stobs sngar byas la 'gyod sems/ slar ldog pa'i stobs phyin chad sdom sems te/ de bzhi tshang ba'o/ /des na thun gyi 'go gzhug rnams su yang de lta bu'i bshags pa tshar re bya/ thun mtshams su ni mkhan po slob dpon bla ma rten gsum dge 'dun la sogs pa'i drung du 'thol bshags yang yang 'bul ba dang / de dag ma 'dzom kyang rgyal ba — 257 —

sras bcas mkha' dbyings gang ba la dmigs te bshags pa 'bul/ bshags tshig phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang / gser 'od dam pa'i bshags pa sogs dang / rang gis sdig pa bgyis pa gang yin pa de 'di ltar bgyis so zhes ma sbas ma gsang bar brjod pa nyid gnad che ba yin no/ /mi dge ba bcur ma zad sdig pa mi dge ba'i las su gtogs pa che chung thams cad rang yang mi byed/ gzhan yang byed du mi 'jug sdig pa la yi rang ba'am dga' bar mi bya/ bstod cing bsngags par yang mi bya snyam du bsgom/ dkar po dge ba'i las ni las lam bcu po der ma zad g.yin gyi srog bskyabs pa dang / 'tsho ba ster ba dang / yo byad sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims srung ba dang / dkon mchog mchod pa dang / dad pa la sogs pa'i dge bar gtogs so cog rang gis kyang ci lcogs su sgrub gzhan yang byed du 'jug /rang gzhan gyis dge ba byas pa la yi rang yang bsgom/ bsngags pa yang brjod par bya'o snyam du bsam/ yang dge sdig gnyis ma yin pa'i las lung ma bstan zhes bya ba 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug sogs nges med sna tshogs pa zhig 'dug pa/ de dag la rnam par smin nga/'i 'bras bu med kyang don med du dus 'da' par 'dug /le lo dang rnam g.yeng gi rgyu las de dag gi dbang du 'gro yin 'dug pa la/ phyin chad le lo rnam g.yeng gi dbang du mi btang / las lung ma bstan 'byung ba'i dod du yang dge ba 'ba' zhig la blo dang bya spyod bsgyur bar bya'o snyam du bsgom/ zhar byung thun mtshams su 'di ltar yang bsam dgos te/ skye ba nas skye bar tshogs khyad par can gsog pa'i rgyur mtho ris kyi lus yon tan brgyad ldan bsgrub dgos pas/ 'tshe ba'i bsam pa — 258 —

spangs pas tshe ring ba dang / mar me dang gos kyi sbyin pa sogs byas pas gzugs bzang ba dang / bla ma dang grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la nga rgyal med cing gus par byas pas rigs phun sum tshogs pa dang / phan thogs kyi zhing dang / sdug bsngal gyi zhing dang / yon tan gyi zhing la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang slong ba po la 'dod dgu sbyin pas dbang phyug ste/ longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang / ngag gi dge ba kho na byas pas tshig btsun pa dang / bla ma dang dkon mchog dang pha ma sogs mchod cing / yon tan sna tshogs sgrub par smon lam btab pas dbang thang che ba dang / skye ba'i dngos po la dga' zhing / pho dbang gcod pa las bskyabs pas skyes pa nyid du 'gyur ba dang / skye bo gzhan gyi bya ba chos ldan la re ba med pa'i sgo nas phan pa'i grogs byas pas/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa thob ste de dag kyang ci rigs par sgrub pa yin no/ /dmigs skor nyer gcig pa'o// //de yan chad kyis skyes bu chung dzña rim pa tshar ro// //gnyis pa skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong gi bsam pa sbyang ba la/ 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras bsam pa dang / thar ba'i rgyu 'bras bsam pa'o/ /dang po la 'bras bu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa dang / rgyu kun 'byung gi rab dbye bsam pa'o/ /dang po la mtho ris kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa dang / 'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyag mchod bshags pa gsum cung zad rgyas pa re byas nas/ yan lag bdun pa dang skyabs 'gro rnams sngon du btang /bdag las kyi dbang gis 'gro ba rigs drug tu skye ba len par 'gyur ba las ngan song gsum du skyes na sdug bsngal ni de 'dra/ mir skyes na skyid do snyam na — 259 —

yang mi skyid de mi phal cher mngal skyes yin/ mngal du zla ba dgu 'am bcu'i bar du gnas dgos na/ mngal gnas de la dog pa'i sdug bsngal dang / mun nag pa'i sdug bsngal dang / dri mi zhim pa'i sdug bsngal gsum rtag tu yod/ ma de bkres pas tshe g.yang za ba'i rnam pa dang / 'greng ba'i tshe ris non pa lta bu dang / bza' btung dron mo zos 'thung byas na chu tshan du btsos pa lta bu dang /grang mo zos 'thung byas na 'khyags rus du bskyur pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal yod/mngal nas phyi ru btsa' ba'i tshe yang til mar 'tshir ba'i shing gi bar du gcer ba lta bu dang / tshigs thams cad bye zhing zhig pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal yod/btsas ma thag tu gang la reg kyang rtsub ste dar 'jam pos dkris kyang tsher ma'i dong du bskyur pa lta bu dang / gzhan gyi lag tu blangs pa na/ byi'u khras khyer ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal yod pa/ da lta rang res ma dran par zad/ dran na gzhan mi dgos skye ba'i sdug bsngal gcig pu la bsam kyang mir skyes pa la grog ci yang mi 'dug /bdag las kyi dbang gis 'khor bar skye ba mi len pa'i chos shig bya dgos/ mi'i 'gro ba mngal skyes kyi sdug bsngal ni de lta bur 'dug /spyir khams gsum gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal/ 'gro ba gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal/ skye gnas ji lta bur skyes kyang sdug bsngal te sdug bsngal rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /de yang skye ba sdug bsngal dang ldan pa zhes bya ba tshor ba drag po dang bcas te skye dgos/ skye ba gnas ngan len dang ldan pa bya ba nyon mongs pa bskyed 'phel gyi sa bon dang ldan par skye dgos/ skye ba sdug bsngal gyi gnas su — 260 —

gyur pa bya ba/ skyes pa las rga nad 'chi ba sogs sdug bsngal gzhan 'byung ba yin/ skye ba nyon mongs kyi gnas su gyur pa bya ba skye ba blangs pas phyis rkyen dang phrad nas/ nyon mongs pa mang po skyes shing des kun nas slangs pa'i las du ma gsog pa'o/ /skye ba nyid dbang med du 'jig pas sdug bsngal ba bya ba ni/ skye ba nyid skad cig skad cig gis 'jig pa'o/ /de ltar na skye ba sdug bsngal ba'o snyam du bsgom/ dmigs skor nyer gnyis pa'o// //gzhan yang mi rnams la rgas pa'i sdug bsngal yod de/ rgas pa'i tshe nyams pa'i sdug bsngal lnga yod/ kha dog nyams pa bya ba sha mdog dang mdangs legs po rnams nub ste kha dog mi sdug pa nag sbam pa'am sngo thal gyis 'gro/mgo spra ba'i me tog ltar skya ba dang dbang po kun gyi bkrag shor ba yin/dbyibs nyams pa bya ba so ni lhung / lus ni gug gug por song / yan lag rnams ni 'khyogs/ sha ni skams/ lpags pa ni lhod/ gdong byad ni gras gdan rnying pa ltar gnyer mas khengs pa la gang la ltas kyang mi mdzes pa'o mthu stobs nyams pa bya ba ni/ ldang ba na sug bzhi 'dzugs/ 'gro ba na 'byor/'dug pa na tsha do thag pa chad pa bzhin sdod/ smra ba na ldab ldib las med pa la sogs pa'o/ /dbang po nyams pa bya ba ni/ mig mi gsal rna ba 'on pa sogs gzhan gyis bltas na rdzus 'debs pa 'dra bar 'gyur/ longs spyod nyams pa bya ba ni/ kha zas nyung na bkres mang na mi 'ju ba la sogs pa 'dod yon la spyad du med pa'o/ /bdag kyang rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ma spangs pas/ tshe ring rgas long byung na tha ma rgas par 'gyur/ gnyen bshes dang dgra gnyen 'gro ba — 261 —

'di kun kyang de dang 'dra snyam du bsgom/ dmigs skor nyer gsum pa'o// //na ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ sdug bsngal gzhan yang yod de sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las nad rnams pa sna tshogs pa 'byung ba yin/ de yang sdug bsngal lnga ste/ sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde 'phel ba zhes bya ba ni zug rngu dngos kyi sdug bsngal yin/ lus kyi rang bzhin 'gyur ba ni sha zhu lpags pa bskams pa la sogs pa'o/ /yul yid du 'ong ba spyad dbang med pa dang / yid du mi 'ong ba nges par bsten dgos pa gnyis ni zas dang spyod lam 'dod pa byed du med cing / mi 'dod pa'i sman kha ba dang me gtar sogs bsten dgos pa'o/ /srog gi dbang po dang 'bral ba zhes bya ba ni/ 'chi ba'am 'chir dogs pas sdug bsngal ba ste/ na ba rang bas kyang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal na bsu ba yin/bdag kyang na ba las ma thar na bar 'gyur te 'ong / bdag gi bshes la sogs pa dgra gnyen 'gro ba 'di kun kyang de dang 'dra'o snyam mo/ /dmigs skor nyer bzhi pa'o// //yang sdug bsngal gzhan yod de/ 'chi pa'i sdug bsngal rnam pa lnga ni longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang 'bral/ rtsa 'jing phun sum tshogs pa dang 'bral/ 'khor grogs phun sum tshogs pa dang 'bral/ phangs shing sdug pa'i lus dang yang 'bral/ 'chi ba nyid sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde drag po dang bcas pa'o/ /rang re mngon par chen cing chags pa'i yul phyogs sam/ khang khyim mam/ nor rdzas sam/ yar gyi dpon/ mar gyi g.yog /thad ka'i grogs po thams cad dang bral zhing / gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal chen po dang bcas te — 262 —

'chi dgos/ rgyas par gong 'chi ba mi rtag pa bshad pa'i skabs su bstan pa ltar bsgom/ dmigs skor nyer lnga pa'o// //sdug bsngal g.yin yang yod de/ 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pas sdug bsngal/ de yang longs spyod dam/ kha drag gam/ mnga' thang 'phran bu bsgrub pa'i phyir du srog la ma bltas par 'khrug pa la yang 'jug lo zla mang por bgrod dgos pa'i byes su yang 'gro/ dus bzhir zin pa dang 'khor ba med pa'i las la rtag tu 'jug /rkang khrag ni rdo/ lag khrag ni shing / byin pa ni rta/ snal ma ni lcag tu byas lho bsla na byang bkug kyang 'dod don gang yang ma byung /ltogs skom thams cad ni dang du blangs/ tsha grang thams cad ni khyad du bsad/nyin mtshan kun tu ni dal ba med/ sha khrag dbu bar song song las byas kyang lto rgyab tsam yang ma 'byor/ 'bad pa byas pa don med du song bas sems la yi chad skye/ gzhan yang mi sdug pa dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal bya ba yod/ rang nyid dgra bo'i dbang du song pa'am/ nad dang sdug bsngal drag po thog tu bab pa'am/gsod par byed pa'i srog chags dang 'phrad pa'am/ g.yengs su lhung ba'am/chus khyer ba'am/ gtam ngan pa thos pa'am/ brtsa ni du gzhug pa dang chad pas bcad pa myong ba la sogs pa yin/ gzhan yang sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal bya ba yod/ pha ma sbun zla khyim thab grogs la sogs pa med thabs med pa dang bral tsa na/ sems la bzod thabs med pa'i sdug bsngal lus tshun chad kyang rgud nas 'gro ba yod/ de bzhin du nor stor rlag byung ba'am/ mnga' thang nyams pa'am/ dbang thang shor ba'am/ rang gi yid chags shing blo smon pa'i spre — 263 —

gnas ci 'dra zhig nyams kyang sems la mya ngan chen po skye ba yin te/ de ltar na sgyu bdag kyang sdug bsngal de dag las ma 'das zhes sogs gong bzhin bsgom/de ltar sdug bsngal bdun po de ni 'gro ba gzhan rnams la yang yod mod kyi/ mi rnams gtso bor spyod pa'i phyir 'dir smos pa'o/ /sdug bsngal brgyad pa skabs 'dir bsam pa'i lugs yod kyang 'og tu bshad na bde'o/ /dmigs skor nyer drug pa'o// //yang lha min gyi 'gro ba zhes bya bar skyes na skyid dam snyam na mi skyid de/rang bzhin gyis lha'i dpal la phrag dog pas sems la mi bde ba chen po rtag tu yod/ dus dus na lha dang 'thab pa las lha min bsod nams kyi stobs chung bas gsod pa dang brdeg pa dang yan lag gcod pa dang 'dral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal shin tu mang / phal cher nag phyogs yin pas chos la mi dga'/'ga' zhig mos su chug kyang rnam smin gyi sgrib pa can yin pas khyad par rtogs pa'i skal ba med do/ /'o na 'dod pa'i khams kyi lhar skyes na bde'o snyam na/der yang mi bde ste 'dod yon la bag med par spyad pas tshe zad du ma tshor ba la zad/ gzhan yang lha dbang chung ba rnams dbang che bas gnas nas bskrad pas sdug bsngal/ bsod nams chung ba 'ga' zhig pi waX re tsam ma gtogs yo byad gang yang med pas shin tu 'phongs pa'ang yod/ de dag gis lha gzhan 'byor pa chen po rnams mthong ba na/ rang gi bsod nams la yi chad pa'i sems kyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod/ khyad par rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs dang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas na lha ma yin dang 'thab pa'i sdug bsngal shin tu che/ 'dod — 264 —

khams kyi lha thams cad la thun mong du 'chi 'pho ba dang ltung ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya ba yod de/ de la lha rnams 'chi ba'i sngon rol zhag bdun nas 'chi ltas lnga 'byung ste/ lus kyi kha dog mi sdug par 'gyur ba dang / yid skyo zhing stan la mi dga' ba dang me tog gi 'phreng ba'i rgyan rnams rnyings ba dang / gos la dri ma nag po chags pa dang lus las rngul 'byung ba rnams so/ /de rnams byung ba na rang rang gi g.yog dang grogs pho mo rnams kyis kyang spangs te lha gzhan gyi drung du 'gro la/ lha'i 'dod yon la ni chags kyang dbang med du 'bral bar shes zlog thabs ni med/ rnga mo rnge'u stor ba lta bu dang / klu nam mkha' lding gis khyer ba lta bu dang / nya bye tshan la bsgres pa lta bu dang / rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su gru zhig pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal 'byung / dus ring thung ni lha'i zhag bdun yin na thung shos rgyal chen bzhi rigs kyi dbang du byas kyang mi lo phyed dang bzhi brgya yin/dos ni drag yun ni ring ltung ba'i sdug bsngal bya ba lha rnams shi ba'i 'og tu lhar skye ba ni srid mtha' tsam/ mir skye ba yang shin tu nyung / phal cher ngan song du skye ba yin/ ji skad du/ lha yi 'jig rten dag nas 'phos pa la/ /gal te dge ba'i lhag ma 'ga' med na/ /de nas dbang med dud 'gro yi dwags dang / /dmyal bar gnas pa gang yang rung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ lha rnams kyi mngon shes 'og tu 'jug pas 'chi khar gang du skye ba len pa shes nas mir skye na'ang 'dod yon gyi mig mi khengs shing sdug bsngal mang po can du mthong / gal te ngan song gsum du skyes na/ de'i sdug bsngal myong dgos par shes nas sems kyi sdug bsngal la bzod glags med pa 'byung ba yin te/ ngan song gsum gyi — 265 —

lus kyi sdug bsngal bas de'i sems kyi sdug bsngal che ba yod snyam du bsam/dmigs skor nyer bdun pa'o// //'o na khams gong ma'i lhar skyes na/ bde ba yod dam snyam na der yang bde ba med de/ khams gong ma de dag na/ so so skye bos bltas na sdug bsngal mngon 'gyur ba med kyang 'phags pas gzigs na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal kho na'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis myos pa ltar gyur pas so so skye bo rnams yon to gong du 'gro ba med cing / ting nge 'dzin gyi ro myang bas ro myang can gyi ting nge 'dzin de 'bral mi phod cing des rang rang gi ting nge 'dzin nyams nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba'ang yod/ sgos su de na gnas pa'i 'gro ba so so skye bo thams cad sngon gyi las kyis 'phen pa zad pa na/ slar yang 'dod pa'i khams su skye ba len te/ sngon mi'i rten la 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i skabs dang / skabs der bsam gtan gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin la nyams bde bde 'dra ba/ sos dal dal 'dra bar 'dug kyang yid brtan ci yang ma byung bar skye bo phal par ma nyams te/ nyon mongs drag la sdug bsngal che bar song ba de 'dra ba la snying po ci zhig yod snyam du bsam/ dmigs skor nyer brgyad pa'o// //gnyis pa 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal du bsam pa ni/ sngon 'gro sogs sngar bzhin las dmyal ba'i gnas na ni sdug bsngal de 'dra snyam pa nas/yi dwags dang dud 'gro dang mi dang lha ma yin dang 'dod khams kyi lha dang /gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i lha'i bar du sdug bsngal de 'dra na/ khams — 266 —

gsum 'khor ba 'di kun sdug bsngal gsum mam drug gam brgyad la sogs pa sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can dang / sdug bsngal gyi khong 'tshangs can dang sdug bsngal gyis kun tu bskor ba yin/ sdug bsngal me ltar 'bar/ chu ltar 'khrugarlung ltar g.yengs/ ri ltar non pa yin/ gnas gang du gnas kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas/ lus ci 'dra blangs kyang sdug bsngal gyi lus/ grogs su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi grogs/ longs spyod ci la longs spyad kyang sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod yin/ sdug bsngal de yang rnam pa gsum ste/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zhes bya ba/ tsha grang nad la sogs pa tshor ba sdug bsngal thams cad yin/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya ba/ tshe dang longs spyod la sogs pa tha na bsam gtan gyi bde ba tshun chad de tshor ba bde ba thams cad yin/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes bya ba sdug bsngal de gnyis ka'i gzhi 'du byed nye bar len pa'i phung po tsam 'di sdug bsngal thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dang zhing sa yin/ 'di tshor ba bto snyoms kho na dang ldan pa'i tshe 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal kho na'i ming thogs pa yin/ 'di las ma thar na gzhan gnyis las thar ba med pas cis kyang sdug bsngal gsum las thar bar bya snyam du bsgom/ dmigs sgor nyer dgu pa'o// //da ni gong du bshad pa ltar skye ba sdug bsngal/ rgas pa sdug bsngal/ na ba sdug bsngal/ 'chi ba sdug bsngal mi sdug pa dang phrad pas sdug bsngal/ sdug pa dang bral bas sdug bsngal/ 'dod pa btsal gyis ma rnyed pas sdug bsngal zhes sdug bsngal bdun dang / brgyad pa ni mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga — 267 —

sdug bsngal te/ de yang rnam pa lngas sdug bsngal ba ste ma phro par 'grub pa'i sdug bsngal gyi snod du gyur pa ni/ skye ba phyi ma phan chad kyi sdug bsngal gsos 'debs pa yin/ mngon par grub pa la brten pa'i sdug bsngal gyi snod ni phung po nyid grub pa la brten nas/ skye rga na 'chi sogs gzhan thams cad 'byung du rung ba yin/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyi snod dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyi snod ces bya ba gnyis ni/ phung po la brten nas de dag 'byung ba yin/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa ni/ phung po rang nyid 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin par shes pa ste/ khams gsum 'khom ra ba thams cad sdug bsngal brgyad kyi ngo bo'o snyam du sgom pa'o/ /sdug bsngal brgyad la bsam pa ste/dmigs skor sum cu pa'o// //'khor ba 'di la sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs gzhan yang yod de/ dang po nges pa med pas sdug bsngal ba'i nyes pa ni/ dgra gnyen dang pha bu dang /gnas lus longs spyod thams cad ma nges pa kho nar 'gro ba ste/ ji skad du/ pha ni bu nyid ma ni chung ma nyid/ /ces pa la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ngoms mi shes pa'i nyes pa ni/ 'dod yon ci tsam spyad kyang ngoms pa med/ sdug bsngal ci tsam myong yang sun rgyu med pa'o/ /re res rgya mtsho bzhi pas lhag pa yi/ /zhes sogs sbyar/ gsum pa lus yang yang 'dor ba'i nyes pa ni/ yang yang 'chi ba myong dgos pa ste/ re res bdag nyid rus pa'i phung po ni sogs so/ /bzhi pa yang yang nying mtshams sbyor ba'i nyes pa ni/ skye ba mtha' med pa len dgos pa ste/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam sogs so/ /lnga pa yang yang mtho dam— 268 —

na du 'gyur ba'i nyes pa ni/ brgya byin du gyur kyang sa steng du ltung / 'khor los bsgyur rgyal du gyur kyang bran gyi tha mar skye/ tshe gcig po de nyid la yang bde sdug mtho dman 'byor rgud gang la yang yid brtan cung zad kyang med pa ste/ brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas kyang / /zhes pa la sogs pa ltar ro/ /drug pa gcig pu grogs med pas sdug bsngal ba'i nyes pa ni/ skye na yang gcig pur skye/ 'chi na yang gcig pur 'chi/ rgas pa dang na ba yang gcig gcig pur myong /bar dor 'gro ba yang gcig pur 'gro dgos na/ grogs bshes mdza' ba thams cad snying po med de/ de ltar nongs par 'gyur 'tshal bsod nams ni/ /rnam gsum mar me'i snang ba rab bzhes shig /gcig pu zla ba nyi mas mi brdzi pa'i/ /mun nag mtha' yas nang du 'jug 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang sbyar ro/ /de ltar na 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsdul drug gi rang bzhin gyis sdug bsngal te/ ya gi srid pa'i rtse mor skyes kyang mnar med pa'i 'gram rdor 'gro ba la tshegs med/ sdug bsngal yang la yang bsrangs kho na yin/ khang ba me 'bar ba'i nang du tshud pa dang 'dra/ tshong ba srin mo'i gling du tshud pa dang 'dra/ 'brog dgon lam med par 'khyams pa dang 'dra bas cis kyang myur du 'di las thar bar bya snyam du yang yang bsam/ sdug bsngal drug la dmigs pa ste/ dmigs skor so gcig pa'o// //gnyis pa rgyu kun 'byung bsam pa ni/ 'o na de tsam du sdug bsngal che ba'i 'khor ba de thams cad kyang rgyu med rkyen med pa ma yin pas/ rgyu spangs te 'khor ba de zlog dgos par 'dug na/ rgyu gang yin snyam na sdug bsngal de — 269 —

rnams las bsags pa las byung / las de thams cad dang por nyon mongs kyis kun nas len dgos shing / nyon mongs med na ni phyis nas kyang las la 'bras bu mi 'byung bas rtsa ba nyon mongs pa la thug /bdag dang sems can 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu'i rtsa ba nyon mongs de yang 'dod chags dang / khong khro dang / nga rgyal dang / ma rig pa dang / lta ba ngan pa dang the tshom ste drug tu yang yod/ kun tu sbyor ba dgu sogs rnam grangs du mar yod kyang kun gyi rtsa ba 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug ste dug gsum du 'dus/ las kyi rnam grangs shin tu mang yang 'khor bar 'phen byed kyi las rnams gsum du 'dus/ bsod nams ma yin pa'i las zhes bya ba sdig pa ste ngan 'gror 'phen nus/ bsod nams kyi las ni sems mnyam par ma bzhag pa 'dod khams kyi dge ba ste thar pa'i lam du ma song ba'i sbyin pa dang / 'dod pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa ste 'dod khams kyi lha dang mi'i rgyu yin/ mi g.yo ba'i las ni/ bsam gtan bzhi'am gzugs med bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin gyi las dge ba nyag gcig ste/ gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams su 'phen nus pa'o/ /de thams cad gnas lugs ma rtogs pa'i ma rig pas bsgribs/ 'khor ba'i phung po la chen nas bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / bdag gces par 'dzin pas kun nas blangs pas 'khor ba'i rgyur song ba yin/ de la nyon mongs pa ma rig pa'am gti mug ni rang re'i blo la rang gis brtags dus 'khor ba'i rang bzhin dang 'khor ba gang las byung ba yang mi shes/ thar ba'i rang bzhin dang de 'thob byed kyi thabs ji ltar yin pa'ang mi shes/ de dag des ji ltar 'grub kyang mi shes/ thos bsam gyi go ba — 270 —

tsam zhig yod pa srid na'ang rang blo'i 'char tshul la brtags na/ de dag gang la bltas kyang cha rgyus med pa'i la phar rgyab kyi yul la sems gtad pa bzhin/gang yang mi shes pa'i mun thom me ba'i rnam rtog gcig 'dug pa 'di ka yin/'dis gnas tshul ma shes pas bden pa'i don la the tshom skye/ nga zhes bya ba med pa la ngar bzung / lta ba ngan pa thams cad byung ste/ lta ba ngan pa thams cad gti mug gi rjes 'brang yin yang de yod pa dang / dang por rang gi lus sems la chags/ de la brten nas bud med nye du 'khor g.yog sogs nang sems can la chags pa dang / zas gos longs spyod khang zhing nor rdzas yul phyogs sogs phyi nyer spyod la chags pa rnams 'byung ste/ da lta rang re'i lus longs spyod la dga' lhang nge sems gnas pa 'di la nyon mongs pa 'dod chags yin/'di la brten nas nga rgyal dang ser sna dang phrag dog thams cad 'byung / yang rang ngam rang phyogs la gnod na de la zhe sdang 'byung ste/ rang ngam rang gis yongs su bzung ba la gnod pa byas sam byed par dogs pa yod pa'i/ sems can de rang gi blo yul du ma bde kar re 'byung ba de kho na khong khro'am zhe sdang yin/ der ma zad sems med la yang khong khro 'di skye ste/ dgra bo'i yul mkhar blo yul du mi bde ba dang / rang gi zhing la gnod pa'i chu rgyun tshun chad la yang tshig pa za ba sogs 'byung bas mtshon no/ /khong khro 'di stobs cher rgyas pa las gnod sems rags pa dang / khro ba dang / 'tshig pa dang / 'khon du 'dzin pa la sogs pa zhe sdang gi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa 'byung ngo / /dug gsum po 'di rnams bdag dang sems can gang ci yang rung ba thams cad 'khor bar — 271 —

'khyams byed kyi rgyu'i gtso bo yin pas/ da res 'di cis kyang sbong thub pa zhig bya'o snyam sterang gi rgyud thog tu bkal gyin rang rgyud la skyes pa'i nyon mongs dang /des kun nas slangs pa'i las ngo shes par byas kyin bsgom dgos so/ /dmigs skor so gnyis pa'o// //'di dag gi skabs sna su las dang nyon mongs kyi rnam gzhag ji ltar rigs pa shes na bogs che bar yong ngo / /gnyis pa thar ba'i rgyu 'bras bsam pa ni/yang bdag 'khor ba spangs nas thar ba 'thob dgos par ni 'dug na/ thar ba de'i rang bzhin ji lta bu zhes dpyod de/ thar ba zhes bya ba yul phyogs gzhan zhig tu bros te 'gro sa yod pa ma yin/ rang gi rig pa'i steng gi nyon mongs rnams sa bon rtsa ba nas spangs/ phyin chad gtan tu mi skye zhing dbyings su dag /de dag pas las rnams kyang ched du spang ma dgos par 'bras bu 'byung ba'i nus pa med de/ don la dbyings su yal ba yin/ sde snod kyi chos skad ltar na 'ga' zhig sa bon spangs/ 'ga' zhig 'bras bu 'byin mi nus par byas pa yin/ las dang nyon mongs spangs pas 'khor ba gsar ba ni mi skyed/ rnying pa'i 'phros rnams myur du dengs par 'gyur/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad zad pa'i mtha' rig pa dri ma med par gnas pa la thar ba zhes bya ste/spangs pa slar mi ldog pa zhes bya ba lan gcig thar ba thob nas slar go 'phang nyams pa mi srid pa yin/ thar pa de thob ba'i rgyu zag med kyi shes rab kyis bdag med la sogs pa'i gnas lugs rtogs shing sgrib pa spangs pas thob pa yin/ de'i rgyur sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin dgos/ sems rtse gcig — 272 —

thob pa la tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dgos/ tshul khrims de yang nges 'byung gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang / bdag med kyi lta bas zin na thar ba'i rgyu grung po yin/ da ni 'khor ba las thar ba'i phyir tshul khrims bsrung bar bya/ ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya/ sgom byung gi shes rab bskyed nas/ mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med kyi don rtogs par bya'o snyam du yang yang bsam/ dmigs skor so gsum pa'o// //skabs 'dir 'bras bu zhi ba myang 'das thun mong ba'i rnam gzhag dang /bslab pa gsum po so rbe'i rnam gzhag rags pa tsam bshad na legs so/ /zhi gnas kyi khrid dang gang zag gi bdag med sgom pa'ang skabs 'di'i thob thang yin mod kyang / nyams len gyi mthil skyes bu 'bring gi lam la mi byed cing /skyes bu chen po'i bsam pa la bsgril ba yin pas skabs 'dir thar pa'i lam la slob 'dod kyi dmigs pa sbyong ba'i rim pa tsam la lag len mdzad do/ /de yan chad kyi skyes bu 'bring gi nyams len tshar ba lags// //da ni gsum pa skyes bu chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam pa la bslab pa la/ bsam pa'i 'jug sgo la bslab pa dang / de nyid mtha' rgyas su byed pa'i rnam grangs so/ /dang po ni snga ma dang sbre ( pa te 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams tsa na/'khor ba spangs pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa zhig thob dgos pa 'dug /de 'thob pa'i phyir bdag bslab pa gsum la slob dgos na/ 'thob bya myang 'das de la byang chub gsum du dbye/ nyan thos kyi byang chub/ rang rgyal gyi byang chub/ rdzogs — 273 —

pa'i byang chub gsum yin/ de gsum las nyan rang gi byang chub gnyis po de rang don spangs rtogs ma rdzogs/ gzhan don sems can la phan 'dogs rgya chen po dang bral/ spangs pa ma rdzogs te nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa kho na spangs kyi shes bya'i sgrib pa ma spangs/ rtogs pa ma rdzogs te gang zag gi bdag med dang /gnas skabs kyi rten 'brel nye tshe tsam rtogs kyi chos kyi bdag med dang rten 'brel mthar thug ma rtogs/ yon tan gyi khyad par yang thor bu thor bu ma gtogs mtha' med du 'phel ba med/ drin can gyi 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal las mi 'dren par/ rang gcig pu grol ba'i thabs sgrub pa de khrel med gdod chung phyi thag med pa gzhan don spangs pa'i thar bar 'dug pa/ 'phags pa de dag 'khor bar mi ldog cing spros med la sems ngang gis gnas pa/ yon tan yang du ma dang ldan pa yin pas/ rang cag so so skye bo la bltos na da blos mi 'byud pa'i rngam chen yin mod kyi/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis sgrib pa gnyis spangs tshul dang / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas tshul dang / yon tan mu mtha' med pa mnga' tshul dang / thugs rje'i shugs dang nus mthu'i rtsal rtogs par dka' ba bzhugs tshul dang / phyogs thams cad la dus thams cad du sems can gyi don spyod pa'i 'phrin las 'jug tshul/ bsam gyis mi khyab rnams dang bsgrun na nyan rang gi rnam grol de ches chung bar 'dug ste/dper na ri rab dang nyungs kar gyi khyad las kyang khyad par che/ des na rang don spangs rtogs thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas/ gzhan don 'phrin las zad pa med pa'i rang bzhin can thar ba'i mchog rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob par bya/— 274 —

ji ltar bya na bdag sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur zhig gu snyam du yang bsam/dmigs skor so bzhi pa'o// //gnyis pa de nyid mtha' rgyas su byed pa'i rnam grangs la/ rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel pa bsam pa dang / rgyu 'bras kyi don bsam pa gnyis so/ /de yang 'di ltar dmigs pa snga ma dang sbrel nas bsgom ste/ bdag sangs rgyas thob dgos pa de sangs rgyas kyi rgyur byang chub kyi sems dgos par 'dug /de'i rgyur snying rje dgos par 'dug /de'i rgyur byams pa dgos par 'dug /de'i rgyur byas pa shes shing drin du bzo ba dgos par 'dug /de'i rgyur sems can thams cad pha ma/ra shes pa dgos par 'dug /'di rnams bdag gis rim can du bsgom dgos sems can thams cad pha ma yin pas drin re che/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung bde zhing skyid na ci ma rung / 'di rnams bde ba la 'god pa'i phyir sangs rgyas 'thob par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thob nas kyang sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag par bya'o snyam du yang yang bsgom/dmigs skor so lnga pa'o// //'dir bshes gnyen shar ba pa'i slob ma dge bshes gtum ston pa blo gros grags nas brgyud pa'i man ngag la/ rgyu 'bras rim pa ltar mdzad pa 'di khar 'dug /yang bya yul pa'i slob ma gtsang pa rin po che nas brgyud pa dge bzhes mus sman pas bkod pa'i theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi rim pa zer ba'i bstan rim gyi yi ge na/ 'di skad ces snang ste thun mong ma yin pa theg pa chen po a ti sha'i rgyu 'bras bdun la/ blo sna rim gyi sbyong dgos gsung / de yang rgyu — 275 —

'bras rnam pa bdun gyi dbang du byas na/ rgyu med rkyen med ma yin te rgyu byang chub kyi sems las skye/ de lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa las skye/ de snying rje chen po las skye/ de byams pa chen po las skye/ de yid du 'ong ba las skye/ de byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba las skye/ de ma'i 'du shes bsgoms pa las skye skad pa/ de rnams rgyu 'bras bdun yin bya ba yod pas rgyu 'bras bdun gyi tha snyad kyang phyis kyi gsar byung rang min pa go dgos so/ /gnyis pa rgyu 'bras kyi don bsam pa la/ byams pa sgom pa/ snying rje sgom pa/ byang chub kyi sems sgom pa gsum mo/ /dang po ni rtsa ba'i ma bya ba tshe 'di bskyed pa'i ma la zer ba lags te 'di bdag la drin che bar 'dug /dang por zla ba dgu 'am bcu'i bar du khong du bzung / de'i bar du'ang rang gi srog las gces par bskyangs/ mi'i lus dang srog dang tshe spyin pa yin/ btsas pa nas brtsams/ lus kyis phan btags te sor bcu'i rtse la blangs/ sha'i drod la bcar/ nu ma bsnun/ zas lces snyod/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ rang cag bya byed gang yang mi nus pa 'bu 'dra ba zhig nas bskyangs pa yin/ ngag gi sgo nas kyang phan btags te/ ming snyan pa nas bos/ bstod rgyu med kyang bstod ra gtong / yon to med kyang yon to brjod/ 'brid thabs sna tshogs kyis kyang sems dga' bar byas/ yid kyis kyang phan btags te/ bdag gi bu 'di ji ltar byas na tshe ring bar 'gyur/ ci 'dra byas na nad med pa yong / ga 'dra zhig byas na mis phu dud du 'khur ba zhig yong / gtam snyan pa zhig e yong / mgo thon pa zhig e yong kho na bsam/ dang po tsog thub pa dang 'gog shes pa dang /— 276 —

gtam tshig re tsam smra shes pa la yang dga' ba dpag tu med pa byas/ cher skyes nas rang la yod tshad bu la 'bogs pa la nyams (nga gtsam yang med kyi steng du dga' ba bsgom/ stong gsum nor dang g.yog gis bkang ba byin kyang ches snyam pa med/ nga'i ma 'dis de tsam du bdag la phan 'dogs pa yin/ bdag la byams pa drin che ba ang / ma 'di dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bde na ci ma rung skyid na ci ma rung / ngas ma 'di bde skyid bla na med pa la 'god par bya snyam du bsgom/ dmigs skor so drug pa'o// //rtsa ba'i ma la byams pa bsgom pa 'di byams pa'i skor gyi dmigs pa'i rtsa ba yin/ skye yang bla ste 'di la myong ba thon pa gal che gsung ngo / /de nas bdag gi ma 'dis tshe 'di la phan btags tshul de ltar yin la/ 'dis skye ba gcig min gnyis min skye ba shin tu mang por ma kho nar gyur nas tshe 'di'i dngos kyi ma bzhin du phan btags pa rang la'ang grangs med/ de bzhin du phar gyur nas phan btags pa rang yang dpag tu med/ de bzhin du nye du gnyen 'dun grogs mdza' bshes la sogs par gyur nas kyang phan btags pa rang yang mtha' med/ gos bskon pa dang rgyan btags pa rang yang phyogs gcig tu sbungs na/ ri bo mchog rab kyi dpangs las kyang thal/ nu zho 'thungs pa gcig pu bsags kyang rgya mtsho chen po bzhis kyang mi tshad/ ma 'di rang cag gi pha ma bu tsha nye dur gyur nas rang re sngon la shi ba la gdung ba'i sems kyis ngus pas mchi ma phyogs gcig tu bsags na chu klung bye ba phrag brgyas mi bsgrun/ bdag gi don du sdig pa la ma bltas/ sdug bsngal la ma bltas/ gtam ngan la ma — 277 —

bltas par bdag gi don kho na bsgrubs pa yin/ 'di tsam du phan 'dogs pa ang snyam pa la sogs pa gong bzhin bsgom/ dmigs skor so bdun pa'o// //de nas de'i steng du pha dang sbun zla nye du 'dres pa lnga drug bsnan te/ 'di dag gis kyang tshe 'dir ni la las phan cher btags/ la las 'bring du btags/ la las chung ngur btags pa yin mod/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsams na rtsa ba'i ma bzhin du phan btags pa la mang nyung med/ drin la che chung med pas 'di tsam du phan 'dogs pa 'di bde na ci ma rung skyid na ci ma rung /ngas bde skyid mthar thug la 'god dgos snyam pa sogs gong bzhin bsgom/ de bzhin du rim gyis sbyar nas bsgom dgos te/ de la yang bshes gnyen bya yul ba dang / snar thang ba'i lugs kyis yul phyogs sogs re re nas bsnan kyin bsgom pa'i lugs yod de/ las dang po pa'i dmigs pa bsgom tshul la lugs 'di kho na gnad che bar mthong / de'i rjes nas rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i yul phyogs de'i mi'i 'gro ba dgra gnyen bar ma gsum/ dud 'gro sa 'og sa steng bar snang la spyod pa gsum/ yi dwags 'dre bkren yang mchog dman bar gsum ci tsam cig yod/ de thams cad skye ba dpag tu med pa'i pha dang ma yin pa dang /phan btags tshul dang drin du bzo ba dang byams pa bsgom pa gong bzhin sbyar/de bzhin du rgyal khams rgya rje che rje cher bsnan te/ mthar rang re bod pa'i dbang du byas na bod ril bo tsam gyi 'gro ba rigs gsum la bsgom/ de nas de bzhin du bod gyi shar na rgya nag lho na rgya gar nub na kha che byang na hor dang stag gzig ste/ rgyal khams chen po de rnams la gnas pa'i 'gro ba rigs gsum la bsgom/— 278 —

denas 'dzam bu gling ril po'i 'gro ba rigs gsum la bsgom/ de nas 'dzam bu gling gi 'og na yi dwags kyi gnas dang / tsha dmyal brgyad dang grang dmyal brgyad kyi gnas yod de/ de rnams la sngar bzhin bsgom/ de bzhin du shar lus 'phags po dang / nub ba lang spyod dang / byang sgra mi snyan te gling bzhi la steng na gong bzhin 'gro ba rigs gsum gyis gang ba dang / 'og na ngan song gsum gyi 'gro ba sna tshogs dang bcas pa la yang gong bzhin ri rab kyi bang rim bzhi la rgyal chen bzhi rigs kyi lha yod/ rtse mo na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams yod/ri rab kyi khong seng chu mtshams man chad na lha ma yin gyi gtso bo rnams gnas pa'i grong yod de dag na gnas pa la sngar bzhin bsgom/ de nas gser gyi ri bdun dang phyi lcags ri khor yug tshun chad la chu mtshams yan chad la lha dang /gnod spyin dud 'gro'i 'gro ba dag gnas/ chu mtshams man chad lha min dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro sna tshogs rnams gnas/ de dag gi bar bar gyi rol mtsho bdun dang phyi'i rgya mtsho la klu dang lha ma yin dang dud 'gro'i 'gro ba phal pa go mtshams med pa tsam du gnas/ de thams cad la sngar bzhin bsgom/ dud 'gro'i nang na dud 'gro rdzu 'phrul can gsum yod de/ nam mkha' la spyod pa'i bya khyung / sa steng na spyod pa'i mi'am ci/ sa 'og gam chu la spyod pa'i klu rnams so/ /de dag la yang sgos su bsgom/ dmigs skor de yan chad kyis 'og dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi yan chod thad kar phyi lcags ri tshun chod/ steng du sum cu rtsa gsum man chad la bsgoms tshar/ de'i steng du mtha' bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams rim pas bsnan te — 279 —

sngar bzhin bsgom/ de nas gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i tshangs ris/ tshangs pa mdun na 'don/ tshangs chen te bsam gtan dang po'i gnas gsum bsnan/ skabs 'dir 'di skad ces bya ste/ 'di nas bzung ste gzugs khams kyi gnas 'di kun na lha'i 'gro ba gzugs khams pa rang kho na ma gtogs/ 'gro ba gzhan lnga po gang yang med de/ lha 'dod khams pa yang med/ gnas so so rang rang gi lha kho na gnas pa yin/ spyir na tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na gnas pa'i/ 'gro ba rigs drug po thams cad la gong bzhin bsgom/ da ni de ka 'dra ba 'phred la stong phrag gcig gshibs pa'i mtha' lcags ri gcig gis bskor ba/ steng na 'od chung / tshad med 'od/ 'od gsal te bsam gto gnyis pa'i gnas gsum yod pa'i nang nas/ 'od gsal ba'i gnas chen po gcig gis steng nas khebs pa ni stong spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams te/ de na gnas pa'i rigs drug la sngar bzhin bsgom/ da de de 'dra ba stong phrag gcig thad kar bsgrigs pa'i mtha' skor du/ slar yang khor yug gcig gis bskor te/ steng du ni dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas te bsam gtan gsum pa'i gnas gsum yod la/ de kun gyi steng nas dge rgyas kyi gnas gcig gis khebs pa yin te/ stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig gi 'gro ba rigs drug la sngar bzhin bsgom/ yang de 'dra ba thad kar stong phrag gcig pa bsgrigs pa'i tha ma/ slar yang khor yug chen po gcig gis bskor/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re la 'og gzhi gser gyi sa gzhi re re yod/ de re re'i 'og na — 280 —

chu'i dkyil 'khor re re yod/ chu'i dkyil 'khor bye ba phrag brgya rlung gi dkyil 'khor gcig la brten/ 'og tu ni rlung gi dkyil snyen ra yan chod/ steng du ni sprin med/ bsod nams skyes/ 'bras bu che ba ste bsam gtan bzhi ba'i gnas phal ba gsum/ de bzhin du mi che ba/ mi gdung ba/ gya nom snang shin tu mthong /'og min pa rnams bsnan/ 'og min pa'i gnas gcig po de steng nas stong gsum khebs/ de la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes zer/ gzugs med khams kyi sems can yang dpag tu med pa zhig yod pa de dag kyang bsnan te/ khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams la gong bzhin bsgom mo/ /de nas yang stong gsum 'di'i shar phyogs na phar la stong gsum grangs med gzhal du med/ dper na stong gsum gcig yungs 'khrus mer te bkang nas/ yungs 'bru de las gcig blangs te 'di'i shar phyogs kyi stong gsum gcig la bzhag /de bzhin du stong gsum re re la yungs 'bru re re bzhag na mthar yungs 'bru ni zad 'gro la shar phyogs kyi stong gsum mi zad do/ /yang de ka bzhin byas kyang yungs 'bru 'dzad stong gsum mi zad yang bskyar te byas kyang de dang 'dra/ de 'dra ba bskal pa mtha' med du byas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams la zad pa med/ de dag thams cad 'gro ba rigs drug gis gang ba yin te/ de thams cad la mar shes pa nas byams pa bsgom pa'i bar gong bzhin/ da ni shar phyogs su ma zad phyogs bcu rab 'byams thams cad kyang de dang 'dra ste phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' la mtha' gtan nas med/nam mkhas gar khyab snod kyi 'jig rten gyis khyab/ sems can thams cad drin — 281 —

can gyi pha ma yin/ pha ma byas pa lan grangs dpag tu med/ byas res nas phan sna tshogs ni btags/ gnod pa sna tshogs ni bsal/ ma rgan sems can 'di rnams bde bar gyur cig skyid par gyur cig /bdag gis 'di rnams bde skyid bla na med pa la 'god par bya'o snyam du bsgom/ de rnams la nang tshan dmigs skor shin tu mang par 'gyur mod/ blo rigs dang bstun nas nges med du 'khrid dgos pas tshad kyi dbye ba cung zad dka' ba dang / byams pa'i sems rgya bskyed par rigs gcig pas dmigs chen gcig tu bsdus te/ dmigs skor so brgyad pa'i tha snyad byed do/ /skabs 'dir snod bcud 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag cig shes na gnad che'o/ /des byams pa'i khrid tshar ba lags// //gnyis pa snying rje bsgom pa ni/ sngon 'gro dang rjes sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ sems can 'di rnams bde zhing skyid pa la 'god dgos pa 'dug pa la sems can gyi khams la bltas na/ sems can 'di rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu la mi gnas/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la gnas/ 'dod pa ni bde ba 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang yong ba ni bde ba mi 'byung sdug bsngal kho na 'byung / phal cher ni sdug bsngal dngos la gnas/ dmyal ba na tsha grang /yi dwags na bkres skom/ dud 'gro na gcig la gcig za/ mtho ris na yang tshe thung ba dang / nad mang pa dang / dbang chung pa dang / bkren cing 'phongs pa dang /las la 'khol ba dang chad pas bcad pa sogs dngos su rang yang sdug bsngal 'di mi myong bya ba med pa der 'dug /'gro ba thams cad spyir na sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dpag tu med pa la spyod pa de yin/ sgos su 'ga' zhig da lta rang mi 'dod — 282 —

pa'i sdug bsngal drag po ni med du chug kyang / sdig pa'i las rngam po che bsags pas dbugs kha gang bo 'gags pa dang mnyam du/ dmyal bar khrod khrod skye dgos pa 'di rnams dngos su da lta sdug bsngal myong ba rnams las kyang snying rje bar 'dug /snang ba re 'khrul na a tsa ma ci rang drag snyam du bsam/ dper na rang gi rtsa ba'i ma de mig ni long rkang pa ni chag long khrid ni med/ mkhar ba ni bor/ gad kha g.yang kha cig nas mar lhung la khad khad 'dug na bdag ci tsug byed/ gzhan gang la yang ma bltas par hab rgyugs su phyin nas ma de g.yang kha nas 'dzin dgos/ dpe de bzhin du ma rgan 'gro ba 'di rnams shes rab kyi mig ni long / thabs kyi rkang pa ni chag /dge ba'i bzhes gnyen nam grogs bzang po'i long khrid ni med/ bsod nams kyi mkhar pa dang ni bral/ yid la dran du yang mi rung ba'i sdig pa thams cad ni lag len du yang yang btab/ mtho ris kyi lam nas brdeg 'chos te/ ngan song gsum gyi g.yang la lhung la khad khad pa sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi bzad pa la gnas pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ da ni 'di rnams ngas sdug bsngal las dngos su ma bskyab pa'i thabs med/ des na ngan song gsum na ni tshor ba sdug bsngal dngos la gtso bor spyod/ bde 'gro gsum na ni tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la gtso bor spyod/ de dag gi sdug bsngal skyes bu chung 'bring gi skabs su bshad pa ltar dran par bya/ sdug bsngal de bdag gi thog tu babs na cha shas tsam yang bzod pa'i glags mi 'dug /bdag gis mi bzod pa zhig 'di rnams kyis kyang ga la bzod/ de 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal dngos su yang myong zhing / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu zad mi shes pa la rim gyis — 283 —

rim gyis spyad pas/ sdug bsngal nas sdug bsngal brgyud mar 'byung ba 'di rnams snying re rje/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las dang nyon mongs thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /ma rgan 'gro drug gi sems can 'di rnams sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad las bdag gi bskyab par bya/ sdug bsngal gyi gnas 'khor ba las 'dren par bya snyam du yang yang bsam/ dmigs skor so dgu pa'o// //yang na 'di la sdug bsngal dngos la spyod pa la dmigs skor gcigasdug bsngal gyi rgyu la spyod pa la dmigs skor gcig /gnyis ka bsdoms pa la gcig ste gsum byed pa'i lugs kyang yod/ sngar byams pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin rim gyis thams cad rgya bskyed de bsgoms na yang legs par 'ong ngo / /yang byams snying rje'i khrid lan cig bskyangs pa'i rjes su 'di gnyis 'brel pa can kho na 'byung bas byams pa re la snying rje re mthud kyin bsgoms pas chog /tshan pa so sor ma bcad kyang rung ba lags so// //gsum pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gnyis so/ /'di gnyis la bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang / sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab pa zhes zer ba'ang yod do/ /de'i dang po la byang chub kyi sems dngos la bslab pa/phan yon dran pa la bslab pa/ bslab bya la dam 'cha' ba ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ sngar gyi byams snying rje gnyis dang 'brel bar bsgom ste/ ma 'di rnams bde dgos par 'dug /skyid dgos par 'dug pa la/ mi bde mi skyid sdug bsngal — 284 —

bar 'dug pa snying re rje/ bdag gis 'di rnams kyi sdug bsngal mi sel ba'i thabs med/ 'di rnams bde ba la mi 'god pa'i thabs med de/ 'on kyang de'i nus pa bdag la mi 'dug /der ma zad tshangs pa brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rnams la'ang med/ 'o na su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la yod/ de lta na yang sangs rgyas de bsgrubs na thob yong ba yin pas bdag gis sangs rgyas thob par bya/ thob nas sems can 'khor ba las 'dren par bya/sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas thob dgos pa 'dug snyam pa yang yang bya/ dmigs skor bzhi bcu pa'o// //gong du dmigs skor so bzhi pa bsam pa'i 'jug sgo la bslab pa'i skabs su ni/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan shes shing theg pa che chung gi khyad par shes pa'i sgo nas rdzogs byang don gnyer tsam bsgom pa yin la/ de tsam gyis byang chub sems kyi mtshan nyid rdzogs par mi 'gyur zhing / 'dir gzhan don kho nar rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi bsam pa bsgoms pas smon pa byang chub sems kyi mawo nyid tshang bar 'gyur ro/ /gong du'ang gas don bsam pa tsam yod mod/byams snying rje mthar ma phyin pas gzhan don du gtso bor dmigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /de nas gnyis pa phan yon bsam pa la bslab pa ni/ rang gi don thams cad sgrub pa'i phan yon ni/ mdo las byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad bskyed pa'i phyir sa bon lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan don bsgrub pa'i phan yon ni/ 'gro ba rnams kyi chos dkar po 'phel bas zhing sa lta bu'o/ /zhes so/ /nyes pa thams cad sel ba'i phan yon ni/ nyes par spyod pa — 285 —

thams cad zad pas sa'i 'og lta bu'o/ /zhes so/ /yon to thob pa'i phan yon ni/ yon tan thams cad 'du bas rgya mtsho chen po lta bu'o/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar phan yon bzhi ste/ da lta byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa nyid nas rang rgyud kyi thar pa'i sa bon gsos thebs shing dge bas bag chags thams cad sad/ bsam pa bzang po des dngos su sems can la phan pa byed cing phan 'dogs pa'i nus pa yang rnyed 'ong / 'di bsgom tsam nyid nas sdig pa mang po 'dag cing chags sdang nga rgyal phrag dog sogs nyon mongs kyi dbal 'joms/ rgyud 'jam por song bas yon tan thams cad skye zhing / sangs rgyas bsgrub par dam bcas phyin/yon tan gzhan mang po bsgrub dgos pa cig kyang shugs la 'ong / de nas mthar thug gi bar du rang don rtogs pa dang / g.yin don 'phrin las dang / spang bya spong ba dang / yon to sgrub pa thams cad 'dir byed pa yin/ mdor na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la yon tan ci tsam yod pa byang chub kyi sems la'ang yod pa yin/ sangs rgyas la ci tsam ri ba 'di la'ang ri snyam du byang chub kyi sems la spro sing nge ba bskyed la slar yang byang chub kyi sems sngar bzhin bsgom/de ka yang yang bskyar/ thun mtshams su sems bskyed rang gis len pa'i cho gas kyang yang yang len pa'i dmigs pa sbyong / yang sngar sems bskyed ma thob na rgyun bshags kyi 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces 'byung ba de kha sems bskyed yin pas yan lag bdun pa yang yang bya/ dmigs skor zhe gcig pa'o// //gsum pa bslab bya la dam 'cha' ba ni/ bslab bya dang po sems can — 286 —

blos mi spang pa la bslab dgos te/ sems can blos spong ba la gnyis yod/ khyu ril du blos spong ba dang sgo thad du blos spong ba'o/ /dang po ni chos la lkog pa'i blo log pa ste ngas rang don gzhan don gang yang mi yong 'jig rten phal pa bya snyam pa dang / theg chen la blo log pa ste sems can gyi don sgrub mi nus pas bdag nyan rang gi theg par sems bskyed dgos snyam pa lta bu yin/ sgo thad du blos spangs pa ni/ rang dang 'gal ba kha cig la khyod la phan thogs pa'i dus byung kyang gnas skabs mthar thug gang la ltos kyang / phan mi 'dogs snyam du snying brtse lhan gyis bral ba de yin/ de ltar khyu ril gyi blos spangs sam/ sgo thad kyi blos spangs kyang rung ste/ gnyen pos ma sleb par thun tshod gcig 'das na sems bskyed gtong ba yin par 'dug /bdag gis sems can spong ba'i blo nam du yang ma skyes pa zhig bya/ gal te dbang med du skyes kyang 'phral du gnyen pos sleb nas de ma thag bshags pa bya/ da lta dngos su phan gdags ma nus pa la yang phugs su phan par bya snyam du bsgom/ dmigs skor zhe gnyis pa'o// //bslab bya gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa la 'bad dgos/ bdag rim pas yon tan gong nas gong du song na tshogs gnyis rgya je che je che la bslab dgos/ nyi ma de ring rang nas tshogs gnyis la bslab dgos te bsod nams kyi tshogs ni/ mdo bstan bcos rnams las phan yon che bar bshad pa'i dkon mchog gi mchod pa/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur/ 'byung po'i gtor ma/ phyag mchod bskor ba gzungs sngags bzlas pa dad pa bsgom pa byams snying rje bsgom pa/ bzod pa bsgom pa la sogs pa la bslab dgos snyam pa dang / ye — 287 —

shes kyi tshogs chos nyan pa tshig 'dzin pa don sems pa 'gal 'brel gyi sgo nas rigs pas the tshom gcod pa/ 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog par rgyas 'debs pa zhes bya ba/ 'khor 'das thams cad bden med du thos pa'i sgo nas go zhing shes/ bsam pa'i sgo nas nges pa rnyed/ sgom pa'i sgo nas mngon sum du rtogs pa cig dgos pas don 'di la bslab dgos snyam pa dang / mchod pa la sogs pa bden med kyi lta bas zin pa dang / lta ba de'i ngang nas de ltar bslabs pas bsod nams kyi ye shes/ ye shes kyi bsod nams su song nas tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa cig bya'o snyam du yang yang bsam/ thun mtshams kun tu de dag las ji ltar 'os 'os lag len du thebs par yang bya/ dmigs skor zhe gsum pa'o// //bslab bya gsum pa zung bzhi ya brgyad la bslab dgos na/ nag po'i chos bzhi spyir yang nyes pa che/ sgos su skye ba 'phos na sems bskyed brjed pa'i rgyu yin/ dkar po'i chos bzhi spyir yang phan yon che/ sgos su skye ba thams cad du sems bskyed dran pa'i rgyu yin/ des na nag po'i chos bzhi spang / dkar po'i chos bzhi la bslab dgos/de la zung dang po bla ma dang spyin gnas dang mchod 'os bslu ba nag po'i chos yin/ bslu ba zhes bya ba de dag la rdzun gyi mgo skor gtong ba la zer/ de'i gnyen por shes bzhin gyis rdzun smra ba mtha' dag spangs pa yin/ skye bo tha mal pa la shes bzhin gyi rdzun phra mo yang mi smra na/ mchod 'os bslu ba lta ga la zhig /zung gnyis rnga/ gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa nag po'i chos zer/ 'gyod pa'i gnas sdig pa byas pa la 'gyod pa —— 288 —

bskyed rnga ni gos kyang / gnas ma yin pa dge ba byas pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa'i thabs byas na/ de 'gyod wo ma 'gyod wo nag po'i chos yin/ 'gyod pa bskyed tshul ni/ sbyin pa 'di ches te 'di tsam skyin na ci za/ /zhes pa dang / khyod sdom pa blangs na bu smad 'di kun kha zhan por 'gro zhes pa'am/ dgra la lan po ma byas pa des khyed stangs chag par 'gyur zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de'i gnyen por sems can rnams theg pa gsum gyi dge ba la smin par bya ba dkar po'i chos la bslab ste/ sems can rnams theg pa gsum po gang mos mos la sems bskyed du gzhug /sgos su theg chen la ci nus nus su dgod/ dge ba'i rigs ci 'grub byed du bcug /de yang byang chub tu smon lam 'debs su 'jug dgos te/ dge ba mi byed pa tsho yang slar nas dge ba la dgod gang thub byed dgos na 'gyod pa bskyed pa ga la 'ong / da ni zung gsum pa la slob ste/ sems bskyed pa'i gang zag la tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa brjod pa nag po'i chos zer/tshigs bcad ma yin pa ni dngos sam lkog tu skyon brjod pa yin/ sems bskyed skyes rung ma skyes rung nyams rung ma nyams rung 'dra/ sems bskyed blangs so zer ba tshun chod smad du mi rung / de'i gnyen por sems can thams cad la ston pa'i 'du shes bsgom pa la bslab pa dkar po'i chos yin/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi snying po can yin pa dang tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi yul la sangs rgyas dang 'dra/ ji skad du/ sems can rnams dang rgyal ba la/ /sangs rgyas chos 'grub 'dra ba la/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ des na ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas rtag tu bsngags pa dang bstod ra brjod par bya/ sems can — 289 —

phal pa la yang mi smod cing bsngags pa brjod na/ sems bskyed pa la mi smod pa lta ci smos/ zung bzhi pa sems can la g.yo sgyus kun tu spyod pa nag po'i chos zer/ rang gi don bsgrub pa'i phyir du ga tsā la khram dang gya bskor byed pa/ tha na bre srang oṃ chad la g.yo sgyu byas kyang rung ste nag po'i chos yin/ de'i gnyen por sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba dang lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas pa dkar po'i chos yin/ phan pa dang bde ba ni tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi bde ba la 'god pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa ni gzhan don gyi khur rang gis khyer ba la yang zer/ yang g.yo thabs kyi gya gyu mi byed par bsam pa drang pos tshig gsong por smra ba pha ma bu tsha ltar phyi nang med pa la'ang zer bas de lta bu la bslab dgos/ sems can thams cad la phan bde lhag bsam du gnas dgos na/ phar la g.yo sgyu 'tshong ba'i go skabs ga la yod/ dkar po'i chos 'di rnams la shin tu nan tan snying por bya rgyu yin par 'dug bdag deng nas bzung ste nag po'i chos bzhi nam du yang mi byed/ dkar po'i chos bzhi la ci nus ci lcogs kyis bslab par bya'o snyam du bsam/ dmigs skor zhe bzhi pa'o// //'dir zung bzhi re re la dmigs skor re re mdzad pa'i lugs kyang yod/blo 'khobs chung ba la de ltar byas na nges shes skye zhing legs par 'ong yang 'ong ngo / /yang sems bskyed kyi phan yon dran pa dang / nyin mtshan dus drug tu sems bskyed len pa yang bslab byar bsdus te/ sems can mi spang pa/ tshogs gnyis la bslab pa/ zung bzhi la re re ste bslab bya brgyad zer ba'ang yod pas ji ltar 'os par sbyar bar bya'o/ /snying rje'i khrid song ba'i mtshams su sems — 290 —

bskyed blangs nas/ de rjes smon sems kyi khrid 'di rnams bskyangs na go rim 'grig mdog kha zhing legs par 'gyur la/ yang thog mar dmigs pa 'di rnams byang bar byas te/ bar 'dir sems bskyed blangs na cho gas len pa'i skabs der nges shes skye tshabs che bas skabs 'dir byas na yang legs par 'gyur/ yang khrid yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar byang sdom len pa'i sngon du sems bskyed blangs kyang rung ste ji ltar skabs su bab pa de ltar bya'o// //gnyis pa 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems la bslab pa ni 'di yin te/sangs rgyas 'thob par 'dod pas byang chub spyod pa la bslab dgos/ sangs rgyas 'grub par 'dod kyang spyod pa la mi slob na/ lo legs par 'dod skad so nam mi byed pa dang 'dra/ spyir byang chub tu smon pa tsam la'ang phan yon mang mod kyi/ byang chub spyod pa nyams su ma blangs na yon tan gong 'phel du mi 'gro bas spyod pa la bslab dgos/ spyod pa'i ngo bo yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang bsdu dngos bzhi yin/ phar phyin dang bsdu dngos bya ba yang logs logs su med/phyin drug rang gis nyams su len/ /g.yin la tshig gi sgo nas ston/ /gzhan rnams byed du 'jug pa de kha phar phyin kyang yin bsdud dngos kyang yin/ bdag gis pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la nan tan snying por bsgrub par bya'o/ /de yang phyi dus phyi dus na ma yin par da lta nyid du 'jug par bya'o snyam pa yang yang sbyong ba yin/ 'di skabs dam bca' dang lag len ma 'dzol bar ci nus ci lcogs kyis lag len du thebs pa nyi ma de ring nas byed dgos pa yin no/ /zhes bya ste 'jug sems spyir bsgom pa yin na/ dmigs skor zhe lnga pa'o// //— 291 —

bdag gis byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod dgos na/ dang por sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab dgos/ sbyin pa de la dbye na gsum/ zang zing gi spyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa/ chos kyi spyin pa gsum mo/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad la zang zing gi spyin pa byin la tshims par bya/ da lta de tsam gyi nus pa med de phyis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid tshun chod bzung la spyin dgos snyam pa bsam pa'i sgo nas bslab/ da lta rang yang rang gi nus pa dang sbyar la chos kyi 'gal rkyen du mi 'gro tsam gyi sgo nas/ zas gos la sogs pa ci nus ci lcogs su spyin/ ma tha rang la yang slong mo ba kha stong du mi gtong tsam re mi byed pa'i thabs mi 'dug bsam zhing / 'di dmigs pa tsam ma yin pa lag len du yang khel nges pa dgos te/ sbyor ba la bslab pa yin/ mi 'jigs pa'i spyin pa/ bdag gis sems can thams cad nad kyi 'jigs pa dang /mtshon gyi 'jigs pa dang / chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa dang / dug gi 'jigs pa dang / gcan gzan dang dug sbrul la sogs pa srog chags gdug pa can gyi 'jigs pa dang / g.yang sa'i 'jigs pa dang / lam 'phrang gi 'jigs pa dang / me'i 'jigs pa dang / chu'i 'jigs pa dang / chad pas gcod pa'i 'jigs pa la sogs pa ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa'i bar thams cad las bskyab par bya snyam du bsam pas sbyangs da lta yang dngos su nad dang gdon dang dgra dang 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pa sogs las ci nus ci lcogs kyis skyob pa'i thabs bya'o snyam du bsgom zhing / dmigs par ma zad lag len gyi sgo nas kyang tshul khrims dang sgrub pa'i bar chad du mi 'gyur ba rnams ci 'grub tu bya zhing /— 292 —

tha na kha phan tshig phan tshun chod bya ba sbyor ba'i sgo nas bslab pa yin/ mi 'jigs pa'i spyin pa byas kyang sems can sdug bsngal ba la phan 'dogs pa'i ming yin/ skabs su ma bab pa dang sdig rkyen du 'gro na khye yis gyong mi subs pa 'byung nyen che bas/ bsam pas sbyong dgos kyang sbyor ba btang snyoms su 'jog pa'i skabs yin no/ /chos kyi sbyin pa bdag gis sems can thams cad chos kyi spyin pas tshims par bya/ bdag gis chos bstan te sems can ma smin pa rnams smin par bya/ smin pa rnams grol bar bya/ ma go ba rnams gor gzhugam rtogs pa rnams rtogs su gzhug ma thob pa rnams thob tu gzhug snyam du bsam pa'i sgo nas sbyangs/ da lta yang rang la chos bshad pa'i nus pa yod na rnyed bkur dang khengs grags la mi lta bar gzhan la chos bshad pas phan 'dogs dgos/ de ltar mi nus pa zhig yin na'ang mi dang mi ma yin la chos bshad par mos te/ mdo 'don pa'am gsung rab sgrog pa'i thun ma chags par bya'o snyam du bsam pas sbyang bar bya zhing / de dmigs par ma zad lag len du yang khel bar byed pa ni sbyor ba'i sgo nas bslab pa yin te/ de ltar na sbyin pa gsum la bsam sbyor gnyis gnyis kyi bslab tshul te drug yod/ yongs bsdoms nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab pa yin te/ dmigs skor zhe drug pa'o// //bsam sbyor so so la bslab tshul 'di phyi ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre/da gzhan yang tshul khrims kyi phar phyin la bslab dgos/ tshul khrims la gsum/nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can — 293 —

don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum mo/ /nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni/ spyir mi dge pa bcu sogs rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba thams cad spangs pa zhig dang /sgos su dge bsnyen nam dge slong ngam/ dge tshul lam byang sdom gyi bslab bya'am/ sngags kyi dam tshig sogs rang gis gang blangs pa'i sdom khrims kyi bsrung bya dang ma 'gal ba zhig dgos/ mdor na mdo dang bstan bcos las mi rung bar gsungs pa thams cad las zlog pa ste/ bdag gis 'di la 'phral du bslab par bya snyam du bsgom/dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims ni/ dge ba sna re dang phyogs rer ma song bar phar phyin drug gis bsdus pa thams cad la rtag tu bslab dgos pa'i don yin/ de la'ang da lta rang nas ci nus ci lcogs su bsgrub/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims ni/ sems can rnams bde ba dang dge ba sna tshogs pa la 'god pa'i sgo nas phan bsgrub pa la zer/ de yang bdag gis ci nus ci lcogs kyis da lta rang nas kyang sems can rnams phan pa dang bde ba la 'god gang thub bya snyam du bsgom/ nyes spyod sdom pa la phyi dus 'debs su med thos ma thag nas bcag ste zlog dgos/ phyi ma gnyis la phyi dus cig kyang 'debs su yod de/rang gi blo stobs dang bstun nas da lta gang nus gang lcogs byas/ da lta mi thub pa rnams phyis smon lam gyi yul du bzhug pas chog pa yin/ spyir byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don ma byas na de nyid nyes pa che shos yin te/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dgos/ gzhan don byed pa la rang rgyud smin dgos pas dge ba chos sdud dgos pa yin/ rang nyes ltung gis ma gos pa gcig pus kyang — 294 —

mi chog pa cig yin par 'dug na'ang / thog ma'i gzhi la nyes spyod sdom pa rang gal che ste/ 'di med na gzhan gnyis kyang ji bzhin mi yong ba lags/dmigs skor zhe bdun pa'o// //da ni bzod pa'i phar phyin la gsum/ gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa/ sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa/ chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa ste gsum mo/ /de'i dang po ni/ g.yin gyi bdag la brdeg pa dang / kha zer ba dang / nor 'phrog pa la sogs pa'i gnod pa byas pa'i tshe mi bzod cing zhe sdang skye ba'i rnam 'gyur yong bas/ bdag sangs rgyas bsgrub rgyu yin pa la gnod pa 'di tsam ma bzod pas ga na 'ong / khams gsum sems can dgrar gyur nas gnod pa sgo mi 'dra ba thams cad nas byed kyang bzod sran tshugs par bya/gnod pa 'di tsam yang mi bzod par sangs rgyas thob tu re ba dang chos pa yin du re ba nga rang 'khrul snyam du bsgom/ sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa ni chos sgrub pa'i dus na tsha grang ltogs skom la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal byung ba'am/lam bgrod dka' ba dang / mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa dang / ngal dub thang chad nyi lhags char gsum sogs gang byung kyang / bdag chos kyi phyir du dka' spyad phra mo 'di tsam ma bzod pas ga la yong / nor dang bu smad kyi phyir/ 'di 'dra bas brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyi sdug bsngal che ba kun la'ang tsham tshom med par 'jug gin gda' ba/ bdag sangs rgyas bsgrub dgos pa la sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar la slob dgos na/ chos phyir dka' ba 'di tsam yang mi bzod par theg chen par khas 'che ba re blun no snyam du gnyen po brtan thang — 295 —

gis btang / chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa ni thabs zab mo dang /thabs mkhas kyi khyad par dang / mdzad pa rlabs po che dang / yon tan mtha' yas pa dang / gnas lugs spros bral sogs gang la'ang blor mi shong ba med pa cig la zer/ stong nyid la sems yun ring du gnas thub pa cig la'ang zer/ da res 'dir gnod pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad sgyu ma lha bu bden pas stong pa med bzhin du snang ba yin na/ mi bzod rgyu ci yod snyam du bsgom par bya'o/ /dmigs skor zhe brgyad pa'o// //da ni gzhan yang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab dgos te/de la gsum go cha'i brtson 'grus/ sbyor ba'i brtson ke 'grus/ slar mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus so/ /go cha'i brtson 'grus ni/ chos dge ba thams cad la 'di lta bu byed mi dgos snyams pa'i khyad gsod dang / chen po rnams la 'di tsam sgrub mi nus snyam pa'i zhum pa'i sems gnyis kar mi byed par/ bdag gis 'di dag thams cad bsgrub kyang dgos/ bsgrub nus pa yang yin da lta nyid du bsgrub par bya'o/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes sems kyi dam bca' dang 'brel ba'i dge ba la spro sems dpa' ma zhum pa de yin/ de rang gi rgyud thog tu sbyar nas yang yang bsgom par bya/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus ni dngos su lag len la sbyor ba'i skabs/ le lo dang rnam g.yeng gi dbang du mi gtong bar spro ba dang bcas pas 'phral du dge ba la 'jug cing / de nyid spro bzhin du rgyun bsring ba'o/ /slar mi zlog pa'i brtson 'grus ni/ drod rtags dang phan yon 'phral du ma byung na'ang / dang por gang la zhugs pa de'i 'bras bu mngon du ma gyur par yun — 296 —

ci tsam 'gor yang rung / dka' ba ci tsam spyod dgos kyang rung spro ba ye mi zlog pa'o/ /yang bstan rim gyi man ngag 'ga' zhig las/ lus kyi brtson 'grus phyag dang bskor ba sogs/ ngag gi brtson 'grus bzlas brjod kha bton sogs/yid kyi brtson 'grus spyir dge ba dang sgos su chos 'di la spro zhing brtson pa ste/zhes pa'ang yod pas/ gang ltar yang rung brtson 'grus ni de rnams yin na bdag kyang brtson 'grus dang ldan par bya/ le lo phyi bshol gyi dbang du ma btang bar dge ba la spro bar bya'o snyam du bsgom/ dmigs skor zhe dgu pa'o da ni gzhan yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bya ba yod de/ de'i rgyu tshogs la da lta nas gnas dgos/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyur sems dben pa gcig dgos/ de'i rgyur lus dben pa dgos/ de'i rgyur don nyung la bya ba nyung ba dgos/ de'i rgyur 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa dgos/ de'i rgyur zas gos gnas mal ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa dgos/ bdag kyang ci ste 'byor pa dang ldan na de la ma chags par ting nge 'dzin bsgom/ gal te ma 'byor na yang ma 'byor ba nyid bzang ste chos kyi bar chad med pa yin/ gang byung de kas chog snyam pa yang yang bsam zhing bsgom/ des ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu bsam pa song /dmigs skor lnga bcu pa'o// //dngos ni bsam gtan la dbye na/ dbye sgo mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang /mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba/ lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba bsgrub pa yin/ yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i bsam — 297 —

gtan zhes bya ba/ spyi ldog nas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa sgrub par byed pa rnams yin/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs la brten nas gzhan rgyud byin gyis rlob par byed pa'am/mngon shes kyi khyad par la brten nas sems can gyi don spyod pa yin/ de thams cad kyang zhi gnas skyon dang bral zhing mtshan nyid rdzogs pa cig la brten dgos/ bdag gis thog mar zhi gnas la sems mnyam par bzhag par bya/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gzhan thams cad kyang bsgrub par bya'o snyam du 1yang yang bsgom/ dmigs skor nga gcig pa'o// //skabs 'dir zhi gnas kyi rnam gzhag zhib tsam bshad cing nges par byung na legs/ zhi gnas kyi 'khrid kyang 'dir ston pa thob thang yin mod kyang lta ba la nges pa dang nyams myong rnyed par 'gyur ba tsam la/ zhi gnas brtan po med kyang chog pa dang / zhi gnas brtan po legs po bsgrub nas/ de'i 'og tu lta ba bskyangs te lhag mthong sgrub pa gzhung chen kun gyi dgongs pa dang / gzhud lam chen mo yin mod kyang deng sang gi gang zag dbang po rtul pos/ sems gnas skyon med brtan po zhig sgrub pa la yun ring du 'thog pas sher phyin sgom pa'i skal ba chad kyis dogs pa dang / lta ba'i myong ba rnyed pa'i steng du sems gnas bsgrub na zhi lhag lhan cig tu 'grub ste/ slob ma 'khrid bla myong ba rnyed bla ba'i gnad yod par dgongs nas phyag len la skabs 'dir mi mdzad pa yin par snang ngo / /da ni de thams cad kyi nang nas tshe pa mchog tu gyur pa bslab bya kun gyi gtso bo yang yin/ nyams len kun gyi mthar thug kyang yin/ shes rab kyi pha — 298 —

rol tu phyin pa ston par byed/ de la shes rab ni gsum yod de/ don dam shes pa'i shes rab dang / kun rdzob shes pa'i shes rab dang / g.yin don shes pa'i shes rab ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni gnas lugs stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab yin/ gnyis pa ni shes bya thams cad kyi ngo bo dbye ba rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ma nor bar shes pa'i shes rab yin/ gsum pa ni bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro don shes pa'i shes rab ste/ de la zang zing gi sbyin pa btang ste skye bo rnams mgu nas chos la 'god thub pa shes/ bsam pa dang mthun par chos ston pa'i snyan par smra ba shes/ don spyod pa gzhan phyin drug la 'god thabs shes/don mthun pa rang yang phyin drug las mi 'da' bar spyod shes pa ste/ de'i nang gi gzhan phyin drug la 'god pa ni/ gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi thabs shes pa'i sgo nas yin no/ /yang na thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i shes rab ste/thos pas go bsam pas sgro 'dogs chod bsgom pas mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab ste/ gsum po 'di rnams bdag gis ci nas kyang rgyud la bskyed par bya'o/ /'di sher phyin gyi bsam pa la bslab pa yin/ dmigs skor nga gnyis pa'o// //da ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sbyor ba la bslab dgos te/ de la gang zag gi bdag med bsgom pa/ chos kyi bdag med bsgom pa/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can la bslab pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro dang rjes sogs sngar bshad pa ltar las/ dngos gzhi'i skabs 'dir rkang pa skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag rgal tshigs bsrang /— 299 —

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/mgrin pa dgug dpung ba phyir bskyed/ so mchu rang sar bzhag cing lce rtse rkan la sbyar/ mig sna rtser lta/ de nas rlung sna nas lan gsum phyi la sang sang ba 'bud/ de rjes dbugs rang sor bzhag /nges 'byung skyo shas dung tsam dang byams snying rje rgyud 'gyur tsam bsgom/ de nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la sems gtad/ gzhig 'grel bcug /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas nga bdag tu 'dzin pa goms pas bdag yod yod ltar snang ba ma gtogs/ nga bdag ces pa gnas tshul la grub pa ye med par 'dug snyam du bsam/ 'di dmigs pa'i gzhi yin de la nga'am bdag ces bya ba/ gnas lugs la yod na da de gang zag gi bdag yin mod/ de 'dra dngos po la ye ma grub pas gang zag gi bdag de 'dra ngo bo'i sgo nas ston rgyu med/ 'on kyang med pa la yod par 'dzin pa'i bdag 'dzin gyi 'dzin stangs rlom tshul dang bstun na rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can du 'dzin pa yin/ de yang na ning ngas 'di byas/ nga da gzod 'di byed snyam pa/na ning gi nga de da lta'i nga 'di yin/ 'di da gzod yang 'gro snyam pa de la rtag par 'dzin pa zer/ nga snyam pa shar dus phyi nang gi dngos po gzhan su dang yang ma 'dres pa'i kho rang gi ngo bo tshugs thub cig yod pa'i khungs su snang ba de gcig pur 'dzin pa yin/ ji ltar rigs pa'i longs spyod dam/ rdzas sam 'khor la rang nyid bdag po'i tshul du yod pa ltar snang ba de rang dbang can du 'dzin pa zhes bya ba yin/ 'dzin stangs kyis de ltar bzung yang de lta bur ma grub ste/ gal te bdag de rtag na ni bdag de lan cig bde ba myong ba rtag tu bde dgos pa dang / lan cig sdug bsngal myong na rtag tu sdug dgos pa dang /— 300 —

dus dang po 'khor bar bcings na phyis grol ba'i dus mi srid pa dang / phyis grol ba'i gnas skabs su yod na/ sngon 'khor ba ma myong bar thal ba las bde sdug spel ma dang / bcings grol gyi gnas skabs so sor 'byung bas rtag pa'i bdag med par thag chod/ gcig pu yang mi 'thad de bdag ces bya ba/ rang gi lus sems kyi phung po la yod pa ltar snang na/ mig kyang bdag ma yin/ rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus dang yid kyang bdag ma yin/ de dag re re bzhin bdag yin na du mar 'gyur/ re re nas bdag ma yin na bdag ma rnyed/ gzhan yang bdag phung po yin na bdag mi rtag par thal/ bdag phung po las gzhan yin na mig shes kyis mthong ba la bdag gis mthong / lus kyis reg pa la bdag gis reg ces pa'i 'du shes 'byung ba 'gal/ de'i phyir gcig pu'i rang bzhin can gyi nga bdag ma grub/ gcig pu ma grub pas rang dbang can mi 'grub/ khyad par du yang bya byed thams cad rkyen la rag lus par mngon sum du mthong bas/rang dbang can gyi bdag mi srid/ gzhan yang phung po'i phyi rol na yang bdag ma grub/ phung po'i nang na'ang bdag mi gnas/ phung po re re'ang bdag min/ phung po bsal ba'i shul na'ang bdag med/ phung po'i spyi la'ang bdag med de re re las gzhan pa'i spyi ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bdag ces bya ba ni blos btags pa tsam/ 'khrul ngo tsam/ phyin ci log kho na yin gyi/ ngo bos grub pa ni 'ga' yang med do snyam du bsgom/ dmigs skor nga gsum pa'o// //gang zag gi bdag med sgom pa 'di la blo'i 'khobs dang bstun pa'i dmigs skor dum bu 'ga' shas su bcad kyang rung ba lags/ da ni chos kyi — 301 —
