bdag med ston te chos zhes pa phung khams skye mched la zer/ de rnams la blos btags pa tsam ma yin par rang tshugs thub pa'i dngos po cig yod srid na de chos kyi bdag yin mod kyang / de 'dra ye mi srid pas chos thams cad chos kyi bdag med pa yin no/ /de ltar yin yang 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas phung khams skye mched rnams/ rang tshugs su grub par 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog 'di sbyang ba'i phyir chos kyi bdag med bsgom dgos pa yin no/ /de la dang por rang rgyud kyi phung po rang bzhin med par bsgom dgos/ de'i yang thog ma rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i gzugs phung lus kyi chos la bltas na/ dngos po sna tshogs tshogs pa ltar snang ba gcig la lus zhes spyi ming cig tu btags nas/ ming dang mtshungs pa'i dngos po zhig yod do snyam/ blo phyin ci log gis bzung ba ma gtogs de ltar ma grub ste/ dang por lus 'di la mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus kyi dbang po rnams kyang tha dad/ dbang po rnams dang mi gcig pa'i dbang rten khog pa yang so so re 'dug /mgo bo dang mgrin pa dang brang dang rgyab dang sked pa dang pho ba dang lto ba dang phrag pa gnyis dang dpung pa gnyis dang bar lhu gnyis dang lag ngar gnyis dang lag mgo gnyis dang dpyi gnyis dang byin pa gnyis dang rkang mgo gnyis dang / don lnga snod drug sogs nang khrol rnams dang bu ga dgu la sogs pa sna tshogs pa 'dus pa'i phung po yin snyam du bsam/ des na lus zhes bya ba blos btags pa ma gtogs bden par mi 'dug /de rnams re re nas lus yin na lus mang po can du 'gyur/ re re nas min na ni lus ma rnyed/— 302 —

tshogs pa tsam yin no snyam na/ re re las g.yin pa'i tshogs pa med pa'i phyir blos btags pa tsam ma gtogs med par song ngo / /dmigs skor nga bzhi pa'o// //yang gzugs kyi phung pos bsdus pa'i lus 'di bden par ma grub ste/rkang lag bzhi stod smad mgo brang zhol nang khrol te gzugs dgur 'gro/gzugs re re nas grub bam snyam na ma grub ste/ re re bzhin lhu gsum gsum la sogs par 'gro/ lhu re re nas bden nam snyam na mi bden te sor tshigs tsam du mar 'gro/ sor tshad re re nas grub bam snyam na ma grub ste re re nas nas tsam bdun bdun du 'gro/ de re re nas kyang mi bden te shig gi tshad tsam bdun bdun mthar sro ma dang / nyi zer rdul dang / glang rdul dang/ lug rdul dang / ri bong rdul dang / chu rdul dang / lcags rdul gyi bar du snga ma snga ma'i dkyus kyi tshad bdun bdun du btubs pas phyi ma phyi ma'i tshad du 'gyur/ lcags rdul re re nas bden nam snyam na mi bden te/ lcags rdul gyi dkyus kyi tshad la rdul phran bdun yod/ der yang ma grub ste rdul phran re re la rdul phra rab bdun yod do/ /bdun 'gyur 'di rnams la dkyus zheng rgya dpangs thams cad bsdoms na/ snga ma snga ma gsil bas phyi ma phyi ma sum brgya bzhi bcu zhe gsum re yod/ dkyus la bdun yod pa zheng la'ang de tsam yin pas bzhi bcu zhe dgur 'gyur la de tsam la dpangs su yang bdun yod pas so/ /dmigs skor nga lnga ba'o/ //rdul phra rab re re bzhin bden par grub bam snyam na ma grub ste/ re re — 303 —

bzhin phyogs re dang / steng 'og tu lta ba'i cha re ste drug tu snang la/ dbus kyi cha gcig kyang yod dgos te de med na shar nub sogs la lta ba rtsom mi thub pas so/ /de ltar cha bdun po re re la yang de bzhin du phye bas de yang ma grub/ de ltar thug med du phye bas mtha' med de/ lus zhes bya ba blos btags pa tsam ma gtogs gnas tshul la ma grub pa kho na'o/ /des na snang ba tsam ma 'gags pa sgyu ma lta bu la/ rang bzhin gdod nas gang du'ang ma grub ste/ dngos po 'di rnams de ltar na gcig tu ma grub/ de ma grub pas du mar yang mi 'grub ste/gcig gcig por grub pa mang por bsags pa las du ma grub dgos pa'i phyir ro// dmigs skor nga drug pa'o// //'o na gzugs phung mi bden yang sems su bden pa yin snyam na/sems la dbye na'ang gzugs mthong ba dang sgra tshor ba la sogs pa gtso bo rnam par shes pa/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad so sor 'dug ste/ rnam shes kyi phung po yang du mar zhig ste thal/ bde sdug btang snyoms myong ba sogs tshor bar 'dug ste/ tshor ba yang gcig tu ma grub/ mtho dman bzang ngan ming don sna tshogs 'dzin pa sogs 'du shes su 'dug ste/ de la'ang gcig tu ngos bzung ma byung lhag ma 'dod chags zhe sdang dad pa la sogs pa rnam rtog mi 'dra ba ji snyed cig la blos bsdoms nas 'du byed ces btags par zad kyi sems zhes bya ba yang gcig tu ma grub gcig ma grub pas du mar yang ma grub bo zhes bsgom ste/dmigs skor nga bdun pa'o// //da shes pa'i rnam grangs de thams cad kyang rig rig co co por 'di'i — 304 —

rnam 'gyur ma gtogs tshugs thub tu mi 'dug /dper na chu la ri brag gi gzugs brnyan shar ba dang 'dra/ rig rig po 'di la bltas na 'das pa'i sems ni 'gags nas med/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems ni ma skyes nas med/ da lta'i rig pa skad cig ma byas kyang rang ngos nas bden par grub pa med de skad cig gcig po de la'ang snga ma dang 'brel ba skye ba'i cha gcig dang / phyi ma dang 'brel ba 'gags pa'i cha gcig dang / dbus na gnas pa'i cha gcig ste sil bur 'gro/ de'i dbus kyi cha la ltos na cha gsum sogs thug med du dpyad na gru/tha' med du song nas/ gang yang gcig pu'i ngo bo ma grub pa der gda'/ gcig ma grub pas du ma mi 'grub pa sogs gong bzhin te/ dmigs skor nga brgyad pa'o// //des rang rgyud kyi phung po bden med du gtan la phab zin/ da ni rang gi lus sems kyis bsdus pa'i phung po lnga po bden med du gtan la phebs zin pa de bzhin du/ sems can thams cad kyi lus sems phung po lnga yang de dang 'dra/khyad par du dgra sdang ba'am gnyen byams pa lta bu nyon mongs drag tu skye ba'i yul cig la ched gtad du dmigs nas/ rang gi lus la dpyad pa bzhin de'i lus la yang dpyad/ rang gi se bye/sa ming gzhi'i phung po la dpyad pa bzhin du/de'i sems la yang dpyad de de rnga ṭa na skye bo che ge mo dang / ga ge mo zhes bya ba 'di kun yang blos btags nas sems can de dang de'o zhes phyin ci log tu btags par zad kyi/ nges par na gang du yang ma grub pas sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes sbyangs nas/des thams cad la rigs 'gres te bsgom dgos so/ /'di bcud kyi sems — 305 —

cad thams cad stong par bsgom pa zhes bya ste/ dmigs skor nga dgu pa'o// //yang bcud kyi sems can du ma zad phyi snod kyi 'jig rten yang mi bden te/ stong gsum bshig pas stong bar ma dang / de bzhin du stong spyi phud dang /gling bzhi pa dang / 'dzam bu gling lta bu dang / rgyal khams gcig dang / dpag tshad tsam dang / rgyang grags tsam dang / 'dom gang tsam dang / khru gru bzhi pa dang /sor gcig tsam dang nas tsam nas rdul phra rab kyi bar du bzhag na snga ma snga ma ma grub cing / rdul phran yang sngon bzhin du bshig pas mthar gang yang ma grub/gcig tu ma grub pas du ma mi 'grub pa sogs gong bzhin te/ mdor na 'di dang 'di lta bu'o/ /'di ni khang khyim mo/ /'di ni kho ngo / /'di ni 'bru'o/ /'di ni nor rdzas so/ /'di ni lo thog go /de bzhi du ri dang thang dang chu dang rgyal khams la sogs par 'dzin pa dag kyang / bden dngos su ma grub pa'i tshogs par snang ba tsam la blos ming 'dog tha dad btags nas bden dngos su 'dzin pa tsam du zad kyi/ don du na cung zad tsam yang grub pa med do snyam du 'dun pa sbyangs/ snod kyi 'jig rten stong par bsgom pa ste/ dmigs skor drug cu pa'o// //yang rang gzhan snod bcud mthong thos gzugs can thogs bcas thams cad ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ste khams lngas bsdus/ rig tsam 'gyu ba thams cad ni rnam par shes pas bsdus/ de la 'byung ba bzhi po ni/ phra mor na rang tshugs ma thub ste 'dres shing gnas sa'i rdul phran yang ma grub ste 'byung ba gzhan dang 'dres pa'i phyir dang / phan tshun gcig la gcig brten te gnas — 306 —

pa ma gtogs/ rang tshugs thub par sdod pa'i skabs gang yang mi snang ba'i phyir ro/ /nam mkha' zhes bya ba ni gzugs can de rnams med pa'i shul la blos btags pa ma gtogs bya byed med cing bden dngos med la/ rnam par shes pa yang rkyen glo bur ba'i snang cha tsam ma gtogs/ ngos bzung du med pas rang bzhin snod bcud thams cad gnas tshul la ye ma grub la/ re zhig 'khrul ba can gyi blo la snang cha ma 'gags kyang rang bzhin med pas sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam du bsgom/ snod bcud thams cad stong par bsgom pa ste/ dmigs skor drug cu re gcig pa'o// //gzhan yang dngos med ces bya ba ni dngos po la brten nas blos bzhag pa tsam yin gyi don dam par lta ci smos/ kun rdzob blang dor gyi yul du yang ma grub ste gang yang yod pa ma yin la/ gong du snang grags kyi chos 'di dag thams cad ye nas ma grub bo zhes bsam mod/ gdod nas rtsa ba dang bral ba la stong pa'i chos zhes bya ba yang med de/ mo bsham gyi bu dang po nas byung ba ma srid pas mo bsham gyi bu med ces pa'ang mi srid de/ de 'dra ba'i stong pa yang mi stong pa la ltos te blos bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ yod med yin min sogs cir yang ma grub pa la blos gang du'ang mi 'dzin par gsal la rtog med kyi ngang du lhan ne 'jog /yang rtog pa skyes byung na de'i ngo bo la bltas te ngos bzung dang bral ba de ka bsgom/ dmigs pa snga ma dang 'di gnyis sbrel nas gsal la yun thung ba yang yang bsgom pa gnad du che/ mthar thug spros bral bsgom pa'i dmigs pa ste/ dmigs skor re gnyis pa'o// //— 307 —

de nas de thams cad bsdoms nas bsgom ste sngar gyi go ba rnams yud cig dran par byas nas/ rang gzhan snod bcud 'di dag thams cad la nga bdag ces bya ba yang ma grub/ byed pa po gang yang med de rten 'brel tshogs pa tsam las snang ba yin/ 'di thams cad gcig dang du ma gang yang ma grub pas 'khrul ngor snang tsam ma gtogs/ gnas lugs la ci yang ma grub cing legs par brtags na ma grub pa dang med pa zhes bya ba yang / blos yod pa'i mtshan nyid gcig gsar du bcos nas de dang 'gal bar snang ba la/ med pa dang ma grub pa'i tha snyad btags pa tsam du zad do/ /de ltar phan tshun brtags pas dmigs gtad yal ba de la ci yang mi bsam par mnyam par bzhag cing /sngar gyi dmigs gtad sangs pa'i ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba'i rnam cha de ma yal bar du mi rtog pa de la bzhag /yang de yal song na stong nyid kyi rnam pa nub pa'i mi rtog pa tsam la mi 'jug ste/ sngar gyi de bskyar gyin bsgom dgos pas yal ma yal gyi sa mtshams shes pa gal che gsung / thog ma'i skabs su stong pa'i rnam pa yun ring mi sdod pa 'dra ba zhig yong yang nyams myong gi sno zhig rnyed pa'i mtshams nas rje ring je ring la 'gro/ 'di ka dmigs pa la sems gto pa'i 'jog pa dang / de'i rgyun bsring ba nye bar 'jog pa yin/ rnam rtog byung tshad 'phro gcod pa de bslan te 'jog pa yin/ de nas yun je ring rje ring la 'gro ba de nye bar 'jog pa yin/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi yon to dran nas dga' ba bsgoms pas lhag par bsgom pa la spro ba 'byung ste 'dul bar byed pa yin/ res 'ga' rnam g.yeng la sogs pa'i nyes dmigs dran pas rnam g.yeng — 308 —

sogs rang 'gags la 'gro ste zhi bar byed pa yin/ de gnyis spro ba bskyed pa dang skyo shas bskyed pa'i rnam grangs yin/ re dogs dang chags sdang gi rnam rtog gang byung ba thams cad gang skyes kyi ngo bo la cer re bltas pas/ sngar shes pa bden med du bsgoms pa des rgyas thebs nas rang babs su zhi ba ni nye bar zhi ba yin/ re zhig bar la rgyud lang shor can de thabs de dag gis yang yang 'tsho dgos shing / de nas ci zhig ltar na sems bsgrims na bying rgod kyi skyon med cing / dmigs yul stong pa'i rnam pa de la sems yun ring du gnas pa 'byung /de skabs bsgrim dgos te sems kyi rgyud gcig tu byed bya ba de yin/ mthar sngar gyi lta ba'i nyams myong dran tsam byas nas bzhag pa kho nas stong pa'i rnam pa can de yun ring du gnas pa 'byung ste/ de'i tshe rtsol ba klod de rang babs su 'jog dgos pas mnyam par bzhag pa zhes bya ba grub pa yin no/ /sgom skyong tshul 'di chos mngon pa las/ lhag mthong sngon du song ba'i zhi gnas sgom tshul gcig kyang yod pa de'i lugs yin/ 'di ka ma la shī la'i sgom rim la sogs pa'i lugs dang mtshungs par dpyad pa sngon song gi mi rtog pa sgom tshul yin/bshes gnyen po to ba chen po'i be'u bum las/ dpal ldan a ti sha'i lugs la dpyad pa sngon song kho na dgos par gsungs/ 'on kyang a ti sha'i blo sbyong gi gdams ngag 'ga' re sogs mdo lugs dang / phyag chen sogs sngags kyi gdams ngag mang po la/ dpyad pa spangs pa'i gdams ngag kyang shin tu mang mod/ re zhig bstan rim gyi man ngag ston pa'i skabs 'dir/ bshes gnyen chen po po to bas gsungs pa ltar byed dgos so/ /dmigs skor re gsum — 309 —

mo// //lta ba skyong lugs 'di'i rigs la sems gnas pa nam grub pa na lhag mthong yang grub ste/ thog ma nyid nas zhi lhag zung du 'jug pa nyid yod par bzhed do// 4 gsum pa stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can ni/ de la stong rkyang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub par mi 'gro bas/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug cig dgos pa yin/ de ltar na don dam par snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa'i chos gang yang ma grub par 'dug /dpe nam mkha' dang 'dra/ de ltar na grub pa la ma grub par mngon gsum du rtogs na/ sdug bsngal myong ba po'i sems can yang med/ myong rgyu'i sdug bsngal yang med/ myong tshul las nyon sdug bsngal gsum phan tshun gcig nas gcig tu 'khor 'gro rgyu yang gdod nas ma grub par 'dug mod/ de ltar ma rtogs tsa na sdug bsngal myong ba po'i sems can gyi snang ba yang shar/ myong bya sdug bsngal gyi snang ba yang shar/ myong tshul dang 'khor tshul yang shar/ de thams cad med bzhin du snang ba yin kyang sgyu mas bslus pa'i sems can ltar sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba snying re rje/ 'di rnams 'khrul ba sangs te gnas lugs rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas la 'god par bya/ don dam par bdag kyang ma grub sems can de rnams kyang ma grub/ zhakhru la ba yang ma grub zhakhru la ba sel bar byed pa'i lam yang ma grub mod kyi/ kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam du sdug bsngal dang sgrib pa yod par snang ba bzhin du/ lam yang yod par snang /lam bsgoms pas 'khru/la ba sangs te gnas lugs la ngang gis gnas pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'ang yin pa la/ sgyu ma lta bu'i bdag gis sgyu ma lta bu'i — 310 —

(sems can rnams la/ sgyu ma lta bu'i lam mam chos bstan pas sgyu ma lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyis sha thang chad pa 'di dbyings su grol bar bya'o/ /sdug bsngal myong bya myong byed thams cad bden par ma grub la/ snang grags kyi chos gang yang bden par grub pa mi srid mod kyi/ brtag pa mthar bzung ste ci ste bden grub kyi sdug bsngal zhig srid du chug kyang / bden med kyi sdug bsngal myong ba 'di las lhag po'i sdug bsngal myong rgyu med/ 'di med par rtogs na rang grol du 'dug pa la de ltar ma rtogs pa snying re rje zhes yang yang bsam zhing bsgom/dmigs skor drug cu re bzhi pa'o// //da ni de'i bogs 'don du zhag gcig stong nyid 'ba' zhig bsgom/ zhag gcig snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom/ zhag gcig sngar gyi stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug de bsgom/ de 'dra yang yang byas pas bogs cig thon nas 'ong / yang res 'ga' thun gcig stong nyid rkyang pa bsgom/ thun gcig snying rje rkyang ba bsgom/ thun gcig gam gnyis la stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug bsgom/ de ltar skabs skabs su yang yang byas pas kyang bogs cig thon nas yong thun gcig go /da 'di la gegs sel gyi tha snyad gsung bar gda'/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'brel de sgom gyi mthil yin/ de la tshe 'di'i bde ba la zhen pa'i gegs 'byung ste/ tshe 'dir longs spyod che ba dang / gtam snyan pa dang / kha drag pa cig 'dod dam/ mi g.yin rnams kyis kyang chos pa bzang por 'dzin du re/ gzhan pas rang lhag pa cig yong du re/ snying nas 'dod zhen ma log par gzhan sun 'byin pa'i phyir dang / rang phyogs 'byongs pa'i phyir du bya btang byed/ chig ri'am/— 311 —

'dag sbyar ram/ dka' thub bam/ ldum bu'am/ lto 'dod kyi btsun pa/ grags phyir gyi bsnyen rdzogs/ khengs dregs kyi tshul 'chos/ phugs mi thams cad rang la dad pa skyes te/ rang rgyal ba cig yong du re bas 'phral pham kha len pa ltar byed pa sogs kyang chos la snyad nas 'jig rten gyi che thabs sgrub par gda'/stong nyid snying rje dang rgyab 'gal yin/ de dag dug dang 'dres pa'i zas bya ba ༈gas/ thog ma nyid nas 'jig rten phal pa bzhin du bsam pa dang spyod pa sbyor ba she gnyis dkar nag rkyang du song ba de ches smad pa gzhir bzhag mod kyang / de la dge sbyor dang 'dres pa ltar bzang rdzu'i yul du yang ma byung / de rnams kyi gnyen por skyes bu chung ngu'i bsam pa yang yang dran dgos/ phyi ma lha mi'i bde ba la zhen pa'i gegs bya ba/ 'khor ba'i bde ba la sred pa ma log pas sbyin pa 'dra gtong / tshul khrims 'dra srung / khrigs chags kyi dge sbyor bag re byed kyang skye ba phyi ma'i zas gos longs spyod gnas khang / bu smad 'khor g.yog dbang thang 'dzoms pas skyid pa cig ka smon na/ stong nyid snying rje'i mi mthun phyogs su song / de'i gnyen por skyes bu 'bring gi bsam pa rnams bskyar gyin bsgom dgos/ blo chos su song yang rang don yid byed kho na 'dug na stong nyid snying rje dang rgyab 'gal yin pas/ de'i gnyen por bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang brje ba bsgom dgos/ de yang go yul tsam la ma lus pa'i rang gi lus sems kyi thog tu dmigs gtad khel nges shes nga/ gal che/ de'i gdams ngag blo sbyong na gsal/ spyod 'jug dang bslab btus kun na yang rgyas par yod/rgyal tshab byams pas/ bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa'i sems nyid dam/ /— 312 —

bdag pas gzhan gces sdug pa rnyed nas ni/ /de ltar bdag pas gzhan don mchog tu shes/ /rang gi don gang gzhan gyi don gang yin/ /zhes gsungs/ stong nyid sgom pa'i go yul yang yang byas kyang bden par med do/ /sgyu ma lta bu'o bya ba de yal yul du song nas gnad du ma 'byor/ dgra gnyen longs spyod gtam sogs kyi rnam rtog rags pa de ka 'dug na/ stong nyid snying rje'i mi mthun phyogs yin pas rang gi lus sems rdzas yo byad dgra gnyen rnams kyi steng du/sgyu ma lta bu'i blo de khel nges shes pa snying thag pa nas sbyong ba gal che/ de yang thun gcig go /yang dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ las rgyu 'bras/ chos la dad pa/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems/ bdag med gnyis bsgom pa rnams zhag re'am thun re'i nang du res 'ga' bstar chags su bsgom/ res 'ga' lugs zlog tu bsgom/ res 'ga' rkang 'thon du bsgom/ res 'ga' dkrugs pa dang 'chol bar bsgom/ res 'ga' sems la gang gnod pa'i spang bya shas che ba de'i steng du bsgom/ res 'ga' 'di sgom bde bar 'dug snyam pa de bsgom/ 'di yang thun gcig go /rgyun gyi nyams len la mi rtag pa dur dur dran pa dang / las 'bras kyi don bsam pa'i 'dzem bag dang / khams gsum 'khor ba thams cad la snying rje dang / spros bral gyi gnas lugs la mnyam par 'jog pa ste bzhi po 'di gtso bor bsgom/ gas rnams 'khor gyi tshul du bsgom mo/ /chos 'di spyod pa'i bla ma dam pa'am grogs bzang po dang 'grogs/ thun mtshams su mdo sde rnams klog pa'am nyan pas kyang sgom gyi bogs 'byin chos la nges pa rnyed dad par — 313 —

gsos 'debs pa yin/ khyad par bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung bstan rim dang 'brel ba'i be'u bum re la'ang / lta rtog dang nan chags dang don sems thog tu 'jog pa kho na gnad du che ba lags/ 'di la'ang thun gcig ste/ phyi ma bzhi bo 'di rgyun gyi nyams len dang gegs sel bogs 'don la slob pa yin/dmigs skor du bcad ni mi dgos/ yang dmigs skor du byas kyang 'gal ba med do// //rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa/ de las 'bras bu bla na med pa'i byang chub 'grub tshul ni/ rgyas par gzhung lugs chen po rnams nyan pas go bar 'gyur/'dir bshad kyis yang mi lang ba lags/ snying po ni ji skad du/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ tshul khrims sbyin pa g.yin gyi don/ /brtson 'grus bzod pa bdag nyid kyi/ /bsam gtan shes rab thar ba'i rgyu/ /snying rje bas ni don kun 'grub/ /ces dang / bdun po 'di dag ma lus par/ /gcig car pha rol phyin pa yis/ /ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab yul/ /'jig rten mgon po nyid 'thob 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin te bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang / spyod pa spyin sogs drug la sbyangs pas rang shugs kyi chos las gzhan du blo mi 'gro zhing / dkon mchog la dad pa dang las 'bras la 'dzem bag dang 'khor ba la skyo shas rnams ngang gis skye/ chos rtse gcig tu bsgom pa la sun pa med par spro ba ngang gis 'phel na/ ting nge 'jin brtan po skyes rung ma skyes rung lam sna zin pa dang tshogs lam chung ngu rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ /de nas tshogs lam du mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med kyi don la gsal snang cung zad rnyed pa ni/— )14 —

byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan zhes bya'o/ /de nas bsgoms pa'i stobs dang tshogs bsags pa'i stobs gnyis 'dzormes pa las/ gzugs ni lha ba rdos pa 'dra/ /zhes sogs ltar phung po lnga sgyu ma ltar rtogs shing chos kyi bdag med la gsal snang rim pas rnyed pa ni/ don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya'o/ /mthong lam nas brtsams te byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu la/ spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes skyes pa ni/ de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya'o/ /sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar du de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i bsam gtan cha phra ba tsam yod la/ sa brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa rnams la/ chung ngu dang 'bring dang r+sā po dag yod do/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar ni de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i bsam gtan mthar thug pa yod de/ bsam gtan bzhi pa 'di ni snying po mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes te rgyas par g.yin du rtogs par bya'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi po 'di gong ma'i yi ge na ma bris kyang mdo nas 'byung ba ltar bkod pa yin no/ /dang por lam sna ma zin gyi bar du cung dka' ba yin pas bya ba gzhan thams cad bor la gcig tu 'bad pa gal che/ de nas kyang 'bad rtsol gong 'phel du gtong dgos mod kyi cung zad bla bar 'ong / tshogs sgo du ma nas bsags smon lam phyogs sna tshogs nas btab ste/ rgyud sbyangs pas sbyor lam gyi ye shes skyes pa na rang shugs kyis gong 'phel du 'gro zhing 'jug pa bde ba yin/ der yang bdud kyi las phra mo spong ba dang gegs sel ba dang bogs dbyung ba mang du dgos par yod/ de nas rim pas chos nyid mngon gsum du rtogs pa'i ye shes skye bar — 315 —

'gyur te/ de nas bde ba nas bde bar spyod pa 'ba' zhig go /'bras bu sangs rgyas ni ngo bo nyid sku rang bzhin 'od gsal spros bral gyi ye shes dang / longs sku 'og min du dag pa'i 'khor la chos 'khor mthar thug bskor ba po dang /sprul pa'i sku ma dag pa'i zhing rnams su gang la gang 'dul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang / 'phrin las ni mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sgo nas/ sems can thams cad skal ba dang 'tshams par phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa la 'god pa'o// 'di la thun gyi nges pa med la ji ltar 'tshams par bshad par bya'o/ /des bstan pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i khrid legs par tshar ro// //da ni grub 'bras sems bskyed dang / byang sdom len pa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ de la gnyis/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga dang / byang sdom gyi cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ rten dang mchod pa bshams maṇ+ḍal phul te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang /sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang slob dpon gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du gsol/ zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos bya/ de nas dgongs gsol gong bzhin la bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams gyi — 316 —

mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos rnams kyi mchog zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa'i rjes bzlos lan gsum bya/skyabs 'gro re re bzhin dgongs gsol re byed pa de rgyas pa'i lugs yin/bsdus na 'di tsam gyis chog /bar 'dir bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya ste tshogs bsags pa'o/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni dgongs gsol gong dang 'dra/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dang gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang / tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang / sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bdag gis bgyis pa dang /bgyid du stsal ba dang / bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas gzung nas/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi ste/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos byar gzhug/— 317 —

smon sems kyi bslab bya gong du bshad pa rnams las ci rigs pa'am rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bshad/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis zhus pa chos bdun pa zhes bya ba'i mdo dang / sdong po bkod pa la sogs pa'i mdo nas bslab bya dang phan yon du ma 'byung ba rnams rgyas par mdo sde de dag las shes par bya'o zhes brjod/ de nas smon lam ji ltar 'os pa gdab cing / bsdu na dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /zhes sogs brjod/ slar yang dkon mchog mchod/ slob dpon la yon dbul/ 'di ni sems bskyed kyi cho gar grags pa smon sems kyi cho ga ste/ 'di la snod brtag pa dang so thar rigs brgyad sngon du 'gro ba sogs gang yang mi dgos pas/ don du gnyer ba thams cad la sbyin du rung ngo / /'di ni byams pa nas brgyud pa'i sems bskyed de/ slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga logs pa zhig 'phags yul na yod par grags la/ de ni dkon brtsegs kyi nang gi 'di ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ces bya ba'i mdo logs pa zhig las bsdus pa ste/ de'i dgongs don phyogs 'dir yod pa dpal ldan a ti shas mdzad pa'i/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga na gsal bar bzhugs pa bzhin bkod pa yin no// //gnyis pa byang sdom len pa'i cho ga ni/ rab tu byang chub sems dpa'i bslab gzhi rgyas par ston pa ni theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rnams yin pas mdo sde mang du thos par bya/ yang na byang chub sems dpa'i sa'am/ bslab pa kun las btus pa lta bu nyan na'ang / theg chen kun gyi snying po 'dus pa yin pas shin tu — 318 —

legs/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin nam nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo lta bu cig gi bklags lung tsam ma mtha' yang nges par thob par bya'o/ /sngar bstan rim gyi khrid zhib par bskyangs pas kyang theg chen gyi snying po thos pa yin mod kyi/rjod byed tshig gi sgo nas theg chen gyi mdo sde gcig ma thos pa'i thabs med/ de nas byang sdom blang ba dngos ni/ rten gsum gyi drung du mchod pa bshams/ slob dpon la lan gsum du phyag byas nas thal mo sbyar te/ slob dpon khyod las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag pa len par 'tshal gyi/ de la gnod pa ma mchis na/ bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du cung zad cig gsan cing stsal ba'i rigs so/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab dgos te/ tshig de blo la yod na slob ma nyid kyis gsol ba gdab/ de min slob dpon nam grogs kyis rjes bzlos bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ rigs kyi bu khyod nyon cig khyod 'di ltar sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang / dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod dam/slob mas kyang 'dod lags zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces bya ste/de la khyod kyis sems bskyed pa brtan pa dang yi dam brtan par bya'o zhes dang /gzhan dang 'gran pa'i ched du ma yin nam/ ma lags/ gzhan gyi nan gyis len du bcug pa ma yin nam/ ma lags/ zhes dri ba dang lan bya/ de nas mchod yon phal cher la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad kyis mchod pa rnams 'bul/ mgon po — 319 —

thugs rje che ldan pa/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pas bstod cing phyag kyang phul/ de nas slob dpon la gus pa dang bcas pas bskul ma'i gsol gdab ni 'di skad ces/ slob dpon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa bdag la myur du stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ ming 'di zhes bya ba'am/ rigs kyi bu khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin nam/ des kyang yin lags/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam/ btab lags/ de nas dngos gzhi ni slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ rigs kyi bu khyod nyon cig /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tshul khrims de dag ci bdag las len par 'dod dam/ de ltar len par 'tshal lo/ /de nas cho ga dngos gzhi ni slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ tshe dang ldan pa'am rigs kyi bu ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang / tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa dang / ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang /tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa dang / da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na da ltar bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir 'gyur pa gang yin pa dang / tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi gang dag dang / tshul khrims sa/nga dag la/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslabs par gyur pa dang / ma byon pa'i byang chub sems — 320 —

dpa' tha myo/sa cad slob par 'gyur ba dang / phyogs bcu dag na da ltar bzhugs pa'i byang tub sems dpa' thams cad da ltar slob bzhin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang / sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims nga las nod dam/ zhes dris pa la/ slob mas rab tu len lags so/ /de ltar lan gsum brjod pas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa skye ba yin no/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mkhyen par gsol ba ni/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i ming 'di zhes bya ba'i/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang bar bya ba lan gsum gyi bar du yang dag par mnos lags te/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba 'dis/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dpang por gyur pas/ 'phags pa'i mchog lkog tu gyur kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mthas gtugs pa'i chos thams cad lkog tu ma gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo/ /zhes lan gsum mo/ /'di slob dpon langs te phyogs bcur me tog gtor nas thal mo sbyar te 'don par snang ngo / /de nas slob mas dkon mchog dang / slob dpon la phyag gsum gsum byas te yang 'dug pa la 'di skad ces khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad — 321 —

kyis bu dang sbun zla'i dgongs pa mdzad de rtag tu srung zhing skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs pa 'di/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la mi smra zhing gsang ba gal che/ deng phyin chad phas pham pa bzhi'am brgyad/ nyes byas bzhi bcu zhe drug la sogs pa rtag tu spangs bar bya/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims srung ba'i thabs dang / lhung ba yang lci'i khyad par dang /de dag phyir bcos pa la yang mkhas par bya'o zhes brjod/chi rgyas pa la spro na bslab bya rags rim tsam skabs 'dir brjod na'ang legs so/ /spyir byang sdom len pa'i lugs 'di la/ bslab bya rnams sngon du nges par byas nas sdom pa phyis len pa yin pas/ skabs 'dir ma brjod kyang cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ro/ /de rjes yon phul dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /des byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga legs par song / bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa'am/ skyes bu gsum gyi khrid bskyangs pa'i grub 'bras/ sems bskyed lag len dang bcas pa tshar ba lags/ chos 'dod pa gang zhig mdo lugs kho na la mos na/ mdo'i nyams len thams cad 'dir 'dus shing / deng sang gi mdo lugs pa gzhan la med pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' babs dang ldan pa yin pas/ chos 'di nyid nyams len gyi gtso bor byed dgos la/ sngags la mos pa rnams kyang 'di la ma zhugs na gsang sngags log par 'gro nyen yod pas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi bzhed gzhung 'di la legs par 'dod pa thams cad kyis bslab par bya'o// //— 322 —

thugs rje'i dbang phyug rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal tshab dam pa rgyal sras mi pham mgon/ /chos kun bdag po 'phags pa thogs med zhabs/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa rgyal sras dbyig gnyen la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog sde la sogs gser gling rgyal po'i bar/ /rgya chen spyod brgyud bla ma mchog rnams dang / /rgyal sras 'jam dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub sogs/ /zab mo lta ba'i brgyud pa mchog rnams dang / /gsang bdag rnal 'byor ma dpal ti snyi sogs/ /nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa mchog rnams la/ /gus pas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs mnga' a ti sha /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'brom ston rin po che/ /mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas po to ba/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mthar son shar ba pa/ /chos bzhin spyod mdzad gtum ston blo gros grags/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i srog shing rdo ston pa/ /ye shes gzi 'od 'bar pa'i dpal ldan gro/ /bslab gsum rnam dag skyo ston seṅge skyabs/ /che dgu'i gtsug rgyan mchims chen nam mkha' grags/ /nus mthu'i mnga' bdag smon lam tshul khrims zhabs/ /'gro don dpag med ze'u grags pa'i mtshan/ /chos mngon rgya mtsho'i mthar son blo bzang mchims/ /rnam dag thugs mnga' gro ston kun rgyal ba/ khrub pa shes rab spang ston chos kyi rje/ /blo mchog dam pa bson nams mchog grub dang / /zab don srol 'dzin dpal ldan don grub zhabs/ /thugs kyis sras gyur gnas brtan bsod nams grags/ /byang chub thugs ldan kun dga' mchog grub zhabs/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog — 323 —

rje/ /skye med don gzigs lung rigs rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /yang na rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi rjes su/ tshul khrims ye shes 'bar ba'i spyan mnga' ba//bla ma dam pas byin brlabs bya yul ba/ /gnas lugs mngon gyur gtsang ba rin po che/ /gdams ngag rgya mtsho'i mthar son mus sman pa/ /de rjes dpal ldan gro nas mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub gyi bar gong bzhin/ de nas/yon tan mchog gyur mkhan chen kun rgyal ba/ /mkhyen rab rnam dag ye shes rin chen dang / /brtson pas rtse gcig sgrub mdzad lha chung ba/ /byams pa'i mtshan can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gzhan yang sne zur ba nas brgyud pa sogs brgyud pa mi 'dra ba mang du bzhugs pas ji ltar sbyar kyang chog la/ gzhung gdams ngag gnyis kyi brgyud pa'i rkang gong du bshad pa nyid gtso bor bya'o/ /de nas 'di skad ces bya ste/dad pa rnam dag skyes bu chung ja'i lam/ /nges 'byung rnam dag skyes bu 'bring gi lam/ /lhag bsam rnam dag skyes bu chen po'i lam/ /rnam dag lam gsum thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba rgyud la ma skyes na/ /ji ltar 'bad kyang tshe 'di'i kha 'dzin can/ /rang blo chos su 'gro skabs mi 'dug pas/ /chos brgyad 'ching ba grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /las 'bras bslu med yid ches ma skyes na/ /chos spyod thams cad bzang rdzu'i ngang du 'chor/ /sgrub pa lhur len skad kyang gzhan ngor thal/ /chos la yid tshes skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /byams dang snying rje rgyud la ma skyes na/ /sgrub la brtson yang theg pa dman par — 324 —

gol/ /'gro ba kun gyi sdug bsngal khur khyer nas/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /spros kun rang grol stong nyid ma rtogs na/ /chos kun sgyu ma lta bur mi shes shing / /mtshan 'dzin dbang song rang sems mi grol bas/ /gnas lugs mthar thugs rtogs par byin gyis brlobs/ /zhes gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /bdag gis chos skor 'dir gtogs pa la/lam sgron rtsa 'grel/ bden gnyis rtsa 'grel/ dbu ma'i man ngag rtsa 'grel gyi bshad pa/ mus sman pa'i 'khrid yig /lum pa ba'i lam rim/ po to pa'i dpe chos rtsa 'grel rnams mkhas mchog byams pa lhun grub las thos/ po to ba'i be'u bum rtsa 'grel dang snar thang pa'i lam mchog rtsa 'grel/ mchims kyi gsung rgyun 'khrid yig gi lung rnams dang bstan rim gyi 'khrid tshul rgyas pa gsung ngag nas nyams khrid kyi tshul du mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho las thos so thor bu thor bu dam pa gzhan 'ga' zhig las kyang thos mod kyi/ chos skor 'di la brgyud pa'i gtso bo gong du smos pa nyid yin no/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi dgongs pa 'di/ /mdo tsam bris las bsod nams gang yod des/ /ma lus lus pa med pa'i sems can rnams/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i gong 'phang myur thob shog /bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa/ skyes bu gsum gyi man ngag gi khrid yig bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o/ /'di ni sgom tshul dmigs pa'i khrid yig yin la/ go don blo la 'god pa'i bshad pa ni/ dam pa snga ma rnams kyis mdzad pa las btsal bar bya'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur — 325 —

rtsa ba'i bla ma dgyes byed mchod sprin dang / /bdag gzhan sgrib sbyang tshogs chen rab rdzogs nas/ /don gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal yon myur spyod shog /ces pa'i bsngo smon nyer bsdus 'di chos mched gu ṇa bha dra nyid la mkho phyir ma tis bris pa'o// //

khrid yig bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal ldan a ti sha'i bka' brgyud dri ma med pa rnams kyi thugs dam gyi mthil ni/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems lags te/ spyir rgyal ba 'brom gyi bka' brgyud rnams la/ sngags dang cung zad 'brel ba'i gdams ngag dang / mdo lugs rang rkang gi gdams ngag brjod kyis mi langs ba zhig bzhugs shing / de thams cad kyang stong pa nyid kyi lta ba phyin ci ma log pa dang yang 'brel mod kyi/ 'on kyang lugs 'di ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi bka' babs shas che bas/ bka' brgyud 'dzin pa'i skyes chen dam pa dpag tu med pa byon pa rnams kyang / bdag gzhan brje ba'i rnam thar kho na khul du byung ba yin/ bka' babs kyi man ngag bstan pa la phyag srol mi 'dra ba ji snyed cig bzhugs pa las/ 'di bya 'chad ka ba chen po'i bzhed pas don bdun gyi gzhung srol lags/ de la sngon 'gro rten gyi chos bstan pa dang gcig /dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba dang gnyis/ rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur pa dang gsum/ tshe gcig gi nyams len dril te bstan pa dang bzhi/ blo 'byongs pa'i 3 dang lnga/ blo spyong gi dam tshig dang drug /blo sbyong gi bslab bya dang bdun no/ /—327—

dang po ni/ thog mar sngon 'gro dag la bslab/ /ces gsungs pas/rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom ste/ de nyid brgyud pa kun snyus kyi ngo bor bsam/ mos gus dung ba dang bcas pas/ bla ma yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen pos bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba yang yang btab pas bla ma de nyid rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying 'od kyi gur khang sgong lkogs kha gyen bstan lta bur bzhugs par bsam la mos gus dung ba zhig bya/ de ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor te/ 'og gi dmigs pa gang sgom pa dang thun gyi sngon du 'di nges par bya/sngon 'gro'i dmigs pa dngos ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khordo ra ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa rnams lags pas/'khrid gsar pa yin na/ bstan rim bzhin du dmigs pa'i rnam grangs shin tu mang pa dang bcas/ zhib mor dpyad nas rgyud la skyes skyes su sgom du 'jug pa lags/ rjes ting nge 'dzin la rang byan chud pa lags na slar cung zad gsal 'debs kyi tshul du/ de thams cad dmigs pa gcig tu dril na/ yang yang mi rnyed pa'i mi lus khyad par can da res rnyed pa las/ ci nas kyang chos nyams su len dgos pa 'dug /de yang nam 'chi cha med pas da lta nyid du chos rang byed/'chi ba'i tshe zas nor longs spyod dgra gnyen gnas lus dbang thang sogs gang yang rjes su mi 'brang / phan gnod sbu tsam yang med/ tshe 'di ltas kyi dngos po thams cad gang legs byung legs la thong cis kyang dgos pa med/ dge sdig —328—

gnyis po ni nges par rjes su 'brang / sdig pa byas zin pa skyur dbang ni med/dge ba rang gis ma byas pa khyer rgyu ni med/ las kyi dbang gis 'gro ba rigs drug gang du skyes kyang / sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa skyed med/ ngan song gsum du skyes na ci tsug byed/ mi skye ba'i gdeng ni gcig kyang med/ da yongs sdig pa srog la bab kyang mi byed/ dge ba la nan tan du bsgrub snyam pa la yang yang sbyong ba yin/ thun mjug tu yan lag bdun pa ci 'grub bya/ thun mtshams su dmigs pa'i don lag len la gdab pa'o/ /gong 'og thams cad du 'di nyid lag len la theb pa gal che'o// //gnyis pa dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyang ba la/ zhar byung don dam byang sems sgom pa dang / gtso bo kun rdzob byang sems bsgom pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ chos kun rmi lam lta bur bsam/ /ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la dpyad/ /gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol/ /ngo bo kun gzhi'i ngang la bzhag /ces gsungs pa'i gnad kyi dril don ni/ sngon 'gro dang rjes sngar ltar las/ dngos gzhi dmigs pa ni phyi nang du snang ba'i dngos po 'di dag thams cad/ snang ba ltar bden bden 'dra bar 'dug kyang rang gi sems kyi 'khrul snang yin/ don la cung zad kyang grub pa med pas rmi lam dang 'dra zhes 'dun pa cung zad sbyangs la/ slar rang sems kyi ngo bo la cer gyis bltas shing / btsal ba na kha dog dbyibs sogs ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pa la/ sems kyang skye med bden med du thag bcad nas/ snying po bden med kyi 'dun pa kho rang gi ngo bo la bltas pas gtad med du yal ba de ka'i ngang du lhod kyis slod la bzhag —329—

go /de nyid yang dang yang du bsgom par bya zhing / thun mtshams sgyu ma'i skyes bur bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thun mtshams spyod lam ci byed kyang / snang ba ci shar de la sgyu ma lta bu med bzhin du snang bar thag bcad pa'i 'dun pa rgyun chags su bskyang ngo / /gnyis pa kun rdzob byang sems la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ byams snying rje sgom pa yin te/ de la dang po skye bla ba la sgom pa ni/ drin che zhing nye ba'i pha ma mdza' bzhes sogs dang / sdug bsngal che ba ngan song gsum dang / g.yin yang sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba'i mi la sogs pa dang / sdig pa che ba tshe 'dir dpal 'byor dbang thang sogs yod srid kyang /sdig pa rngam po byas pas shi ma thag dmyal bar skye nges rnams la thog mar bsgom/ de nas skye dka' ba gnod byed dgra dang gdon rnams la bsgom/ de nas sems can thams cad la bsgom/ de yang dang por rang gi tshe 'di dang dngos kyi mas ji ltar phan gdags pa bsam/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas/ de thams cad kyang de ltar phan 'dogs pa sha stag yin/ de yang skye ba gcig kho na ma yin gyi/ skye ba grangs med pa'i pha ma 'ba' zhig yin pas/ 'di rnams bde ba dang skyid pa zhig bya dgos/da lta mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong bar ma zad/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu rngam po che la 'jug pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ bdag gi pha ma sdug bsngal myong ba 'di kun ci tsug rang bya/ zhes sems can sdug bsngal myong ba la mi bzod pa'i sems gang drag ci drag gi tshul du bya'o// //—330—

gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ gtong len gnyis po spel mar sbyangs/ /de nyid rlung la skyon te bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ snga ma bzhin du byams pa dang snying rje bsgom ste/ snying rje'o zer nas bzhag pas mi phan/ 'di dag gi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal bdag gis blangs/ bdag gi bde ba dang dge ba 'di rnams la sbyin snyam pa byas la/ dbugs nang du rngub pa dang bstun nas/ de thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ dbugs phyir 'gro ba dang bstun nas bdag gi bde dge ci yod pa sems can thams cad la re re byung bar bsam/ de ltar byung ba la dga' ba yang bsgom ste dmigs skor gcig /yang snga ma bzhin nas rlung nang du rngub pa dang bstun/ de thams cad kyi sdig sdug thams cad ko ba skyi gris bzhar ba bzhin du nag 'ub kyis byung sna sgo nas zhugs te rang gi snying gar/thim dbugs phyir 'gro ba na/ rang gi bde ba dang dge ba thams cad zla ba lta bu'i rnam pas sna sgo nas dkar lam gyis song / sems can thams cad la phogade rnams de nyid du sangs rgyas thob par bsam/ de la dga' ba yang bsgom/ de ltar dbugs phyir 'gro nang 'gro thams cad la sbyang bar bya'o// //gsum pa rjes thun mtshams kyi nyams len la/ yul gsum dus gsum dge rtsa gsum/ /spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyangs/ /len pa'i thog ma rang nas brtsams/ /zhes gsungs bas/ yul dga' ba dang yid du 'ong ba la zhen chags/ gnod pa byed pa dang yid du mi 'ong ba la sdang sems/ bar ma la ci yang mi gsal ba'i rmongs ba'i sems rnams 'byung bas/ de dag nam byung tsa na sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dug gsum thams cad/ bdag gi 'di —331—

la 'dus par gyur cig /de rnams nyon mongs pa dang bral bar gyur cig /de rnams kyi nyon mongs kyi gob bdag gi 'dis chod par gyur cig snyam du bsam pas/ dug gsum dge rtsar 'gyur ba'o// dus thams cad du/ bdag la de dag sdig smin zhing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ces pa dang / khe dang rgyal kha thams cad jo bo sems can pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /gyong dang bub kha thams cad bdag gis blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes yang yang brjod cing yid la bsam/gzhan gyi sdug bsngal len pa'i sngon du/ rang la skye ba gzhan du 'gyung 'gyur gyi sdug bsngal thams cad da lta smin par bsam mo// //gsum pa rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba ni/ snod bcud sdig pas gang ba'i tshe/ /rkyen ngan byang chub lam du bsgyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/rkyen ngan thog tu bab pa'i tshe/ byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur dgos pa yin pas/ de yang da lta nas sbyangs dgos te/ de la gsum/ kun rdzob byang sems la brten pa dang / don dam byang sems la brten pa dang / sbyong ba khyad par can la brten pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ le lan thams cad gcig la gda'/ /kun la bka' drin che bar sgoms/ /zhes pas rang la gzhan gyis gnod pa byed pa dang /lus la na tsha sems la sdug bsngal/ rang phyogs gyi sde grong zhig nyams/ grogs kyis bslus pa mi 'dod pa ci byung na yang/ 'di ltar gnod pa byas snyam pa'i 'khon 'dzin dang / gzhan la 'dis lan zhes mi bsam par rang la bsam ste bdag gces 'dzin 'dis las ngan bsags pas lan pa yin/ rang sdug rang gis nyos pa yin/ da bdag gces 'dzin 'di ci rlag la gtong / gnod byed —332—

'di rnams bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyong mkhan yin pas shin tu bka' drin che snyam du yang yang bsgom/gnyis pa ni/ 'khrul snang sku bzhir lta ba yin/ /stong nyid bsrung ba bla na med/ /ces te/ spyir snang ba thams cad dang dgos rkyen ngan ci byung ba de la/'di snang yang bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam pa/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gang la brtags kyang / ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du shes nas/ snang tsam de la ci yang ma yin pa'i mi rtog par bzhag /de yang stong pa chos sku/ gsal ba sprul sku/ zung 'jug longs sku/ dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs kyi mchog /'phral la gang thug sgom du sbyar/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la sbyor ba bzhi ldan ni/ tshogs bsags pa'i sbyor ba/ sdig pa bshags pa'i sbyor pa/ lha 'dre la gtor ma spyin pa/mkha' 'gro chos skyong la mchod gtor 'bul ba'o/ /de yang 'di ltar bsgom ste/bdag sdug bsngal mi 'dod cing bde ba 'dod na/ de phyin ci log tu 'ong ba 'di tshogs bsogs shig /sdig pa sbyongs shig ces pa'i brdar 'dug pas da de ltar bya dgos snyam nas/ yan lag bdun pa dang khyad par dkon mchog gsum la mchod bstod rgya cher bya/ sdig pa bshags bsdams drag tu bya/ thun mtshams thams cad du zang zing yo byad bla ma dang dge 'dun la 'bul ba/ sku gzugs lha khang glegs bam la sogs pa bzhengs pa dge ba'i rkyen 'ba' zhig tu 'gro bar bya/ sdig bshags kyi don du mdo 'don pa gzungs bzla ba ca gdab pa/—333—

phyag dang bskor ba sogs la 'bad/ gnod byed rnams la dmigs nas gtor ma sbyin te/ khyed kyis sngar bdag gi lan chags 'jal du 'ongs/ bu lon khyer bar byed pa shin tu bka' drin che/ da dung bdag brlag par mdzad du gsol/sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa/ nad byur chags nyam nga thams cad nga la spung du gsol/ sems can rnams sdug bsngal dang bral bar mdzod cig ces bya/ chos skyong la mchod gtor phul nas kyang tshe 'di'i bde skyid la gsol ba mi 'debs/ bdag na ba legs na na bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ shi ba legs na shi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sos pa legs na sos par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs re dogs 'gog pa'i gsol 'debs bya'o/ /'phral du bya ba ci byed kyang thams cad sems can la phan pa'i don du byed snyam pa dang / dge ba la sogs pa'i rang gi bya ba legs pa kun la sems can thams cad 'di bas kyang ches lhag pa'i chos kyi bya ba la 'jug par gyur cig snyam pa dang / gal te bya ba ngan pa la dbang med 'jug dgos byung ba'am rnam rtog ngan pa byung na/ sems can thams cad kyi bya ba dang sems ngan pa thams cad bdag gi 'di la 'dus par gyur cig snyam pa bsam pa thag pa nas bya/ za nyal 'chag pa sogs btang snyoms kyi bya ba thams cad kyang /gzhan don gyi sems nyag gcig gis bya'o// //bzhi pa tshe gcig gi nyams len dril te bstan pa la/ man ngag snying po mdor bsdus pas/ /stobs lnga dag dang sbyar bar bya/ /theg wo 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ni/ /stobs lnga 'di yin spyod lam gces/ /zhes gsungs te/ de —334—

la stobs lnga ni/ 'phen pa'i stobs/ goms pa'i stobs/ dkar po'i sa bon gyi stobs/ sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ smon lam gyi stobs rnams yin te/ de yang 'phen pa/ dus 'di nas bzung ste sangs rgyas pa thob bar dang / khyad par ma shi ba'i bar du dang / yang dgos de ring lta bu cig la byang chub kyi sems dang gtan nas ma bral bar bya zhes drag tu bsam/ goms pa ni byang chub kyi sems gnyis drag tu sbyong ba'o/ /dkar po'i sa bon ni/ lus ngag yid gsum dge sbyor dang dge ba'i las la chog tshod mi byed par ci 'grub 'grub sgrub pa'o//sun 'byin pa ni/ da yang bdag 'dzin 'di cis kyang thul ba zhig bya/ sngar yang 'khor bar 'khyams shing sdug bsngal myong ba 'di kho nas lan/ da yang 'di dang 'grogs na skyid med/ da res 'di ci brlag cig bya snyam du 'dun pa yang yang gtong pa'o/ /smon lam ni/ spyir sems can thams cad 'khor ba nas 'dren pa dang / dgos su byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i rgyur dge ba thams cad bsngo zhing smon lam 'debs pa'o/ /'pho ba ni/ dang por yo byad thams cad zhen chags med par/ rang phan yon 'di rang che snyam pa'i yid ches yod pa'i sar dge ba gtong pa/ dkar po'i sa bon gyi stobs dang / de skye ba thams cad du byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i rgyur smon lam 'debs pa smon lam gyi stobs dang /sun 'byin pa'i stobs gong bzhin gsal btab/ 'chi kha bar do skye ba thams cad du byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang ma bral ba byed snyam pa 'phen pa'i stobs dang / spyod lam lus gnad chos bdun nam/ de ma nus na glo g.yas phab/ sna bug g.yas bkag la/ sngon sgom pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis spyong ba ni —335—

goms pa'i stobs so/ /'dir 'gron bu ma nyams pa mes bsregs pa'i thal pa dang / rdo khab len gyi phye ma sbrang smyon la sbyar ba spyi bor byugs pa rdzas kyi 'pho ba'i man ngag yin no// //lnga pa blo 'byongs pa'i tshad ni/ chos kun dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus/ /zhes chos thams cad kyi dgongs pa bdag 'dzin 'dul bar 'dus pas blo sbyong sgom bzhin bdag gces 'dzin je chung du 'gro ba dgos/ dbang po gnyis kyi gtso bo bzung zhes rang blo drang po zhig gis rang la ma khrel ba cig dgos/ yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten/ zhes rkyen ngan sdug bsngal ci byung yang / de la 'jigs skrag dang yi mug ni nam yang mi skye bar/ dge sbyor gyi grogs su 'gro bas/ mi 'dod pa byung ba sogs kyis yid mi bde ba med pa'o/ /yengs kyang thub na 'byongs pa yin/ /zhes ched gtad gnyen pos ma btul/ dran pas ma bzung na yang dgra gnyen bde sdug gnod byed thams cad kyi steng du/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis rtsol med du lhan lhan skye'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag ni blo sbyong gnad du song ba'i tshad de/ 'di rnams yod kyang phyis sgom mi dgos pa ni ma yin no// //drug pa blo sbyong gi dam tshig la/ spyi don gsum la rtag tu bslab// ces pa ni/ blo sbyong khas blang dang ma 'gal ba ste/ sdom gsum nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos pa dang / tho cor ma shor ba ste/ rang la bdag gces 'dzin med par g.yin gyis dkor re ba'i shing gnyan gcod pa/ chu mig dkrugs pa/ lha rten skyel ba/ mdze sprang dang 'grogs pa sogs spangs te/ rnam thar gtsang bar byed —336—

pa dang phyogs rer ma song ba ste/ dgra gnyen phyogs re la blo sbyong ba'am/gdon gyi gnod pa bzod la da lta'i gnod pa mi bzod pa dang / dgra gnyen bzod kyang sdug bsngal mi bzod pa dang / de kun bzod kyang skyid thog tu chos 'chor ba sogs phyogs re ba ma yin par/ bde sdug rkyen bzang ngan sogs thams cad la sbyong ba'o/ /'dun pa bsgyur la rang sar bzhag /ces sngar rang gces gzhan mi gces pa'i 'dun pa de bsgyur la rang thed la 'bor te/ de yang / mngon tshan med par rang sor 'jog /yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya/ /zhes gzhan gyi skyon mi brjod/ /gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo/ /zhes gzhan su la'ang skyon zhig 'dug pa mthong na/ nga rang snang ba ma dag pa yin khong la de lta bu e yod mi shes rang snang ma dag pas/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyang skyon can zhig tu lta ba ji snyed cig byung ba dang 'dra snyam/ rang sems skyon can tshar bcad par bya'o/ /nyon mongs gang che sngon la sbyangs/ /zhes rang rgyud la brtags nas nyon mongs pa gang che ba de'i steng du chos thams cad sbungs dgos/ 'bras bu re ba thams cad spangs/ /zhes blo sbyong bsgoms pas lha 'dre sogs dbang du 'du la re ba'am/ rang skyes bu dam par go ba la re nas/gnod lan du phan byed pa la sgo/sa mgo bskor yin pas spangs/ dug can gyi zas spangs zhes pas ni/ rang sa/ces 'dzin dang dngos po bden 'dzin gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i dge sbyor ni/ dug can yin pas 'dzin pa spangs pa'i sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya'o/ /gzhung bzang ma brten zhes pa gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa la 'khon du 'dzin pa mi bya/ gshags ngan ma rgod ces pa ni/ gzhan skyon gyi —337—

mtshang nas mi 'khru ba'o/ /'phrang ma sgug ces pa ni gzhan gyis gnod pa byas nas lo mang po song yang ma brjed par gnod lan 'khyol dus gnod pa skyel bar mi bya/ gnad la mi dbab ces pa/ mi'i mtshang 'bru ba dang tshig rtsub byed pa dang / mi ma yin gyi srog sngags bzla ba sogs/ gzhan sems la zug rngu bskyed pa'i tshig mi brjod/ mdzo khal glang la mi 'byo zhes/ gzhan la khag ngan bskur ba dang / rang la bab pa'i dka' ba'i bya ba rnams g.yo thabs kyis gzhan la bsgyur bar mi bya/ lha bdud du mi dbab ces pa/ blo sbyong bsgoms nas rang rgyud rengs na lha bdud du babs pa dang 'dra bas/ chos tsi tsam sgom gyin rang rgyud je thul du 'gro bar bya'o/ /lto log mi bya zhes pa/ nad zhi ba gdon zhi ba rkyen ngan bzlog la re nas blo spyong byed na/ gto bcos bon gyer dang 'dra bas snyems 'khrigs re dogs spangs te bsgom/ skyid kyi yan lag tu sdug ma tshol zhes pa ni/yon bdag la na tsha shi chad byung na tshogs gsog yong / grwa rogs grogs mched shi na dpe cha lha rten sogs 'ong / /rang dang mnyam pa shi na nga gcig pu la bsod nams 'ong / dgra shi na 'tsheng snyam pa dang / mdor na rang skyid pa'i phyir du gzhan la sdug bsngal dang mi 'dod pa yong du re ba de spong ba'o// //bdun pa blo sbyong gi bslab bya ni/ rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya/ /zhes zas kyi rnal 'byor/ gos kyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/'dug rme'i rnal 'byor sogs thams cad gzhan la phan pa'i sems 'ba' zhig gis bya'o/ /log gnon thams cad gcig gis bya/ /zhes nyams len byas dus nad mang ba dang / gnod pa kha zug pa dang / mi kha sdang ba dang / sgom gyin nyon —338—

mongs che ru 'gro ba 'dra ba byung na sgom log yin te/ de thams cad la log gnon ni/ mi 'dod pa 'di'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi mi 'dod pa sdug bsngal thams cad 'dus par gyur cig snyam du/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i log gnon kho na bya'o/ /thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis/ /zhes snga dro de ring nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos pa bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag sbyangs/ srod la de'i nyin gos ma gos bltas te/ nyes ltung ma byung na dga' ba bsgom/ byung na bshags bsdams bya/ nyin bar yang dran gsos yang yang bya'o/ /gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya/ /zhes sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa nyams dma' ba gang byung na'ang / sngon gyi las kyi mthur bsam ste zhe zhabang dang sems sdug mi bya/gzhan gyi sdig sdug thams cad blangs/ sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya ste/ sdug bsngal bzod pa dang / bde skyid 'byor ba'i tshe/ bag med dang btang snyoms mi bya bar nor dge phyogs su btang / dbang thang dge bar bsgyur/sems can thams cad bde skyid dang ldan par smon lam btab pas skyid pa bzod par bya'o/ /gnyis po srog dang bsdos nas bsrung / zhes chos spyi'i bslab bya thams cad dang / blo sbyongs dgos kyi bslab bya/ ci byed rang don gyi rnam rtog gi 'khri ba ma zhugs par byed pa gnyis las ma 'das par bsrung ba'o/ /dka' ba gsum la bslab par bya/ /zhes nyon mongs dang por ngo shes dka' bas/ skyes ma thag nyon mongs yin par shes par bya/ bar du bzlog dka' bas/ de ma thag 'phral du spong / mthar rgyun gcod dka' ba la/ phyin chad 'di lta bu gtan nas mi 'byung ba bya snyam pa'i zhe bcad dam po bya'o/ /rgyu'i gtso bo —339—

rnam gsum blangs/ /zhes bla ma dam pa dang mjal ba/ rang rgyud las su rung ba/zas gos mthun rkyen 'dzom pa ste/ dge sbyor skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo gsum po de rang la tshang na/ sems can thams cad kyang de dang ldan par smon lam btab/ma tshang na gang ma tshang ba de nyid kyi steng du/ sems can thams cad kyi de gsum ma tshang ba thams cad sbungs nas/ de rnams de gsum dang ldan par gyur cig ces smon lam btang/ nyams pa med pa rnam gsum sgoms/ zhes bla ma la mos gus nyams pa med pa/ blo sbyong sgom pa la spro ba nyams pa med pa/ sdom pa gsum gyi bslab bya nyams pa med pa rnams la slob/ 'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya/ /zhes lus ngag yid gsum dus rtag tu dge ba dang ma bral bar bya/ yul la phyogs med dag tu sbyangs/ khyab dang gting 'byongs kun la gces/zhes yul sems can rnams dang 'byung ba bzhi sogs bzang ngan thams cad la blos khyab par bya zhing / de yang kha tsam tshig tsam min par blos gting nas 'byongs par bya'o/ /bkol pa rnams la rtag tu bsgom/ /zhes blo sbyong dka' ba'i yul ni sdang ba'i dgra/ gnod pa'i bgegs/ khyad par rang gis phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa byed pa'i log sgrub mkhan rnams la gtso bor blo sbyong bar bya'o/ /rkyen gzhan gang la'ang ltos mi bya/ /zhes khams bzang ngan dang / longs spyod dkon mod dang / mi kha byams mi byams sogs gang la'ang khyad med par blo sbyong ba ste/ gzhan la rag ma las pa'o/ /da res gtso bo nyams su blangs/ /zhes da res tshe 'di las phyi ma'i don gtso che de yang 'khor ba las thar ba gtso che/ rang don pas gzhan don gtso che bshad pa bas sgrub pa —340—

gtso/ de yang mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ti'i lung rigs kyi sgo nas dpyod pa pas/ bla ma'i man ngag la phur btsugs su bsgom pa gtso/ go log mi bya zhes/ chos sgrub pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod par/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong ba'i bzod pa sgom pa bzod pa go log /chos rnam dag byed pa la 'dun pa mi byed par tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor la 'dun pa byed pa 'dun pa go log /thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas chos spyod kyi ro mi myong bar/ zang zing longs sbyod kyi ro myang ba ro myang go logasdig ngo byed pa la snying rje mi byed par/ chos phyir dka' thub byed pa la snying rje byed pa snying rje go log /rang la ltos pa'i mi chos la mi sbyor bar/ tshe 'di'i che thabs la sbyor ba gnyer sems go log /'khor 'das kyi bde skyid dang dge ba byed pa la dga' ba mi bsgom par/ dgra la sdug bsngal byung ba la dga' ba sgom pa ni rjes su yi rang go log ste drug po de spang par bya'o/ /res 'jog mi bya/zhes pa ni/ chos la nges shes ma skyes pas/ res byed res 'ga' mi byed pa blo sna mang pa de spangs/ dol chod du sbyang / zhes rnam g.yeng dang ma 'brel bar blo sbyong nyid la blo langs kyis bsgyur la phyogs gcig tu sbyong / rtog dpyod gnyis kyis thar bar bya/ /zhes rang rgyud la nyon mongs skye ba'i yul yid la byas te/drag tu skye mi skye brtag skye na gnyen po drag tu bsgom/ yang bdag gces 'dzin ci 'dra 'dug blta/ gal te med pa ltar 'dug na chags sdang gi yul zhig bsam nas/ yang gces 'dzin skye bar 'dug na/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i gnyen pos de ma thag spong / yus ma sgom/ zhes pha rol la rang gi drin yod pa dang /rang gi chos nyams su blangs pa rang don yin pas/ de kun gyi yus gzhan la mi —341—

'tshong ba'o/ /kun slong ma sdom zhes pa/ gzhan phyogs la phrag dog mi bya/gzhan gyis rang la gnod pa'am/ dma' phab sogs byas pa la/ sems rgyud 'khrugs pas de'i lan byed pa sogs spangs/ yud tsam mi bya zhes cung zad tsam la dga' mi dga'i rnam 'gyur mi ston/ 'or che ma 'dod/ ces rang gi chos nyams su blangs pa dang / dge ba'i las byas pa la snyan grags yong du re ba spang ba'o/ /snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba ni/ /byang chub lam du bskyur ba yin/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i snying po 'di/ /gser gling pa nas brgyud pa yin/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /'di skabs su/ dzo bo gser gling pa'i gsung gis/ rtog pa thams cad 'bur 'joms te/ /gnyen po thams cad bcom brdeg yin/ /'dun ma thams cad cig 'dril te/ /las rnams thams cad chig chod yin/ /gnyen po rnam byang gi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ rtog pa skyes tsam nyid nas/ stong nyid du 'bur 'joms bya/ nyon mongs skyes ma thag tu gnyen pos thog rdzis bya/ 'dun ma thams cad bdag 'dzin ci brlag dang sems la ci phan du sgril/ lam chig chod de/ sa lam rtsi rgyu med/ bdag 'dzin rnams brlag nas sangs rgyas pa yin/ rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ /'dre gdon rgyal ba'i sprul ba yin/ /na tsha sdig sgrib kyi chags shing yin/ /sdug bsngal chos nyid kyi yo langs yin/ /kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob sogs gong dang 'dra/ mi 'dod pa'i rkyen byung na dge bskul yong / gdon zhud byung na tshogs gsogs dang thugs dam —342—

'phel/ na tsha byung na sdig sgrib 'dag /sdug bsngal rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /chos nyid yin pas nyams su blangs chog /de kun byung na byung gi bzang / /zhes nyams su blangs/ skyid kyi gnya' gnon chen po yin/ /sdig gi 'jug sdud r+ṣa po yin/ /mi mkho shos la 'dod thog yin/ /ltas ngan g.yang du len pa yin/ /gnyen po log gnon gyi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob sogs gong bzhin/ skyid skyid 'dra na/ chos min gyi bya ba sna tshogs byed 'dod nas 'ong bas/skyid pa'i ngo bo la bltas na skyid pa dngos por grub pa med/ skyid par snang ba tsam de sems can thams cad la spyin/ rang tsho thub par byas pas gnya' gnon yin/ cung zad gcig sdug na yi mug ga chad par 'dug /de la sdug par snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma dang 'dra/ btsal bas ma rnyed/ snang ba de'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi mi 'dod pa thams cad sbungs/ sdug bya sdug byed stongs pas mjug sdud chen po yin/ ltas ngan dang cho 'phrul byung na/ rnam rtog sna tshogs 'char te/ de la 'di kha dgos rgyu yin/ bdag gces 'dzin 'di'i steng du ltas ngan thams cad sbungs shig snyam pa byed cing / snyems 'khrigs ma zhugs par byas la bzhag /mi mkho ba thams cad thog tu bab na/ bdag gces 'dzin khyod la 'di rang 'kho ba yin/ 'di brlag tu chug cig snyam la blo bde 'bol gyis bzhag /gzhan yang 'di gcig pu 'dug na skyo rogs yin/ las ngan dbang gi sems lhongs byung / nang du bsdad na phyir 'gro snying 'dod/ ri la bsdad na klung la 'bab snying 'dod/ klung du phyin na ri khrod dran pa sogs 'byung ste/ sems dpa'i rim pa las/ yang yang sdod sa rang spo zhing / khres pa mi dga' skyo ba —343—

na/ /rang la bshags 'debs 'di ltar bya/ khyod kyi gshis lugs 'di 'dra na/ /gnas mal 'di yang yang rab yin/ /blo sems 'di kun bde mo yin/ /gzhan du khyed kyis sdug sran 'dis/ /dmyal bar ma skyes khar rje che/ /btso bsreg ma myong khar rje che/ /zhes sogs dang / gzhan yang 'jigs pa rab bsams te/ /bdag la khrel brdas chen po bya/ /lto la gyong bskur dka' thub bya/ /gos la gyong bskur dman cha blangs/ /bde sdug khyad bsad gnyen po bsgom/ /na na nad g.yog yin te/ na tsha byung na nad g.yog la zhabang / de la 'di las drag pa zhig byed thang ba la/ 'di la nga drin che ba yin te snyam yus pa'i dus su/ na ba 'di bdag tu bzung bas lan pa yin/ gzhan sus kyang ma lan/nad g.yog dang sman gyis phan na lta/ sngar 'di ma byas zhes bya ba med/ da yongs gces 'dzin can khyod la 'di ltar byung ba snying tshim zhes bzhag pas blo bde 'bol gyis 'gro/ bdag ni skyon gyi rtsa ba ste/ /rgyangs kyis skyur ba'i chos cig yin/ /gzhan ni yon tan gyi 'byung khungs te/ /cangs te len pa'i chos cig yin/ /gnyen po mjug sdud kyi chos gnyis te/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su dgos pa yin/ /rang skyon rgyangs kyis skyur ba dang / /gzhan don la cangs kyis 'jus pa gnyis su blo sbyong thams cad 'dus pa yin no// log cer log la cer cer ltos/ /shig ge shig la 'bol le zhog /des ni mi 'ching grol bar 'dod/ /rnam rtog gang shar de la sems phyir yengs su song ba 'di/ nang du log cer log /ngo bo la cer gyis ltos/ de kha'i ngo bo la shigs kyis shigs la lhod kyis —344—

bzhag /de ltar na theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi gdams ngag jo bo'i bka' brgyud yin nges khrid tshul mtha' yas pa zhig bzhugs na'ang / don bdun gyi gzhung shing 'dir nyams len thams cad 'du ba yin/ zhes pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rje btsun bla ma dam pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos de/ rje btsun dpal stag lung pa chen po dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ rje ngag dbang kun dga' legs grub bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi blo sbyong gi khrid yig bsnyel byang / 'dus la ma tshang pa med pa zhig yi ge'i lam du gyis shig ces bka' stsal spyi bos nod nas snying po'i don tsam bkod pa ste/rang lo nyer drug tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig la gnas mchog rnam rgyal rab brtan du'o/ /yi ge pa ni kun dga' dar rgyas so/ /bkra shis/ zhus dag /'dir smras pa/ rje btsun mar me mdzad dpal nas brgyud pa'i/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i blo sbyong byed pa'i thabs/ /don bdun grangs su nges pa'i man ngag 'di/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i nyams len gnad kyi mthil/ /yongs su grags pa'i legs pa 'di dag gi /'grel pa 'jam mgon kun dga' snying po yis/ /mdzad pa'i gzhung 'di'i mi zad chos spyin 'di/ /tshul khrims bzang pos bskrun pa'i dge ba yis/ /ma rgan 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la byang chub sems mchog skyes gyur cig /pukhye shis bris pa'o// //—345—

oṃ swā sti/ de la lam rnams kyi rim pa mdor bsdus pa'i dbang du byas te/ yan lag bdun pa'i rim pa'o// de yang phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras bcas 'gro la phan mdzad pa/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs mnga' ba/ /kun la dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /deng nas brtsams te dus rtag tu/ /bdag dang ma lus sems can rnams/ /'dren pa mchog dang mya ngan 'das/ /'phags pa'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /me tog rnams dang bdug pa mar me dri/ /rnam mang zhal zas rol mo gos rnams dang / /byas dang byed 'gyur dge ba dpag med pas/ /rnam 'dren sras dang bcas la mchod par bgyi/ /rab med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho cher lhungs pa'i/ /rmongs pa bdag dang mtha' yas bdag gi mas/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga la sogs/ /nyes par spyad pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /so so skye bo lam ma zhugs pa dang / khyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong dgra bcom/ /rang rgyal rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /byas dang byed 'gyur dge la'ang rjes yi rang / /zhi bar bzhed pa'i 'bum phrag rgyal ba rnams/ /srid pa ji srid zhig pa de srid bzhugs/ /nyon mongs dug gis rnam nyams sdug bsngal gyis/ /ngan skyugs khung bu dag la rab chags pa/ /'di dag zhi ba'i dga' tshal mthong ba'i slad/ /bdud rtsi'i dam chos stsol cig bcom ldan kyai/ /ma lus phyogs bcu'i 'dren pa bdag la —346—

dgongs/ /bdag gis deng nas brtsams te bdag gi ma/ /mi brtan mtha' yas 'di rnams yongs bzungs shing / de la gnod pa ci yang mi bgyi'o/ /bdag ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir mi gnas/ /zhi ba'i 'brog dgon der yang bdag mi 'gro/ /lus pa med pa'i 'gro rnams byang chub phyir/ /bdag ni bla med byang chub nges 'thob bya/ /'di ltar bgyis dang ma lus dge ba yis/ /bla med byang chub gsal bar mthong bar shog /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin ni/ /thams cad sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /rnal 'byor pa gang de rig 'dod/ /des ni 'di ltar bsgom par bya/ /grong ngam dgon par 'dug na yang / /byang chub sems ni ma nyams pas/ /byang chub spyod pa bla med pa/ /yid kyis kyang ni rtag tu spyad/ /'di ltar khyim ni nyes mang can/ /nam yang sdig pa'i las kyi gnas/ /'jol sgeg 'thab dang glag cor can/ /rtag tu zil gyis gnon byed mang / /kye ma nam zhig 'di las thar 'gyur zhes/ /blo ldan de ni dben pa tshol bar byed/ /nyes mang khyim de gdon mi za bar spangs/ /gnod pa med pa'i nags su de 'gro ste/ /mang ngam nyung ngur thos kyang rgyal sras rnams/ /rtag tu sgom pa lhur len byis pa rnams/ /thos pa tsam gyis 'di na khengs par byed/ /de ni 'tsho ba pa bzhin rnam par nyams/ /de nas blo dang ldan pa de/ /dge ba'i bzhes gnyen bsten pa yis/ /dam pa'i chos ni tshol bar byed/ /man ngag mchog gi nor blangs nas/ /nags 'dabs bab col skye bo yis/ /nam yang 'grod pa med pa'i gnas/ /mi mchog de ni der song nas/ /drang po'i lus kyis gnas par bya/ /sems kyis sems ni bzung byas —347—

nas/ /'dir ni dbang po rnam par bsdu/ /rnam rtog mang ༷ pos (po ka rnam nyams tshe/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin zhi bar bya/ /yid ni rnam par g.yeng gyur pa/ /de tshe dran pas 'dul bar bya/ /'dod yon spyad pa dran la sogs/ /de tshe dpal dang lus 'dod pa/ /'dus byas yud tsam gar mkhan dang / /dus kyi sprin dang glog 'gyu mtshungs/ /'khor ba sprul gyi ro 'dzin na/ /kye ma bdag ni g.yeng bas gnas/ /gzhan yang zhe sdang 'dod chags rmongs/ /chom rkun 'jigs chen 'di dag rnams/ /byams dang rten cing 'brel 'byung dang / /mi sdug ting 'dzin dpung gis bcom/ /sems ni sgo gtan bcug pa ltar/ /rnam rtog rlung gis g.yo ba med/ /'dod pa rnams la dga' mi 'gyur/ khren tu sbyangs nga/'i bde ba 'thob/ /de nas theg pa chen po las/ khres rab pha rol phyin gang gsung sdo// /de las 'byung bzhin blo ldan ni/ /gdams ngag ldan pas sgom par byed/ /sā la'i myu gu 'ja' tshon ltar/ /rten cing 'byung ba ngo mtshar rmad/ /chos kun bden pas stong pa'o zhes/ /yang yang rang bzhin de bsgom bya/ /dran dang shes bzhin ldan pa yis/ /spyod lam kun tu bag yod bsten/ /bya ba kun la'ang ci zhig ltar/ /sems mi g.yo zhing chos rnam 'byed/ /de nas gzhan yang / blo ldan khyim na 'dug gam/ yang na bas mthar 'dug kyang rung /mnyam par 'jog kyang rung / 'dod pa la spyod kyang rung / yun ring mor bslabs pa'am/ las dang po pa yin yang rung ste/ re zhig sems can thams cad la snying rje bsgom par bya'o/ /gang ci yang rung ba gang la bsad par sems pa rnams la/ dge ba'i bzhes gnyen dang pha dang mar 'du shes par bya'o/ /—348—

gal te de khong du chud par ma gyur na/ gzugs brje zhing bsgom par bya ste/yang na re zhig byams pa bsgom par bya zhing phyi mas nges par snying rje la nan tan du bya ste/ gzhan du na byang chub kyi sems rgyas par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar 'gro ba kun byang chub la 'god par 'dod pas snying rje la goms par bya zhing / gnod pa dang sdug bsngal bzod pa la nan to du 'bad nas/ rim gyis na pha rol tu phyin pa drug la yang dag par bslab par bla'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' snying rje la bslab pas bslab par byed pa rnams/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod par bya/ brjed par bya/ bsnyen par bya zhing bsgom par bya'o/ /lam mdor bsdus pa rdzogs so// //bdag gis 'di bris dge ba yis/ /sems can tshogs rnams ma lus pa/ /myur du bla na med byang chub/ /rtag cing bde ba myur thob shog /dge slong kun dga' snying pos bris/ /maṅga laX/ zhus dag /—349—

oṃ swā sti ge ra sdu/ gang zhig dngos kun 'dab brgya las/ /ye shes sbrang rtsir spyod byed pa/ /de la 'khrul bar sems byed na/ /rigs pas 'bad de gsal bar bya/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i sde snod kyang / /mdor na rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur/ khyu yi theg pa'i sde snod dang / /'bras bu rig 'dzin sde snod do/ /dang po'ang rgyal ba'i sras kyi lam/ /rdzogs dang ma rdzogs dbye ba yis/ /pha rol phyin dang theg dman gyi/ /sde snod gnyis su bstan pa yin/ /bdag nyid nges par ཿnga 'dod dang / /'gro ba sgrol 'dod blo chen dang / khren tu dbang po rnon po yis/ /gdul bya rnams la dgongs nas ni/ /nyan thos pha rol phyin pa dang / /sngags kyi theg pa bstan pa yin/ /tshegs chung dus ni myur ba sa /byang chub thob 'dod de dbang rno/ /sku yi rnam pa mi sgom zhing / /bde ba dam pa med pas na/ /grangs med gsum du ngal byas kyang / /da dung mthar thug thob ma yin/ /mdo las bshad pa'i che ba dag /byang chub sems dpa' la yod min/ /de phyir tshul gnyis thob bya yi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la khyad par med/ /sangs rgyas gnyis su 'dod na ni/ /theg pa bzhi pa cis ma yin/ /mthar thug theg pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /bzang ngan med na ci zhig khyad/ /cung zad mngon rtogs khyad yod kyang / /phal cher mtshungs phyir gcig ce na/ /nyan thos dang ni —350—

rang rgyal gyi/ /theg pa'ang gcig tu smra bar byos so/ /thob bya'i yul la khyad med kyang / /lam des thob dang mi thob khyad/ /rang bzhin stong nyid sgom tsam la'ang / khyad par yod pa ma yin no/ /pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs las/ /spros bral chos sku'i rnam pa dang / /mthun pa lam du byed mod kyi/ /gzugs sku'i rnam pa lam byed med/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas bde ba zhes/ /bshad kyang de yi lam ma bstan/ /'bras bu rgyu las gzhan min phyir/ /'di ni sngags kyi che ba yin/ /sbyin sogs bsod nams tshogs rdzogs shing / /smon lam mthu las gzugs kyi sku/ /'gyung bar 'gyur na chos sku yang / /smon lam mthu las cis mi 'byung / /goms pa sngon du ma gyur pas/ /de mi 'byung na gzugs sku yang / /'byung zhes brjod par nus ma yin/ /lha ru skye ba tshul khrims kyi/ /mthu las byung gi lha nyid dang / /rnam pa mthun pa ci zhig dgos/ /de phyir lhag pa min zhe na/ /skye 'di nyid la tshul khrims kyis/ /lha ru 'gyur ba 'ga' yang med/ /byis pa'i mig dag 'phel ba las/ /mthu ldan ring du mthong bar 'gyur/ /rnam smin rgyu ni 'ba' zhig gis/ /gzugs sku sgrub par 'dod pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bar srid nyid/ /longs spyod rdzogs par skyed byed dam/ /bsod nams rnam smin byed sems kyi/ /lus mchog mtshan dpes brgyan pa 'byung / /de yi rgyu mthun 'bras bu ni/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku kho na/ /'on kyang sgom pa med pa'i phyir/ /skye ba gcig la sku mi 'grub/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba'i sku sgom pa/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran yin gsungs na/ /lha yi rnam pa sngags bskyed 'di/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran cis ma yin/ /de phyir 'di ni —351—

bsten bya ste/ /pha rol phyin la med pas na/ /des kyang thabs mang nyid snye ri 'gyur te/ /de bstan gang yin 'di ru yod/ /stong nyid lha yi snang ba yis tha mal snang ba 'gog byed de/ /rnam pa 'gal ba'i mthu nyid blo yi zhe/ /spyin sogs dge bas de ltar min/ /sems ni sgom pa'i gzugs su snang / /sems kyi tshul las lus 'khru/ba pas/ /sgom pas tshe 'dir mi 'gru/ba min/ /lhan skyes bag chags zlog pa'i phyir/ /stong nyid sgos kyi bde ba min/ /ji snyed shes phyir shes bya ni/ /kun la slob ces 'gal bar smra/ /stong nyid rang bzhin tshul zhugs na/ /bde ba'ang kun rdzob tshul la zhugs/ /de phyir sgom ste snying rje bzhin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /mi shes 'khrul phyir sdug bsngal na/ tags na bde ba kun 'thob phyir/ /rang bzhin bde ba cis ma yin/ /mi rtag pa las sdug bsngal gyi/ /'du shes 'khrul med skye bar gsungs/ /rang bzhin 'jig med la bde ba'i/ /'du shes 'khrul ba med pa 'byung / /bde min bde bar 'du shes na/ /'du shes 'khrul ba ci phyir min/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung la sogs pa/ /ji snyed chos kun sgom byed na/ /bde ba kho nas ci zhig nyes/ /sngags dang las tshogs dngos grub sogs/ /thabs mang gzhan yang 'dir yod do/ /dka' ba med par myur 'grub pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /'dod chags lam byed mi byed kyang / /mdo dang sngags kyi tshul la mthong / /sngags dang rgyu sbyor lam gyis ni/ /dngos gzhi ston dang mi ston khyad/ /bde dang myur ba'i khyad par gyi/ /rdo rje theg pa gtso bo'i gtso/ /dpal ldan rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /'di ni yongs su bstan pa yin/ /'di ni mdo sder shin tu rgyas/ /ma mo —352—

dang ni 'dul ba'ang yod/ /rig 'dzin sde snod gas zhig ni/ /ma mthong phyir na 'di kho zu/ /drag shul bud med sbyor sngags sogs/ /'di dag thabs mkhas dag la gnang / /dgag bya gtso bor ldan pa na/ /sngags las kyang ni de dag bkag /byang chub sems la reg sogs las/ /ting 'dzin thob ces mdo las bshad/ /de dgug sngags bzlas sgrib byang ste/ /myur nas grol ba ston ces rigasungs/ /33 rdo rje theg pa'i khyad par 'phags pa bstan pa ste le'u dang pho// //lha yi rnal 'byor sogs bde ba/ /sgom gyi stong nyid de ltar min/ /gzugs kyi sku ni de yis 'grub/ /lta ngan rang bzhin shes pas bzlog /de nyid mi shes de skad smra/ /bdag 'dzin lhan skyes ma spangs na/ /thar ba thob pa ga la zhig /de yang rnam pa 'gal ba'i spongs/ khres rab de nyid bsgom bya ste/ /gsal snang rab kyi mthar thug 'gyur/ /'di yis bdag 'dzin bzlog 'gyur gyi/ /rjes su dpag pa skyes pas min/ /yin na shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /'bad med grol bar mi 'gyur ram/ /chos sku ma sgom 'grub 'gyur na/ /gzugs kyi sku yang cis mi 'grub/ /gzugs sku chos sku med na min/ /sems kyi yon tan mthar thug pa/ /med par rnam smin mthar thug med/ /ye shes tshogs ni sgom byed na/ /bsod nams lhag par 'grub par 'gyur/ khres rab sgom pa'i nyin gcig kyang / /gzhan gyis bskal pa du mar min/ kha cig rdzogs sangs rgyas pa yi/ /gnyis med ye shes rgyu mthun las/ /'byung phyir spros bral bsgom bya yi/ /thabs gzhan mkhas la mi dgos la/ /zab mos 'jigs rnams drang phyir —353—

dang / /skur 'debs chad lta dgag pa dang / /bzlas sgom zhi sogs bsgrub phyir te/ /mchog 'dod pa la de mi dgos/ /sprin dang byi ba dkar nag dpes/ /rnam rtog thams cad chos nyid la/ khren tu sgrib byed yin no lo/ /'khrul shes phyir na rnam g.yeng can/ /rnam par rtog phyir ting 'dzin med/ /de ma yin la der 'dzin can/ /gsal bar snang la min zhes zer/ khri / mthun med na gnyis med kyi/ /ye shes nam yang 'byung med na/ /sngon nas 'gro kun 'phags par 'gyur/ /zhi sogs 'grub par mi 'gyur na/ /mchog 'dod 'di las tha shal ci/ /'grub na stong nyid ston par rigs/ /rnam rtog des ni mngon sum du/ /chos nyid mthong ba ma yin kyang / khyur 'gyur dad pa la sogs bzhin/ /kun rtog kun gyis sgrib ces btags/ /yang na mi rtog ye shes de/ /'bad med skyes nas kun grol 'gyur/ /'dun pa med na 'jog med pas/ /yang na nam yang skye mi srid/ /'dun sems kyis kyang cis mi sgrib/ /tha mar sgrib kyang re zhig de/ /mi rtog sgrub phyir rten zhe na/ /thabs gzhan dag kyang cis mi bsten/ /rig pas dpyod pa rnams la ni/ /dgra ltar lta ba kun la yang / /rig pa 'di ni 'jug 'gyur te/ /blo ldan rnams kyis dpyod par gyis/ /bskyed rim mtshan bcas rdzogs rim sogs/ /spros pa yin phyir spong pa dang / /g.yul dang bud med don gnyer sogs/ /rang ngo shes nas rung ngo zhes/ /'di 'dra'i tshig la'ang bden par 'dzin/ /phyogs 'di'i blun po ma gtogs pa/ /yul g.yin dag gi blun po yang / /'di la ga zhar cis mi byed/ /rang ngo shes na nyon mongs ni/ /blang du rung na spros bcas dge rang ngo shes pas cis mi byed/ /rang ngo —354—

shes pa mnyam po la/ /dge ba ci'i phyir na spong / /phung po rnam dpyad stong nyid ni/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /rnam pa kyen gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ba min/ /sbyin sogs yongs su goms pa las/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid 'grub/ /zab mo ge cig pu sgom pas min/ /blo dman don du gsungs pa'i phyir/ /las dang po la dgos par grub/ /rnal ma'i sbyor ba rtogs nas ni/ /bcos ma mi bya zhes gsungs la/ /chu yi pha rol ma phyin pas khri/ gzings 'dor ba blun po'i lugs/ /dge ba rtsa ba ma rdzogs par/ /stong pa'ang mthar phyin min zhes bstan/ /rnam par rtog cing ting 'dzin dag /'grub mi nus na zhi gnas kun/ /rang byung nyid du skye bar 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin phal gyi dmigs pa yang / /rnam par rtog dang bcas pa yin/ /don dam la ltos 'khrul spong na/ /sems dang sems byung kun 'khrul bas/ /'tshang rgya ba dag med par 'gyur/ /mi sdug zad par la sogs pa/ /log par 'khrul yang de bsgom bya/ /gsal bar snang ba mthong ba na/ /rtog las rtog med skye ba ste/ /'dod ldan rnams la chags yul bzhin/ /dpyod dang sgom pa 'bras dang bcas/ /bud med gzugs kyang 'dod ldan la/ /res 'ga' gsal gyi rtag min ltar/ /lha yang brtan par mi 'gyur min/ /de ni rnam g.yeng goms pa dang / /'di ni rtse gcig tshul gyis sgrubs/ /cha gcig mthong tshe gzhan min pas/ /sku yang 'grub pa med snyam na/ /so sor rtog pa gnyis med kyang / /gsal bar snang ba gcig char snang / /gcig car dbang shes lnga 'jug bzhin/ /rtog pas cig car mi 'dzin kyang / /de yi rgyud 'gyur shin tu yod/ /'byud tshe 'o byed mi rig —355—

cing / /gdong ltas nu ma mi mthong sogs/ /mi mthong 'dod spyod med par 'gyur/ /kun rdzob don dam ma phyed par/ /lha dag dga' ba'i spyod la ltos/ /bsam pa gang dang gang gis ni/ /mi rnams yid ni yang dag sbyor/ /de de'i rang bzhin 'gyur lha mo/ /sna tshogs gzugs can nor bu 'dra/ /zhes pa'ang drang du gsungs pa yin/ /31 lam phyogs re ba dgag pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //rdo rje theg pa 'di la ni/ /nyon mongs lam du byed mthong ste/ /mi mkhas nyon mongs spangs zin nas/ /nyon mongs lta bur spyod ces 'dod/ /bkag pa'ang spyod par gnang ba ste/ /rnal 'byor de nyid ldan gyur na/ /ngan zos ngan spyod thams cad kyang / /sgrib pa dag tu yongs mi 'gyur/ /'on kyang dmigs pa'i lta ba can/ /rab tu zhen pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyis ni/ /lung bzhin rigs pas gsal bor dbye/ /ded dpon snying rje chen po yis/ /thabs mkhas ldan pas g.yo can bsad/ /de yis bskal mang tshogs rdzogs shing / khye'u skar mar gyur ba'i tshe/ /tshong dpon bu mor longs spyod pa'ang / /byang chub nye ba'i mchog gyur ces/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin shes pa dang / /snying rje chen po'i mthu yang bstan/ /tshangs spyod lam gyis mngon par brgyan/ /bud med khrag ci khrig kun sems rgyu/ /chos rnga dbyangs chen rab sgrog pa/ /theg pa'i dam pas bdag bstan gsol/ /de skad sdong po bkod par gsungs/ /grong khyer skye bo'i mi gtsang lud/ /bu ram shing gi zhing la phan/ /byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ /sangs rgyas chos kun skyed pa'i gzhi/ /—356—
