'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'dzin pas dug tu 'gyur ba yin/ /dug ni nye bar zhi gyur na/ /dug ni dug med byas pa yin/ /bdud rtsi rim gyis brten na ni/ /bdud rtsi nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /blun po gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /de yis mkhas pa yongs grol zhes/ /byang chub rnam par bsgom na ni/ /'di dag thams cad phyin ci log /gang gis rmongs pa 'ching 'gyur zhing / /ngu 'bod mtha' ni de 'gro ba/ /de nyid kyis ni grol gyur cing / khres rab stobs kyis bde ba 'thob/ /yid 'ong bde ba'i 'bras bu ni/ /bla med gsal ba blo yis mthu/ /'bras bu don gnyer rgyu bsgrub na/ /der ni blo ldan su zhig 'gog /dka' thub sdom pa mi bzad pas/ /lus ni skams shing sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni sems g.yeng te/ /g.yeng bas dngos grub gzhan du 'gyur/ /lus dang sems ni brtan byas na/ /bde ba thams cad brtan par 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag dang sems rnams ni/ /bde bar gnas na byang chub 'thob/ /gzhan du dus min 'chi ba dang / /dmyal bar nges par 'tshed par 'gyur/ /dka' thub sdom pa mi bzad pas/ /bsten pas 'grub par mi 'gyur gyi/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad kyis/ /bsten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /bkag pa dag kyang byed pas na/ /bya dang bya min rnams spangs te/ /pad+ma la ni 'dam gyis bzhin/ /ngo bo nyid shes gos mi 'gyur/ /chags pas 'jig rten 'ching 'gyur ba/ /'dod chags nyid kyi rnam grol 'gyur/ /'dod chags rnyog med chags bral 'joms/ /bde ba thams cad sbyin par byed/ /gang zhig dge slong dngos gnas dang / /gang yang rtog ge la dga'i —357—

mi/ /gang zhig rgan por gnas gyur pa/ /de la de nyid bstan mi bya/ /las kyi phyag rgya gang spangs nas/ /byang chub sems ni rab brtan pa/ /gzhan gyis mtshon pas mi ༷ (thob ka mthong ste/ /dang po'i las pas rig bya ba/ /thog ma bar mtha' dri med pa/ /gnas te gzhan du nus ma yin/ /bdag tu dmigs par mi bya zhing / /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid bzhugs/ /de ltar bsam nas rnal 'byor gyis/ /dbang pos gang la'ang brnyas mi bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad cing gus/ /byang chub sems kyis rnam par brgyan/ /sems can kun la rjes su brtse/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom la gnas/ /gzhi mnyam khrag dang sha nyid dag /byang chub sems dang rab bsres la/ /chu chen dang ni yang dag ldan/ /de nyid rig pa'i rtag tu bza'/ /mi khyi rta dang ba lang sgron/ /sna chen dang ni khur bskyed kyi'ang / /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /de nyid grub phyir bza' bar bya/ /srid gsum las byung bsad bya wo / /pha rol nor ni 'phrog pa dang / /gas gyi bud med la 'dod spyod/ /rdzun gyi tshig ni smra bar byed/ /thabs chen yang dag ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor 'jig rten don sgrub pa/ /de la bya ba mi bya med/ khres rab thabs dang ldan pa la/ /sdig par grags pa yongs med ces/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyis gsung / /rnal 'byor pa yi sems sbyangs phyir/ /bu mo la sogs rjes su gnang /27 /rtog pa'i chu yis gang ba yi/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho wo po ni/ /rdo rje theg la ma zhon par/ /su zhig pha rol 'gro bar 'gyur/ khren tu mi bsrun dgra bo dag kha cig gsug gis bslus byas te/ /dpa' bo g.yul du 'joms par —358—

byed/ /pho brang bsrung bas thul ma yin/ /'dod chags rtog pa thag bsrings pas/ /de 'joms shin tu nus ma yin/ /de nyid rang bzhin shes byas nas/ /drung du bsnyen pas 'joms par byed/ /'di ltar kun nas slong ba'i sems/ /nyon mongs can dang yul de la/ /de ru 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing / /bdag nyid dge slong 'du shes can/ /las de la yang der shes na/ /phas pham la sogs lhung ba zhes/ /dpang gyur mkhyen pa'i gzigs rnams gsungs/ /chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro zhing / /yid ni gtso bo yin zhes gsung sa/ /dge slong rang gi pha rgan la/ /myur ldong zhes ni bskul ba'i phyir/ /phul ba'i de ni shi gyur kyang / /mtshams med spyor ba ma yin no/ zhan tu na ba'i dgra bcom pas/ /dge slong nad g.yog byed pa la/ /nga yi mgrin pa sdoms zhes bskul/ /de shi na yang skyon med bstan/ /'du shes gzhan gyis gzhan dag gishi yang nyes de mi spyod par/ /'di 'dra lung las gsal bor bstan/ /de phyir sems dge nyes pa med/ /de 'dus bya ba'i blo yis ni/ /mchod rten bzhigs kyang nyes med de/ /nye ba'i mtshams med byas pas kyang / /bsod nams phung po 'ba' zhig go /de phyir bsam pa'i rtsa ba la/ /bsod nams sdig pa rnam par gnas/ /dga' mgur spyod pa'i rmi lam dag /'dul la nyes pa med par bstan/ /dngos dang rmi lam dag tu yang / /sdig dang bsod nams kun mtshungs te/ /mos pas dge ba 'phel 'gyur sogs/ khres rab pha rol phyin par gsungs/ /lus dang ngag gi spyod pa'i tshul/ /rmi lam snang ba 'bras med nyid/ /gang du yid kyis rnam g.yo ba/ /rmi lam sad la bye brag med/ /chos —359—

rnams rmi lam ltar shes na/ /lus ngag yid kyi nyes las grol/ /ser skya bzang mo dge slong ma/ /ma skyes dgra yis log zhugs kyang / /de la phas pham med par bstan/ /g.yo can lnga brgyas bsgrod gyur kyang / /dge slong ma ni bzang mo skyes/ /nyes pa med ces bstan pa yin/ /nyon mongs spangs pa ma yin kyang / /dge slong gnyid kyis non pa la/ khreng thun mo yis btsal ba yang ma tshor bas na nyes med gsungs/ /klu mo dang ni ce spyang mor/ /reg pa bdag gir ma byas te/ /'dod spyod pham par ma gyur pas/ /'khrig pa la dngos gtso bo ste/ /'du shes gtso bor med ces pa/ /dgos pa gzigs pas gsungs pa ste/ /sngon gyi bstan la bud med dag /rab byung dgag bya med ces pa'ang /dngos po dag la khyad med pas/ /bsam dang 'du shes khyad par bstan/ /'jig rten sna tshogs 'dod min gyi/ /'dod pas kun rtog yin pas na/ /'jig rten sna tshogs gnas kyang ni/ /brtan rnams 'dun pa 'dul zhes gsungs/ /rang bzhin shes pas 'bro/da yon la/ /spyod pa mdo sder rjes su gnang / /'du shes rnam par bzhag byas la/ /bdag dang gzhan du mi shes pas/ /de la der shes rnam par log /yul dang yul min mnyam sgom pas/yul la nges pa'i 'du shes med/ /gang yang rnam par rtog med pa/ /de la nyes pa yod min te/ /ji ltar sems med shing sogs bzhin/ /rgyu yi dus na 'dod chags dag /yod kyang nyes 'gyur ma yin te/ /'dod chags ldan pa gnyid log bzhin/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas/ /dge slong dge bsnyen khyim pa dang / /bud med sogs su 'du mi shes/ /rdo shing 'du shes bud med la/ /reg —360—

pa nyes med 'dul las bstan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su 'du shes na/ /ci phyir nyes pa bstan par 'dod/ /ji ltar snang ba thams cad ni/ /'khrul ba nyid du rnam gnas shing / /ci tsam 'du shes kun 'khrul na/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul rnam phye ba'ang / /nges don mi shes ngor gsungs pa'o/ /de nyid rig la 'du shes med/ /'du shes thams cad 'khrul bar mthong / /'dod la dga' ba ma yin te/ /bde ba'i phyir ni bsten pa dang / /rang gi lha yi bdag nyid sbyor/ /rnam par mi rtog dmigs su med/ /bde ba rang bzhin med shes shing / /las la'ang der shes yod min la/ /mchod dang lam du mngon par rtogs/ /snying rje che dang yi rang dang / /yongs su bsngo dang byang chub sems/ /bdag dang gzhan du brje ba dang / /spros dang bral ba'i shes rab kyi/ /dgag bya dgos pa'i dbye shes pas/ /thabs mkhas khyad par 'byung ba ni/ /theg chen kun las mthun par bshad/ /de dag kun yang 'di la yod/ /nyes spyod sdom las mi ldog pas/ /so sor thar pa rnams nyams med/ /grub pa mkhas pa mang po dag /dgos pa chen po mthong bas na/ /rtags tsam phul ba nyid yin gyi/ /de yi sdom pa phul ba med/ /chos kun sgyu mar mthong ba dang / /'bul sems ji bzhin med phyir ro/ /grub pa rnams la nyes med pas/ /de phyir sems nyid gtso bo yin/ /'dod chags dag pa 'ba' zhig la/ /phyag rgya gsungs pa ma yin te/ /'dod chags lta bu'i bde ba med/ /de ni sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul/ /'dod chags lam du byed ces pa/ /med na ci zhig lam du byed/ /bde ba chen po mi sgrub na/ /sgrub po re zhig 'dod mas ci/ /nyan thos bzhin du chags bral na/ /'dod pas bde ba —361—

ji ltar bskyed/ /bde ba'i ye shes bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /'dod ldan rnams la gsungs pa yin/ /nyon mongs mngon gyur spang dgos na/ /nyon mongs lam byed tshig tsam nyid/ /nyon mongs che zhing lam myur la/ /snying rje nges 'byung sogs kyang che/ /rang gi sems nyid yongs dag na/ /rnam kun rdzogs par byang chub pas/ /sems ni dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /phyag rgya bzhi po bsgrub par bya/ /'di ltar 'dod la longs spyod pa/ /zhen pa med pas rnyed pa'am/ /ye shes sgrub la gnang ba yin/ /gang zag dbang po dul ba 'am/ /tshegs med rnyed par gyur na ni/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas dang / khang mig lnga brgya pa yang snang / /lha las tshe 'phos dge slong la/ /yo byad lhag por snang ba dang / /dri zhim la sogs rnam g.yengs rgyu/ /skabs 'gar rtse gcig rgyun yong bstan/ /chags can 'dod yon las gzhan pas/ /sems ni rtse gcig thob pa med/ /bde la chen par mi byed do/ /gdung ba zhi ba'i rtse gcig 'thob/ /ji ltar khrus mkhan dri ma yis/ /gos kyi dri ma med par byed/ /li khri'i rdul gyis me long gi /dri ma dag par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin mkhas pas nyes pa dag /sbyangs phyir nyes pa bsten par bya/ khres rab thabs kyis sems 'di yis/ /nyes pa'i ri bo bcom nas ni/ /bdag dang gzhan yang sgrol bar byed/ /'dod pa'i yon to lnga rnams gyis/ /dbang po brtas par byed par 'gyur/ /de las byang chub sems rgyas shing / /de yis bde ba 'phel bar 'gyur/ /reg pa'i bde las yid bde bskyed/ /yid ni bde bar gyur pa na/ /dbang po rnams kyang bde bar 'gyur/ /ngo bo nyid kyi bud med las/ /rnam par mi rtog skye bar 'gyur/ /bde —362—

bas sems ni sdud byed cing / /bde dang rnam par mi rtog pas/ /de nyid mthar thug yang dag rig /nyon mongs zhes dang las 'di yang / /'khor bar lhung bar byed pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi rgyur 'gyur bas/ /nyon mongs nyid kyi skyon ma yin/ /dngos ngo/ra 'dzin pa de yi skyon/ /dug gis 'chi bar byed ces pas/ /dug nyid kho na'i skyon ma yin/ /'chi byed nus pa med pa'i skyon/ /gzhan du rma bya lus rgyas byed/ /pha rol phyin pa'i bstan bcos las/ /skyon du lta zhing spyod par gsungs/ /'dir ni bde ba che don du/ /ye shes rgyu yi phyir du bsten/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i sku yang 'grub/ /sems kyi rang bzhin gos la bar mtshon/ /rlung gi g.yo ba thim par 'gyur/ /de phyir de nyid rig pa yi/ /yid ni gzhan du ma gyur pas/ /'dod can ma la 'dod spyad na/ /'dod dang thar ba 'grub par 'gyur/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo dge slong la/ /bkag na sngags spyod des 'dul gyi/ /gtso bo'i gdul bya la med pa'am/ /yang na khyim pa gtso bor 'gyur/ /kun spangs khyim pa ga la zhig /tshangs spyod bla mar gsang dbang dang / /slob mar shes rab ye shes ni/ /las dang po la dngos bkag cing / /de nyid rig la nyes med gsungs/ /'di ni mtha' yi gsal byed yin/ /'khor lo'i mchod sogs dge slong dang / khyim pa'i dbye ba mi rung ste/ /gsum las dge slong mchog yin no/ /21 'dod yon lam byed sgrub pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o/ //bzhi pa don dam ye shes ni/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi bgrod gcig lam/ /las rgya'i bde ba de nyid min/ /'gyung ba'i bde ba 'jig rten de/ /don dam —363—

'jig tshogs la ma brten/ /rkyen gyi glo bur 'byung mthong zhing / /chags bcas ngal dang rtsol bar bcas/ /lus la nye tsher khyab pa'i phyir/ /rang bzhin zag med lhun grub dang / /kun tu khyab pa ma yin no/ /sems kyi rang bzhin bde 'diyin/ /rtog bcas stong pa'ang de min te/ /rtog dang bcas phyir gnyis su snang / /de phyir yang dag don las log /rmongs par 'jig pa'ang bya kun la/ /rmongs na zab mor lta ci smos/ /dbang po nye tshe ba yi yul/ /las kyang nyi tshes byed pa'i phyir/ /bskyed rim sku ni nye tshe yin/ /rtog pa'i ngo bor snang ba las/ /med phyir rdo rje'i sku ma yin/ /sems las dngos su grub pa'i sku/ /kun khyab zhen med sems bde ba/ /rang bzhin phyir na bde mi 'gyur/ /rang bzhin stong par gsal snang can/ /lus sems ngo bo gcig gyur pa/ /'di ni don dam bzhi pa'i dbang / ngo bo bde dang rang bzhin med/ /gsal cha 'gag med ye shes te/ /de ltar de nyid de ye shes/ /de ltar rnal 'byor ma mtshan nyid/ /dam tshig la zhen mkhas pa dang / /rlung gi de nyid pha rol son/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i don bslabs pa/ /ngag 'jam shes rab ldan ma dang / /mig yangs mi yi bu mo rnyed/ /gzugs dang lang tshos rnam par brgyan/ /ji bzhin rnal 'byor dam tshig la/ /phyag rgya lhan cig sgrub par byed/ /de nas de nyid thob pa ni/ /phyag rgyas chen po'i mtshad nyid do/ /de nyid bde chen go 'phang ni/ /kun tu rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /stong nyid ye shes dri ma med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi go 'phang gsal/ /las dang po la ma rdzo pa ni/ /gcig tu nges pa yod min pas/ /slob dpon kun gyi gzhung lugs kyi/ /rtsod pa rab tu zhi ba yin/ /don dam skyes pa —364—

med pa la/ /dbang po gnyis skyes der 'dod dang / /gnyid 'thug bzhi par 'dod pa dang / /'dir yang dpyod par 'dod pa zhabrul/ /'on kyang mi mo las mtshon cing / /lha dang mi rtog rgyas gdab byed/ /de dag dper byas go ba la/ /bzhi pa bskur zhes bshad pa yin/ /zhu ba phyag rgya'i dbang yid kyis/ /rung na chu sogs cis ma yin/ /dbye par ma nus bsam gtan gyis/ /dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin dam rgyas bya/ kha cig mdo dang sngags dag kyang / /mtha' yas phyir na thabs mnyam zhing / /rkang lag gtong la'ang zhus med pas/ /dka' ba med par mnyam zhes 'dod/ /sde snod min na sngags kyis ci/ /yin na sde snod gsum gyis chog /drod thob bskal pa grangs med ni/ /gsum yang skad cig gsum yin te/ /rtag tu ngu bzhin tshe gcig la/ /sangs rgyas mdo las nges par yod/ /gsang sngags drang don mdo sde ni/ /nges don yin zhes smra bar byed/ /mi dang ngan song gnyis ka yang / /mtha' yas phyir na mnyam par 'gyur/ /dga' ba tshor ba sdug bsngal te/ /de med na ni gzhan don du/ /rang bde khyad du bsad mi 'gyur/ /tshor ba bde ba 'dir lam byed/ /rin chen min na gser gyis ci/ /yin na dngul gyis chog ces pa/ /mi mkhas lugs la su zhig brton/ /skad cig bskal par ston na yang / /skad cig bskal pa nyid ma yin/ /de phyir skad cig gsum kho nas/ /grangs med gsum gyi tshogs mi rdzogs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas dam bca' tsam/ /mthun pa'i dpe yang ma grub po/ /stong nyid sngags las rgya cher bstan/ /mdo sde nyi tshe 'ga' zhig las/ /dgongs pa gzhan du drangs yang dgos/ /tshig rnams phal cher thabs —365—

nyid ston/ /gnyis ka'ang gnyis ka gnas bzhin du/ /phyogs su lhung bar ma gyur cig /sgrub dka' nyams na nyes che bas/ /so skyes sngags spyod dus min lo/ /g.yul du 'jug dang bsod nams dang / /nor bu'i gling du 'gro la spros/ /dge slong sdom dang sems bskyed len/ /'di la'ang de yis dgag par gyis/ /dgag bya yod kyang dgos che bas/ kho bo sngags la 'jug par byed/ /rang dang g.yin gyi grub mtha' la/ /sngags rgyud brten pa bde bar 'grub/ /bskal pa gsum du ngal byas kyang / /byang chub sgrub par mi nus pa/ /lus gcig la yang thob pa ni/ /sngags shes rnams kyis byas pa yin/ /rig sngags med rnams thams cad du/ /dka' ba kho na 'phel bar mthong / /tshul min yid byed phyir mnyam sbyor/ /dge slong gis sgom mi rung zer/ /rgyan gyis sgeg dang mtshon 'dzin sogs/ /rang nyid sgom la'ang de skyon yod/ khrus dang gtsang sbra zhes pa dang / /rigs dang rigs min zhes pa yang / /de nyid ma rig rnams kyi tshul/ /mi gtsang rdzas nyid mi gtsang na/ /khrus kyis dag par ci ste 'gyur/ /mi gtsang phur ma bkrus pa bzhin/ /mi gtsang ba yi gong bur gnas/ /ci tsam lus nyid de mi gtsang / /yul dang rigs chos tha dad phyir/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang rtog par zad/ /gdol ba'i rigs kyang dka' thub kyis/ /drang srong chen por 'gyur zhes gda'/ /dge dang mi dge las gzhan pa'i/ /rigs la bye brag rigs mi 'grub/ /bdun pa gnyen 'dun nyid yin na/ /brgyad pa'ang ci yi phyir ma yin/ /de bzhin grangs med par du bsgre/ /de phyir gnyen sogs btags par zad/ /'gro ba thams cad pha dang ma/ /de la nye —366—

ring dbye ba med/ /sems nyid ma dang bur gyur la/ /gnyen mi 'thad na lus brten pa'i/ /pha ma bu yi 'brel mi 'thad/ /der 'gyur sems kyi'ang cis mi 'gyur/ /sgron ma lnga sogs bza' min la/ /de dag bza' bar mngon shes dag /med pa'i rgyud 'grel mkhan smra mod/ /de yis 'grel byed mi rung lo/ /de lta na ni mngon shes dag /med par rgyud kyang bshad mi 'os/ /log par bris phyir nyes bcas na/ /log par bshad la'ang cis mi nyes/ /ma nor bris pa'ang nyes pa ci/ /dgra bcom mngon shes drug ldan yang / /theg pa 'di la rnal 'byor rmongs/ /mngon shes ldan yang lha chen po/ /'di ru byol song yin zhes gsungs/ /'gyur bcas phyir na rgyas pa sogs/ /mngon shes med ces bya ba dang / /bde ba ches drangs mngon shes te/ /'di yod dang por 'grel byed nus/ /de'i rjes 'brangs pas gzhan gyis kyang / /ci phyir 'grel pa byed mi nus/ /sgrub thabs chog sogs kyang de bzhin/ /bza' bya'ang las dang po la gnang / /dam tshig phyir na bsten bya yin/ /yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam bsten sogs kyis/ /las dang po la cis mi 'grub/ /'gro la phan don gdul phyir yin/ /'o ma 'thung sogs klu mo dag /'grub kyi gzhan du nyon mongs zhes/ /gsungs pa'ang las dang po la dgongs/ /des de 'grub na gzhan cis min/ /thams cad bza' la nus pa mthong / /klu sogs sgrub la'ang gsang chen don/ /rtogs pa dgos na ha cang thal/ /sngags dang sman gyis chags sogs dag /'phel dang 'grib mthong sngags kyis ni/ /sdang bar byed phyir des de ni/ /mi spongs zhes pa'ang 'thad par dka'/ /sa bon spong zhes kho bo'ang min/ /byams sogs —367—

bzhin du bsten par byed/ /de phyir sngags dang sbyor ba yis/ /sdig pa spyod la dga' bar rigs/ /rig sngags spyod pa'i mthu kho na/ /phun tshogs thams cad mthong ba yin/ /45 log par smra ba sna tshogs pa dgag pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //sngags shes gnas pa'i ri bo sa /tā ra nā thas brjod pa ste/ /gang na gsang sngags spyod pa der/ /dam chos yun ring gnas par byed/ /zhib mo rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa rang lo nyer lnga pa la'o// /khu bha ma stu sarba dzā ga taX/'dir smras pa/ tshad dang ldan pa'i slob dpon 'gas/ /rnam par dpyad pa'ang yongs rig cing / /rgyud sde kun gyi gnad shes nas/ /rab byed 'di ni sbyar ba yin/ /zer zlos yang yang ma bskyar bar/ /dgag skrub rigs pa gsar ba'i tshogs/ /dus mthar 'byung 'di ya mtshan to/ /mkhas rnams rjes su yi rang byos/ /tshigs bcad 'di tsam sbyar bas kyang / /gang gi blo gros dpag yas pa/ /mtshon par byas pa ma yin nam/ /blo ldan rnams kyis drang por smros/ /sngags la dad pa mang na yang / khyu mtshan shes pa nyung ba'i phyir/ /blun dad tsam la mi 'jog na/ /rigs pa 'di la lan brgyar sbyongs/ khres rab che zhing blo drang ba/ /rnam dpyod ldan pa 'ga' yod na/ kho bo'i legs bshad gsar ba la/ /legs so mgrin gcig spyin par 'os/ /gzhung 'di sngon dus bzang po'i tshe/ /brtsams na rgya bod gang du yang / /dam pa thams cad dgyes 'gyur mod/ /blun po rnams la ci cha yod/ /da lta dus kyi skyon nyid kyis/ /phal cher —368—

ldan lan gyi legs smras spong / /ngan du zer yang kho bos ni/ /brag cha bzhin du rtogs mod kyis/ /legs bshad chos la bstod byas na/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar bar 'gyur/ /100 aṅga yang bshad pa/ zhus dag /bkra shis/ /

bsdo/gas/oṃ swā sti/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga gang zhe na/ chos dang dus dang ston pa dang gnas dang 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /chos dus ston pa gnas dang 'khor/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga ru 'dod/ /kun shes rta thul rlangs pa dang / /ming can ri ldan lnga sde'o/ /grags pa dri med gang po dang / /ba lang bdag dang lag bzang ni/ /nye ba'i lnga sde zhes su brjod/ /dga' bo nyer dga' 'gro mgyogs dang / /'char ka 'dun pa nam so ste/ /drug sde zhes su brjod pa yin/ /'od srung kun dga' sha na'i gos/ /nyer sbas dhi dhi ka nag po/ /legs mthong bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun/ /stag mo shi bi ko sa la/ /tshong dpon gnyis dang ri bong dang / ā ga sta dang sha byin dang / /thams cad sgrol dang mchod sbyin byed/ /brgya byin bram ze myos byed ma/ /legs par pha rol phyin dang nya/ /bya dang bum pa phyug po'i bu/ /dka' thub can dang tshong dpon no/ /byang chub dang ba byang chub che/ spre'u ri dwags sha ra bha/ /ru ru sprel rgyal bzod par smra/ /tshangs pa gling chen dag ste bcu/ /zla ba lcags kyi khyim na skyes/ /ma he shing rta mo zhes pa/ /skyes rabs sum cu rtsa bzhi yin/ gzhan ni brjod las 'das pa'o/ /mnyan yod gnas bcas tsam pa ka /wā rā ṇa si yangs pa can/ /rgyal po'i khab ste grong khyer drug /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan nas ni —kye 70—

'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltam pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol pa dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi mkhor lo dang / /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis zhes su grags/ /mdo sde dbyangs snyan lung du bstan/ /tshigs bcad rmad brjod gleng gzhi dang / /rtogs brjod de lta bu 'byung dang / /skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang / /rmad byung gtan la dbab pa'i sde/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis yin/ /rdzogs ldan gsum ldan gnyis ldan dang / /rtsod ldan zhes bya dus bzhi yin/ /dpyid sos dbyar ston dgun gnyis ni/ /dus drug dgun dpyid dbyar dus gsum/ /dus bzang dus ngan bsam mi khyab/ /gsang ba'i dus ni gsum du brjod/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga las 'phros pa'i rabs te dang po'o// //mig rna sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos ni/ /skye mched bcu gnyis zhes su brjod/ /bcu gnyis po de'i steng du ni/ /mig rna sna lce lus yid kyi/ /rnam shes bsnan pas khams bco brgyad/ /gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed dang / /rnam shes rnams te phung po lnga/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga/ /mig rna sna lce lus dbang lnga/ /rig byed min pa'i gzugs zhes pa/ /bcu gcig po de gzugs phung yin/ /mig sogs 'dus te reg pa drug /reg pa'i tshor ba drug yin te/ yang na bde sdug btang snyoms dang / /yid bde yid mi bde ba lnga/ /reg drug las byung 'du shes drug /mtshan bcas mtshan med chung che —371—

dang / /tshad med ci yang med 'du shes/ /'du byed mtshungs ldan mi ldan gnyis/ /rnam shes drug po sngar bshad zin/ /sngo ser dkar dmar ring thung dang / /lham pa zlum po mtho dma' dang / /phya le phya le ma yin dang / /sprin dang du ba rdul khug rna/ /grib ma nyi ma snang mun no/ /zin dang ma zin de gnyis la/ /ston dang mi ston gnyis gnyis bzhi/ /de yang snyan dang mi snyan brgyad/ /dri zhim mi zhim mnyam mi mnyam/ /yang na lhan skyes sbyar byung bzhi/ /mngar skyur lan tshwa kha tsha bska/ /ro drug 'byung bzhi 'jam rtsub dang / /lci yang grang bkres skom reg bya/ /bcu gcig tu ni brjod pa yin/ /nyer dgu bcu gcig drug bcu gnyis/ /nyer drug theg chen gzhung las bshad/ /thob dang ma thob skal mnyam dang / 'du shes med dang 'gog snyoms dang / /'du shes med pa'i sems can dang / /srog dang skye rga gnas dang 'jig /ming tshig ye ge bcu bzhi po/ /ldan min 'du byed ces pa'o/ /nyer gsum rnal 'byor spyod gzhung las/ /nam mkha' so sor brtags 'gog dang / /brtags min 'gog gsum 'dus ma byas/ /gzhan las 'dus ma byas brgyad bshad/ /rnam shes drug dang nyon yid dang / /kun gzhi rnam shes zhes bya ba/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad ces su brjod/ /kun 'gro lnga dang yul nges lnga/ /rtsa nyon drug dang nye nyon mongs/ /nyi shu dad sogs dge bcu gcig /gzhan 'gyur bzhi ste sems byung yin/ /tshor 'du sems pa reg yid byed/ /'dun mos dran ting shes rab lnga/ /'dod khong nga ma the tshom lta/khro dang 'khon 'dzin ser sna 'chab/ /g.yo sgyu rgyags dang rnam 'tshe dang / /'tshig dang phrag dog med gnyis dang / /ma dad pa dang rmugs dang rgod/ /le lo bag —372—

med brjed nges dang / khres bzhin min dang rnam g.yeng ngo / /dad dang bag yod shin tu sbyangs/ /btang snyoms ngo tsha shes khrel yod/ /rtsa ba rnam gsum mi 'tshe dang / /brtson 'grus dge ba bcu gcig go /gnyid 'gyod rtog dpyod gzhan 'gyur bzhi/ /reg drug las byung sems pa drug /dge phyir kun nyon mongs phyir dang / /gnas skabs bye brag la sems pa/ /gsum du dbye bas bco brgyad yin/ /srid dang 'dod pa'i 'dod chags gnyis/ /nga rgyal che ba'i nga rgyal dang / /nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal dang / /nga'o snyam dang mngon nga rgyal/ /cung zad snyam dang log nga rgyal/ /lta ngan gnyis te rtag chad gnyis/ /log lta 'jig tshogs mthar 'dzin dang / /tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin lta mchog 'dzin/ /lta ngan lnga zhes brjod pa yin/ /gzugs bdag ma yin bdag ldan min/ /bdag la gzugs med gzugs la med/ /phung po bzhi la'ang de bzhin sbyar/ /'jig tshogs lta ba nyi shur 'dod/ /bdag dang 'jig rten mtha' ldan dang / /mi ldan gnyis ka gnyis min dang / /rtag mi rtag gnyis gnyis ka min/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grongs phan chad/ /'byung min 'byung gnyis gnyis ka min/ /bdag srog gcig gam tha dad ces/ /lung ma bstan lta bcu bzhi yin/ /ma rig 'du byed rnam par shes/ /ming gzugs skye mched drug reg pa/ /tshor ba sred len srid pa dang / /skye ba rga shi rten 'brel ni/ /bcu gnyis zhes su brjod pa yin/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /mi rnams dang ni 'dod lha drug /yang sos thig nag bsdus 'joms dang / ngu 'bod ngu 'bod wo po dang / /tsha ba rab tsha mnar med pa/ /chu bur chu bur brdol ba dang / /a chu kye hud so tham pa/ /—373—

ut+pal pad+ma pad cher gas/ me ma mur dang ro myag dang / /sbu gri sogs gsum chu bo yin/ /rgyal chen bzhi rigs sum cu gsum/ /'thab bral dga' ldan 'phrul dga' dang / /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed ces lha drug /gnyis ka 'khyud dang lag bcang dang / rgod dang bltas pas 'khrig pa'o/ /dud 'gro yi dwags bying kha 'thor/ /phyi nang zas sgrib yi dwags gsum/ /brgyad po kun la lhag bcu drug /yi dwags so drug dud 'gro ni/ /bye ba mang por mdo las gsungs/ /'di nas byang du ri nag po/ /dgu 'das gangs ri'o de nas ni/ /spos ngad ldan pa'i tshur rol na/ /chu zheng lnga bcu yod pa'i mtsho/ /gaṅgā glang po kha nas shar/ /rdo glang gi kha nas lho/ /pak+ṣu rta yi kha nas nub/ /si tā seṅge'i kha nas byang / /ma dros rdzing bu dal 'bab dang / /gser gyi bya skyibs swā la'i rgyal/ /glang chen sa srung bu rab brtan/ khang bu can dang sprin gyi shugs/ /lhun po gnya' shing 'dzin ri dang / /gshol mda' 'dzin dang seng ldan can/ /de bzhin lta na sdug ri dang / /lta na dang ni rnam 'dud dang/ /mu 'byud 'dzin dang lcags ri'o/ /rol mtsho bdun dang ba tshwa'i mtsho/ /ri rab bang rim bzhi sogs la/ /lag na gzhong thogs phreng thogs dang/ /rtag myos pi waX can gsum pa/ /bar snang sa bla'i gnod sbyin dang / /kun tu rgyu ba'i lha rnams so/ /yul 'khor dang ni 'phags par skyes/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang lcang lo can/ /rgyal po 'jig rten skyong bzhi gnas/ /gnya' shing 'dzin ri'i rtse mo la'o/ /lhun po'i rtse na sum cu gsum/ /lta na sdug rnams khang bzang dang / /chos bzang yongs 'du'i tshal dang ni/ /phyi rol shing rta sna tshogs dang/ /rtsub 'gyur 'dres tshal dga' bas brgyan/ /de —374—

dag gi ni phyogs bzhi na/ /nyi shus bcad na sa gzhi bzang / /byang shar mtshams na yongs 'du ste/ /lho nub mtshams na chos bzang ngo / /de steng lha rnams gzhal med khang / /'dod pa spyod pa drug yin no/ /zla phreng bzang po gser ldan dang/ /mi g.yo ba ste sa bzhi bzhi/ /'od can skar phreng zab pa dang / /mdzes pa zhes te grong khyer bzhi/ /sgra gcan mgul phreng me tog dang / /thag bzang ris te dbang po bzhi/ /lto nub mtshams na nor bzang dang / /byang shar mtshams na tsi tas li/ khang bzang gtams pa can dang ni/ /tshal bzhi bzod dka' gangs brtsegs dang / /skrag 'jigs sogs kyis lha min bsdus/ /tshangs ris tshangs pa 'dun na 'don/ /tshangs chen bsam gtan dang po yin/ /'od chung tshad med 'od 'od gsal/ /gnyis pa'o dge chung tshad med dge /dge rgyas bsam gtan gsum pa yin/ /sprin med bsod nams skyes dang ni/ /'bras bu che zhes gnas gsum dang / /mi che mi gdung gya nom snang / khren tu mthong dang 'og min ni/ /gnas gtsang lnga ste bzhi pa yin/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / /rnam shes mtha' yas ci yang med/ /srid rtse zhes bya gzugs med bzhi/khams gsum 'dod khams gzugs khams dang / /gzugs med khams rnams rim pa bzhin/ /nyi shu bcu bdun bzhi yin no/ /til sbyang nang nas lo brgya zhig /til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can gyi tshe yin te/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shus sgyur/ /yang gsos la sogs drug rim bzhi/ /'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/ /rab tu tsha phyed mnar med ni/ /bar gyis bskal pa'o dud 'gro rnams/ /mchog ring bskal pa'o yi dwags rnams/ /zla ba nyin zhag gi lnga —375—

brgya/ /gling bzhi ba dang nyi zla dang / /ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni/ /stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod/ /de stong la ni stong gnyis pa/ /bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin no/ /de stong la ni stong gsum mo/ /mnyam du 'jig cing 'byung ba yin/ /'dzam bu'i gling ba rnams kyi tshad/ /khru bzhi pa dang phyed dang bzhi/ shar dang ba lang spyod dang ni/ /byang zhes bya ba nyis 'gyur bskyed/ /'dod dang ldan pa'i lha'i lus/ /bzhi cha nas ni rgyang grags dag /byed dang gnyis kyi bar du bskyed/ /gzugs can dang po dpag tshad phyed/ /de yis gong ma phyed phyed bskyed/ /'od chung rnams kyi lhag yan chad/ /lus ni nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur te/ /sprin med dpag tshad gsum dor ro/ /sgra mi snyan na tshe stong ste/ /nub shar lnga brgya phyed sum brgya/ /'di ni ma nges tha mar ni/ /lo bcu dang po dpag tu med/ /mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu la/ /'dod pa dag gi lha rnams las/ /'og ma dag gi nyin zhag gcig /des na tshe lo lnga brgya'o/ /gong ma gnyis ka nyis 'gyur ro/ /gzugs can nyin mtshan med tshe ni/ /rang lus gzhal ba'i bskal pa yin/ /gzugs med bskal pa stong phrag ni/nyi shu lhag pas lhag pa yin/ /'od chung nas gzung bskal chen te/ /de yi 'og ma phyed yin no/ /gzugs ming dus mtha' rdul yig dang / /skad cig phra rags rdul dang ni/ /rdul phran dag ni de bzhin du/ /lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang / /nyi zer rdul dang sro ma shig /sor tshig zhes bya gong bdun bsgyur/ /sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru/ khru bzhi la ni gzhu gang ngo / /de dag lnga brgya rnams la ni/ /rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod/ /de brgyad dpag tshad ces bya'o/ /skad cig —376—

ma brgya nyi shu la/ /de'i skad cig de dag kyang / /drug cu la ni thang gcig go /yud tsam nyin zhag zla gsum ni/ /gong nas gong du sum cur 'gyur/ /'chags dang 'jig dang gnas dang zhig /bar bskal bskal chen bskal chung dang / /mtsho ni dang nad dang mu ge sogs/ /bskal pa rnam pa mang po yin/ /las la sems pa bsam pa gnyis/ /myong bar nges dang ma nges gnyis/ /rnam rig rnam rig byed min gnyis/ /'phen byed rdzogs byed las gnyis so/ /kun slong rnam gnyis rgyu dang ni/ /de'i dus kyi slong zhes bya/ /rig byed min rnam sum zhes bya/ /sdom dang sdom pa min dang gzhan/ /sdom pa so sor thar zhes bya/ /de bzhin bsam gtan zag med skyes/ /bsod nams bsod nams min mi g.yo/ /las ni rnam pa gsum du brjod/ /sdug bsngal myong 'gyur bde myong 'gyur/ /sdug min bde min myong 'gyur gsum/ /mthong chos dang ni skyes nas dang / /lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gsum/ /las dkar rnam smin gnag pa dang / /las gnag rnam smin dkar ba dang / /gnyis kar dkar dang gnyis ka nag /dkar dang nag dang 'dres ma dang / /mi dkar mi nag de yang gsum/ /dkar nag gnyis ka zad byed pa'o/ /mtshams med skyes nas myong 'gyur yin/ /bde gshegs sku la ngan sems kyis/ /sku mtshal 'byin dang dgra bcom gsod/ /pha ma gsod dang dge 'dun dbyen/ /ma dgra bcom ma sun byas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' nges gnas dang / /slob pa gsod dang dge 'dun gyi/ /'du ba'i sgo nas 'phrog pa dag /mtshams med pa dang cha 'dra ste/ /lnga pa mchod rten ba jig pa yin/ /srog gcod log g.yem ma byin len/ /—377—

phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal rdzun/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta ni/ /byed na mi dge spangs dge bcu/ /tshe thung dgra mang 'phongs pa dang / /bshes bral mi snyan ngag mi btsun/ /skur ba re ba 'jom pa dag /'jig bcas lta ngan gyis rmongs pa'i/ /gzi chung lo nyes rdul 'khrig dang / /dri nga mtho dman tsha sgo skyes/ /dus log dgun dus sogs tha chad/ /'bru kha 'bras bu med pa'o/ /kun gyi rnam smin ngan 'gro ste/ /thams cad bdag po rgyu 'thun dang / /rnam smin 'bras bu yin par 'dod/ /sdug bsngal phyir dang bsad phyir dang / /gzi byin med phyir 'bras rnam gsum/ /mthong chos 'bras bu can gyi las/ /zhing dang bsam pa'i khyad par las/ /gang dag 'gog byams nyon mongs med/ /mthong dang dgra bcom 'bras langs pa/ /de la phan gnod byas pa yis/ /'bras bu 'phral du myong bar 'gyur/ /'gro dang sdug bsngal phan 'dogs dang / /yon to rnams kyi zhing khyad 'phags/ /'phags pa min yang pha ma dang / /nad pa dang ni chos smra dang / /skyes mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ /yon ni gzhal tu med pa yin/ /'jug dang zhing dang gzhi dang ni/ /sbyor dang sems pa bas myo/ pa ste/ /de dag chung dang che ba las/ /las kyang chung dang che ba yin/ /bsam bzhin pa dang rdzogs pa dang / /mi 'gyod gnyen po med pa dang / /'khor dang rnam par smin pa las/ /bsags pa'i las shes bya ba yin/ /las su rnam smin sgrib pa gsum/ /sdug bsngal gsum mam brgyad ces bya/ /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal 'gyur sdug bsngal/ /'du byed sdug bsngal zhes pa'o/ /nyon mongs mthong bas spang bya dang / /sgom pas spang bya gnyis su 'du/ /gnyis ka'ang khams gsum so —378—

sos bsdus/ /byed rgyu lhan cig 'byung ba dang / /skal mnyam mtshungs par ldan pa dang / /kun tu 'gro dang rnam smin te/ /rgyu ni rnam pa drug tu 'dod/ /rkyen rnam bzhi te rgyu dang ni/ /dmigs pa dang ni de ma thag /bdag po yang ni de bzhin te/ /rkyen lnga pa ni yod ma yin/ /rnam smin bdag po rgyu 'thun dang / /skyes bu byed dang bral 'bras lnga/ /rgyu drug rkyen bzhi 'bras bu lnga'o// gzhi'i chos kyi skabs te gnyis pa'o// //bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen pha ma dang / /dge tshul pha ma dge slob ma/ /dge slong pha ma so thar brgyad/ /tshogs spyor mthong sgom mi slob lam/ /lam lnga zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /nyan thos rang rgyal theg chen gsum/ /lha dang tshangs pa'i theg ste lnga/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das theg gnyis/ /lus tshor sems dang chos rnams kyi/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ /dge ba ma skyes bskyed pa dang / /skyes pa srung dang mi dge ba/ /skyes spong ma skyes mi skyed pa'o/ /'dun brtson sems dpyod ces bya ba/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /dad brtson dran kho shes rab ni/ /dbang po lnga dang stobs lngar brjod/ /dran shes brtson dga' sbyangs ting btang / /byang chub yan lag bdun du brjod/ /rang bzhin yan lag gnas yan lag /gsum pa nges 'byung yan lag ste/ /bzhi ba phan yon yan lag yin/ /rnam gsum nyon mongs med yan lag /lta rtog ngag las 'tsho dang rtsol/ /dran ting 'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog dang lam/ /bden pa bzhi zhes rab tu bsgrag /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ /rgyu dang kun —379—

'byung rkyen rab skye/ /'gog zhi gya noms nges 'byung dang / /lam dang rig sgrub nges 'byin te/ /mi rtag sogs rnams bcu drug go /chos dang gang zag bdag med gnyis/ /rnam thar sgo ni stong nyid dang / /mtshan med smon med rnam gsum mo/ /stong nyid stong nyid la sogs gsum/ /phyi nang gnyis ka stong pa che/ /don dam 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /mtha' las 'das dang thog ma med/ /dor med rang bzhin chos thams cad/ /rang gi mtshan nyid dang mi dmigs/ /dngos med ngo bo dngos po dang / /dngos po med pa'i stong nyid ni/ /bco brgyad rang dang g.yin ngo bo/ /stong nyid bsnan pas nyi shu yin/ /gnyen po rnam bzhi spong ba dang / /gzhi dang thag sring sun 'byin pa'o/ /mdor na lam ni rnam bzhi ste/khyad par can dang rnam grol dang / /bar chad med dang sbyor zhes bya/ /tshogs lam che 'bring chung gsum ste/ /sbyor lam drod rtse bzod chos mchog /re re'ang che 'bring chung gsum mo/ /sdug bsngal chos bzod chos shes dang / /rjes bzod rjes shes zhes pa bzhi/ /kun 'byung 'gog lam la bzhi bzhi/ /mthong lam skad cig bcu drug go /sgom lam chung ja'i chung sogs dgu/ /nyams pa 'chi sems rjes su bsrung / /gnas las mi bskyod rtogs skal can/ /mi g.yo chos can zhes pa drug /dgra bcom slob dang byas la 'dod/ /mtshan nyid rab rig mos dben byung / /dga' sdud spyod pa sbyor ba'i mtha'/ /sbyor mtha'i 'bras bu yid byed bdun/ /mig rna gzhan sngon rdzu 'phrul zab / /mngon shes drug tu brjod pa yin/ /bsam gtan yan lag bco brgyad ni/ /dang po la lnga rtog dpyod dang / /dga' dang bde dang ting 'dzin rnams/ /gnyis pa la ni yan lag —380—

bzhi/ /rab dang dang ni dga' la sogs/ /gsum pa la lnga btang snyoms dang / /dran dang shes bzhin bde dang gnas/ /mtha' na bzhi dran btang snyoms dang / /bde min sdug min ting 'dzin no/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms tshad med tshad med bzhi/ /bsam gtan dang po'i snyoms 'jug sogs/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi/ /'gog snyoms zhes pa snyoms 'jug dgu /gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i dang / /gzugs med gzugs lta khyad par sdug /gzugs med bzhi dang 'gog pa yi/ /rnam par thar ba brgyad yin no/ /zad par sngon po'i ting 'dzin dang / /ser dmar dkar dang sa chu me/ /rlud dang nam mkha' rnam shes bcu/ /nang gzugs 'du shes phyi yi gzugs/ /chung ngu bzang ngan zil gnon dang / /chen po zil gnon nang gzugs med/ /sngar bzhin che chung zil gnon gnyis/ /sngo ser dmar dkar zil gnon bzhi/ /de ltar zil gnon brgyad du dran/ /chos shes rjes shes gzhan sems shes/ /kun rdzob sdug kun 'gog lam dang / /zad dang mi skye shes pa bcu/ /dbang po rtul dang rnon po dang / /dad dang mthong thob rigs nas rigs/ /bar chad gcig par skyes nas dang / /byed dang byed min 'og min 'gro/ /'phar gsum srid rtse mthar thug 'gro/ /gzugs la chags bcom mthong ba yi/ /chos la zhi lus mngon sum byed/ /bse ru dang ni nyi shu'o/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub ni/ /mtshan nyid gsum zhes brjod par bya/ /mawo nyid skye ba don dam ste/ /ngo bo nyid med gsum du brjod/ /dag dang nyon mongs dang ldan phyir/ /kun nas nyon mongs med dag phyir/ /rnam par dbye —381—

ba med chos phyir/ /lhun grub rnam par mi rtog phyir/ /rgyu bzhi yis ni bsam mi khyab/ /thog ma med nas brgyud 'ongs dang / /skye mched drug gi khyad par 'dra/ /chos nyid kyis thob sangs rgyas rigs/ /rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /chos la khong khro bdag lta dang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs dang / /sems can don la ltos med nyid/ /'dod chen mu stegs nyan thos dang / /rang byung rnams gyi sgrib rnam bzhi/ /chos mos lhag pa'i shes rab dang / /ting 'dzin snying brtse lam bzhi'o/ /gtsang bdag bde dang rtag nyid kyi/ /yon tan pha rol phyin pa 'bras/ /sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la/ /sbun pa snying po mi gtsang nang na gser/ /sa la gter dang myug sogs 'bras phyung dang / /gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni/ /bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang / /sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji lta bar/ /glo bur nyon mongs dri mas sgrib pa yi/ /sems can rnams la de bzhin khams 'di gnas/ /sems zhun/ sems can dman la brnyas pa dang / /yang dag mi 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ /bdag chags lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spangs don du gsungs/ /chu khams gser dang nam mkha' ni/ /dag pa bzhin du dag par 'dod/ /byang sems mtshan bcu drug po ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems dpa' che/ /blo ldan nyid dang gsal ba'i mchog /rgyal sras rgyal ba'i gzhi dang ni/ /rgyal byed rgyal ba'i myu gu dang / /rtsal ldan dang ni 'phags mchog dang / /ded dpon dang ni bsod nams —382—

che/ /dbang phyug de bzhin chos dang ldan/ /gzungs ni rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /bzod pa sngags chos don gyi gzungs/ /thos 'dzin don ston la mi 'jigs/ /bdag med srung ba phun tshogs dang / /thabs shes mthar phyin bar chad med/ /sems can don la mi 'jigs te/ /rgyal sras mi 'jigs rnam bzhi'o/ /ma bstan par yang sbyin la 'dug /tshul bzod brtson bsam shes bsdu dngos/ /yongs bsngo shes dang nges 'byung ston/ /theg las ma nyams lam gnyis ston/ /zung dang sel bzhi'i rgyud la mkhas/ /ye shes sngon 'gro 'du mi byed/ /sgo gsum dge ba bcu dang ldan/ /bzod pas sems can yongs mi gtong/ /'gro kun mngon par dga' bar ston/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems ma nyams/ /dkon mchog rtsa bar bstan pa las/ /mi ldog rgyal sras ma 'dres chos/ /bsam lhag sbyor shes smon theg spyod/ /rnam 'phrul byang chub chos 'khor stobs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i stobs bcu yin/ /tshe sems las yo skye mos dang / /smon rdzu ye chos dbang ṣ+ka yin/ /smon 'jug kun rdzob don dam gyi/ /sems bskyed gnyis gnyis brjod pa yin/ /sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ /mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang / /rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o/ /grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs/ /thos stobs dge ba gom pa las/ /mi brtan pa dang brtan byung ba/ /gzhan gyis brtan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ /rigs dang chos la mos pa dang / /de bzhin sems ni bskyed pa dang / /spyin la sogs pa sgrub pa dang / /skyon med pa la 'jug nyid dang / /sems can rnams yongs smin byed dang / /zhing ni rnam par —383—

sbyong pa dang / /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa dang/ /byang chub mchog dang ston pa'o/ /gcig ni mos pa dang ldan pa/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa dag dang gzhan/ /mtshan ma dang ni mtshan med dang / /mngon par 'du byed med spyod pa/ /lnga po 'di dag sa kun la/ /byang chub sems dpa' yin zhes bya/ /brtse dang snyan par smra ba dang / /brtan pa nyid dang lag brkyangs dang / /dgongs pa zab mo nges 'grel ba/ /'di dag blo ldan rnams kyi rtags/ /ngo bo nyid dang gnas dang ni/ /'bras bu go rim bsdu ba yin/ /yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /'chad dang kha bton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang sgom pa ni/ /spyod pa de bcu'i bdag nyid de/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gtong / /tshul khrims lha rjes dran pa drug /gos gsum phying ba phyag dar khrod/ /bsod snyoms stan gcig phyis mi len/ /dgon pa shing drung bla gab med/ /dur khrod cog pu bzhi ji bzhin/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis yin/ /bsod snyoms phyag dar khrod shing drung / /sman bkus bor ba gnas bzhi'o/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyar/ zhas rab thos bsam sgom byung gsum/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims sgom byung gi /bsod nams rnam pa gsum du gsungs/ /rnam par bsngos pa'i 'du shes dang / /rnag 'bus bam dmar zos 'thor zhig /rus gong 'du shes mi sdug dgu/ /bgrang dang rjes 'gro rtog pa dang / /'jog dang rgyur dang yongs dag ste/ /dbugs bgrang ba yi'i man ngag go mi sdug byams dang rten 'brel rlung / /dug gsum rnam rtog gnyen por —384—

gsungs/ /so skye tshul khrims la gnas dang / /dbang po'i sgo bsdams mi nyal brtson/ kha zas tshod rig shes bzhin gnas/ /byang sems tshogs lam yon tan lnga/ /'jog par byed dang rgyun du 'jog /klan 'jog nyer 'jog 'dul bar byed/ /zhi byed nyer zhi rgyud gcig byed/ /mnyam 'jog sems gnas thabs dgu yin/ /the tshom 'gyod gnyid le lo rgod/ /skyon lnga nyid yin gas yang ni/ /le lo dang ni gdams ngag rnams/ /brjed dang bying dang rgod pa dang / /'du mi byed dang 'du byed de/ /'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do/ /gnas dang de la gnas pa dang / /rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du'o/ /dmigs pa brjed par ma gyur dang / /bying dang rgod dang rtog pa dang / /de spong mngon par snyu byed dang / /zhi tshe rnal du 'dug pa'o/ /de dag spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad/ /dkar po rnam mthong rigs kyi sa/ /brgyad pa mthong srab 'dod chags bral/ /byas pa bsrung ba'i sa de brgyad/ /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong / /dgra bcom zhugs 'bras brgyad po ste/ /nyan thos sa brgyad ces bya'o/ /dad tshul ngo khrel thos gtong shes/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun zhes su brjod/ /mthong ba thos pa rnyed pa bslab/ /rim gro rjes dran bla med drug /sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang / /don mthun don spyod bsdu dngos bzhi/ /bden pa'i byin brlab ri gtong nyer zhi/ khres rab ces bya byin rlabs bzhi/ /gnod sems rnam 'tshe mi dga' dang / /'dod pa the tshom mtshan ma las/ /'byin byed tshad med nga rgyal bcom/ /mtshan med rnams te 'byung 'os drug /smra bo phun tshogs rnam pa bzhi/ /gzungs dang rab tu gsal byed dang / /dris lung ston dang 'dzin phun —385—

tshogs/ /gzungs kyang rnam pa bcur 'gyur te/ /don gzhung mngon shes 'od zer 'gyed/ /tshar bcad rjes 'dzin gzengs bstod dang / /spobs pa mi bzad pa dang ni/ /sna tshogs don la spobs pa'i gzungs/ /rab tu dga' dang dri ma med/ /'od byed pa dang 'od 'phro ba/ /sbyangs dka' ba dang mngon du gyur/ /ring du song dang mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab thabs dang stobs/ /smon lam ye shes phar phyin bcu/ grangs nges de yi mtshan nyid go rim dang / /nges pa'i tshig dang goms pa'i yon tan dang / /de dag rab dbye bsdu dang mi mthun phyogs/ /yon tan phun tshogs rnam nges yin zhes bya/ /phyin drug mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum/ /'dzam gling bdag dang 'khordo ra bsgyur che/ /brgya byin 'thab bral dga' ldan bdag /rab 'phrul dbang bsgyur bdag po dang / /stong dang stong gnyis bdag tshangs pa/ /gnas gtsang bdag po dbang phyug che/ /sa bcur rnam par smin par gsungs/ /ting 'dzin brgya la snyoms 'jug dang / /sangs rgyas brgya mthong byin rlabs shes/ /'jig rten khams brgya g.yo snang byed/ /zhing brgyar 'gro zhing 'gro brgya smin/ /bskal brgyar sngon dang phyi mar 'jug /chos brgyar lus brgya 'khor brgya ston/ /stong dang 'bum dang bye ba brgya/ /bye stong bye ba stong brgya dang / /bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang / /stong gsum 'bum dang de nyid kyang /—/grangs med gsum brgya dang mtha' yas/ /mtshan nyid gang zag bslab pa dang / /phung po grub pa —386—

rtags dang ni/ /nges pa'i tshig dang goms pa yi/ /gnas pa dang ni sa nyid do/ /sems can cho se la dmigs pa dang / /dmigs med snying rje gsum du 'dod/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog yod/ /de la gnyis po yod ma yin/ /stong pa nyid ni 'di la yod/ /de la yang ni de yod do/ /yod pas med pas yod pas na/ /de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /bdag las ma yin g.yin las min/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /dngos po gang dang gang na yang / /skye ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /mu bzhi skye 'gog gcig du bral/ /yod med skye 'gog rten 'brel te/ /dbu ma'i rigs pa bzhi ru brjod/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid/ /de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ /rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang / /rtse mor phyin dang mthar bgyis pa/ /skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub/ /chos kyi sku dang de rnam brgyad/ /lam gyi chos kyi skabs te gsum pa'o// //me long ye shes mnyam nyid dang / /so sor rtog dang bya ba sgrub/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam lnga'o/ /ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs byas dang / /de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni/ /chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /gnas chos 'khor dus rnam pa nges/ /'og min theg chen sa bcu pa/ /rgyun mi 'chad dang mtshan dpes spras/ /ston pa rnam snang gangs chen mtsho/ /longs sku nges pa lnga ldan no/ /kha dog dbyibs tshad yul dang rgyu/ /'bras bu bdag po phyogs dang ni/ /zhabs 'bring longs spyod 'phrin las dang / /phan 'dogs 'jigs med rten dang lam/ /bzhon pa sgo dang bzhi bco brgyad/ /'og 387—

min gnas kyi spyi sdom yin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa gsum/ /sku'i sprul pa rnam pa gsum/ /rdzu 'phrul kun tu ston pa dang / /skye ba kun tu ston pa dang / /las kyi rnam smin kun tu ston/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni cho 'phrul dang / /kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul dang / /rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul te/ /cho 'phrul gsum du rab tu brjod/ /zag med sde tshan nyer gcig ni/ /byang chub phyogs 'thun tshad med dang / /rnam par thar dang mthar gyis ni/ /snyoms 'jug yi bdag nyid dang/ /zad par bcu yi bdag nyid dang / /zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched ni/ /rab tu dbye bas rnam brgyad dang / /nyon mongs med dang smon gnas shes/ /mngon shes so so yang dag rig /rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi dang / /dbang bcu dang ni stobs bcu dang / /mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dag dang / /srung ba med pa rnam gsum dang / /dran pa nyer bzhag rnam gsum dang / /bsnyel ba mi mnga'i chos nyid dang / /bag chags yang dag bcom pa dang / /skye la thugs rje chen po dang / /thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos/ /bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin dang / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang / /chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ /nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta/ /mi yi nyon mongs yongs spongs nyid/ /grogs sogs su de'i nyon mongs dag /rgyun gcod rgyal ba'i nyon mongs med/ /sangs rgyas smon gnas mkhyen pa ni/ /lhun gyis grub dang chags spangs dang / /thogs pa med dang rtag gnas dang / /'dri ba kun lan 'debs par bzhed/ /rten dang dmigs pa thugs dang ni/ /ye shes rnam par dag pa bzhi/ /gnas dang gnas min mkhyen stobs dang / /las dang rnam —388—

smin mkhyen stobs dang / khams sna tshogs dang mos sna tshogs/ /dbang mchog mchog min mkhyen stobs gsum/ /thams cad 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen stobs/ /bsam gtan rnam thar ting 'dzin sogs/ /snyoms 'jug kun byang mkhyen stobs dang / /sngon gnas rjes dran mkhyen stobs dang / /'chi 'pho skye ba mkhyen stobs dang / /zag zad mkhyen pa'i stobs de bcu/ /mngon par rdzogs par byang chub dang / /zag pa zad dang bar gcod chos/ /nges 'byung chos la mi 'jigs pa/ /rgyal ba'i mi 'jigs rnam bzhi'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa la/ /srung ba med pa rnam pa gsum/ /gus pas chos nyan mi nyan dang / /gnyis ka la yang thugs mnyam pa/ /dran pa nyer bzhag rnam gsum mo/ /nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi /sgrib gsum bag chags spangs pa'o/ /rtogs pas bsdus dang spyod bsdus drug /ye shes bsdus gsum 'phrin las gsum/ /ma 'dres bco brgyad yin te 'dir/ /'khrul ca bsnyel g.yo tha dad btang snyoms med/ /'dun brtson dran ting shes grol nyams pa med/ /dus gsum chags thogs med pa'i ye shes gsum/ /sgo gsum 'phrin las ye shes sngon rjes 'jug /rgyu 'bras gzhan phan phun sum tshogs/ /phung nyon 'chi lha bdud bzhi bcom/ /dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang / /dpal dang grags dang ye shes dang / /brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /drug po de la skal zhes bya/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol rnam grol ye shes mthong / /zag med phung po rnam lnga'o/ /sha lha shes chos sangs rgyas spyan/ /tshogs gnyis goms dang dus ring goms/ /rgyun goms bkur bstir —389—

byas te goms/ /rgyu ni phun tshogs rnam bzhi'o/ /ye shes spangs pa mthu dang gzugs/ /'bras bu phun tshogs rnam pa bzhi/ /ngan 'gro gsum dang 'khor las sgrol/ /bde 'gro dang ni theg gsum 'god/ /gzhan phan phun tshogs rnam bzhi'o/ /ma bstan mkhyen dang thams cad mkhyen/ /rnam kun mkhyen dang 'bad med mkhyen/ /ye shes phun tshogs rnam bzhi'o/ /nyon mongs kun spangs gtan du spangs/ /bag chags bcas spangs snyoms 'jug gi /sgrib spangs spangs pa rnam bzhi'o/ /sprul brgyur dang ni gtong 'dod rkedang / /chung tso che 'jug ya mtshan chos/ /nar ma sna tshogs mnga' 'byor bzhis/ /nus mthu phun tshogs rnam bzhi 'o/ /mawo bzang ba dang dpe byad bzang / /stobs dang sku gdung rdo rje ltar/ /sra ba'i yon tan mchog mnga' ba/ /gzugs sku phun tshogs rnam bzhi'o/khams dang rang bzhin bsam pa dang / /bag la nyal kun mkhyen pa bzhi/ /brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs pa dang / /nyi ma nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra brnyan bzhin/ /nam mkha' dang ni sa bzhin no/ /de ltar 'phrin las dpe dgu'o/ /thub dbang dus gcig kho nar de'i rgyu mthun/ /gzugs ni gcig la rang gi skye gnas skabs/ /sngar 'gags gsal dang ma 'chol 'byung tshul ni/ /ma lus kyi bkra mtha' dag ston par mdzad/ /dag pa 'di ni bzhed pa 'jug pa yi/ rdul gcig yul la mkha' gsags 'jig rten dang / /'jig rten mtha' yas phyogs khyab rdul ston mod/ /rdul rags mi 'gyur 'jig rten phrar mi 'gyur/ /rnam rtog mi mnga' khyod kyi srid mtha'i bar/ /skad cig de re re la spyod sna tshogs/ /ji snyed ston pa de snyed 'dzam bu gling / /ma lus rdul gang de —390—

snyed la grangs med/ /gsungs dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang / /'phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad brgyad cu thugs rje che/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis sogs dbye ba/ /re zhig bdag gis 'dir ma bkod/ /rten dang brten pa don dam dang / /kun rdzob bral dang rnam smin dang / /chos dang gzugs sku rang don dang / /gzhan don sku zhes bya ba yin/ /'bras bu'i chos kyi skabs te bzhi pa'o// //da ni lnga pa sna tshogs pa'i sde bshad par bya'o/ /chen po bdun ni/dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang / /ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang / /yang dag 'grub pa chen po dang / /sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod/ /'byor pa bcu ni/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang / /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad/ /sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs/ /bstan pa gnas dang der rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying ni brtse ba'o/ /rang 'byor lnga dang gzhan 'byor lnga/ /mi khoms pa brgyad ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni/ /log lta can dang sangs rgyas stongs/ /lkugs pa 'di dag mi khoms brgyad/ /sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa dang ltas bco brgyad ni/ shar mtho nub ni dma' ba dang / /de bzhin phyogs bzhi dbus mtha' drug /'byung ngo 'ur dang rab tu 'ur/ /kun tu rab tu lung de bzhin/ /sprin sogs chem dang ri sogs 'gu la/ /sa gzhi ldeg dang nags tshal g.yos/ /chu sogs 'khru / gas sogs —391—

gsum bco brgyad/ /sdug bsngal brgyad ni/ skye rga na 'chi 'dod mi rnyed/ /sdug bral mi sdug phrad pa dang / /mdor na nyer len phung sdug bsngal/ /skye gnas bzhi ni/ mngal sgong drod gsher rdzus skyes so/ /zas bzhi ni/ reg dang sems pa rnam shes dang / khams kyi zas zhes bya ba'o/ /sems can gyi gnas dgu ni/lus dang 'du shes tha dad dang / /lus tha dad cing 'du shes gcig /mdog dang lus dang 'du shes gcig /gzugs med bzhi dang 'du shes med/ /sems can gyi ni gnas dgu yin/ /lta ba nyon mongs sems can tshe/ /bskal pa'i snyigs ma lnga zhes brjod/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed snyan mi snyan/ /bstod smad bde sdug chos brgyad do/ /mu stegs kyi ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad la/ rtog ge pa drug ni/ 'od srung rdzogs byed/ kun tu rgyu gnag lhas gyi bu/ smra 'dod kyi bu'i bu yang dag rgyal ba can/ mi pham skra'i lwa ba can/ kā ta'i bu nog can/ gcer bu ba gnyer gyi bu'o/ /snyoms 'jug pa drug ni/ sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur/rengs byed kyi bu lhag spyod/ drang srong nyon cho ngas med/ bram ze'i khye'u kun rgyal/kun tu rgyu rab bzang / ltengs rgyas 'od srung ral pa can no/ /rjes sgrog pa drug ni/ bram ze rgyus rgyal/ gnag ldeg bzang ldan/ tshangs pa'i tshe/ pad+ma'i snying po/dmar po'o/ /mang bkur 'od mdzes dge ba dang / /dge mchog gso sbyong nga las nu/ /sngon gyi rgyal po de drug gog ser dngul zangs lcags 'khor lo can/ /gling bzhi gsum dang gnyis dang gcig /phas bsu rang 'gro g.yul bsham dang / /mtsho ni brtsams pas rgyal gnod pa med/ /legs sbyar rang bzhin zur chag skad/ kha za'i skad de skad rigs bzhi/ /byed pa'i skyes bu —392—

rnams ni/ bdag sems can srog skye ba gso ba skyes bu gang zag shed las skyes shed bu byed pa po tshor ba po shes pa po mthong ba po slong ba po'o/ /nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad ni/ shar dang nub dang gangs rir gnas/ /'jig rten 'das par smra ba dang / /rtag par smra ba'i sde tshan ni/ /lnga tshan dge 'dun phal chen pa/ /gzhi kun pa dang 'od srung dang / /sa ston sde dang chos srung dang / /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang / /rnam par phye ste smra ba ni/ /thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde/ /rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs med ri/ /gcung chen gnas brtan sde ba'o/ /sa sgrog ri dang srung ba pa/ gnas ma bu'i sde rnams ni/ /kun gyi bkur pa rnam pa gsum/ /lha mi'i 'khor lo bzhi ni gang / /mthun pa'i yul na gang gnas pa/ /skyes bu dam pa la brten pa/ /bdag gi yang dag smon lam btab/ /sngon gyi bsod nams bsags pa'o/ /mgo gcig dang ni rnam phye dang / /dri dang bzhag pa lung bstan bzhi/ /dbang po gzugs can lnga po dang / /pho mo srog yid ces pa bzhi/ /bde dang yid bde sdug btang snyoms/ /yid mi bde ste tshor dbang lnga/ /dad sogs lnga dang kun shes dang / /kun shes byed dang kun shes ldan/ /de ltar dbang po nyer gnyis so/ /chos gsum ni/ bshad dang sgrub pa 'bras bu'i chos/ /dgongs ldems dgongs brgyad ni/ mnyam pa nyid dang don gzhan dang / /de bzhin du ni dus gzhan dang / /gang zag gi ni bsam pa la/ /dgongs pa rnam pa bzhir bshad do/ /gzhug pa ldem por dgongs pa dang / /mtshan nyid ldem por dgongs pa dang / /gnyen po ldem por dgongs pa dang / /bsgyur ba ldem por dgongs pa'o/ /brton pa bzhi ni/ tshig la mi brton —393—

don la brton/ gang zag la mi brton chos la brton/ rnam shes la mi brton ye shes la brton/ drang don la mi brton nges don la brton/ 'dus ma byas gsum de bzhin nyid/ /'dus ma byas pa rnam pa bzhi/ /rig gnas bco brgyad la/rol mo 'khrig thabs 'tsho tshes grangs/ /sgra dang gso spyad chos lugs bzo/ /'phongs dpyad gtan tshigs rnal 'byor thos/ /dran pa skad cig mig 'phrul dang / /sngon byung ba dang sngon rabs so/ /gzhan yang brtags pa bco brgyad dang / /rgyu rtsal drug cu la sogs yod/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga la/ nang rig pa/ gtan tshigs rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ gso ba rigs pa/ bzo rig pa'o/ /bzo dang gso ba sgra tshad nang don rig /bzo la lus bzo ngag bzo yid bzo gsum/ /gso bya gso byed ji ltar gso ba'i tshul/ /brda sprod rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gsum/ /mngon gyur lkog gyur shin tu lkog gyur gsum/ /nang rig sde snod gsum du grags shing grub/ /gnas rnams dang ni mtshan nyid dang / /chos don smos phyir mdo sde yin/ /mngon 'du'i phyir dang yang yang dang / /zil gnon rtogs phyir mngon pa'i chos/ /lhung dang 'byung dang ldang ba dang / /nges par 'byung dang gang zag dang / /bcas pa dang ni rab dbye dang / /rnam par nges phyir 'dul ba nyid/ khri/ gsum bzhi dang brgyad kyis ni/ /sde snod gsum du rnam par ba theg /bslab pa gsum ni/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims ting 'dzin dang / zhas rab ces bya bslab pa gsum/ /chos lnga ni/ ming dang mtshan ma rnam rtog dang / /de bzhin nyid dang mi rtog shes/ /chos sdom phyag rgya bzhi ni/ 'dus byas mi rtag /zag bcas sdug bsngal/ chos thams cad stong —394—

zhing bdag med/ mya ngan las 'das pa rab tu zhi ba'o/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi rmi ltas bco brgyad ni/ glang chen khron pa phye dang be'u dang / /kun dga' ra ba 'thab dang ras yug dang / /me tog rdze'u gsum tsan dan spyi cer dang / /rta khyi ba dang phyi dro rgas pa dang / seng ge spre'u rgyal mi gtsang skud pa'o/ /yang bcu ni/ glang ngan khron pa phyi dang tsan dan dang / mu tig be'u spre'u rgyal mi gtsang skud/ chom rkun ras yug bgo bsha' byed pa'o/ /dgod pa bzhi ni/ theg pa bden pa rigs dang chos la dgod/ rigs pa bzhi ni/ ltos pa dang ni bya ba byed/ /'thad pa sgrub dang chos nyid rigs/ /mngon shes myur bul dka' sla la/ /lam bzhir rnam par dbye bar bya/ /blo rtul mngon shes bul ba ste/ /gcig shos kyi ni mngon shes myur/ /slong dang ming dang khas 'che dang / /gsol bzhi'i las dang nyon mongs bral/ /dge slong lnga zhes brjod pa yin/ /'dod chags gnod sems rmugs gnyid 'gyod/ /rnam g.yeng the tshom zhes bya bdun/ /gnyis bzhi gcig rnams bslab gsum la/ /rim pa bzhin du sgrib pa yin/ /phyin ci log gi lta tshul min/ /yid byed bzhi ni/ mi gtsang la sogs bzhi po la/ /gtsang bdag bde dang rtag par 'dzin/ /rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad ni/ mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag /ltar snang bcas pa bdag rig byed/ /sgrub pa dang ni sun 'byin dang / /ltar snang bcas pa gzhan go byed/ /bslu ba'i bdud bzhi ni/ thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang / /theg chen nges par 'byung ba la/ /bslu byed bdud ni rnam pa bzhi/ /gzugs ni dbu ba rdos pa 'dra/ /tshor ba chu'i chu bur 'dra/ /'du shes smig sgyu lta bu ste/ /'du byed chu shing 'dra bar gsungs/ /rnam par shes pa —395—

sgyu ma 'dra/ /bsam gtan sa dgu ni/ bsam gtan dngos gzhi'i nyer sdogs tsam po dang / nyer sdogs mi lcogs med pa dang / bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi dang / /gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa'i nyer sdogs dang dngos gzhi'o/ /bstan bcos dgu ni/ don med don log don dang ldan/ /ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal sbongs/ /thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len pa/ /bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod/ /mdo sogs 'chad pa'i man ngag ni/ /dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang / /tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyor bcas/ /brgal lan bcas te bsnyad par byas/ /grub mtha' smra ba bzhi ni/ bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod dang dbu ma pa/ /bye brag smra ba ni/ nyi 'og kha che tho gar ba gsum mo/ /dbu ma pa ni/ rnal 'byor spyod dang mdo sde spyod/ /'jig rten grags sde spyod pa dang / /phyi mo'i dbu ma pa ste bzhi/ /mu stegs kyi grub mtha' las byung ba khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu ni/ nya dang rus sbal phag pa dang / /mi yi seṅge mi'u thung dang / /dga' byed rā ma dā ma dang/ /sangs rgyas ka snyi ta ste bcu/ /bye brag pa'i tshig don drug ni/ rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi/ /bye brag 'du ba rnam pa drug /rig byed bzhi ni/ nges brjod mchod sbyin snyan tshig dang / /srid bsrung zhes bya rig byed bzhi/ /bram ze'i las drug ni/ klog dang klog 'jug mchod spyin dang / /mchod sbyin byed 'jug spyin dang len/ khres bya nyer lnga ni/ bdag dang gtso bo blo nga rgyal/ /gzugs sogs de tsam lnga dang ni/ /sa chu me rlud mkha' dang mig /rna sna lce lpags rkang lag 'phongs/ /'doms dang ngag yid nyi shu lnga/ /mgu ba dgu ni/ chu dang chu rgyun chu po char/ /—396—

legs brgal g.yin min mig bzang dang / /'od can lus mchog mgu ba dgu/grub pa brgyad ni/ sgrol po legs sgrol sgrol mthar phyin/ /mgu gyur nyams dga' rab dga' dga'/ /mchog dga' zhes pa grub pa brgyad/ /nus pa nyer brgyad ni/ dbang po bcu gcig skyon can nus/ /mgu dang grub pa 'gal zla ni/ /mi dga' ma grub sogs bcu bdun/ /phyin ci log lnga ni/ mun rmongs rmongs chen shin tu mun/ /smag gyur phyin ci log lnga yin/ /mi mthong pa'i rgyu brgyad ni/ ha cang ring phyir nyer phyir dang / /dbang po nyams phyir yid med phyir/ /cha phra phyir dang sgrib phyir dang / /zil gnon phyir dang 'dres phyir ro/ /lta ba ngan pa drug cu rtsa gcig ni/ rtag par smra ba rnam bzhi dang / kha cig rtag par smra ba bzhi/ /mtha' yod sogs bzhi mi sbong bzhi/ /rgyu med gnyis ni sngon mthar rtog /'du shes yod smra bcu drug dang / /med smra brgyad dang de bzhin du/ /yod min med min smra ba brgyad/ /chad smra bdun dang tshe 'di la/ /mya ngan 'da' par smra ba brgyad/ /phyi ma'i mthar rtog lta ba'o/ gcer bu pa'i don dgu la/ srog dang gang zag sdom pa dang / /nges par rgas dang 'ching pa dang / /las dang sdig dang bsod nams dang / /thar ba zhes bya don dgu po/ /'byung lnga dus phyogs bdag yid ni/ /rdzas dgur bye brag pa rnams 'dod/ /rig pa can pa'i tshig don bcu drug ni/ tshad ma gzhal bya the tshom dgos pa dpe/ /grub mtha' cha shas rtog ge gtan la dbab/ /brjod pa rtsod pa sun 'byin rgyu ltar snang / /tshig don ltag chod tshar gcod gnas rnams so/ /dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad ni/ phra yang mchod 'os bdag por gyur/ /dbang gyur gar phyin 'dod dgur bsgyur/ /—397—

dga' mgur gnas pa dbang phyug brgyad/ /lha bzhi ni/ tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug ste/ /bzhi pa ni ra dzñā na'o/ /da ni g.yin yang / sangs rgyas dkon mchog ni/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ /g.yin gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ /don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /chos ni/ bsam med gnyis med rtog med pa/ /dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs dag gi /gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba/ /bden gnyis mtshan nyid can te chos/ /dge 'dun ni/ ji lta ji snyed nang gi ni/ /ye shes gzigs pa thob bya'i phyir/ /blo ldan phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ /bla med yon tan dang ldan nyid/ /theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la/ /mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas/ /skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ /byang sems kyi sprul pa bcu ni/sems can lus zhing mchod dbyangs spyod/ /smon smin gdul ba byang chub chos/ /byin rlabs zhes bya sprul pa bcu/ /byang sems rgyu mthun bcu ni/ byang sems dge bshes phar phyin chos dang smin nam spyod/ 〈'dir nor po yod par 'dra bsadapyad dgos so/ /yig ga kha pa'i spo 〉sems pa mchod pa de bzhin gshegs/ /byang sems ngo mtshar 'du shes bcu ni/ dge dang sa bon snod 'du shes/ /chos kun la ni 'gyung pa dang / /chos la sangs rgyas chos 'du shes/ /rgyal la pha dang gnyis med du/ /'du shes dang ni de gnas gsum/ /smon nam sbyong pa tshig kun la/ /smon med la sogs rnam pa gsum/ /yongs smin bcu ni/ spyin gzugs chos ston skal mnyam dang / /gnas med spyod pa rdzu 'phrul dang / /sangs rgyas ched brjod zhing rnams kyis/ /sems can khems yongs smin par byed/ /byang —398—

chub sems dpa'i byang chub kyi 'jug pa bcu ni/ smon lam spyod pa yang dag sgrub/ /mos pa tha dad zhing gi rgyan/ /rnam 'phrul skye ba bstan la 'jug/ dbang bsgyur bcu ni/ lha mi gzugs stobs 'khor 'dod rgyal srid dang / /dbang phyug yon tan shes rab dbang bskyur bcu/ /sangs rgyas chos las sems can dang / /spyod pa smon lam spyod yul dus/ /dge ba ye shes byin rlabs bcu/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la tshad med pa bcu ni/ mkha' dbyings chos dbyings sems can ltar/ /las ltar mos ltar nyon mongs ltar/ /sgra dbyangs thams cad pa lta bu/ /ye shes dus gsum tshad med ltar/ /sangs rgyas yul ltar tshad med bcu/ /mnyam nyid bcu ni/ sems can chos dang sangs rgyas zhing / /lhag bsam dge rtsa byang sems dpa'/ /smon lam phar phyin spyod sangs rgyas/ /mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba yin/ /byang sems kyi dga' ba bcu ni/ dran dang shes rab rtogs dang blo/ /rnam 'phrul ting 'dzin gzungs spobs pa/ /byang chub chos 'khor bskor ba yi/ /dga' ba bcu zhes brjod pa yin/ /mdo sde blta bar gyis shig dang / /'di sogs mtha' mu tshad med gsungs/ /sangs rgyas bcu dang sems can bcu/ /byang chub snying rje bcu drug dang / /'phrin las so gnyis la sogs pa/ /mangs kyi dogs pas re zhig bzhag /rgyan bzhi ni/ tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab gzungs kyi brgyan/ /snang ba brgyad ni/ dran pa blo gros rtogs chos shes pa dang / /bden pa mngon shes sgrub pa'i snang ba brgyad/ /re re'i dbye ba dpag tu med pa dag /gzungs dbang gis zhus mdo sde nyid du ltos/ /rgyan bzhi snang brgyad snying rje bcu drug dang / /'phrin las so gnyis —399—

yongs sbyong drug cu yin/ /g.yin yang phal po che sa bcu pa dang / chos yang dag par sdud pa sogs cis kyang ltos shig dang blo gros mi zad par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i gnas bdun ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang / /yon tan sangs rgyas 'phrin las tha ma ste/ /bstan bcos kun gyi lus ni mdor bstan na/ /rdo rje'i yi ni gnas bdun 'di dag go /da ni gsang sngags las byung ba ci rigs pa la/ dkyil 'khor ra ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang / /stang stabs 'dug stangs bzlas brjod dang / /sbyin bsreg mchod pa las sbyor dang / /slar sdud pa yi rnam pa ni/ /phyi'i de nyid bcu yin no/ /phyir zlog gnyis kyi cho ga dang / /gsang ba shes rab ye shes dang / kha sbyor dbye ba'i cho ga dang / /gtor ma rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / /drag shul sgrub pa'i cho ga dang / /rab tu gnas dang dkyil 'khor sgrub/ /gsang ba'i de nyid bcu yin no/ /rgyud sde gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi/ /lnga dang drug tu 'dod pa yin/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /bya rgyud drug ni/ de bzhin gshegs dang pad+ma dang / /rdo rje nor bu lnga brtsen dang / /'jig rten phal ba'i rigs te drug /spyod rgyud sku gsung thugs rigs gsum/ /de bzhin gshe/gas rigs de bzhin gshegs/ /khro bo 'gro 'dul don grub ste/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la rigs lnga'o/ /gnyis med bla na med pa la/ /thabs shes pha ma rnal 'byor dang / /rnal 'byor ma rgyud rnam pa bzhi/ /rigs lnga'am 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /gti mug gi ni rgyud gsum po/ /thabs rgyud kyi ni dbye ba yin/ /rdor sems rnam snang he ru ka /rdo rje nyi ma gar dbang phyug /rta mchog ces bya ma rgyud drug /rnal 'byor —400—

bzhi ni/ rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang / khren tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byorache/ /bsnyen pa nyer sgrub sgrub pa dang / /sgrub chen bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi/ /dang po sbyor dang dkyil rgyal mchog /las rgyal mchog ste rang bzhin gsum/ /spyan drangs bzhugs dang gshegs su gsol/ /las/ gsum du ni brjod pa yin/ /rdzas dang lus dang longs spyod ni/ /rig pa 'dzin pa gsum du brjod/ /dam tshig bzlas pa sbyin pa dang / /'chad byed man ngag ston pa dang / /dbang bskur pa dang las byed pa/ /slob dpon drug tu brjod pa yin/ /sa 'og steng 'gro ral gri dang / /tshar gcod phan 'dogs nyid dang ni/ /ril bu mig sman gter dang ni/ /rkang mgyogs dang ni bcud kyi len/ /dngos grub dgu ru bshad pa yin/ /bzhi pa bor ba grub chen brgyad/ /gzhan du gnod spyin mo yang bgrangs/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku yan lag bdun ni/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med/ /ro myang brgyad ni/ rtas// pa dang ni mi gdung dang / /bsil ba dang ni gcig pa dang / /bde ba dang ni dri med dang / /dga' ba dang ni yid dang ba/ /dbang phyug brgyad ni/ sku yi dbang phyug dang ni gsung gi dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi rnga / bang phyug dang / /rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas kyi dbang phyug dang / ci 'dod byed dang yon to brgyad pa'o/ /'dus pa'i rim lnga ni/ sngags dang sems dang lus dang ni/ /rnam dag dang ni zung 'jug ste/ /rim pa lnga yi bsdus pa'i don/ /lus dben ngag dben sems dben dang / /sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug go /sgom pa'i thig le bzhi ni/ snying kha nor bu sprul pa —40 —

dang / /mi shigs thig le rnam bzhi'o/ /ma rgyud kyi rdzogs rim gsum ni/ rang byin brlabs dang dkyil 'khor dang / /bsam mi khyab ces bya ba rnam gsum yin/ /sngags dang dbyibs dang chos bdag nyid/ /sbyor ba rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /bde dgyes kyi rim pa bzhi ni/ rgyud sngags ye shes gsang rim bzhi/ /bde mchog rim lnga ni/ bdag byin brlabs dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /nor bu 'gengs dang 'bar 'dzeg bsam mi khyab/ /sgyu drwa nyi shu rnam lnga dang / /skad cig mngon rdzogs byang chub bzhi/ /e waX ma ya yi ge bzhi'o/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje dmangs bzhi/ /blta rgod lag bcings gnyis sprod bzhi/ /sad rmi gnyid stug bzhi pa ni/ /gnas skabs bzhi zhes bya ba yin/ /'dus ma byas bcas rnam thar bzhi/ /skad cig ma bzhi ni/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang /rnam par smin pa dang / rnam par nyed pa dang / mtshan nyid dang bral ba'o/ /dga' ba bzhi ni/ dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba dang / khyad par gyi dga' ba dang / lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /gdan bzhi ni/ bdag gzhan sbyor dang gsang ba'o/ /de nyid bzhi ni/ bdag sngags lha dang ye shes ni/ /de kho na nyid bzhi ru 'dod/ /rgyud bshad rgyan ni rnam pa bdun/ /bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang / /de nyid rnam pa bcu drug yin/ /dbyug gu drug cu bzhi dang ni/ /dam pa'i rigs ni brgya dag las/ /mtha' yas rigs rnams 'phel ba yin/ /zhes pa slob ma la phan pa zhes bya ba rnam grangs kyi mdo ste/ las dang po pa kun dang / khyad par sde snod rgya chen po dag nyan par mi nus par sngags la 'jug pa dag la phan pa'i phyir dang / blo gsal mos ldan kun dga' chos —402—
pa nags rgyal gyi dben gnas jo mo nang du sbyar

gnad kyi gsal byed bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ 'gro ba'i blo mun sel mdzad pa/ /'jam dbyangs zhabs kyi pa khror 'dud/ /dogs sel dri ba'i 'phreng ba la/ /rang dang rjes mthun lan tsam brjod/ /dri ba dang po/ dpal kyi rdo rje'i dbang gi sngags sdom thob la ma nyams pa'i gang zag gis/ 'khor lo bde mchog lta bu'i dbang thob pa'i tshe/ sngags sdom gsar du thob rgyu ji ltar yod/ /ces pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ de'i tshe gsar thob ni yod de/ sngar bla med kyi sdom ldan la/ slob dpon gyis dbang bskur byas sam/ sdom ldan rang nyid kyis dbang blangs kyang rung ste/ sngar gyi sngags sdom gyi rgyun de nyid dbang bskur re re thob pa la brten nas/ lhag par 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir na/ ci tsam 'phel ba'i cha de/ de dang de las gsar du thob par 'gyur la/ 'phel ba de yang rgyun mi chad par 'jug go /'on kyang gang thob bya dbang gi ngo bo rigs mthun phyin chad du/ sdom par rigs mi 'dra med cing / dbang phyi ma phyi ma thob pa rnams la yang / snga ma'i sdom pa'i rgyun de nyid bzung zhing rgya che bar song ba ma gtogs/ sdom pa rigs 'dra zhing / ngo bo tha dad pa 'jug pa'ang med pas/ sdom pa dngos gzhi yongs rdzogs gsar thob ni med do/ /skabs 'dir 'di ltar shes dgos te/ dbang dang po de la ma smin pa smin par byed pa zhes bya zhing / phyi ma rnams la yang rang rang gi ngo —404—

skal gyi sngar ma smin pa smin par byas pa'i cha shas re yod mod kyang / smin tshul de tsam zhig ni sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du rtag tu 'byung bas/ phyi ma rnams la ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i tha snyad mi sbyor ro/ /yang sam pu ṭa'i rgyud phyi ma nas/ rig pa'i dbang gi skabs su gos kyi dbang zhes pa lhag por gsungs pa dang / mi g.yo ba bla med las ral gri zhags pa'i dbang sogs bshad pa dang /dus 'khor las dar dpyangs kyi dbang logs su gsungs shing / chu dbang sogs g.yin rnams kyang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed spyi dang mi 'dra bar gsungs pa rnams la yang / phan tshun gcig gis gcig dod thub pa yin pas/ cho ga'i rnam grangs mi 'dra ba tsam dang / rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par tsam ma gtogs/ gtso bo'i don la mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de dag so so las thob pa'i sdom pa rnams kyang ngo bo gcig tu 'gyur bar shes par bya zhing / dus kyi 'khor lo rang lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la ni/ sdom pa'i rim pa gsar 'thob yod par shes dgos te/ slob dpon chen po'i gnas 'thob par byed pa'i dbang yin par yang yang bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dbang de ni ma thob kyang / dbang bcu gcig po thob pa'i slob dpon gyis/ slob ma la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba dang rgyud bshad pa'i tshe/ dbang dang rgyud bshad rnam dag gi go mi chod pa ni ma yin te/ dbang bzhi pa'i bar gyi mthar thug pa'i dbang rgyun yod pa'i phyir na/ rgyud sde gzhan gyi rigs 'grer rung bas so/ /'on kyang rgyud de nyid kyi lugs la/ de bzhin gshegs pas bkag pa las 'das pa'i nyes pa dang / slob dpon gyis bkas ma gnang ba'i nyes pa gnyis slob dpon rang la 'byung zhing / dbang de —405—

nyid kyi rgyun chad pa dang / de chad pas rgyud sde de'i dbang yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i nyes par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du kyi rdo rje'i dbang kho na thob pas 'dus pa dang bde mchog la sogs pa yang sgom du rung ba tsam ni yin zhing / 'on kyang so so'i bka' ma thob na/ slob dpon gyi bkas ma gnang ba'i nyes pa yod pas byin rlabs kyi sgo chung ba yin no/ /'o na dkyil 'khor gcig tu dbang thob pa kho nas sngags sdom dang ldan pa de la/ slob dpon gyis 'di sgoms shig ces pa'i tshig tsam gyis sgrub thabs man ngag gzhan thams cad la gnang ba byin pas chog gam snyam na/ de ltar mi chog ste/ de lta bu'i gnang ba sbyin pa de la'ang /sangs rgyas nas slob dpon gyi bar du gnang ba sbyin pa rgyun ma chad par dgos la/ gnang ba ster tshul ni ma nges te/ cho ga'i tshul gyis ster ba dang / lung 'bogs pa dang / glegs bam bklag pa la sogs pas kyang rung mod/ de yang lag len gyi rgyun ma chad pa'i srol de nyid bzang ba yin no/ /des na/ theg pa bla na med pa'i dbang bskur ba rdzogs pa gcig thob pa phyin chad/ dkyil 'khor de nyid dam dkyil 'khor g.yin gyi yang rung ste/ dbang bskur ba ci tsam mang ba de tsam bzang la/ yang so so mtha' dag la dbang bskur kho na thob mi dgos par/ tha dad kyi byin brlabs dang rjes gnang sogs thob pas kyang de dang de sgom du rung zhing / ci nas kyang slob dpon la bka' de 'dra ba re ni thob par byed pa lag len rnam dag gi rgyun la 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin no// //dri ba gnyis pa/ dbang gsum pa'i ye shes las gzhan pa'i/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes ji ltar yod/ ces pa ste/ de la brjod pa/ re zhig dbang bzhi pa'i —406—

ye shes ni/ dbang gsum pa'i ye shes las ngo bo shin tu tha dad pa yin no zhes dam 'cha' dgos/ de'i don cung zad tsam brjod na/ spyir 'phags pa'i yul gyi rdo rje 'dzin pa 'gangs chen po rnams la yang bzhed pa mi 'dra ba du ma yod par yang bshad/ mi 'dra ba ci rigs pa so sos mdzad pa'i gsung rab rnams la dngos su yang snang / de la rdo rje slob dpon rgyud gzhung mang po la mkhas shing /nus mthu dang byin rlabs kyi gzi byin chen po mnga' ba rnams la rgya gar gyi yul du slob dpon chen por brtsi ba 'dug /ngo mtshar yang shin tu che ba lags mod/'on kyang de tsam gyis rdzogs rim gyi nges don mthar thug rtogs pa'i khyab pa rang yang med cing / de rtogs su chug kyang gdul bya'i blo ngo la ltos nas drang don tsam gsung ba yang srid/ nges don nyid gsung du chug kyang / de ngo sprod pa'i thabs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'byung srid pas/ lugs tha dad pa de rnams la'ang gcig tu tshad ldan no zhe bzhag par dka' mod/ mtha' gcig tu nor ro zhes kyang dgag par dka' bas/ re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag cing / mchog tu tshad ldan du gyur pa sems 'grel skor gsum yin la/ gzhan yang bram ze chen po'i do ha dang / rim lnga/ zhal lung sogs kyi dgongs pa dang bstun na/ bzhi pa'i ye shes ni/ don dam pa'i ye shes rang bzhin lhan skyes zhes bya ba de yin la/ gsum pa'i ye shes ni/ zhu bde lhan skyes kun rdzob dpe'i ye shes so/ /de yang sems 'grel skor gsum nas/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po dang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zung du 'jug pa la bzhi pa mtshan nyid par bshad pa dang / bram ze chen pos kyang / grogs dag zab mo dang ni rgya che ba —407—

g.yin med bdag nyid ma yin no/ /lhan cig skyes dga' bzhi pa'i dus/ /gnyug ma nyams su myong bas shes/ /zhes dang / de ltar yin te de ni ma yin no/ /zhes sogs dang / gzhan yang mang du gsungs shing / rim lnga spyod bsdus sogs kyi dgongs pa'ang / bzhi pa mtshan nyid pa ni/ sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'ju ga la bzhed cing / zhal lung grol thig gnyis las kyang / zab gsal dbyer med la 'chad la/ sbyor ba bdun pa'i gzhung rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang / bzhi pa'i ye shes kha sbyor yan lag bdun du bshad pas/ de rnams dgongs pa gcig ste/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs dang / sgyu lus dang / gsal ba dang / kha sbyor dang bcas pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa rnams don gcig cing / mi 'gyur bde chen dang / 'od gsal dang / zab pa dang /rang bzhin med pa dang bcas pa'i bde ba'i yan lag rnams don gcig pas so/ /des na dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ni/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i bde ba dang / stong pa dang / dkyil 'khor gsum zung du 'jug pa gcig yin la/ de'i khyad par yang / bde ba ni sems nyid bde ba dang / de'i rten thig le 'gyur ba med pa gnyis yin zhing / de yang ji srid rdul phra rab kyi tshogs par snang ba yod phyin chad mi 'gyur ba ma yin pas/ de 'gags nas ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa na/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde bar 'jog cing / bde ba chen por lhag par rigs pa yod kyang / gzung 'dzin gnyis snang 'gags pa ni de'i stong pa yin la/ bde ba de nyid dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i 'khor 'das kyi rnam pa thams cad dang mtshungs pa'i snang char 'char ba ni dkyil 'khor yin no/ /de ni —408—

rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor las 'thob par 'gyur zhing / thob tshul yang sems kyi chos nyid dam/ rang bzhin bde stong gsal ba zung du 'jug par gnas pa de lam gyi stobs kyis dri ma bsal nas mngon du gyur pa yin la/ de yang gdod nas lhun rdzogs su grub pa la/ dri ma tsam bsal bar 'dod pa dang /dang po rigs sam sa bon gyi tshul du gnas pa/ phyis dri ma'ang bsal zhing / ngo bo'ang 'phel rgyas su 'dod pa ni/ rang rang gi grub mtha'i dbang las gang la sbyar kyang 'grig la/ spyir de gnyis ji ltar 'thad logs su gtan la dbabs dgos mod/ 'dir skabs kyi don ma yin pas bzhag go /las dang po pa la bzhi pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ de dus bzhi pa'i ye shes mi skye yang / de'i lam nyan pa dang / sgom du rung bar byed cing / phyis ye shes de skye ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig byed yin pas/ tshig dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i brdar gzhag pa yin no/ /gsum pa'i ye shes la ni/ 'dod tshul mi 'dra bar che ba med mod kyi/ ngo bo ni/ las sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten pa gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya rtsol dang rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las/ byung ba'i glo bur ba'i shes pa yin no/ /des na 'jig med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhal snga nas/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes de nyid bzhi pa'i myu gur gyur pa zhes gsungs pa yang / de sgom pas bzhi ba 'thob par 'gyur ba tsam la dgongs pa yin na snga ma rnams dang mthun pas legs la/ gsum pa'i rigs rgyun de nyid bzhi par 'gyur ro zhes dgongs na ni nges don gyi grub mtha' min no/ /de bzhin du lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs zhes grags pa yang / bzhi pa rtogs pa'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa la bzhi —4()()—

pa'i lam du brtags pa yin na legs por 'gyur zhing / bod sgom phal che ba gnas lugs phyag rgya chen por grags pa bzhi pa'i ye shes su 'dod pa ni/ bzhi pa'i ma.ā+oṃ nyid kyi zur gyi stong pa'i rigs tsam du 'gro ba srid kyang / bzhi pa'i bde ba dang gsal ba ma tshang bas bzhi ba dngos su ni mi 'gyur ro/ /'o na stong pa de dang gtum mo'am las rgya'i bde ba dang / sgom bzlas kyi lha sku rnams kyang rig pa skad cig ma gcig la dus mnyam du tshogs na bzhi par 'gyur ba ma yin nam zhe na/ de dag bzhi pa'i ye shes kyi brgyud pa'i rgyu tshogs su ni cis kyang 'gyur ba'i skabs yod mod/ bskyed rim gyi ltas tu lhas ka don dam gyi lha sku'i go mi chod cing / las rgya'i bde ba tsam sa kyang phyag chen gyi bde ba'i go mi chod do/ /des na gang dag sems gsal la ngos bzung med pa bzhug thabs bde ba tsam zhig 'dug pa la/ rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yin du re ste/ rig pa skad cig snga phyi gang la yang rnam pa mi 'dra ba med pas mi 'gyur ba dang / gnas pa'am 'gyu ba gang la yang bya thabs bde bas/ bde ba'o snyam du bsam zhing / ci yang ma yin pa'i sems kyi snang cha/ snang ba thams cad la 'char rung tsam 'di ka rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po yin du re ste/ rang bzhin thabs cir yang ma grub pas stong pa/ snang ba cir yang 'char bas rnam kun mchog ldan gyi gzugs so zhes sems pa de dag ni/ mdo sngags thun mong gi lta ba'i gnas la nges shes ma nor ba tsam yin du chug kyang /bzhi par 'dod pa de ni/ rgyud sde'i nges gsang las shin tu phyir phyogs pa yin cing / de dang des de dag gi go chod pa yang ma yin pas gnas lugs phyag rgya —410—

chen po tsam bzhi par mi 'gyur ro/ /des na sgom chen pa byings dmangs kyi 'dod pa ltar/ lta ba tsam la bzhi par 'dod pa de yang min/ sngon gyi sngags pa 'ga' zhig 'dod pa ltar/ kun rdzob kyi bde ba'i khyad par gcig tsam mam/ de la mi rtog pa'am/ stong nyid mos sgom tsam gyis rgyas 'debs byed pa la bzhi pa dngos su 'dod pa de yang min/ bod phyis byung 'ga' zhig 'dod pa ltar kun rdzob kyi bde ba dang / rjes dpag gis rtogs pa'i stong nyid dang / 'byung lus kyi lha sku gsum ngo bo tha dad dus gcig tu 'dzom pa zhig la 'dod pa ltar ni ga la zhig ste/ mdor na gong du bstan zin kyang slar yang gsal bar brjod pa ni/rdzogs rim sna tshogs pa'i rkyen gyis rlung sems dbu mar 'gags pa'i zhu bde khyad par can thob/ de nas de ring du goms pas gtum mo 'bar ba dang sems nyid dbyer med du 'dres pas/ de nyid sgyu lus kyi dkyil 'khor ram/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba der mngon du 'gyur/ de dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i rjes chags kyi rkyen zhig las/ thog mar 'dzag med kyi zhu bde re 'byung zhing / zhu bde'i rten thig le re yod pa de yang / zhu bde shar ba'i skad cig ma gnyis pa der/ 'byung lus su snang ba dag ste/ gong du bshad pa'i stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po der gyur pa na/ brten pa sems bde ba de yang mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zhes bya bar gyur zhing / des na bzhi pa'i ye shes kyi gsal ba dang bde ba de 'dra zhig yin la/ de'i dus na lus thig le la sogs pa gnas gyur gyi stong gzugs de yang sems nyid bde ba de dang ngo bo gcig pa ni/ sku dang ye shes zung 'jug gi char gtogs pa yin na/ de lta bu'i zung 'jug —411—
